"I'd better get back to it. As for you, I think you're best suited for the front lines, fighting the battles we can't."

title: Casualties of War
speaker: Devrim Kay
text:
"The Red Legion hit us hard," Devrim says, glancing out his window at the warring Cabal and Fallen outside the church. "Where we were most vulnerable. We lost many people, Guardians and civilians alike."



He turns to face you again, managing a smile. "But we can do more than just honor the memory of the people we lost. We can help those who still remain. The safer these areas are, the easier it is for Hawthorne and her people to help refugees find their way to the City. Perhaps you can help with that."

title: Ascendant Lens
speaker: Darbi 55-30
text:
Queen Mara's eyebrows lift as you hand her the Ascendant Lens. "This is an exceedingly rare trinket," she says, peering at you through the lens.



"It may not look like much to a common Guardian, but in the hands of our Techeuns, it will be a valuable research tool. You were right to bring it to me."



"Allow me to repay your generosity," she says, handing you a handsome reward.



You start to thank her, but she's already walking away. You've been dismissed.

title: A Spark of Hope
speaker: Devrim Kay
text:
"I met Cayde enough times to know a thing or two about his codenames for things. Cosmonaut Club…"



Devrim scratches his beard and stares out the window of the steeple.



"I'd bet the pot he's referring to the Cosmodrome. Must have been spooked by something and decided to relocate the package there."



"You're probably best off checking the interior of the Cosmodrome wall; that's the only place he could reliably hide something from the Fallen in Old Russia."



"Good luck, Guardian. Don't forget a coat. It gets a bit nippy in Siberia this time of year."

title: Armament Protocol
speaker: Devrim Kay
text:
Devrim greets you with a stern, but familiar nod. 



"Got it done just in time, Guardian. The fight's far from over, but with you in it, I'd wager we've got a chance."

title: Armament Protocol
speaker: Devrim Kay
text:
"Welcome to Call to Arms, Guardian. Gather the best gear you can and put it to the test. "



"I'll have new shipments of the latest gear every day here at the Tower. If you're on the hunt for something specific, my scouts can help you find that special weapon you're looking for."

title: Dawning's Gift: Devrim
speaker: Devrim Kay
text: Devrim raises an eyebrow at the gift, but his gratitude seems genuine. He does not take a sip, however.

title: Devrim Kay
speaker: Devrim Kay
text:
Devrim has heard of your victory over Ghaul in the City, and wishes to congratulate you. Speak with him in Trostland.




        Devrim congratulates you on your victory over Ghaul.



While the head of the Red Legion has been slain, the Red War continues across the solar system.

title: Clarion Call: EDZ
speaker: Devrim Kay
text:
Hey Guardian,




        Now I know why they call it the European Dead Zone. You killed everything!

title: Devrim Kay
speaker: Devrim Kay
text:
With the Vanguard back together, more adventures await in the EDZ. Speak with Devrim in Trostland to learn more.




        Devrim describes the new challenges you'll face in the wilds of the European Dead Zone



Explore the area for new adventures to complete.

title: Devrim Kay
speaker: Devrim Kay
text:
Devrim is grateful for your many successful adventures in the EDZ. Speak with him in Trostland.




        Devrim thanks you for the work you've done in securing the EDZ.



New challenges appear on the horizon, however.

title: Clarion Call: EDZ
speaker: Devrim Kay
text: Now I know why they call it the European Dead Zone. You killed everything!

title: Devrim Kay
speaker: Devrim Kay
text:
Devrim Kay is no stranger to loss. But the wise know that death never gets easier. Go check in on Devrim to see how he's doing in the wake of Cayde's death.




        If you ever want to talk, or even just keep an old man company for a bit, Devrim will always be there with a warm cup of tea.

title: Devrim Kay
speaker: Devrim Kay
text:
The communication network is in place, but a nearby Cabal outpost has been jamming all outbound signals. Hawthorne needs to get her message out to the survivors. 



Take Devrim's signal booster and help Hawthorne by completing mission "Combustion."

title: Dawning Delivery
speaker: Devrim Kay
text: Devrim is polite as always in his gratitude and waits for you to depart before returning his attention to the window.

title: Discover the EDZ
speaker: Devrim Kay
text:
"Ahh, Guardian. Welcome to the EDZ. I can always use your help to keep the local riffraff in check. From the Outskirts to the Gulch, we've got plenty of nasties roaming these hills. And don't get me started on the Cabal's Firebase."



Devrim Kay offers EDZ bounties, pursuits, and various rewards to Guardians who fight to reclaim the EDZ.



Help Devrim by completing the EDZ adventure, "A New Frontier." Then, complete his other challenges to earn a new reward.

title: Discover the EDZ
speaker: Devrim Kay
text:
"Ahh, Guardian. Welcome to the EDZ. I can always use your help to keep the local riffraff in check. From the Outskirts to the Gulch, we've got plenty of nasties roaming these hills. And don't get me started on the Cabal's Firebase."



Devrim Kay offers EDZ bounties, quests, and various rewards to Guardians who fight to reclaim the EDZ.



Help Devrim by completing the EDZ adventure, "A New Frontier." Then, complete his other challenges to earn a new reward.

title: Earth Reclaimed
speaker: Devrim Kay
text:
Devrim nods approvingly at your scratched and spattered armor.



"I've been watching you battle back Maya's forces. Impressive stuff. With a sustained effort like that, we may even be able to resettle the Plaguelands someday."



His optimistic tone becomes tempered by years of war fatigue.



"But I still don't think we've gotten to the bottom of Maya's ambitions in the region. Keep working with Caiatl's Psions to learn what her endgame is with all this Golden Age tech."



The sniper gives you a jaunty salute. "Keep up the good work, Guardian."

title: EDZ Challenges
speaker: Devrim Kay
text: The EDZ remains as hotly contested as ever, but today you've done your part.

title: Devrim Kay
speaker: Devrim Kay
text:
Devrim has noticed your efforts in the European Dead Zone and wishes to speak with you.




        Devrim thanks you for the significant progress you've made in the EDZ.



Continue your adventures on the planet to earn his appreciation and rewards.

title: Earth Reclaimed
speaker: Devrim Kay
text:
Devrim waves you over with a fire in his eyes.



"Maya's attack on the Tower started a new gold rush across Sol. She's losing control of her collective and needs the latent power from Golden Age tech to maintain it."



Devrim gives your loadout a quick up-and-down, nodding in approval.



"We need to beat her forces to that tech and reclaim lost territories while you're there. We'll be inserting you into some former quarantine zones, so be ready for anything."

title: Enhance!
speaker: Devrim Kay
text:
The Fallen stole technology from the Cabal and were using it to make enhanced Ether. Now that they can't make any more, it's time to find any remaining caches of the stuff and destroy them. 



Seek out caches of enhanced Fallen Ether on EDZ and destroy them.

title: Enhance!
speaker: Devrim Kay
text: The Fallen stole technology from the Cabal and were using it to make enhanced Ether. Now that they can't make any more, it's time to find any remaining caches of enhanced Ether and destroy them.

title: Faction Reward
speaker: Devrim Kay
text: Your reputation in the EDZ precedes you. Take this reward in recognition of your deeds.

title: Enhance!
speaker: Devrim Kay
text:
Devrim has a strange tale to tell of the Fallen.




        Oh, Guardian, while you're here… The Fallen are up to something nearby, and it might be worth your time to investigate.

title: Faction Reward
speaker: Devrim Kay
text: Your reputation in the Crucible precedes you. Take this reward in recognition of your deeds.

title: Faction Reward
speaker: Devrim Kay
text: Complete patrols and public events in the EDZ to get EDZ tokens, and earn Level 20 rewards from Devrim Kay.

title: Faction Reward
speaker: Devrim Kay
text: Complete patrols and public events in the EDZ to get Dusklight Crystals and earn rewards from Devrim Kay.

title: Foregone Conclusions
speaker: Devrim Kay
text:
Devrim turns from his sniper post, lowering his gun to take the gift you offer. "Thank you," he says, examining it. "Marc does send me care packages sometimes. But it's difficult to get them here. The Fallen activity is quite persistent, and I've been out of ammo for ages."



He glances up. "I like the gifts he sends, but the notes are the real treat. I re-read them sometimes, when it's quiet."

title: Foregone Conclusions
speaker: Devrim Kay
text:
"Stellar job, as always," Devrim says when you return. "I greatly appreciate it."



He glances out his lookout window, and then back at you. "The Festival of the Lost is an important tradition for the people of the City. Our struggles have made us very resilient, very determined to remember the past and to look forward, hopefully, to the future. Guardians like yourself participating in that tradition is important to us." He nods. "Anyway. Here's a little something for your efforts, hm?"

title: Increase Reputation
speaker: Devrim Kay
text: Show Devrim Kay proof of your deeds in the EDZ.

title: FLASHPOINT: EDZ
speaker: Devrim Kay
text:
Complete various activities around the EDZ, including public events, Lost Sectors, and Heroic adventures.




        Complete various activities around the EDZ, including public events, Lost Sectors, and Heroic adventures.

title: The Last Hurrah
speaker: Devrim Kay
text: Devrim pats you on the back. "Thanks for helping the Last City during the Call to Arms, Guardian. You've helped us fortify our arsenal, and that has not gone unnoticed. Celebrate and collect your rewards!"

title: The Last Hurrah
speaker: Devrim Kay
text:
Devrim chuckles, "The Call to Arms was answered. You can relax now, Guardian." 



"Please, take the time to celebrate this week. Attune your weapons and gather daily shipments while you can. I hear there's some extra goods around for you, too."



He shrugs, then sighs. "I have to return to the EDZ after packing all this gear. Don't be a stranger in the meantime."

title: The Last Hurrah
speaker: Devrim Kay
text:
Devrim nods your way. "That was the last rally horn and the Call to Arms has quieted. You did good, Guardian." 



"Well, there's plenty to enjoy as Celebration Week marches ahead. Take advantage of attuning your weapons and gathering Daily Shipments for the rest of the week. Who knows, there might be a little bonus for you, too."



He motions behind him. "I'll need to pack the gear and head back to the EDZ soon. Enjoy while it lasts, Guardian!"

title: Reach Level 20
speaker: Devrim Kay
text: Increase your level to claim these rewards.

title: The Red War
speaker: Devrim Kay
text:
Hi again




        The communication network is in place, but a nearby Cabal outpost has been jamming all outbound signals. Hawthorne needs to get her message out to the survivors. 



Take Devrim's signal booster and help Hawthorne by completing mission "Combustion."

title: The Red War
speaker: Devrim Kay
text:
Devrim has been working to set up a regional communication network to let the scattered people of the City know they can find safety and community on the Farm. But the Fallen are not making that task easy. 



Learn more about the EDZ by completing adventure "A New Frontier."

title: The Red War
speaker: Devrim Kay
text:
The communication network is in place, but a nearby Cabal outpost has been jamming all outbound signals. Hawthorne needs to get her message out to the survivors. 



Take Devrim's signal booster and help Hawthorne by completing mission "Combustion."

title: Unnamed Interaction
speaker: Devrim Kay
text:
Hey Guardian,




        Now I know why they call it the European Dead Zone. You killed everything!

title: Visit Devrim Kay
speaker: Devrim Kay
text:
"Hello again, Guardian. Getting a feel for the old place? There's constant trouble nipping at our heels out here… They don't call it the European Dead Zone for nothing."



As you continue to explore the EDZ, you'll earn XP and rewards for completing adventures, Lost Sectors, public events, world quests, and EDZ bounties.

title: Where in the EDZ Is Archie?
speaker: Devrim Kay
text: "Ah yes, Archie came through not too long ago. What a good lad. He kept watch while I brewed some tea, then darted away claiming to have seen a bird made of light… and I think he took my favorite mug, the little scamp."

title: The Red War
speaker: Devrim Kay
text:
Hi




        Devrim has been working to set up a regional communication network to let the scattered people of the City know they can find safety and community on the Farm. But the Fallen are not making that task easy. 



Learn more about the EDZ by completing adventure "A New Frontier."

title: A Death of Nightmares
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
It is possible you've done a terrible thing in caging such power. But terrible things have forced your hand. Unleash your fury across the system, until all who consider themselves the fever dreams of our eternal torment understand. You, when pushed, are the only nightmare worth fearing.



You have crafted a weapon of corruption and doom, powered by the stolen might of the Hive's wicked Song.



Unleash its fury upon your enemies. Become death.

title: A Rising Tide
speaker: Donations Chest
text:
Collect Captain's Coins from Ketchcrash and Expedition activities, destination chests, Lost Sectors, public events, Dares of Eternity, and the "King's Fall" raid.



Donate the Captain's Coins here at the Donations Chest to help Mithrax and Spider improve the Eliksni Quarter.

title: A Persistent Threat
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
Speak to Eris.




        Your success in entering the Pyramid and obtaining the Unknown Artifact has prepared us more than ever for the looming threat of the Darkness. But this is no time for rest.




Help Eris dispel the phantoms of her lost fireteam


Hunt Nightmares at higher difficulties


Uncover the secrets of the Moon's Lost Sectors


Find further Nightmare Essences spread across the Moon


Gather Phantasmal Fragments to choose Essences from the Lectern of Enchantment

title: A Rising Tide
speaker: Donations Chest
text:
As you draw close to the unfamiliar chest, Mithrax's voice crackles over the radio.



"I require your assistance," he says, but then hesitates. "I must ask… that you work alongside… someone…"



An exasperated Spider cuts into the feed, sparing Mithrax further embarrassment. 



"I'll take it from here, Misraakskel," he says.



He outlines the plan Mithrax and the Vanguard have come up with: Guardians are being asked to scour the system for any remaining pirate treasure and bring as much as they can back to the Tower. The recovered funds will be used to improve the Last City, starting with the Eliksni Quarter.  



While the Guardians are working together, Mithrax will be able to focus on studying the relics of Nezarec-he feels he is close to a breakthrough. He has asked Spider to distribute the resources and finance the improvements the Eliksni Quarter needs.



"Bring me everything you can get your hands on!" Spider says.



"And may the Light provide," he adds begrudgingly.

title: Another Step Closer
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
"It is no surprise that the Pyramid now inflicts the phantom of Omar Agah upon me. The Pyramid will do anything to stop us from getting inside."



Hashladûn has been disposed of, and with her death comes a path to victory: the Hive Cryptoglyph.



Travel to the Hellmouth and locate the Catacombs within. Hashladûn's Cryptoglyph lies inside for the taking.

title: A Dubious Bento
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
Eris greets you with a muted smile. This time, she does not appear surprised as she reaches out to retrieve the meal you've brought her. 



"Ah… Drifter has always dedicated himself whole-heartedly to even the most foolish causes, though he protests all the while. Be it that cynical game of his, or…" She taps the food container. 



"I imagine he only sought to spite us all, in those early days. Prove us wrong. Fortunate, then, that neither you nor I are very good at backing down from an argument."



Eris laughs quietly.



"Do you recall our entreaties to the Nine? Our communion with the entity we believed to be the Darkness itself? Those first, hesitant steps?"



"Drifter is right, I think. We make an effective fireteam."

title: Dawning Delivery
speaker: Eris Morn
text: Eris takes the gift from you, looks at it a moment, and then smiles very faintly. She thanks you and wishes you well.

title: Back from the Dark
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
"The phantom of Eriana-3 now haunts me alongside the rest. They are a burden that weighs heavy on my mind."



The Cryptoglyph must be used to empower the Lectern of Enchantment near Eris. In tandem with the cleansed Essence of Anguish, this will yield another piece of Dreambane armor.



Empower the Lectern of Enchantment with the Cryptoglyph before setting off to hunt the remaining Nightmares.



More Nightmare Essences are required to craft the remaining three pieces of Dreambane armor.

title: Essence, Cleansed
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
"The Pyramid wastes no time-a phantom of Toland has arrived with every intention of distracting me. It will not work."



During Eris's time in the Hellmouth, she discovered many Hive curios. All that remained was an ancient talisman pulsating with Hive magic. Now, the union between the talisman and the Essence of Despair has yielded a powerful tool in the fight against the Nightmares.



Take this piece of Dreambane armor and use it to hunt the Nightmare of Omnigul.

title: Catching Up
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
"A phantom of my deceased fireteam member Sai Mota haunts me. It is only a trick of the Pyramid."



From the Nightmare of Crota, you received an unknown object that harbors a dark energy. You leave it with Eris Morn so she can unearth its secrets.



In the meantime, the Moon hosts further mysteries to uncover regarding entering the Pyramid. The Hive seem to be exhibiting strange behavior that may be related.



Investigate the strange Hive behavior near the Scarlet Keep.

title: Finality
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
"This… communes with me. And I know it… I know him. This is what remains of dear Omar. Tortured by the Hive. I knew not that he would be transformed by Crota's twisted experiments…



"I am sorry I couldn't save you, friend. In life, you may have been unable to escape their grasp. But you will have your vengeance yet."



Eris has kept in her possession one of Omar's greatest assets: his beloved Machine Gun. Eris empowers it with the spirit of Omar, and grants it to you.

title: Dredgens of Yore
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
"Guardian, I wish to express my gratitude. Not only for the food, which has been… unexpectedly appetizing."



"I have enjoyed these regular visits. They invite recollection, without sorrow. As much as I have lost, today I find myself in the company of those who will extend to me their kindness and their trust, and that is a great gift."



"We are not the same people we were even a few years ago. To risk connection is to be changed. And we have changed too much already to fear what the future may bring. I only count myself fortunate that, when I walk forward to meet it, I will not do so alone." 



"…And please, tell Germaine that he is not fooling anyone. He wouldn't leave now that he's just begun showing off his culinary skills."

title: Eris Morn
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
Eris Morn has heard of your victory over the Undying Mind and wishes to speak to you. Visit her in Sanctuary on the Moon.




        While Eris is pleased that you defeated the Undying Mind, she warns you not to let your guard down. There are greater threats on the horizon. She urges you to keep those threats at the forefront of your mind-and prepare accordingly.

title: Legacy: Bound in Sorrow
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
Eris Morn greets you with a grim demeanor. "Guardian. If Caiatl cannot complete her severance, we must find another way forward. In the meantime…"



Eris looks past you, to a point in the distance. "Sorrow's Harbor is again teeming with Nightmares. The Leviathan is to blame, but intelligence suggests that Calus has a more direct influence than I previously assumed."



"It would appear he is reaching out to the Witness's other denizens on the Moon, and the Hive weave rituals beneath the lunar surface to accommodate him. You will find them preparing such a ritual in the sector known as 'K1 Revelation'."



Eris's focus snaps back to you. "Xivu Arath's forces still hold much of this place, despite the Lucent Brood's attempts to usurp them. You will no doubt encounter their warriors attempting to block your path," Eris says.



"I imagine, in your path, they won't remain obstacles for long. Find out what foul scheme Calus intends to hatch and if we can manipulate it for our own purposes."

title: Legacy: Shadowkeep
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
"The phantom of Eriana-3 now haunts me alongside the rest. They are a burden that weighs heavy on my mind."



The Cryptoglyph must be used to empower the Lectern of Enchantment near Eris. In tandem with the cleansed Essence of Anguish, this will yield another piece of Dreambane armor.



Empower the Lectern of Enchantment with the Cryptoglyph before setting off to hunt the remaining Nightmares.



More Nightmare Essences are required to craft the remaining three pieces of Dreambane armor.

title: Eyes on the Moon
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
Though you made short work of the Vex on the Moon, it will all be for naught if the source of the incursions is left untended. Eris has found a way into their staging grounds in the Black Garden, but she must keep her attention fixed on the mysterious Pyramid for now. She asks that you and Ikora attend to this threat in her stead. Your investigation begins at the source, in the Black Garden.



Descend into the Black Garden and complete the Vex Offensive activity.

title: Legacy: Shadowkeep
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
You now stand at the precipice of the future. The Pyramid holds many secrets within. Lift the veil, and find a way inside. Look for something within-anything that might help humanity fight the oncoming storm.



Return to the Enduring Abyss with a full set of Dreambane armor equipped, and find a way inside the Pyramid.

title: Legacy: Shadowkeep
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
"It is no surprise that the Pyramid now inflicts the phantom of Omar Agah upon me. The Pyramid will do anything to stop us from getting inside."



Hashladûn has been disposed of, and with her death comes a path to victory: the Hive Cryptoglyph.



Travel to the Hellmouth and locate the Catacombs within. Hashladûn's Cryptoglyph lies inside for the taking.

title: Legacy: Shadowkeep
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
"It appears the screams of Sai's phantom have brought forth another burden for me to bear-the phantom of Vell Tarlowe."



As the Nightmare of Omnigul swept through camp, Eris noticed a strange reaction from the Essence of Despair. Upon further investigation, it appears the Essence can be of use in fighting these Nightmares. But first, it must be cleansed of any dark energy.



Take the Essence of Despair and purify it any way you can. Then, return to Eris Morn.

title: Legacy: Shadowkeep
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
You have acquired further Nightmare Essences but are out of Hive curios with which to create more Dreambane armor.



After discovering the Hive's ability to shield themselves from the Nightmares, Eris learned of a dark power possessed by the Hive inside the Scarlet Keep. This power may be our answer to how they've protected themselves-and our key to creating more Dreambane armor.



Investigate the dark power within the Scarlet Keep.

title: Legacy: Shadowkeep
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
"The Pyramid wastes no time-a phantom of Toland has arrived with every intention of distracting me. It will not work."



During Eris's time in the Hellmouth, she discovered many Hive curios. All that remained was an ancient talisman pulsating with Hive magic. Now, the union between the talisman and the Essence of Despair has yielded a powerful tool in the fight against the Nightmares.



Take this piece of Dreambane armor and use it to hunt the Nightmare of Omnigul.

title: Legacy: Shadowkeep
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
Eris believes that whatever these things are, they want nothing more than to destroy everything we hold dear.



Eris takes the Unknown Artifact from you. She desires to study it in hopes of making sense of all that you saw within the Pyramid.

title: Legacy: Shadowkeep
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
"A phantom of my deceased fireteam member Sai Mota haunts me. It is only a trick of the Pyramid."



From the Nightmare of Crota, you received an unknown object that harbors a dark energy. You leave it with Eris Morn so she can unearth its secrets.



In the meantime, the Moon hosts further mysteries to uncover regarding entering the Pyramid. The Hive seem to be exhibiting strange behavior that may be related.



Investigate the strange Hive behavior near the Scarlet Keep.

title: Lingering Torment
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
Speak to Eris in Sanctuary.




        Somehow, within the Pit of Heresy, the remaining Daughters of Crota managed to revive Zulmak, strengthened and protected by the Darkness within the crystal. With their rejection of sword logic, Crota's daughters have become far more dangerous. You may have scared them off for now, but there is no doubt they will seek revenge.

title: Memory of Eriana-3
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
"Eriana-3 was the Praxic Warlock who led our fireteam of six into the Hellmouth and… unknowingly… to our doom. I do not blame her, Guardian. During the Great Disaster, Crota snuffed out the love in her heart and left only venom. In the end, before she lost her life in the Oversoul Throne, Eriana-3 came to regret her haste for vengeance."



Reclaim the true memory of Eriana-3 for Eris Morn.



Begin by recovering stolen treasures from Lunar Scavengers beneath the surface of the Moon.

title: Memory of Sai Mota
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
"Sai Mota was a Hunter who walked with us on our doomed journey for vengeance against Crota. Most of us did not make it, however. She… fell to the Wizard Omnigul, laughing as she died."



Reclaim the true memory of Sai Mota for Eris Morn.



Begin by searching for the system core vault within the K1 Revelation Lost Sector.

title: Memory of Toland, the Shattered
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
"Toland, the mad. Toland, the cursed. The exiled. And finally, the Shattered. He knew more about the Hive and the 'song' of their Deathsingers than any other. Had Eriana-3 questioned his convenient obsession further before recruiting him to our fireteam, things might have been different. But fate is fate. That he could not control."



Reclaim the true memory of Toland for Eris Morn.



Search the Moon's surface for a Hive Trove Guardian obscuring a hidden path.

title: Memory of Vell Tarlowe
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
"Vell Tarlowe was one of the strongest Titans I've ever known. A member of the Pilgrim Guard, but even his Light was smothered by the waves of Thrall that rush beneath the surface of the Moon. He underestimated them… and he paid the price."



Reclaim the true memory of Vell Tarlowe for Eris Morn.



Begin by completing an active replayable story mission on the Moon.

title: Nightmare Kills
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
"Ah. I see our dinner conversations have come to a close. For now, at least." Eris tips her head in acknowledgment as she retrieves her final delivery. 



"Drifter has great admiration for you. He may obscure it all he likes with jokes and affected bewilderment… it remains plain to see. You are a part of this City in a way some part of him longs for." 



Eris pauses, thoughtful. "To serve as lofty inspiration alone would be dispiriting. But I hope you know that we both consider you a friend." 



"I, at least, am content to communicate that directly."

title: Martial Mementos
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
Eris accepts the container with a polite nod. 



"…Perhaps someday, we might all share a meal together. If we can ever find the time." 



"Until then, Guardian, please feel free to claim a gift."

title: Nightmare Lunch
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
"Drifter sent you here with… lunch?"



Eris warily regards the container you've brought her, then cracks it open. The air fills with a tantalizing blend of aromas. 



"…Dumplings," Eris observes with solemnity. 



She sighs. 



"The Drifter and I have been-cautiously-discussing the past. That is, we have been reflecting upon my tendency to cling to material remnants of years gone by… and the Drifter's reluctance to divest himself of his old reputation." 



"This seemed an adequate opportunity in which to make a fresh appraisal of all that I have gathered throughout the years. I believe Drifter meant this small kindness as… encouragement." She smiles faintly.



"…I would not wish for you to leave empty-handed. Please: take something. Consider it a fair exchange."

title: Memory of Omar Agah
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
"Of the six of us who descended into the pit, the Hunter Omar Agah surely suffered the most terrible fate. Captured alive by the Heart of Crota, Omar's Light was cut away from him in small bits, used to feed and coax newborn creatures from their cocoons. I will never forget the sounds he made as he died."



Reclaim the true memory of Omar Agah for Eris Morn.



Begin by defeating a powerful Hive Wizard using Super abilities.

title: On the Other Side
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
Eris believes that whatever these things are, they want nothing more than to destroy everything we hold dear.



Eris takes the Unknown Artifact from you. She desires to study it in hopes of making sense of all that you saw within the Pyramid.

title: Raisin the Dead
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
"As ever," Eris says gravely, "I am bidden to grant you dried fruit candies."



She hands you a small box of raisins. "It's traditional at this time of year to trade small gifts and sweets. Perhaps there is someone in this System who would be willing to make a trade for this."

title: Snakebite
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
"…He really found pineapple." Eris's voice softens. 



"We lost so much with the arrival of the Black Fleet. It seemed senseless to mourn my little garden on Io, at the time. But sometimes I think on how frightened we all were, in the face of a second Collapse… and what it meant to me, to plant a garden at the end of the world." 



"The garden is gone. But the hope remains."

title: Symphony of Death
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
It is possible you've done a terrible thing in caging such power. But terrible things have forced your hand. Unleash your fury across the system, until all who consider themselves the fever dreams of our eternal torment understand. You, when pushed, are the only nightmare worth fearing.



You have crafted a weapon of corruption and doom, powered by the stolen might of the Hive's wicked Song.



Unleash its fury upon your enemies. Become death.

title: Symphony of Death
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
"Memories buried, only now remembered. Years ago, I recall reports of music, of a hymn murmured by Deathsingers beneath the Moon's surface."



"This is a song of destruction, our destruction. I believe we can harness this power and turn it against the Hive."

title: Symphony of Death
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
"This skull is only the first instrument in our new symphony. With its guidance, we will twist the Hive's tainted lullaby to our will. But first we must bind its gifts. Scour the Moon. Bring me the bones of the damned."



Hunt enemies on the Moon. Gather bones for Eris by completing the activities she requires.

title: Tainted Lullaby
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
"This skull is only the first instrument in our new symphony. With its guidance, we will twist the Hive's tainted lullaby to our will. But first we must bind its gifts. Scour the Moon. Bring me the bones of the damned."



Hunt enemies on the Moon. Gather bones for Eris by completing the activities she requires.

title: The Dance of My People
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
Eris takes the Void Fizz from you and studies it. "Elemental candies," she says thoughtfully. "A strange way to exploit the power of the Void."



She sets the candy aside and looks at you. "Thank you, Guardian." She pauses."I sometimes wonder if our people rely too much on candy and masks to divert the sting of loss. But then, I'm guilty of my own diversions."

title: The Dance of My People
speaker: Eris Morn
text: Eris thanks you for taking part in the celebration. She speaks about the meaning of the Festival and her own experiences with loss, and then hands you a toothbrush.

title: The Deepening Wake
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
"Our focus is to be shifted. We created a wake when we destroyed Hashladûn and took the Cryptoglyph-and that wake has grown and grown. Hashladûn's two remaining sisters appear to have picked up where her foul plans left off. Once again, strange Hive rituals have commenced near the Keep. We must tame these plans before they become too grand to handle."



Investigate the Hive rituals in Sorrow's Harbor.

title: The Encroaching Nightmare
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
"It appears the screams of Sai's phantom have brought forth another burden for me to bear-the phantom of Vell Tarlowe."



As the Nightmare of Omnigul swept through camp, Eris noticed a strange reaction from the Essence of Despair. Upon further investigation, it appears the Essence can be of use in fighting these Nightmares. But first, it must be cleansed of any dark energy.



Take the Essence of Despair and purify it any way you can. Then, return to Eris Morn.

title: The Infection Runs Deep
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
Speak to Eris regarding discoveries made within the Black Garden.




        The efforts of Guardians within the Black Garden seem to have unlocked the Unknown Artifact. It now provides communications from something… sinister. Eris warns us not to bow to it but believes the Artifact too valuable to dispose of.



Collect any further communications it sends, but remain cautious. There is little here to trust.

title: The Journey
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
"This… communes with me. And I know it… I know him. This is what remains of dear Omar. Tortured by the Hive. I knew not that he would be transformed by Crota's twisted experiments…



"I am sorry I couldn't save you, friend. In life, you may have been unable to escape their grasp. But you will have your vengeance yet."



Eris has kept in her possession one of Omar's greatest assets: his beloved Machine Gun. Eris empowers it with the spirit of Omar, and grants it to you.

title: The Deepening Wake
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
The strange Hive rituals within Sorrow's Harbor have proven to be only the tip of the iceberg. Eris believes the remaining Daughters of Crota are sacrificing Nightmares to obtain their dark energy. What the Daughters are using them for, she does not know. But all signs point beneath the Harbor itself.



Search Sorrow's Harbor for the entrance to the Pit of Heresy.

title: The Journey
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
"There is a mystery here," Eris says softly. She turns the tablet around in her hands. "A memory stirs. I think…no."



She shakes her head. "The runes indicate the Anchor of Light. You may begin there to unravel the threads of this enigma."



Make your way to the Anchor of Light on the Moon to begin this journey.

title: The Keep Looms
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
You have acquired further Nightmare Essences but are out of Hive curios with which to create more Dreambane armor.



After discovering the Hive's ability to shield themselves from the Nightmares, Eris learned of a dark power possessed by the Hive inside the Scarlet Keep. This power may be our answer to how they've protected themselves-and our key to creating more Dreambane armor.



Investigate the dark power within the Scarlet Keep.

title: The Stuff of Legends
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
Eris takes the container gingerly from your hands.



"I see that this will not be a… one-time occurrence." 



She pauses, then lifts the lid to peer inside. You catch the flicker of a smile before Eris snaps the container shut and regards you intently. 



"I have been reflecting upon power, of late. How it accumulates. How it can be bent to purpose. And… what becomes of it, when that purpose is fulfilled." 



"A line of thought that flowed, inevitably, to you. To the role you have played in each of our lives. Your triumphs have altered the fates of entire stars. Today, I see the good you do for the City, and that, too, seems a sweet and indulgent vengeance." 



"My gratitude, Guardian, for this gift. Perhaps something in my collection will suit you in kind."

title: The Pyramid Awaits
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
You now stand at the precipice of the future. The Pyramid holds many secrets within. Lift the veil, and find a way inside. Look for something within-anything that might help humanity fight the oncoming storm.



Return to the Enduring Abyss with a full set of Dreambane armor equipped, and find a way inside the Pyramid.

title: Where on the Moon Is Archie?
speaker: Eris Morn
text: "Hmm? Oh, yes. Archie was here. He wanted very much to play fetch." Eris pauses for a moment. "I managed to divert his attention to the railgun."

title: Whispers in the Dark
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
Whispers flow from the Unknown Artifact, creating sinister messages picked up by Eris Morn.



Someone or something is attempting to speak to us.




        "What first appeared as nonsense and trickery has begun to reveal itself. Certainly we are being manipulated through these interactions, though there is an honesty here… a spark of truth that speaks louder than I sought to allow. I will give it some credence, but please, do not let my curiosity infect your truths."

title: Whispers in the Dark
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
Whispers flow from the Unknown Artifact, creating sinister messages picked up by Eris Morn.



Someone or something is attempting to speak to us.




        "Please do not think I have strayed from the Light. Understand that first and foremost, knowledge will save us all. Know thy enemy… a cliché, yes. But for a reason. Please realize-this enemy, it is not like our other enemies. It fights with a different kind of force. Were we to simply shoot at it, I fear we would never stand a chance. Sometimes you must accept another's truth to understand their weakness. I hope you'll join me on this journey."

title: Whispers in the Dark
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
Whispers flow from the Unknown Artifact, creating sinister messages picked up by Eris Morn.



Someone or something is attempting to speak to us.




        "Sinister transmissions seep out from our Unknown Artifact. Their intentions are anything but pure. Place your eyes upon them only if you seek to find truths among the lies."



Press Accept to receive a mysterious transmission.

title: Whispers in the Dark
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
Whispers flow from the Unknown Artifact, creating sinister messages picked up by Eris Morn.



Someone or something is attempting to speak to us.




        "Pay little attention to the false equivalencies within these messages. They seek to use familiarity to lead us into the darker recesses of our minds… Do not misunderstand-these are certainly fascinating places to explore. But we do so at the risk of giving ourselves to something without our best interests at heart."



Press Accept to receive a mysterious transmission.

title: Whispers in the Dark
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
Whispers flow from the Unknown Artifact, creating sinister messages picked up by Eris Morn.



Someone or something is attempting to speak to us.




        "We know we should keep ourselves from these deceptive interactions, but what we are learning here are truths previously untold. They are asking to be understood. To be known. Perhaps their intentions are far less black-and-white than we first assumed. As always, stay cautious… but perhaps we should not stray from learning the secrets of the universe."



Press Accept to receive a mysterious transmission.

title: Whispers in the Dark
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
Whispers flow from the Unknown Artifact, creating sinister messages picked up by Eris Morn.



Someone or something is attempting to speak to us.




        "What first appeared as nonsense and trickery has begun to reveal itself. Certainly we are being manipulated through these interactions, though there is an honesty here… a spark of truth that speaks louder than I sought to allow. I will give it some credence-but please, do not let my curiosity infect your truths."



Press Accept to receive a mysterious transmission.

title: Whispers in the Dark
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
Whispers flow from the Unknown Artifact, creating sinister messages picked up by Eris Morn.



Someone or something is attempting to speak to us.




        "How long have we lived without questioning the nature of our crafted existence? Do not mistake my curiosity for a turnabout of loyalty-the Light has given us life, while these things have given us only deceit and dysfunction. But… perhaps we are not as in control as we'd like to be. After all, what is the point of life without liberty?"



Press Accept to receive a mysterious transmission.

title: Whispers in the Dark
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
Whispers continue to flow from the Unknown Artifact, but their transmissions have stopped.



Eris, however, has a message for you.




        "Their transmissions have ceased. But I am confident it is not the end of their trechery. You have continued to stand by me through it all. A beacon of light shining through their forced darkness. For that, I have only this remaining message to give."



Press Accept to receive Eris's message.

title: Whispers in the Dark
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
Whispers flow from the Unknown Artifact, creating sinister messages picked up by Eris Morn.



Someone or something is attempting to speak to us.




        "Somewhere in the space between it all… between the truth and the lies, between power and weakness, between day and night, I have lived. In the gray. I believed not by choice, but by force. Chaos reigned, and I embraced it, but ultimately sought to regain equilibrium. Now, however, if these stories are true, I wonder… Perhaps there is only chaos. Perhaps it is the only thing worth embracing."



Press Accept to receive a mysterious transmission.

title: Whispers in the Dark
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
Whispers flow from the Unknown Artifact, creating sinister messages picked up by Eris Morn.



Someone or something is attempting to speak to us.




        "Please do not think I have strayed from the Light. Understand that first and foremost, knowledge will save us all. Know thy enemy… a cliché, yes. But for a reason. Please realize this enemy-it is not like our other enemies. It fights with a different kind of force. Were we to simply shoot at it, I fear we would never stand a chance. Sometimes you must accept another's truth to understand their weakness. I hope you'll join me on this journey."



Press Accept to receive a mysterious transmission.

title: Whispers in the Dark
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
Whispers flow from the Unknown Artifact, creating sinister messages picked up by Eris Morn.



Someone or something is attempting to speak to us.




        "Perhaps what we think of ourselves is simply within our minds, not in our makeup. Perhaps what built us is not what we thought it was. Always prescribing rationale to the chaos. Always finding light within the dark. Never considering the possibility of a parallel existence within the very building blocks of life. The cards are not what we thought they were. But we still must play the game."

title: Whispers in the Dark
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
Whispers flow from the Unknown Artifact, creating sinister messages picked up by Eris Morn.



Someone or something is attempting to speak to us.




        "You must see this… The implication is an alteration of the very fabric of reality as we know it. Who or what has life descended from? It cannot be what these transmissions suggest. But at the same time, perhaps maybe… I believe you must judge for yourself."

        "Sinister transmissions seep out from our Unknown Artifact. Their intentions are anything but pure. Place your eyes upon them only if you seek to find truths among the lies."

title: Whispers in the Dark
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
Whispers flow from the Unknown Artifact, creating sinister messages picked up by Eris Morn.



Someone or something is attempting to speak to us.




        "Pay little attention to the false equivalencies within these messages. They seek to use familiarity to lead us into the darker recesses of our minds… Do not misunderstand-these are certainly fascinating places to explore. But we do so at the risk of giving ourselves to something without our best interests at heart."

title: Whispers of the Past
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
Eris Morn turns to face you, the Ahamkara bone in her palm glowing faintly. Even through her blindfold, Eris's gaze is piercing. 



"Guardian," she begins, "it's my understanding that you're sharpening yourself against the forces of the Witness. Making ready for a final reckoning."



"My brief time as a Hive god made it clear to me that some preparations can be made without. Others must be made within," she says. 



"I have a proposal to do both," she says. "If you are willing to delve into a troublesome memory, I can use your forgotten recollections to reassemble a great weapon from your past."



"And in facing the Darkness," she concludes, "you may find even more power than you imagined."

title: Whispers of the Past
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
Eris grasps your hands and mutters under her breath. You feel light-headed as her incantation takes hold. After a moment, an enigmatic smile plays over her face.



"Yes," she mutters. "I can see it. I can feel it. I can hear it. The whispers. I had almost forgotten myself."



She drops your hands and disappears from view. She returns a moment later and gives you a hauntingly familiar weapon. 



"Wield this," she commands you. "Use it to test your foe. Let this be your worship."



She turns from you, looking out over the barren Moonscape. "Aiat."

title: Whispers of the Taken II
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
Eris marks your approach with a grim smile.



"Most people work tirelessly to avoid unpleasant memories," she says. "Yet you face them time and again in the pursuit of power."



"A quality you share with the Witness."



"Such power is limited only by one's own will," she explains. "And yours has yet to reach its limits."



"Continue gathering Taken Essences and delving into your investigation of the anomaly," she commands you. "I will use what you glean to ensure that you remain indominable in the face of our ancient enemy."

title: Whispers of the Taken I
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
Eris cocks her head as you approach, listening to something you can't hear.



"Darkness binds as much as the Light," she greets you. "It connects us to each other, and to ourselves."



"Mastery of the Darkness may give one access to memories occluded from our conscious minds," she explains. "Harvest Taken Essences to coalesce this power within yourself."



"Then return to the memory of your investigation on Io," she instructs you. "Vanquish your enemies there, opening neural pathways to knowledge that even you did not know you possessed."



"Do this and I will manifest the connection as something… useful."

title: The Guardian Games
speaker: Commander Zavala
text:
Zavala gazes toward the podium as you approach. "The Guardian Games were hard fought, but ultimately the Warlocks took the gold with their finely honed powers." He glances down at his armor and rubs absently at a scuffed patch. "I would have preferred a Titan victory, but I can't say I'm surprised. Warlocks are true masters of the Light. They demand respect - and if it isn't given, they take it."



The ghost of a smile plays across Zavala's face. "Ikora taught me that. And I feel her Warlocks just taught their opponents the same lesson

title: Whispers of the Taken III
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
Eris Morn places one hand on your weapon, and the other on your shoulder. You feel a pulsing connection, and flashes of memory wash over you.



When it ends, Eris seems to sag under her own weight.



"You've seen so much violence," she mutters. "As much as any of us. With so much more to come. I've done all I can in this matter." 



She looks into your face, searching. "Take this weapon and face whatever may come with your full power. Win for humanity what we all yearn for: a future free from the whispers of the past."



"Now go," she concludes. "I must rest."

title: Whispers of the Taken III
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
Eris seems fidgety as you approach. 



"The whispering. It gets louder with each visit," she says.



"I will honor my commitment to empowering you in the face of our ancient foe, but this must be the last time."



"Delving into the memories of another can produce a profound disassociation. A blurring at the edges of identity." She rubs her temples and flexes her jaw. 



"But it's nothing I haven't overcome before," she says resolutely. "Provide me with the means, and I shall fill you cup once more."

title: A Classy Reward
speaker: Eva Levante
text: "Excellent work, dear," Eva says. "You've shown great spirit during the Games. I hope this little reward will help you remember them all year."

title: A Classy Reward
speaker: Eva Levante
text: "Very impressive," Eva says with a smile. "You've earned this. Please choose your favorite. If you keep up this enthusiasm, perhaps you'll earn another next week."

title: With a Vengeance
speaker: Eris Morn
text:
Eris gives you a smile of acknowledgment as you approach.



"I hear that Shaxx has you on the front lines again," she says. "Wielding weapons of ill repute, no less. The unofficial Iron Lord never was a master of subtlety."



"I would lend my expertise," she continues, "but my transformation to and from Hive godhood took a greater toll than even I anticipated. And regrettably, my body no longer recovers as quickly as it once did." 



You detect a note of persistent weariness in the former Hunter's voice. "In the absence of a Ghost, I must make do with tea and silence."



"Let me then serve as a reminder, Guardian: every creature has limits. For the Lightless, they are hard and uncompromising."



"I suggest you visit a few more of us mere mortals. Devrim and Hawthorne, for instance. I'm sure your strength will raise their spirits, as it has mine."

title: A Classy Reward
speaker: Eva Levante
text: "Well done, my friend!" Eva says. "I had these made so that Guardians of all kinds could show their appreciation for one another. Choose your favorite, and if you show the same spirit next week, you can earn another."

title: A Glowing Solstice
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
Eva once again appraises your Candescent armor.



"Now that you've rekindled one piece of your armor, why not do the same for the others? After all, what better way to celebrate Solstice?"



She grins and waves you off, as if encouraging you to have some fun.

title: A Glowing Solstice
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
Eva once again appraises your Sunlit armor.



"Now that you've rekindled one piece of your armor, why not do the same for the others? After all, what better way to celebrate Solstice?"



She grins and waves you off, as if encouraging you to have some fun.

title: A Glowing Solstice
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
Eva makes a playful show of shielding her eyes from your glowing armor.



"I must say, isn't this a bit much? What if you were to start a fire?"



She grins as she lowers her arm and applauds you.



"It may seem like a silly thing, to place such importance on a show of light and heat. But I assure you, there is little silliness about it."



Eva turns her eyes to a nearby Solstice banner, emblazoned with a golden sun.



"Every sun sets. Every fire burns out. But if we hold their warmth in our hearts, if we keep hope alive, then eventually the sun rises again. A new fire springs to life, from the ashes of the old. Just like the phoenix."



She turns to you with a smile as bright as your armor.



"And seeing you glow? That reminds us that warmth-that hope-is still alive and well. Thank you, Guardian. And have a Happy Solstice."

title: A Glowing Solstice
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
Eva once again appraises your Sublime armor.



"It's beginning to look rather radiant," she says approvingly. "Why not finish the set out? You will shine like the sun, and I for one always love to see it."



She waves you off beaming, looking forward to your progress.

title: A Glowing Solstice
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
Eva once again appraises your Lustrous armor.



"It's beginning to look rather radiant," she says approvingly. "Why not finish the set out? You will shine like the sun, and I for one always love to see it."



She waves you off beaming, looking forward to your progress.

title: A Guardian in Shining Armor
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
The corners of Eva's eyes crinkle as she gives you a kindly smile.



"You shine as bright as the sun, Guardian. But knowing you, I suspect that your flame has only begun to burn."



She reaches out to offer a stack of Silver Leaves.



"Please, take these and continue celebrating Solstice. Something tells me you have more bonfires to light."

title: A Guardian in Shining Armor
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
Eva takes a moment to look over your armor.



"I see the embers of your armor glowing with renewed spirit. A small fire, wanting to grow. Perhaps with more Kindling and some Silver Ash from the bonfire, we can help it along!"

title: A Spooky Good Time
speaker: Eva Levante
text: Eva smiles when you walk up. "Welcome," she says, and then gestures to the decorations adorning the Tower. "A beautiful transformation, isn't it? These decorations honor a yearly tradition here in the City. I am so pleased to invite you to be part of it."

title: And to All a Good Flight
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
There's pride in Eva's eyes as you approach. "Thank you for showing the commander kindness," she says.



"One thing I've learned about Zavala… he's reluctant to let himself enjoy things. The man is responsible for so much, and he feels our losses more deeply than most."



"A bite to eat, a cup of coffee," she steals a glance at Zavala, who stands in the distance, issuing orders to a group of Guardians. "Help him however you can-these are difficult times."



She looks back to you. "Now, while you've been busy spreading Dawning cheer, Amanda finished her gift for you! I know generosity is its own reward, but you deserve it."



"Tell her I wish her a happy Dawning!"

title: And to All a Good Flight
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
"Happy Dawning!" Eva cries as you approach. The scent of fresh cookies surrounds her like a Well of Radiance.



"Baking treats for those you care about is a Dawning tradition. I know you spend most of your time with bullets and bombs, but during the Dawning, a handful of raisins can be more important than a grenade!"



She leans close to you. "Don't tell Shaxx I said that."



"Now, I know Amanda has prepared something special for you. Why don't you bring her a fresh-baked cookie? She'd be so thankful, and I have all the ingredients right here!"

title: And to All a Good Flight
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
Eva still holds the cookie you brought her. "Thank you, dear! These are my favorite."



She takes a generous bite. "Oh," she says. "This is… it's quite…"



She swallows, then composes herself with a bright smile. "Listen," she says as she reaches up and clasps your shoulder, "what's important is that you never stop improving!"



She hands you a package. "Amanda asked me to give you this. She said she still has improvements to make, so while she works, go spread the spirit of the Dawning across the system. We can't let our friends think we've forgotten them, especially not at this time of year!"

title: And to All a Good Flight
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
Eva is grateful when you report that Eris enjoyed the cookies you brought her.



"How was she? Did she seem healthy?" she asks, then waves her hands to shoo the questions away. "I'm sorry, I just worry about that girl sometimes."



She absentmindedly pulls at the fringes of her shawl. "She holds the Darkness closer than most, and has suffered greatly for it," she says.



Eva looks up at you with a sad smile. "I hope the Dawning can bring her some joy-even if it is only once a year."

title: And to All a Good Flight
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
Eva greets you as you return from the Tangled Shore. 



"Did you bring something to that new Guardian?" she asks. She seems genuinely concerned.



"I hear he keeps to himself. It's important to respect that, but you must also reach out from time to time and make sure he feels welcome."



"No one should feel alone," she says, "especially not during the Dawning!"

title: And to All a Good Flight
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
Eva is pleased to see your return. "I hope Devrim appreciated your visit."



"I know he enjoys the occasional shortbread, but the Dawning isn't only about cookies. Your deliveries show that while the people we care about may leave our sight, they never leave our thoughts."



Eva sighs, no doubt picturing Devrim celebrating the Dawning alone in his isolated church.



"That dear man spends more time around the Fallen than he does other Guardians," she says. "I'm sure your visit meant more to him than he let on."

title: Best in Class
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
"Welcome to the Guardian Games!" Eva greets you warmly. "I'm glad you decided to join us. As always, Titans, Warlocks, and Hunters will all be competing against each other for yearly bragging rights."



"Let's get you a class item to make your class selection official," she says, proffering an array of fancy items.



"I've also got some Laurels to get you started," she says. "You can earn more by using your class abilities to defeat your adversaries, or by defeating especially powerful ones."



"Now, get out there and show the other classes what you're made of," she says with mock seriousness. "May the best class win!"

title: And to All a Good Flight
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
Eva nods as if expecting your question about the Dawning spirit.



"Despite our festive decorations, you may have felt… an emptiness," Eva says quietly, glancing at an untouched bowl of Radiolarian Pudding. "We have known loss before, but recently, we have faced tremendous difficulties. I fear we need the Dawning spirit this year more than ever."



The woman lifts her eyes to the peaceful sky. "But though the wind may be cold, the air remains full of stories."



"Raise the spirits of those around you. Spread hope, Guardian. Amanda will make sure you're well rewarded for your efforts, but the true reward will be in the eyes of those in need."

title: Best in Class
speaker: Eva Levante
text: "Very impressive, Guardian!" Eva smiles warmly. "Now that you've gotten your bearings, you can really start showing off by earning those Medallions!"

title: Best in Class
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
"I see you've earned your first Medallion!" Eva's eyes twinkle with delight. "This is just the first of many."



"With skills like yours, you'll soon have more Medallions than you know what to do with!" She gives you a friendly wink.



"Here's a little something to hold all of your trophies," she says, handing you a Medallion Case. "Now you'll be able to track all of your class contributions and look back on your achievements with pride."

title: Best in Class
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
"You're off to a great start," Eva encourages you, "but there's still plenty you can do!"



"The more Medallions you turn in, the more you'll help you class," she adds, "and the better individual rewards you'll earn."



"Track your weekly contributions so you know how close you are to your next reward threshold. Now go have fun with your friends," she encourages, "and earn some Medallions for your class!"

title: Best in Class
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
"Very impressive, Guardian!" Eva smiles warmly. "Now that you've gotten your bearings, you can really start showing off by earning those Medallions!"



"If you're up for a challenge, you could even try a Diamond Card. As a former couture professional, I can assure you that diamonds are always in style."

title: Best in Class
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
"Looks like you're all caught up on this year's Guardian Games," Eva says approvingly.



"Now, enjoy yourself by earning some Medallions for your class. And maybe even bank some points for yourself," she adds, "if you're feeling sassy." 



She lowers her voice conspiratorially. "Don't tell the other Guardians, but I saw this and thought of you." She hands you a handsome weapon. "I hope it fits."



"Go show everyone what you can do, and have fun!"

title: Best in Class
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
"Very impressive, Guardian!"



Eva smiles warmly. "Now that you've gotten your bearings, you can really start showing off. Get out there and start earning those Medallions. You can take on Guardian Games strikes or compete in Supremacy matches. I'm certain Zavala and Shaxx are both keeping an eye on the top contenders!" 



"Oh, but first: I set this aside for you. For good luck."

text:
"Very impressive, Guardian!" Eva smiles warmly. "Now that you've gotten your bearings, you can really start showing off. This year, the Vanguard has helped me set up Focus Activities. Hunters, Titans, Warlocks-you'll compete to earn the most points in an activity as a class over a limited time."



"Now get out there and start earning those Medallions!" Eva winks. "If you're up for a challenge, you could even try a Diamond Card. As a former couture professional, I can assure you that diamonds are always in style."

title: Best in Class
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
"Welcome to the Guardian Games!" Eva greets you warmly. "Once again, Titans, Warlocks, and Hunters will be competing for bragging rights. I've been hard at work with Zavala to set up a new scoring model for this year. Your Light protects us all, Guardian. The least I can do in return is give you a competition to remember!"



Eva indicates a selection of gleaming class items. "Ikora herself gave me a hand with the finishing touches on these. The bonds, marks, or cloaks of our winning class will receive a special something to make sure they stand out in any crowd-just as they will deserve."



"Now, go show the other classes what you're made of," she says with mock seriousness. "If you want those bragging rights, you'll have to earn them!"

title: Celebrating Solstice
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
"Happy Solstice, Guardian."



Eva welcomes you to the celebration, smiling with deep warmth. 



"I am so pleased to see you here. There is always something special about Solstice, isn't there? We remember what has been, and we celebrate the life and hope of here and now, of the future yet to come with the people by our sides."



"I have asked Zavala to devise some exciting new challenges for you to overcome this year, Guardian. You'll have access to these during your Operations this Solstice. It is our hope that these will drive you to ever greater heights, and that you shine brightly for all to see."

title: But Wait, There's More!
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
"Isn't it a marvelous idea!" Eva exclaims as you approach. "An island in the sky. My goodness. When I was a little girl, I read stories about such things, but you Guardians can actually make them real."



She sighs, sobering as she offers you a gift: a set of ruined armor from the Red War. "But of course, the Solstice is more than just floating islands. Take this armor to the Statue of Heroes, dear. Try to think about everyone who came before you, everyone who made it possible to stand here in this Tower today…"

title: Celebrating Solstice
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
"You look splendid, Guardian! Speaking of which…"



Eva reaches out her hand. In her palm rests a small pile of leaves that appear to be made of silver. They shimmer in the light of the sun.



"Beautiful, aren't they? Leaves like these have been seen all across the solar system. I believe they are… what's the word? Paracausal? Yes, that is how Rahool described them."



She smiles as she presents you with the leaves.



"You know, Ms. Holliday has been planning to build a bonfire in celebration of Solstice. Doing so in the Tower could be dangerous, so Ikora has raised the European Aerial Zone into the sky once again. Why don't you bring Amanda some leaves for her fire?"



Eva meets your eyes before handing over the leaves and gives you a knowing wink. 



"And please, watch your step while you're up there."

title: The Guardian Games
speaker: Commander Zavala
text:
"Thanks to your hard work, we now have some time to breathe and enjoy our successes.



"To that end, I've asked Eva Levante to bring back the Guardian Games. It will give Guardians of every class an opportunity to come together in camaraderie and competition. Talk to Eva to get started.



"Before you go, take this gear as a thanks from the Vanguard. Good luck in the Games, Guardian."

title: Celebrating Solstice
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
Eva clasps her hands together as she greets you with a warm smile.



"What a splendid new purpose for your Silver Ash! I see how it makes your armor shine in the sunlight, a beacon of hope for all whom you encounter."



She reaches for the table, picks up a bundle of Silver Leaves, and offers them to you.



"Amanda is always looking for more leaves to build a new bonfire. Please bring these to her with my blessings, along with any other leaves you find on your adventures. The more you bring to her, the more Silver Ash the fire will leave when it has burned out. I look forward to seeing how bright you can shine!"

title: Celebrating Solstice
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
"Welcome back, Guardian." 



Eva greets you with a warm smile and a gentle wave. She looks you over and nods.



"I am glad to see you are making good use of the forge, and that you are well on your way to creating the armor of your dreams. I dare say I have nothing else to teach you this year… but I hope you'll keep coming back. There is more to forge, and I am always happy to see you."

title: Celebrating Solstice
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
"You look splendid, Guardian! Speaking of which…"



Eva reaches out her hand. In her palm rests a small pile of leaves that appear to be made of silver. They shimmer in the light of the sun.



"Beautiful, aren't they? Leaves like these have been seen all across the solar system. I believe they are… what's the word? Paracausal? Yes, that is how Rahool described them."



She smiles as she presents you with the leaves.



"Saint-14 and Saladin have agreed to build a bonfire in celebration of Solstice. Doing so in the Tower could be dangerous, so Ikora has raised the European Aerial Zone into the sky once again. Why don't you bring them some leaves for the fire?"



Eva meets your eyes before handing over the leaves and gives you a knowing wink. 



"And please, watch your step while you're up there."

title: Celebrating Solstice
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
Eva clasps her hands together as she greets you with a warm smile.



"What a splendid new purpose for your Silver Ash! I see how it makes your armor shine in the sunlight, a beacon of hope for all whom you encounter."



She reaches for the table, picks up a bundle of Silver Leaves, and offers them to you.



"Saint-14 and Saladin will need more leaves to build a new bonfire. Please bring these to them with my blessings, along with any other leaves you find on your adventures. The more you bring to them, the more Silver Ash the fire will leave when it has burned out. I look forward to seeing how bright you can shine!"

title: Celebrating Solstice
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
"Did you enjoy the bonfire, Guardian?"



Eva listens as your recount your adventure in the EAZ, including throwing the Silver Leaves onto the fire and how they were transformed into Silver Ash.



"How wonderful," she remarks with a smile. "When the flames have gone out, the ashes they leave behind bring us hope for the future."



Eva inhales deeply and takes stock of the surrounding greenery.



"The spirit of Solstice is in the air, and everyone is in the mood for some well-earned celebration. I wanted to help organize the festivities, so I put together a list of things to do. Why don't you take a look?"

title: Celebrating Solstice
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
Eva greets you with a smile, as she ever does. "You're doing good work with that Forge, I see," she says, and reaches out. "Allow me? I have something that will unlock its potential for you."



She takes the Forge and, referring to a carefully-sketched diagram, removes the back panel. She keeps talking as she installs a piece that glows in a rippling, humming sort of way. "This will let you reconfigure its material needs to suit your preferences. It's all very technical." Eva laughs warmly as she closes the Forge up again and hands it back to you. 



"And you'll need these as a catalyst." The last thing she gives you is a small stack of Silver Leaves.



You can use Silver Leaves to refresh the selection of bounties per category offered in the Solstice Forge. Use this to help you better align your objectives across each of the armor piece categories. To earn more Silver Leaves, complete activities while carrying the Solstice Forge.

title: Celebrating Solstice
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
"Welcome back, Guardian." 



Eva greets you with a warm smile and a gentle wave. She looks you over and nods.



"The Solstice Forge truly seems to suit you! I am glad to see you are making good use of it, and that you are well on your way to creating the armor of your dreams. I dare say I have nothing else to teach you this year… but I hope you'll keep coming back. There is more to forge, and I am always happy to see you."

title: Celebrating Solstice
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
"Happy Solstice, Guardian!"



Eva beams as you approach, gesturing to the verdant splendor that now decorates the Courtyard.



"It brings me such happiness to see life thriving in the Tower. If we focus only on what we've lost, we can easily lose sight of the hope and beauty that surrounds us."



She folds her hands in front of her and gives you a kind smile.



"Have you heard the legend of the phoenix? A mythical bird from pre-Golden Age folktales, it was said that it would burn within its own flames and rise anew from the ashes."



"That is the spirit of Solstice. Not one of sorrow, but of joy at the chance for renewal."



Reaching for the table next to her, Eva picks up a neatly wrapped package and hands it to you.



"May this gift remind you that, just like the phoenix, a bright future rises from the ashes of the past. Now go out there and celebrate all that life has to offer!"

title: Celebrating Solstice
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
"Happy Solstice, Guardian."



Eva welcomes you to the celebration, smiling with a deep warmth. 



"I am so pleased to see you here. There is something special about Solstice, isn't there? We remember what has been, and we celebrate the life and hope of here and now, of the future yet to come with the people by our sides."



She offers you something: compact, lightweight, humming gently. 



"In honor of the occasion, a gift. This year, the Solstice Forge will help you create your new armor. I look forward to seeing what you create, Guardian. May your fire blaze ever higher!"

title: Cheer Up?
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
Eva is delighted to see the completed blueprint. She thanks you for your hard work and rewards you with a festive sparrow.



"I'm sure this will help you show off your Dawning spirit," she says warmly.

title: Classic Carving
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
"Thank you for helping the Tower get into the festival spirit, Guardian," Eva says. "Here's a little something for your troubles." She hands you a package, her eyes twinkling with delight.



"Keep filling the Book of the Forgotten with those Manifested Pages, and don't forget to visit me from time to time," she encourages you. "I've got plenty of masks, treats, and festival gear to go around!"



Eva grasps your hands warmly. "Happy Festival of the Lost, Guardian!"

title: Classic Carving
speaker: Eva Levante
text: "I found one more gift for you to finish the festival strong."

title: Classic Carving
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
Eva's eyes twinkle as she gives you a warm smile. "There you are." 



She reaches behind her, picking up a mask. "I made this just for you. I patterned it from a similar one that Maria had when she was little. Her head was a bit smaller though." 



She chuckles fondly. "Well, try it on!"

title: Classic Carving
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
Eva studies the tome beside her. "Even now, The Book of the Forgotten is simultaneously amazing and unnerving. I still don't understand how it knows whether your additions are Spectral or Manifested Pages."



She shakes her head in disbelief. "But who am I to judge after all this time? It's clearly much better at telling stories than me," she laughs. "I believe the book thrives best when you collect Spectral Pages, manifest them by fighting your way through Haunted Sectors, and then add the Manifested Pages to the book…"



"If you dare," she adds with a wink.

title: Classic Carving
speaker: Eva Levante
text: "Hello, dear. Would you believe that this old lady has a new trick up her sleeve?" she asks with a wink. "If you bring back the mask, I'll tailor some personal touches in. You'll love it."

title: Classic Carving
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
"Thanks for helping the Tower get in the festival spirit, Guardian," Eva says. "Here's a little something to help you on your expeditions." She hands you a package, her eyes twinkling with delight.



"Keep filling the Book of the Forgotten with those Manifested Pages, and don't forget to visit me from time to time," she encourages you. "I've got plenty of masks, treats, and festival gear to go around!"



She leans in and whispers conspiratorially, "And do watch out for that grumpy Hive Ghost. He is nothing but trouble if you ask me. Keep Eido and Glint close by if you can-it'll put my worrying mind at ease."



Eva grasps your hands warmly. "Happy Festival of the Lost, Guardian!"

title: Classic Carving
speaker: Eva Levante
text: "There's no better way to scare up some Spectral Pages than with a festival mask!" -Eva Levante

title: Classic Carving
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
Eva looks relieved as you stride into the Courtyard.



"You've got some Manifested Pages? Thank goodness. I get the strangest feeling that the Book of the Forgotten is… hungry." She regards the book with concern. "I could swear I heard it grumbling."



Eva waves you over to the tome. "Add your Manifested Pages to the book, Guardian. Hopefully that will keep it quiet!"

title: Classic Carving
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
"Thank you for feeding the Book of the Forgotten," Eva says appreciatively. "If you keep giving it Manifested Pages, I'm sure it will reveal some fascinating tales."



"Take a peek at your Event Card, and don't forget about the masks and goody bags I've prepared for all the Guardians!" She gestures proudly to an array of handmade crafts and treats.



"Nothing like a creepy sweet to get us in the festival spirit!"

title: Classic Carving
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
Eva's expression warms as she sees you. "Happy Festival of the Lost, dear! I am so grateful that you are here, celebrating. I know this can be a bittersweet time for many of us, and it is important that we acknowledge our grief as well as our joy. I hope you will allow yourself as much time as you need to embrace all the feelings you hold in your heart this year."



She motions toward the pedestal beside her. "And when you find yourself in the mood for a little mystery or magic, I have no doubt that you will discover something ghoulish in the latest volume of the Book of the Forgotten!"



"Just watch out for anyone trying to spoil the celebration for you. I'm sure they'll be nothing but trouble," she says with a wink.

"If you dare," she adds with a wink.

title: Cookie Delivery Helper
speaker: Eva Levante
text: Eva grips your hand tightly as you approach and smiles warmly.  "You've been busy this year. I'm sure our new Aionian friends and that adorable Exo puppy were delighted with what you baked them. But no doubt you can come up with a few more recipes to make in that Dawning oven. I'll bet your old friends throughout the system could use a tasty treat. You've all fought hard this year, faced existential dread-again. I'm sure they'll all be glad to spend some time with you outside of a crisis." She gives you a rosy-cheeked wink "Here's a few ingredients to get you started."

title: Dawning Duty
speaker: Eva Levante
text: "A gift need not be material. Sometimes your presence, a little favor, or some advice is just as welcome. The Dawning is a time to care for one another." -Eva Levante

title: Dawning Delivery
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
Eva accepts the cookies with a warm smile. "Happy Dawning to you," she says. "Things may be grim at times, but the world is full of things that remind us never to give up hope."



She laughs. "I'm talking about you, Guardian. Of course, the cookies help, too."

title: Drop In
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
Eva has a special offering for you this year: Earth's homegrown take on a Cloudstrider's skyboard, built for swift movement and flashy tricks. 



This brand-new Skimmer comes courtesy of a mysterious benefactor with an equally mysterious message: "A peace offering, to a place that used to be home."  



"That's a nice sentiment, isn't it?" Eva smiles warmly. "Now, the Games are all about the spirit of friendly competition. If you want to keep this Skimmer after the Games end, you'll have to earn it!"



Eva gives you a grandmotherly wink. "I've left some choice open in how you do, which means there's room for the most important element of all: personal style."

title: Faction Reward
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
"Congratulations, my friend!" Eva says, beaming. "The Warlock banner rose to the top yesterday, bringing your team one step closer to the Guardian Games Cup."



She hands you a reward for your contributions. "Take this reward for your excellent work. And don't let up-the Hunters and Titans won't!"

title: Faction Reward
speaker: Eva Levante
text:
"You are doing your team proud, my dear," Eva says. "Even in adversity, you Warlocks show us all how to be resolute in our goals. Perhaps today will be your day."



She hands you a reward for your contributions. "Take this reward for your part in yesterday's competition. Well done, and don't give up."
