title: Faction Reward
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text: Complete bounties for XP and undertake quests for valuable gear. Completing Crucible matches grants you tokens, which can be turned in here for packages.

title: Feats of Bravery
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
"Back already?" Shaxx exclaims. "The Witness's forces will be on notice now. And I haven't even finished gearing you up yet!"



"As your battlefield accomplishments in the Defensive Zone grow, you'll have the chance to return here to expand your BRAVE arsenal." He gestures toward the weapons chest prominently displayed in the hall.



"Come back periodically to see what new weapons of war Ada and I have on offer!"

title: Feats of Bravery
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
Shaxx eyes your new gear with pride. "It looks good on you, Guardian! I bet those other Lightbearers in the Crucible will die of jealousy if you don't shoot them first!"



"That's not nearly the bottom of our arsenal, though," he continues. "I have a whole selection of other weapons for you." 



"I've arranged a series of challenges. Combat scenarios designed to keep you sharp," he explains. "Master them, and I'll reward you with choice pieces from my BRAVE arsenal."



He holds his fist up for emphasis. "Now get out there and defend our city!"

title: Feats of Bravery
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
"A Guardian's greatest advantage is their Light, but a top-notch arsenal certainly helps. And to face the Witness, you'll need the best," Shaxx says, gesturing broadly to the hall. 



"I've assembled the BRAVE arsenal together with Ada-1. Many of the weapons here were discontinued for being too dangerous," he says, shaking his head. 



"We've revived a dozen of them for your edification, because annihilation is coming for us, and Vanguard safeguards won't save us. But you might."



"I prepared a welcome gift to get you started," he says pointing to a nearby chest. "But after that, you'll have to earn each weapon the old-fashioned way-in combat!"

title: Feats of Bravery
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
"You prove your worth time and again," Shaxx greets you approvingly. "But I'm sure you recognize that more goes into your victories than your skill alone."



"Foundries make your weapons," he explains. "Scouts provide you with reconnaissance objectives. Armorers make your clothing. And old buzzards like me train you in the use of your Light!"



"So it is with me," he continues. "I couldn't do this without the help of Arcite 99-40, my quartermaster."



"Go talk to Arcite yourself to learn more about what he has planned for you!"

title: Forged Anew
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
Lord Shaxx shifts from foot to foot like a giddy schoolchild. His remaining horn waggles in the breeze.



"Guardian!" he greets you, barely containing his enthusiasm. "I have some thrilling news."



"I'm hereby opening THREE NEW CRUCIBLE ARENAS!" His bellowing attracts several nearby Lightbearers.



"The first is a defunct research facility, reclaimed from the Fallen. It's built right into an ice shelf on Europa!"



More Guardians begin to hover around interestedly.



"The second is on Neptune. I've convinced the Neomuni to donate a mall as a Crucible site!"



The group of intrigued Lightbearers is growing. Shaxx begins gesturing broadly, playing to the audience.



"And finally," he announces. "I have secured the most prestigious battleground of them all… A CAPTURED PYRAMID!"



"And not just any Pyramid," Shaxx continues. "The fell lair of the famous, the notorious, Final God of Pain himself… NEZAREC!"



There's a clamor as the eager crowd closes in.



"See you on the battlefield!" Shaxx shouts to you over the din.

title: Forged Anew
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text: "Wonderful! You look stronger already. I look forward to the heights you will climb!" -Lord Shaxx

title: Forged by Fire
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text: Lord Shaxx gives you a nod of a approval. You can't see it, but he's smiling under his helm.

title: From the Mouths of Babes
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
The Recluse




        "I had a feeling I'd be handing this over to you," Shaxx booms. He collects your new Recluse and hands it over with a respectful nod. "Do the children proud."

title: The Drowning Labyrinth
speaker: Ikora Rey
text:
Ikora's face is drawn, mouth set in a grim line. She launches into business without any preliminaries.



"I'm hearing reports from Savathûn's throne world that a party of Dread have infiltrated the ruins of Rhulk's Pyramid ship. They appear to be collaborating with Hive within the ship."



Ikora taps through reports on her pad.



"We don't know what they're doing there. We don't know why. And, Guardian, the Vanguard is not pleased that the Dread snuck into a guarded area behind our backs."



"I'm asking you to take in your fireteam. My agents will remain on the scene for backup, but you're the tip of our spear. We need you in there, doing what you do best. Find out what the Dread are doing-and take what countermeasures you find appropriate."



Enter the "Sundered Doctrine" dungeon and uncover the mysteries of Rhulk's ship.

title: Glory Rank: Fabled
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text: As you are a Fabled competitor in the Crucible, Shaxx wishes to reward your efforts.

title: Glory Rank: Legend
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text: You have become a Legend in the Crucible. Shaxx wishes to bask in your glory.

title: The Red War
speaker: Ikora Rey
text:
Ikora realized that the more we learn, the less we know. She now reflects on past events and meditates on the bright future promised by a reborn and living Traveler. She has also found in you a friend, someone she can trust. For her, that can be rare. 



Return to Ikora Rey to relive past Red War activities.

title: In Your Sights
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text: Lord Shaxx is impressed when you return. "The Crucible is fast-paced, even chaotic at times," he says. "That you can pull off such a careful, precise shot under those conditions… Anyone on the other side of your scope should be worried. Well done!"

title: Howl at the Moon
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
Shaxx is kneeling in the Courtyard, petting a happy warbeast pup when you approach.  



The Crucible handler looks up at you. "Guardian-have you ever rounded a corner in the Crucible, and suddenly been face-to-face with another Lightbearer?" he asks. 



"Yes, they have. Oh yes, they have!" he coos to the slobbering puppy. "I watched it happen!" 



"In situations like those," he tells you, "a hand cannon is the final word in short-range stopping power." He gestures to the firearm holstered at your side. 



"I commissioned the first Luna's Howl as a gift to someone who lost their dearest companion on the Moon," he says, lowering his voice in tribute. 



"I'm reviving this model so that you'll have a reliable companion of your own against the Witness," he concludes. 



"And speaking of companions, pop in on Zavala, will you? With all this stress, I fear he's looking… a little blue."

title: Increase Reputation
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text: Show Lord Shaxx proof of your deeds in the Crucible.

title: Jury Duty
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
"Hung Jury. An excellent scout rifle." 



"The preferred weapon of seasoned marksmen, with enough stopping power to make each shot count." 



Shaxx's helmet tips your way. 



"Why am I telling you this?" he asks, deceptively quiet. 



"Weapons doctrine is meditative! I recommend daily recitations. You'll sleep better."



You aren't certain that Shaxx's bellowing will contribute positively to your sleep patterns. 

Luckily, Shaxx has already moved on. He studies Hung Jury with what you imagine is a thoughtful expression. 



"Do you know, I wonder what became of our Dead Orbit friends? I never liked them-gloomy bunch-but they did keep their word. They left."

title: Kill-Tracker Ghost
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text: Lord Shaxx has a gift for you: a Ghost Shell that will track your victories.

title: Keepsake
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
Not Forgotten




        "She used to glow with pride when you'd return from a match." -Lord Shaxx, to Josef

title: Cleansed Essence of Brutality
speaker: Lectern of Enchantment
text: The Lectern of Enchantment rumbles with energy and provides you with gear to fight against the Nightmares-and the Pyramid.

title: Light Reforged
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
"Tell me this, Guardian," Lord Shaxx bellows, his horned helmet towering over you. "Did the Cosmodrome sufficiently hone you? Are you prepared to face all the Darkness can muster?"



"You're a fool if you think so. All blades dull with time; keeping yours sharp is a matter of diligence and discipline. For that end, I created the Crucible."



He gestures at an array of screens streaming video footage of Guardians battling each other.



"Pit yourself against your fellow Lightbearers, and we'll see if you have your edge yet."



Shaxx invites you to participate in Crucible matches against other Guardians and to complete the Crucible bounties he offers.

title: Light Reforged
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
"I see you've found your edge," Shaxx says with a nod.



"That's a good start, but the hard part is keeping it. Diligence and discipline, Guardian. I look forward to seeing your future matches."

title: Lord Shaxx-o-Lantern
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
"The Festival of the Lost is a special time for us, Guardian," Lord Shaxx says, inclining his head. "Although we do not fear death, we must respect it. But during this holiday, we can laugh at death. We can shed a little light on the unknowable thing and celebrate that we are always one step ahead."



He puts his hands on his hips. "No better way to laugh at death than dying, again and again, in the Crucible! HA HA HA HA!!"

title: Live-Fire Exercises
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
"All blades dull with time, Guardian," Shaxx says with a stern nod.



"The work you've done here will keep yours sharp, for now. Good effort, but I expect you back soon."

title: Meet Lord Shaxx
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
"Ahh, another brave Guardian ready to test their might. The Crucible awaits!"



Lord Shaxx offers bounties, pursuits, and special rewards for competing in the Crucible.



The Crucible is a player-vs-player activity. Face other Guardians, alone or with your fireteam, to gain XP and unique rewards including weapons and gear.

title: Lord Shaxx Reputation
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text: Play Onslaught and complete bounties and weekly quests to increase your reputation with Lord Shaxx.

title: Meet Lord Shaxx
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
"Ahh, another brave Guardian ready to test their might. The Crucible awaits!"



Lord Shaxx offers bounties, quests, and special rewards for competing in the Crucible.



The Crucible is a player-vs-player activity. Face other Guardians, alone or with your fireteam, to gain XP and unique rewards including weapons and gear.

title: Midnight Ride
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
Lord Shaxx greets you with a Cabal salute. "You look ready to join Valus Forge's forces," he says, gesturing to your new weapon. 



"The City's foundries are the best at what they do, but they're not the only weapons manufacturers out there. Those of us who've felt the business end of a Scorpius turret know that firepower has no allegiance." 



"That's why I insisted on refurbishing the Midnight Coup."  



"It's a perfect homage to our victory over Calus. A reminder to the Witness that, even armed with the best, his Disciples are no match for the Vanguard!" He thumps his breastplate with a meaty gauntlet for emphasis. 



"If you're interested in non-Human weaponry," he continues, "you should visit the Drifter. He's an expert on the matter, as he barely qualifies as Human himself!"

title: Path of Demolition
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text: "Magnificent! Thunderous! Sensational! Guardian, your performance brings a tear to my eye. Encore!" -Shaxx

title: Path of Demolition
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text: "The sound of steel tearing and fuel splattering! Music to my ears." -Shaxx

title: Path of Demolition
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
Shaxx waves you over to join him. He seems positively giddy.



"Come to join the fun, have you? Good! More is more, when crashing Brigs are involved!" He claps you on the shoulder, dropping his voice to a conspiratorial whisper. "Now, I believe explosions are their own reward. But a shiny new Sparrow wouldn't hurt, eh?"

title: Recluse Endangerment
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
Lord Shaxx takes your new weapon and ensures that the receiver is empty before peering down the sights. 



"Ahh, the submachine gun. When only a wall of bullets will do." 



"They were very popular during the Dark Age," he explains. "Maybe it was all the small-caliber ammunition left over from the Collapse. Or maybe people just had worse aim in those days!" 



"After Lightbearers had another century of training, precision fire rose in popularity." 



He hands the weapon back to you. "But like civilizations, weapon doctrines ebb and flow. After Ghaul kicked off the Red War, people realized that a wall of bullets is just the ticket against Cabal infantry."



"That particular model is close to my heart," the legendary Titan says, his voice softening. "I designed it long ago in honor of Sjur Eido, the former Queen's Wrath. Seeing it now gives me hope that perhaps I'll see her again someday." 



He snaps out of his reverie. "But first, we've got the small matter of an ontological telekinetic god to sort out! Let's see how the Witness deals with a generous helping of Void munitions, shall we?"

title: Patience and Forbearance
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
Shaxx regards the launcher in your hands with an uncharacteristic sense of solemnity. 



"You know, for a long time, weapons forged in the Darkness were shunned by Lightbearers," he explains. "Especially Pyramid souvenirs like Forbearance." 



He leans in conspiratorially. "Praxic pearl-clutching and all that." 



"But you showed us all that Darkness can be harnessed for good!" the Titan says, his boisterous demeanor returning. "And that true strength lies not with Light or Dark, but in the balance between them. Not even those Praxic fuddy-duddies can deny it now." 



"That's the spirit I used to design your new launcher," he declares. "A weapon of the Darkness, by the Darkness, AGAINST the Darkness!" 



"Now let's get out there and destroy the Witness with its own toys!"

title: Remembrance
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
Acceptance




        "We have all borne witness to your journey, Guardian. But I know you still have some things undone. Use this to finish what they started." -Lord Shaxx, to Josef

title: Right of Succession
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
"That's BrayTech you've got in your hands. Upgraded, of course. We've learned some things since that old monster's day." 



Shaxx pauses, then aims a gauntleted finger your way. 



"Here's a lesson for you: Facing the enemy doesn't mean facing them on their own terms. Especially if you haven't got the lives to spare. Plenty of Ghostless fighters favor sniper rifles- accuracy and power, at long range."



"The caliber and make differ, but a good sniper can always remove key threats from the battlefield, with or without the Light."



"And if you want to hear from a good sniper," Shaxx says, pointedly, "you'll want to talk to Devrim Kay. He's got enough experience with that rifle of his to make a Guardian proud."

title: Seasonal Rankings
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text: Shaxx, looking even more animated than usual, welcomes you to a new world of Valor and Glory-and encourages you to test your prowess in the newly ranked Crucible.

title: Spin to Win
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
Lord Shaxx throws up his hands in salutation as you approach. You heft the Falling Guillotine, and see its cruel gleam reflected in Shaxx's visor.



"Now THAT'S a sword!" he exclaims. "I remember the first time I saw a Guillotine. It was just after the Pyramid ships arrived in Sol."



"Of course," the Titan continues, "swords have always been part of the Lightbearer's arsenal, going all the way back to the Dark Age. But they fell out of style around the time the Last City was founded."



He lowers his voice and leans forward conspiratorially. "We were mostly fighting the Fallen in those days. People wanted a bit more range, I suppose."



"But blades are never long out of fashion," he says, admiring your weapon. "They had a renaissance during the Taken War. No more satisfying way to wade through a pack of Thralls, I say!" 



"Which reminds me: do pop in on Eris, won't you? After all, she put a Hive god to the blade herself just recently!" 



"Hmmm… I haven't had a proper go at a Hive god in an age."

title: Rubicund Wrap
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
Lord Shaxx takes your weapon and drapes a Crucible flag over it.



"All rituals begin somewhere, Guardian," he says. "Let this be ours."

title: Stranger Danger
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
"So, the Stranger's Rifle. One of them, at least." 



Perhaps Shaxx senses some confusion; he sighs and crosses his arms. 



"Each of these supposedly traces back to another of Elsie Bray's timelines. Exposed to forces we've never seen, tuned in unexpected ways. So says her sister, anyway." 



Shaxx shrugs his massive shoulders. 



"I never bothered with alternate realities, myself. But the Drifter has worked with Vex Chronometric tech before. And Ada-1 is a master of Golden Age weapon systems." 



"Between them, I think we have our bases covered. And now you reap the benefits of their experience."

title: Cleansed Essence of Greed
speaker: Lectern of Enchantment
text: The Lectern of Enchantment rumbles with energy and provides you with gear to fight against the Nightmares-and the Pyramid.

title: The Crucible
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
Welcome back.




        Now that you've had a taste of the Crucible, Shaxx is eager to see what you've really got. 



Each week, answer Shaxx's Call to Arms by completing matches in the Crucible to earn valuable rewards.

title: The Crucible
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
Now that you've had a taste of the Crucible, Shaxx is eager to see what you've really got. 



Each week, answer Shaxx's Call to Arms by completing matches in the Crucible to earn valuable rewards.

title: The Crucible
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
Lord Shaxx oversees the Crucible, a tournament that trains Guardians by pitting them against one another in friendly competition. Though the future of the Crucible was in doubt after the fall of the City, Shaxx is convinced that it is needed now more than ever. 



Complete matches in the Crucible to hone your skills against other players and earn rewards.

title: The Guardian Games
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
"Welcome to the Guardian Games," Lord Shaxx booms as you walk up to him. "We protect humanity not only because we were chosen to, but because we know it is right. These games will be a celebration of that duty. It almost doesn't matter who actually wins."



He lowers his voice. "Almost," he says. "Titans have a reputation to uphold. The Hunters will try to steal this from us if we don't stay on our toes." He leans back and crosses his arms again. "Wily as they are."

title: The Guardian Games
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
"The Guardian Games," Lord Shaxx booms as you walk up to him. "It was Zavala's idea, I believe. One of his better ones."



He studies you, unreadable as always behind his helmet. "We protect humanity not only because we were chosen to do it, but also because we know it is right," he says. "The Guardian Games will be a celebration of that duty. It almost doesn't matter who actually wins."

title: The Red Hat
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
"You've done well, Guardian!" Shaxx shouts. "It's my honor to bestow the Crucible colors on someone like you." 



"You've given us something to believe in: that the greatest Guardians are forged in the Crucible!"

title: The Red Hat
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
"Guardian!" Shaxx shouts as you approach.



"Banshee already told me about the deal, and I think it's brilliant!"



"We're living in complicated times," he says. "Sometimes people need something simple to believe in."



"And right now, that something is you-" he points to you, "taking that-" he points to your weapon, "down there!" he finishes, and jerks his thumb over his massive shoulder.



"Why are you still standing here? GET TO THE CRUCIBLE!"

title: Valor
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text: Compete in the Crucible. Earn armor and weapons at each rank, and powerful upgrades at major ranks.

title: Unnamed Interaction
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
Hey Guardian,




        Now I know why they call it the European Dead Zone. You killed everything!

title: Valor Rank: Legend
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text: Your efforts in the Crucible have become Legend. Time to begin your story anew.

title: Visit Lord Shaxx
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
"Are you ready to step up to the challenge, Guardian?"



Crucible bounties offer focused objectives for Guardians to complete while competing in Crucible playlists.



Select Crucible bounties from Lord Shaxx. Complete their objectives, then turn in the completed bounties to gain XP and rewards.

title: A Guardian Rises
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
"Ah, Shaw Han's savior arrives," Lord Shaxx says. He towers over you, standing proudly in front of the waving Crucible flags that adorn his workspace.



"You may have survived the Cosmodrome, Guardian, but your steel is not yet tempered."



He clasps his hands together.



"When you're ready for a real test, join your fellow Guardians in the Crucible. Only by pitting yourself against other Lightbearers can you truly forge yourself into the weapon you're meant to be."



You can now access the Triumphs menu. Triumphs are a collection of specific objectives to achieve within Destiny 2. Completing them contributes to your Triumph score, and sometimes grants additional rewards. Claim the item below to unlock this system.

title: Warlord Wisdom
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
You return to find Shaxx in uncharacteristically subdued spirits. He meets your arrival with a nod and a quiet admission:



"Always thought of myself as a Warlord. Even when the City Age came along and the Iron Lords drove the rest of them into extinction. I felt… out of place."



"I mastered every weapon I could get my hands on during the Dark Age. Under Lord Saladin's mentorship, I mastered myself. I came to terms-my own terms."



He brings up his hands and hammers a fist against his palm.



"Time tempers us like steel, Guardian. Seize every chance to learn, and you will emerge a glorious new weapon unto yourself."



"This city has seen a great deal since the Collapse, and its Guardians are better prepared than any Warlords. If the Witness wants war, we'll give it war."



Shaxx turns toward the tower courtyard, inclining his helmet. 



"Zavala is organizing operations, readying the tip of the spear. You should check in with him. You have the starring role."



"And Guardian… I admit, this training was mostly about giving you a look from my point of view. Weapons come easy. People, though… the real training is reckoning with potential loss."



"I hope you took the opportunity to look in on those you care about. If not? That's all right. Only some of them can die forever."

title: Welcome to Crimson Days
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text: As boisterous as ever, Shaxx speaks warmly (and loudly) of Crimson Days-and of his challenge to Guardians who choose to celebrate with him in the Crucible.

title: Constellation: Lock
speaker: Mara Sov
text:
"Petra has come to me with a report, straight from her Corsairs. An anomaly has appeared above the Dreaming City, and they are requesting input from any expert I may have. In this case, it seems you may be the likeliest expert."



Mara tips her head to you, acknowledgment only semi-ironic.



Visit the Dreaming City with Wish-Keeper to investigate the celestial anomaly.

title: Constellation: Pair
speaker: Mara Sov
text:
"There is so much about Riven that I never knew. It was our mutual role to be a keeper of secrets, of course. But still…"



Mara shakes her head lightly. "The Ley Lines still resonate, like a plucked string vibrating even after a musical instrument has been set down. My Techeuns have felt the appearance of another anomaly within the Black Garden. It will require a closer look."



Visit the Black Garden with Wish-Keeper to investigate the celestial anomaly.

title: Feats of Bravery
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
Shaxx asks for your help to defend the Last City:



"And so my favorite Guardian arrives," Shaxx intones. "Our borders are burning once again, thanks to the Witness. Nothing changes, including our need for you."



He seems to stare you in the eyes, his helmet expressionless, his broken horn silently spiteful. "This," he gestures to the armory around you, "is my personal vault. It's been refit to serve as the Hall of Champions, and your base of operations against the encroaching forces of the Witness."



"Crow awaits us beyond the shell of the Traveler. We've yet to hear from him. But if he lives, we must be ready to follow him through. And the Witness lies just beyond. In the meantime, you'll push our enemies out of our borders… and prepare for full scale war."



Shaxx points to the holographic weapon plinths lining the chamber. "I remember how to entice the Guardian psyche. I've prepared customized firearms and blades from my personal collection-once banned by the Vanguard, now reissued by necessity. Yours, if you earn them, in live-fire training against the forces of the Witness."



"We'll engage in anti-siege warfare against our enemies, in a multi-step regimen to have you master classical weaponry as you defeat our foes. And we'll make you an even better Guardian than you are."

He looks you up and down. 



"The Witness is doomed."

title: Constellation: Tower
speaker: Mara Sov
text:
Mara nods at you.



"Guardian. My Techeuns have felt the ripples of a celestial anomaly within the Black Garden. Some remnant of Riven's power, most likely. As the bearer of Wish-Keeper, it seems appropriate that you be the one to investigate."



Visit the Black Garden with Wish-Keeper to investigate the celestial anomaly.

title: Constellation: Wish
speaker: Mara Sov
text:
Mara looks into the distance. With reluctance, she says, "Riven and I built the Dreaming City together out of wish and will. We spun its skies into existence as partners, took pride in the timing of sunsets, the construction of years. An anomaly has appeared in those skies once again, and… I begin to ask myself new questions about that work."



Visit the Dreaming City with Wish-Keeper to investigate the celestial anomaly.

title: Forging the Broadsword
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
The End




        "Your old life is over, Redrix. This is different from your birth as an Exo and your rebirth as a Guardian. Now, you are an icon. Let that guide your future." -Lord Shaxx

title: Final Wish
speaker: Mara Sov
text:
Mara laments the state of the Dreaming City and its curse, laying the blame for it at Riven's feet.



The scrolls we recovered from Savathûn's Spire confirmed her greatest fear: the curse is unbreakable. Once granted, an Ahamkara's wish cannot be undone.



Mara dislikes Riven's bargain, but knows we have no other option. She tells us to cooperate with Riven for now while she thinks of a contingency plan.

title: Riven's Wishes I
speaker: Mara Sov
text:
Mara greets you with a pleased nod. 



"A challenge issued, accepted, and overcome. You have earned your first token-and the first of Riven's gifts." 



"May it grant you what you desire-and no more." 



She flashes you a small, amused smile. "Even our final wish to Riven may hold some unintended consequence. But there has never been much sense in seeking to tame the universe and all within it." 



"The world is as it is. And we do what we must to survive in it."

title: Riven's Wishes I
speaker: Mara Sov
text:
"Guardian.



"Riven's final moments afforded little time for last words, but we made prior arrangements. She was adamant that you be rewarded for your part in fulfilling her final request.



"To that end, she left me with instructions-a series of challenges, each to be rewarded with a token that will grant you a prize of your choosing. I have spent long hours examining the terms, trying to uncover any hidden treacheries woven into this… parting gift. But I found nothing. Perhaps Riven simply sought to bind you to her children through gratitude. She is no longer here to entice you into mercy.



"I cannot say for certain. Nonetheless, her bounty is here for you to claim, should you desire it."

title: Riven's Wishes II
speaker: Mara Sov
text:
Mara has few words for you upon your return. Your deeds-and the telltale odor of Queensfoil-speak for themselves. 



You have earned a Wish Token, and with it, another portion of Riven's wishes.

title: Riven's Wishes II
speaker: Mara Sov
text:
"Guardian. I have your instructions. I suspect you'll have had your fill of Queensfoil before you're through." 



Mara looks thoughtful. 



"I mourned the fate of the Dreaming City once before. But if its ultimate desolation is to be the cost of securing freedom for those within its walls, I would pay gladly.



"We may never see the likes of it again. At least, not constructed through the same means. And, I hope, not subject to the same follies.



"We live such long lives. Even the greatest wonders can become commonplace. Yet others are fleeting, there and gone-known to us only because we happened to be looking at the right moment." 



"Keep your eyes open, Guardian."

title: Riven's Wishes III
speaker: Mara Sov
text:
A simple gesture, a flicker of Light and Dark: the second token manifests in Mara's palm. 



"Your token-and with it, your reward.



"I have given further consideration to Riven's posthumous generosity. Tit for tat, ever to the last. As she might have said, is any prize ever as sweet as when it is hard-won?



"A dragon's mindset. But it has its time and place. Well fought, Guardian."

title: Riven's Wishes III
speaker: Mara Sov
text:
"Welcome back, Guardian.



"Riven would have you scour the Dreaming City, it seems. Her rewards await you, as before.



"Petra is out there, playing her role with renewed zeal. If there is an answer-a way to wrest our people from Dûl Incaru's grasp-then I have no doubt she will find it. But it will be a long battle.



"Something you're both all too familiar with. Good luck, Guardian."

title: Riven's Wishes IV
speaker: Mara Sov
text:
"Your next challenge awaits you in the Blind Well.



"The power of the Well is never to be taken lightly. As vital as it proved during our efforts to secure Riven's last clutch, it is just as capable of opening gateways to planes not even your Ghost could withstand.



"That is, if its use were not constrained by the mechanism that houses it. It's been calibrated for Guardians, after all. The risk is minimal."



There is a glint in Mara's eyes that suggests she may be teasing you. "Fight well."

title: Riven's Wishes V
speaker: Mara Sov
text:
"Riven has set you upon a hunt. A powerful enemy awaits you in the heart of Rheasilvia. Track it down, and claim your next token."



"I know Crow would have liked to help, if he could. I sense him still-like a distant vessel on a turbulent sea. Moving further and further away from us." 



Mara sighs. "You have your target, Guardian."

title: Riven's Wishes IV
speaker: Mara Sov
text:
As before, Mara conjures the Wish Token into her hand with an errant thought. 



"You play a game with an absent opponent. There might be power in even these small rituals, but nothing waits to feed upon it." 



"Yet we play on. In her memory."

title: Riven's Wishes VI
speaker: Mara Sov
text:
"I am glad to see Eris Morn so… rejuvenated as of late. It was through her that I learned of the Drifter's communications with the Nine. Portents and fictions alike.



"For this next challenge, you must survive a prophecy of Light and Dark… Riven must have thought it relevant.



"Walk with caution within the realms of the Nine. They are too… vast for simple allegiances."

title: Riven's Wishes V
speaker: Mara Sov
text:
"Only Riven could retain some portion of her will, when she was Taken. For all others, it is a cold, lonely death of the self. A foreign will burrows into the mind. Strangles thought; shapes volition."



"That is the curse that threatens to consume the Dreaming City every cycle." Mara looks down at the Wish Token in her hand.



"I won't forgive. But I will move forward."



"Take what you can from Riven's hoard, Guardian. Learn what lessons serve you best. Leave all the rest behind."

title: Riven's Wishes VI
speaker: Mara Sov
text:
"No more challenges await, Guardian. No bargains, no ultimatums. Here: Riven's final, parting gift, justly earned.



"I think Riven's gratitude, at least, was honest. No small thing, to earn the favor of a wish-dragon.



"I hope this inheritance is of use, even if only to please you. With all that lies ahead, sometimes the best gift we can ask for is a measure of peace."

title: Wishing All the Best
speaker: Mara Sov
text: Mara dislikes Riven's bargain but knows there are no other options. She tells you to cooperate with Riven for now while she thinks of a contingency plan.

title: Wishing All the Best
speaker: Mara Sov
text:
Mara cautions that the corrupted egg is in great danger, but there is a chance it can be saved. Three of her own Techeuns previously were cleansed of corruption.



"The effort and circumstances were extraordinary, but perhaps it can be done again."



Taken corruption feeds on itself. With luck, you may be able to find an object in the Ascendant Plane that can eat the egg's corruption and leave the egg whole.



Mara ends with a grim reminder: "If we fail here, Riven loses an egg; but we lose our path to the Witness, and all roads thereafter."

title: A Guardian Rises
speaker: Master Rahool
text:
"Greetings, Guardian," Master Rahool says. His attention does not shift from the datapad in his hand. "As the Tower's resident Crypto-Archeologist, I am ever at your service."



His tone is dry and flat, and he does not look at you.



"Bring me any engrams you find, and I will decrypt their matter into a usable state, and hopefully learn something interesting in the process."



You can now access the Seasons menu. Seasons last for a certain period of time, and provide a variety of rewards as you gain experience. Claim the item below to unlock this system.

title: A Guardian Rises
speaker: Master Rahool
text:
"Greetings, Guardian," Master Rahool says. His attention does not shift from the datapad in his hand. "As the Tower's resident crypto-archeologist, I am ever at your service."



His tone is dry and flat, and he does not look at you.



"Bring me any engrams you find, and I will decrypt their matter into a usable state and hopefully learn something interesting in the process."

title: Wishing All the Best
speaker: Mara Sov
text:
"It's no small feat, the things you've helped accomplish today." 



In securing Riven's clutch, you have averted the annihilation of a species. 



"Riven was never truly an ally, but common cause aligned us in a way I had not anticipated. Relying on her was a risk, true." 



"But there was a time when the Vanguard was averse to trusting me as well." 



"Trust is dangerous, risky, vulnerable. But to trust is to hope, and what is life without it?" 



Hope, she says, is what separates us from the Witness. 



"Expunge the Vex from the dreaming halls while Osiris prepares the Veil to forge a bridge to my brother. This will allow you to lead a strike force into the Traveler's Pale Heart and rendezvous with Crow."



"From there, it will be the fight of your lives. Steel yourself… You fight for all of us."

title: Dawning Delivery
speaker: Master Rahool
text: Rahool's mouth tightens at your approach, but he is polite enough as he accepts the gift.

title: Dawning's Gift: Rahool
speaker: Master Rahool
text: Rahool frowns at the engram-shaped chunk of rock, but he chuckles after a second. It's clear he appreciates the jab.

title: Filled Stamp Card
speaker: Master Rahool
text:
Rahool beams as he adds the final stamp to your card.



"You've done me a great service, Guardian. I've collected enough data now that I can decipher brand new patterns for you. Take a look, see if there's anything you'd like to try."



He opens his focusing catalog, sliding it towards you.

title: Bounty Season
speaker: Master Rahool
text:
"Hello, Guardian! The changing of the seasons offers many strange, new opportunities. Treasures and unknown wonders await those who face our enemies and triumph over the challenges that lurk in the wilds."



Completing bounties and challenges earns you XP. Gaining XP levels up your Season Pass to unlock new rewards.

title: Focused Decrypting
speaker: Master Rahool
text:
Master Rahool, dedicated Tower Cryptarch, holds out a shadowy engram. Hissing strands of Darkness lick off its surface as you peer into its swirling depths.



"Welcome, Guardian. This is an Umbral Engram," he says, "capable of granting unmatched rewards… if one knows how to focus its contents."



He tells you the War Table is capable of focusing Umbral Engrams through a series of lenses and suggests you try focusing one yourself.



"A skilled Cryptarch-and I humbly consider myself in that category-is certainly capable of simply opening an Umbral Engram for you. However, their mysterious contents remain in flux, and I would be remiss if I did not suggest trying to focus one before you hand it over to me."



He graciously hands you the Umbral Engram.



Focus Umbral Engrams to choose their contents at the War Table in the H.E.L.M.

title: Lost Stamp Card
speaker: Master Rahool
text:
Master Rahool greets you warmly. You dig through your pockets for your stamp card but can't find it.



Luckily, he doesn't seem to mind. "Don't worry, Guardian. I'll get you another card." He holds one out for you. It's new, but somehow already wrinkled.



"As usual, keep decrypting to earn stamps. Once you have enough stamps, I'll have enough data to grant you access to more advanced decryption techniques."

title: Decrypt Engrams
speaker: Master Rahool
text: A Cryptarch can decrypt complex engrams into powerful gear and other items.

title: Engram Ensiders
speaker: Master Rahool
text: Focusing and decrypting powerful gear grants reputation. Earning ranks grants enhancement materials, and eventually, new Exotic focusing avenues.

title: Focused Decrypting
speaker: Master Rahool
text:
Master Rahool, dedicated Tower Cryptarch, holds out a shadowy engram. Hissing strands of Darkness lick off its surface as you peer into its swirling depths.



"Welcome, Guardian. This is an Umbral Engram," he says, "capable of granting unmatched rewards… if one knows how to focus its contents."



He tells you the Star Chart is capable of focusing Umbral Engrams through a series of lenses and suggests you try focusing one yourself.



"A skilled Cryptarch-and I humbly consider myself in that category-is certainly capable of simply opening an Umbral Engram for you. However, their mysterious contents remain in flux, and I would be remiss if I did not suggest trying to focus one before you hand it over to me."



He graciously hands you the Umbral Engram.



Focus Umbral Engrams to choose their contents at the Star Chart in the H.E.L.M.

title: Master Ra-ghoul
speaker: Master Rahool
text:
"Cryptarchs are always looking to the past," Rahool says. "Forgotten knowledge, languages, meaning: We revive the things others believe to be lost. This festival feels very personal to me, to my work."



He looks up from his tablet. "Enjoy the celebration. And remember, Guardian: Forgotten things need not remain that way."

title: Prime Example
speaker: Master Rahool
text:
Prime Engrams decrypt into a piece of gear that can provide a larger increase to your power level than some other engrams.



They are acquired by defeating challenging combatants or completing Crucible matches while you have the Prime Attunement buff.



Check for the buff on your Character Screen to see when a new one is available to discover.

title: Prime Example
speaker: Master Rahool
text:
Rahool barely looks up from his datapad as you approach.



"Engrammic computation is the process of encrypting matter as data. I don't think I can go into more detail than that without some supplementary reading on your part, but suffice to say that engrams are quite valuable to Guardians like you. Who knows what treasures of days gone by lay waiting to be unsequenced?"



For a moment, his dour countenance breaks and he smiles giddily, but he promptly clears his throat and furrows his brow.



"The Cryptarchy is at your service to continue your education in engrammatic sciences, and to aid with decryption. I look forward to what you bring me next, Guardian."

title: Rahool's Rewards Program
speaker: Master Rahool
text:
As you stroll through the Tower, Rahool waves you over.



"Guardian," he calls, "I have been meaning to thank you. The data we have been able to recover over the years has been invaluable to rebuilding the archives. I know you have a lot of options for cryptarchs here in the Tower, and I hope you know that your loyalty has not gone unnoticed."



You've never seen another cryptarch here, but before you can ask about them, he barrels onward.



"I know, I know. Words without action are only so much bluster. But I have something special for you," he says, reaching into his pocket, "I've been working on a new technique for focusing the results of exotic engrams. Now, I wouldn't do this for just anyone who asked. But for a loyal client like yourself…"



Rahool produces a small and battered card, handing it over to you with a flourish.

title: Prime Example
speaker: Master Rahool
text:
Speak to Master Rahool in the Tower.




        In an effort to further the goals of the Cryptarchy, Master Rahool asks for your devotion. In exchange, he shares with you a Prime Engram, which decrypts to a piece of powerful gear.



Each day you will gain the Prime Attunement buff, which gives you a chance to find more Prime Engrams by defeating challenging enemies or completing Crucible matches.

title: Relics of the Golden Age
speaker: Master Rahool
text: "Interesting, Guardian. Very interesting. And marked with signatures from... hmm. In this case, I believe this to be beyond even my understanding. My colleague, Tyra Karn, may be able to set you on your path. Give her my regards. Won't you?" -Cryptarch Rahool

title: Prime Example
speaker: Master Rahool
text:
In an effort to further the goals of the Cryptarchy, Master Rahool asks for your devotion. In exchange, he shares with you a Prime Engram, which decrypts to a piece of powerful gear.



Each day you will gain the Prime Attunement buff, which gives you a chance to find more Prime Engrams by defeating challenging enemies or completing Crucible matches.

title: Reshaping the Enigma
speaker: Master Rahool
text:
"Ascendant Alloys, curious…" Master Rahool looks up from his research.



"These are rare materials that only manifest in specific areas of conflict. While Banshee and I can provide this material to Guardians, our supplies are quite limited. If you need larger quantities of these Alloys, you will need to seek out these conflict zones."



• Ascendant Alloys can be purchased in limited quantities from Banshee-44 and Master Rahool in the Tower.



• These Alloys also can be acquired from weekly campaign missions in the Throne World, and from the Wellspring activity in the Throne World.

title: Return to the Cryptarch
speaker: Master Rahool
text:
"You have weathered the trials and tribulations of another season, Guardian, with a Gate Lord's Eye as your prize. To celebrate, I offer you this small token of my admiration. But know this: Seasons change and new wonders await."



Continue to complete bounties and challenges as you aid allies and explore destinations. Your victories will reap amazing new rewards.

title: Return to the Cryptarch
speaker: Master Rahool
text:
"The final step is up to you, Guardian. The bounties you hunt and the challenges you endure will lead you to your goal. Don't let up. Each new experience will move you closer to your ultimate reward."



Continue engaging in bounties and challenges to gain XP and advance your Season Pass rank. Reaching Rank 7 will give access to a powerful artifact, the Gate Lord's Eye.



Once unlocked, acquire the Gate Lord's Eye from the Season Pass page in the Director.

title: Return to the Cryptarch
speaker: Master Rahool
text:
"The season ebbs and flows-day-to-day, week-to-week. Work with your allies here in the Tower and beyond to maintain vigilance against all that threatens us."



Bounties can be found in the Tower and on other destinations. Acquire and complete weekly bounties to gain even more rewards and XP to level up your Season Pass.

title: Return to the Cryptarch
speaker: Master Rahool
text:
"You've just begun to discover all the changing seasons can provide. Further your exploration. Expand your horizons. Your allies out in the wilds want for your… talents. Aid them, and you will find the experience rewarding."



Completing daily bounties is a good way to gain XP. Acquire and complete bounties provided by the vendors on any destination to gain XP and level up your Season Pass.

title: Seasonal Focusing
speaker: Master Rahool
text:
Rahool is pleased to hear of your natural gift for focusing Umbral Engrams.



"Well done, Guardian," he says. "I'm glad the secrets of the engrams speak to you, and I hope you will use their power wisely."



He tells you he will be honored to decipher any engram you bring him, though he does not promise results as potent as those you could find by focusing at the War Table.



"I look forward to what puzzles you may bring," he says.

title: Return to the Cryptarch
speaker: Master Rahool
text:
"You will need to challenge yourself if you wish to progress at a rate in-step with your ambitions, Guardian. Travel the system and embrace the dangers that mark our lost worlds."



There are challenges in the world that give great rewards. Visit any destination and engage in a weekly challenge to gain XP and level up your Season Pass.

title: Speak to the Cryptarch
speaker: Master Rahool
text:
"Well now, Guardian… Your Power increases, but I can see you're not done yet. There are more battles to be won… More lost frontiers to explore and more secrets to uncover."



Now, you can increase your Power level only by acquiring powerful gear. Continue to seek these treasures by completing challenges, decrypting Prime Engrams, and testing your might in pinnacle activities such as raids.



Keep pushing the limits of your strength, and you will continue to grow even more formidable.

title: Twitch Bounty Reward: Gifting Subs
speaker: Master Rahool
text: When we witness greatness, we spread the word so that others can marvel in it with us.

title: Seasonal Focusing
speaker: Master Rahool
text:
Rahool is pleased to hear of your natural gift for focusing Umbral Engrams.



"Well done, Guardian," he says. "I'm glad the secrets of the engrams speak to you, and I hope you will use their power wisely."



He tells you he will be honored to decipher any engram you bring him, though he does not promise results as potent as those you could find by focusing at the Star Chart.



"I look forward to what puzzles you may bring," he says.

title: The Guardian Games
speaker: Master Rahool
text:
"The Guardian Games," Rahool muses. "I've never known Zavala to be so… enthusiastic about a holiday." He glances up at the sky toward the Almighty's looming silhouette. "Especially at a time like this."



He meets your gaze again. "But then, if we put our lives on hold during every crisis, we would never live, would we?"

title: Twitch Bounty Reward: Match Reactions
speaker: Master Rahool
text: We watch. We learn. We improve.

title: Unlimited Power
speaker: Master Rahool
text:
"Part of every Guardian's journey is the path to unmatched Power. Seek out and equip more powerful gear to increase the limits of your strength, Guardian!"



Your Power level will increase as you equip your Guardian with more powerful gear.



Earn powerful gear and engage in activities with pinnacle rewards by completing the "Unlimited Power" quest offered by the Cryptarch.

title: Twitch Bounty Rewards: Cheers
speaker: Master Rahool
text: By supporting our fellow Guardians, we support humanity's survival.

title: The Territory War Begins
speaker: Mechanic Deoriks
text:
The Pikers' quartermaster Deoriks beckons you over with a confiding air.



"You know us, Guardian. Do you want the frontier run by a military force with Imperium ties? Or a bunch of soup that likes to gamble? Pikers are the only answer."



She leans in. "Listen, Riliks is a weird one, but they've got vision. I've never regretted joining up. I'll take this gang over any House you could name. 



"We've got the best tech, the best perks, and-let's be honest here-the best company. Ride with the Pikers, Guardian. You won't regret it."

title: Earn Reputation
speaker: Mechanic Deoriks
text: Deposit Dark Matter Ingots at the Pikers War Chest to earn Reputation with this Syndicate. Earn Renegade Abilities, Praxic Blade modifications, gear, and currency.

title: Renegades
speaker: Mechanic Deoriks
text:
Deoriks flags you down with a wave of a datapad.



"You're the Guardian Vixis has been talking to? Well, I guess if you're helping him out, you're all right for a Lightbearer," she says.



"You ever ride a Pike? A Falcon's like that, but more. I can list every component we use in 'em and where we get 'em, but I don't want to keep you when you've got Imperium goons to squash.



"Remember-if you're not scared you're about to crash, you're not going fast enough."

title: Alone in the Dark
speaker: Micah's Conduit
text: A gift for your efforts.

title: Convalescence: Budding
speaker: Micah's Conduit
text:
"Good work as usual, Guardian," Micah says when you return. "I can already tell you've done as much as you can. At this point, it looks like we'll need to deal with the main act-the Witness-before we can make any more difference. Fixing holes only works for so long when the Witness is busy making new ones by the moment, you know." 



Her tone is somberly hopeful-much relies on the capability to defeat the Witness and drive it from the Traveler, but if that can be accomplished then the future will be bright.

title: Weekly Shipments
speaker: Mechanic Deoriks
text:
Mechanic Deoriks waves you over, a stack of datapads heaped precariously in the crook of one elbow.



"Good news, latest shipment's just in. Riliks told me to reserve a portion of it for you in thanks for your efforts last week. Spider's holding onto it for you."



She clacks her mandibles. "Don't love Spider getting his greasy hands on our stuff, but Riliks says we gotta pick our battles sometimes. And in this case, victory is meditating on the lovely warm memory of Spider's barge exploding."

title: Convalescence: Full Flower
speaker: Micah's Conduit
text:
"Talk about addressing the source of a problem directly, huh?" Micah says. There's nothing quite like uprooting a weed. "Good job. You and I both know the work's never done… but I think you can take a moment to feel proud."



If the surroundings are any judge, the Traveler is also feeling better. Some things might not be mendable, but it's clear that having ended the Witness entirely has made a huge difference. However the Traveler heals and grows in the future, this one great thorn has been plucked out.



Micah says she's going to be sticking around in the Pale Heart-to learn, to help, to grow for herself. She's come to understand some new things while she's been here and is looking forward to more. She might not be right here all the time, but that's the nature of a Hunter, after all.



"See you around, Guardian," she says. "The Six Coyotes know your name."

title: Convalescence: Budding
speaker: Micah's Conduit
text:
"Hang on a moment," Micah says. "Oh darling, that's a huge data swap-" 



She takes a moment to sort through the information she's receiving from Differential Calculus, the healed Ghost. The data looks promisingly revelatory on a first analysis: the Traveler is hurt by what the Witness has done to it, and all of the lost Ghosts have been trying to help it, in their way-seeking out dangerous places to get closer to the Traveler. 



The instinct is sound. Revitalizing the connection between Ghost and Traveler helps both, although the scale of the Traveler is much greater than any single Ghost. There's still a long road ahead: if the Traveler even CAN be healed completely.



But there is a duty, held by Micah-10 and the Ghosts she shepherds, to do everything in their power to help. And they'd welcome your continuing assistance. "Keep up the good work," Micah-10 says. She has a bigger picture mission in mind: tackling the Witness's influence directly while she works to track other missing Ghosts.

title: Convalescence: Greenery
speaker: Micah's Conduit
text:
"Nicely done, Guardian," Micah says. She's seen the effects of your efforts out in the Pale Heart, and she's impressed, optimistic for the future.



There's still more to be done. Micah mentions Ulan-Tan, a historical Warlock with theories about Light and Darkness which were considered dangerous at the time. All Light was part of itself, he had concluded: Ghosts connected to Guardians connected to the Traveler, inextricably tied together. Micah thinks-maybe-that the problem with this damaged Ghost is that they've been disconnected from the Traveler in some way and forced to rely only on their own Light.



She's found some places, deep in the Pale Heart, that she thinks are as close to the Traveler's unfiltered essence as you can possibly get. Maybe there you can join this Ghost's Light with the Traveler's again. And even if that doesn't help, you'll still know more than you did before.



"No harm, no foul," Micah says, though she'd clearly prefer the idea works. The slow process of eliminating what doesn't work isn't ideal for situations like these. "Sending you one of the locations I've dug up now."

title: Convalescence: Greenery
speaker: Micah's Conduit
text:
"Guardian," Micah says when the feed opens again. "I can tell already something has changed for the better. I'm processing the readings now. Give me a moment, but early prognosis is very, very hopeful." 



It's taken hard work to get to this point, and there's a note of tangible relief in her voice as she talks. Relief for her charge, and for what it may mean for the future. "Thank you," she says. "Let's keep it up."

title: Convalescence: Rootbound
speaker: Micah's Conduit
text:
The fissure of Light brightens slightly in response to the Ghost's presence. Motes of Light well up and drift toward the damaged Ghost you carry, like dandelion seeds floating in the wind. Micah's machinery whirrs into high gear, analyzing what it can of the patterns in the Traveler's Light.



However, the damaged Ghost looks far from healed…

title: Convalescence: Underbrush
speaker: Micah's Conduit
text:
"Good news, bad news," Micah says, clearly putting a brave face on things. It's a little of both. It would have been nice to find this lost Ghost in perfect condition, but at least they're alive.



The trouble is that it's difficult to know how to help. Simply exposing this Ghost to the Traveler's Light didn't seem to do anything immediately, but the Pale Heart is full of wonders. The line to Micah crackles as she hums in thought.



"Heal one, heal the other, maybe?" she says eventually. It's hard to miss that the Traveler's as hurt as this Ghost is, even if it's in a different way. The growth in the Arbor suggests you're on the right track, but not enough yet. Micah asks you to make a sweep around the Pale Heart, looking for things out of the ordinary-concentrations of Light that beg to be freed, or especially virulent servants of the Witness attacking vulnerable places.



It's just a hunch. But it's the best you've got, and this Ghost is counting on your help.

title: Convalescence: Underbrush
speaker: Micah's Conduit
text:
The Light from the Traveler surrounds you, and something seems different when you bring the damaged Ghost to the fissure of Light. 



Even this may not be enough. However, this time when you examine the Ghost, you see something more: echoes of a corrupting touch, silhouetted against the Traveler's Light. Perhaps this is the true nature of the injury.

title: Destined Heroes
speaker: Micah's Conduit
text:
The console has been hastily, but cleverly, rigged for communications. When you approach, it flickers to life.



Micah-10 tells you about her mission to find and save unpartnered Ghosts. They returned to help the Traveler as soon as they could, but the Witness's infection caused chaos. They need help.



The console's interface shows an area of the Pale Heart that Micah has marked. She says she's receiving telemetry from a Ghost in the area, but it must be damaged; the signal is unclear. You'll need to search to find it.



She also says that some of the Ghosts have helped scout safe zones within the Pale Heart. You should be able to use them as LZs to travel more efficiently.

title: Purification
speaker: Micah's Conduit
text: The Arbor of Light extends its gratitude to you.

title: The Ascendant
speaker: Micah's Conduit
text:
"Welcome back, I've got another Ghost telemetry for you." Micah is eager to get to work. "This time, it's Akasha. She's an unpartnered Ghost that has been systematically scanning Awoken territory for years."



Micah brings up a map of the Dreaming City on the display. "I got a lock on her beacon in the Dreaming City, probably still trying to find her Guardian. I need you to head out and find Akasha and bring her back safe and sound."



"I look forward to your return."

title: The Desperation
speaker: Micah's Conduit
text:
"I've been observing the energy coming from the Traveler, and… it's not good." Micah can't hide her worry. 



"While we've been doing everything we can to heal the Traveler, the Witness's push to complete the final shape hasn't slowed."



"I'm sending you to find Hecate, a scholar in Hive lore who once studied under Toland, the Shattered and Eris Morn," Micah explains. "Hecate was investigating a rumor that members of House Dusk were trying to ally with Hive broods in the Cosmodrome. The House of Devils have been gone for a long time, though. There has to be something else going on." 



"Good hunting, Guardian."

title: The Ascendant
speaker: Micah's Conduit
text:
"So this is interesting…" Micah trails off for a moment as she reads your report. "Akasha returned some analytics from her scans of the Dreaming City's Ley Lines, and it's troubling. There's Hive activity surging through the Ascendant Plane. Xivu Arath's brood. And as far as I can tell, she's a no-show here."



A thought crosses Micah's mind. "Which means she's cut her losses from the Witness. But that also means she's planning something else…"



"If we make it out of this alive, I've got a bad feeling there'll be another war waiting for us on the horizon. Nothing we can do about that right now, though," she notes with a hint of resignation. 



"Get back out there. One apocalypse at a time."



This quest reward can be accepted on only one character, but armor is unlocked for all three classes when this quest is completed.

title: The Desperation
speaker: Micah's Conduit
text:
"Hecate is back with us, and not a moment too soon," Micah says, tension evident in her voice. The end is approaching.



"The Vanguard are rallying our forces together for the final push. I've sent Hecate out to aid with healing the Traveler, but… there's not much time left. I can feel the tension escalating to a breaking point. I can feel the universe cracking under the strain." Micah grows silent.



"The final shape is upon us, and I can only pray that we've done enough to fight back against it." For a moment, that feels like the end. But then, with a hint of hope in her voice, Micah offers one final benediction:



"Eyes up, Guardian."

title: The Hellmouth
speaker: Micah's Conduit
text:
Micah has telemetry on another unpartnered Ghost. "Your next target is Link, a member of a covert team of unpartnered Ghosts called the Watchful Eye."



With worry in her voice she explains, "His last known location was roughly in the area of the Ocean of Storms on the Moon. But he may have moved on by now."



Go to the Moon and pick up Link's trail.

title: The Hellmouth
speaker: Micah's Conduit
text:
"The final shape spreading to the moon isn't a surprise. But that it's hitting the Hive as hard as anyone else?" Micah sighs. "I guess there really is nowhere safe. No promise or allegiance that can save you."



"But ah, one thing at a time, I guess. I'll let you know when I know more."

title: The Illusion
speaker: Micah's Conduit
text:
"I found the general location of Heilung. She's another member of the Watchful Eye," Micah explains, short and to the point.



"Turns out, Heilung was sent on a long-term recon operation inside Savathûn's throne world," she admits with some surprise. "But that was over a year ago. There's been no contact with Heilung since, and I don't know what to expect. The Hidden provided me with her last known coordinates.

We'll have to start there and see what we can find."

title: The Illusion
speaker: Micah's Conduit
text:
Micah bristles with frustration. "If what Heilung has already told me is correct, Savathûn has aligned her brood against the Witness… but she's hedging her bets. She has some other plan in the works, something she intends to pursue after the Witness is defeated. She thinks its defeat is inevitable. I should be inspired by that vote of confidence, but coming from her? Nah."



"I'll let you know when I have more Ghost telemetry to follow up on, Guardian." Then, with a warmth in her voice she adds, "Great work out there."

title: The Oracle
speaker: Micah's Conduit
text:
"So I found telemetry for Bean." There's a hint of mirth in Micah's tone. "He's a handful, always rushing off into hostile territory. He and I tend to cross paths on remote scouting missions, so the fact that his beacon pinged from Nessus shouldn't surprise me."



For a moment, Micah is quiet. Then, fondly, she says, "But that's what I like about him. No fear, no hesitation. Bean just plows through. We need that kind of energy here."



"Go make sure he didn't get caught in a temporal loop or some other Vex nonsense," Micah says with a laugh. "I'll keep an eye on things here."

title: The Past
speaker: Micah's Conduit
text:
"Mars." Micah says it like a curse. "Of course Citrine would be on Mars."



There's a mixture of wryness and frustration in Micah's voice. "She's been obsessed with Warmind hardware for a long time. I don't know how many times Ana had to tell her she wasn't going to build her a combat frame to ride in. Just so she could 'have arms to beat a Hive with.'"



All humor aside, Micah gets down to business. "Citrine means well, but we need her here. Be careful out there, Guardian. "

title: The Past
speaker: Micah's Conduit
text:
"Citrine is so sweet. She profusely apologized for her delay in arrival… and tried to hide the fact that she was stripping the Warmind bunker for parts," Micah says with a laugh.



"I'm putting her with a patrol of Ghosts to help expunge the Witness's corruption and she's taken right to it. And with any luck, she'll put her analytical mind to expediting the process."



"Good work out there, Guardian. I'll let you know when I find another Ghost."

title: The Return
speaker: Micah's Conduit
text:
"We've got a lot to do before we can strike at the Witness." Micah-10 is eager to add to the combined efforts of the coalition.



"I think it'll be the smaller, more humble kind of reinforcement that wins the day," she adds, recruiting you to track down unpartnered Ghosts that can help treat the wounds of the Traveler.



Your first target is Peach, a wayward Ghost last seen in the Cosmodrome on Earth. Track Peach down and bring her home.

title: The Oracle
speaker: Micah's Conduit
text:
"I'm glad you were able to rescue Bean, he's going to be a great asset to healing the Traveler," Micah says with relief.



"I can't help but be worried about what you found while searching for him. I thought the Psion defectors sided with the Witness…" She falls silent in thought. "But it's looking more and more like that may be a deception."



Micah lowers her voice in suspicion. "There's something else going on here. Something we're going to have to tackle head-on in the future, if we're lucky."

title: The Return
speaker: Micah's Conduit
text:
"Peach was lucky to get out of that situation with only a few dents and dings." Micah's relief is tempered by uncertainty. "The world outside of the Pale Heart is transforming… We've got no room for error now. I'll get Peach set up in a cleansing team here in the Pale Heart." 



"I'll contact you when I have telemetry on another Ghost. Stay safe, Guardian."



This quest reward can only be accepted on one character, but armor is unlocked for all three classes when this quest is completed.



Return to Ghost in the Pale Heart to decrypt or focus engrams on another class.

title: The Shadows
speaker: Micah's Conduit
text:
"The final shape has reached Earth." Micah is weary. "We're running out of time."



With a sigh, Micah continues. "I knew we might reach this point eventually, but seeing it is something else entirely. But we're not ready to move against the Witness. The Traveler isn't ready. Though… we may not have time. But we only get one shot at defeating the Witness. We have to make it our best."



This quest reward can only be accepted on one character, but armor is unlocked for all three classes when this quest is completed.

title: The Veiled
speaker: Micah's Conduit
text:
"I have Ghost telemetry for you, but a word of warning on this one." Micah sighs. "Anwar is a Ghost who has been through a lot. He was once a close confidant of the Speaker. After the Speaker died, Anwar started to question his connection to the Light, and began to seek the truth about Darkness."



"Anwar believes the Darkness is an intrinsic, universal force that must be tended to like a garden, lest it grow unruly. Do not let Anwar's beliefs cast a shadow of doubt on his allegiances. He is an unwavering ally, but one who questions everything."



"His telemetry data leads me to believe he may be inside the Pyramid on Europa," Micah says with a wary tone. "I don't know what you'll find there. Be safe, Guardian."

title: The Veiled
speaker: Micah's Conduit
text:
"I've… never told anyone this, but I knew Cayde. Before he was a Guardian. Before I was a Guardian," Micah confesses in a moment of grief over Anwar's death.



She speaks of their time together on Europa before the Collapse, and how she found out about this past by performing a Guardian taboo: researching her own past.



"Cayde doesn't remember. And… that's okay. What matters is that I'm here. That he's here. That somehow, in the face of all this loss and hopelessness… we found each other. I can hug him, one last time… and remind him that he was missed."



"That he saved me."



This quest reward can only be accepted on one character, but armor is unlocked for all three classes when this quest is completed.

title: The Visitation
speaker: Micah's Conduit
text:
"Guardian, I have telemetric data for the Ghost Balthazar." Micah is eager to get to work. "He's an old friend of Peach, the first Ghost you recruited."



With seriousness, she adds, "Balthazar is a scholar like Anwar, but usually not as daring in field work. Which makes my discovery of his telemetric data on the moon all the more concerning."



"If Balthazar has gone to the moon he must have good reason, but we need him here. We need every ghost we can find." Micah says with urgency. There is little time left.



"Please, bring him back, and make sure he's safe."

title: The Visitation
speaker: Micah's Conduit
text:
"I know Anwar's death weighs heavily on Balthazar," Micah explains. "He will heal, in time, as the Traveler will. Perhaps in their shared healing, Balthazar will find new spiritual connections to the Traveler too."



There is relief in Micah's voice. "Thank you, Guardian. As soon as I've pinned down another Ghost's location, I'll contact you."



This quest reward can only be accepted on one character, but armor is unlocked for all three classes when this quest is completed.

title: Armed and Dangerous
speaker: Nimbus
text:
"The Witness is still out there," Nimbus says, looking out across the city with uncharacteristic seriousness, "but we're not going down without a fight. What we've done here will help us in the days to come. I'm sure of it."



Their smile returns in full force, and they wink at you. "So go on, Guardian! Put some of these shiny, explosive new toys to use."



As a reward for completing the Legendary campaign, you have received powerful gear to help in the battles to come.

title: The Shadows
speaker: Micah's Conduit
text:
"Some Ghosts have searched for centuries for their Guardian. I know yours did," Micah-10 says with an unseen smile in her voice. 



"The unpartnered Ghost Dejana was last seen in the EDZ investigating Taken activity. Hopefully we can find her quick."



"Come back in one piece, okay?"

title: Bluejay
speaker: Nimbus
text:
"Bluejay, huh? That's a heck of a story." Nimbus grins. "Jain had serious problems with authority. Makes me look like an Academy drill instructor by comparison. Big brain, though, and an even bigger heart. Once he learned to actually listen to others, he went from public enemy to public hero. Eventually became a Cloud Strider."



"The Cloud Striders maintain the original sim space he built way back when. It's technically in the VexNet, so we use it like a listening post. Problem is, with everything going on, it's full of Vex. Locked with a quadrinomial encryption sequence too. Nasty stuff. You'd need a Polymorphic Engine to crack it. And a ton of their Shellcode samples."



They pat you on the shoulder. "This is the part where I tell you to stay away. 'It's too dangerous.' But neither of us would believe it coming from me."



Destroy Vex and gather their Shellcode Fragments to continue bonding with this legacy.

title: Cloud Strider
speaker: Nimbus
text:
Nimbus beams as you approach, clapping you on the shoulder. "Well, well, well! If it isn't the hero of the hour!" 



Not even the remaining threats to the city can dim their enthusiasm, it seems. Their smile turns wry as they look out over Neomuna.



"Job's not done yet. But it's easier to shoulder the burden with a helping hand. And I'm glad it's yours."



You have completed the Legendary campaign. Please select your reward.

title: Earn Reputation
speaker: Nimbus
text: Complete bounties, patrols, public events, Lost Sectors, Terminal Overload runs, replayable campaign missions, Partition activities, secrets, and open chests in Neomuna to increase your Neomuna rank and earn rewards.

title: Dawning Delivery
speaker: Nimbus
text:
"Hey, Guardian. Is that a Neomun-Pie that I spy?!" Nimbus asks as you hand them a delicious Neomun-Pie.



"Did you… bake this yourself? REALLY?! That's amazing! Never had a 'home cooked' Neomun-Pie before though. I bet it's better than the ones in the vending receptacles."



As Nimbus munches on the Neomun-Pie you hear a muffled, "Thank you, Guardian, you rock! Happy Dawning!"

title: From Zero…
speaker: Nimbus
text:
While Nimbus supports going on the offense, they caution you not to forget the ordinary people caught in the crossfire.



The people of Neomuna are skeptical of Earth's Warlords, and they're caught between dual assaults from the Shadow Legion and Vex. Nimbus has some ideas for how you can tackle both problems at once.



Complete tasks to bolster the city's defenses and improve relations between Earth and Neomuna.

title: Grandstrand
speaker: Nimbus
text: As a reward for completing the Legendary campaign, you have received Strand Meditations to help in the battles to come.

title: From Zero…
speaker: Nimbus
text: "Y'know, word in the CloudArk is, there's someone from Earth running around the city. Except they aren't a Warlord trying to take over, they're a Guardian here to help and kick butt. How about that, huh?" -Nimbus

title: Legacy: Lightfall
speaker: Nimbus
text:
Calus beat us to the Veil and secured it on behalf of the Witness. Luckily, its containment infrastructure should delay their efforts, at least for a little while. Based on Ghost's strange experience, it appears Calus intends to use a device called the Radial Mast to link the Veil with the Traveler.



Whatever the Witness wants, this can't be good. With Calus's forces focused on the Veil containment, Osiris wants us to hit Calus's fortress directly and take out this Radial Mast before it is moved closer to the Veil. Even despite Rohan's concerns.



Nimbus recommends you check in with Rohan and Osiris at the Hall of Heroes before moving on to mission "Downfall."

title: Legacy: Lightfall
speaker: Nimbus
text:
Death is part of a Cloud Strider's lot. Nimbus knows this, but that doesn't make Rohan's early exit any easier to accept. 



Still, he made every moment count; by destroying the Radial Mast, Rohan wrecked the Witness's plan for creating a link with the Veil.



But that doesn't mean the war is over. Calus is sure to retaliate-and it looks like his sights are set on the CloudArk. 



There's no time to mourn now. The best way to honor Rohan is to get Neomuna's defense systems up and running again.



You might check in with Osiris and Caiatl in the Hall of Heroes before jumping back into the fray. 



Complete the strike "HyperNet Current" in Neomuna.

title: Legacy: Lightfall
speaker: Nimbus
text:
You power-cycled the CloudArk-the tech built off the Veil that keeps all Neomuni citizens linked in their virtual infrastructure. With the CloudArk back online, they'll be able to contribute more to resisting Calus's assault on their city. Your recent success with Strand has Osiris and Nimbus thinking it's worth exploring further, as another potential advantage over Calus. You're still not ready for a head-on assault but, maybe with Strand, you can be. 



After a pleasant chat with Osiris, Nimbus was reminded of a place that you and the Old Bird might find useful for mastering Strand. Before they hand you the coordinates, they take a moment to tell you just how much you amaze them. It took Rohan a while to give Nimbus their first compliment on the job, and they made a promise that they'd do it differently when they took over. The old man might think compliments go to your head, but Nimbus sees nothing but good in appreciating people when they deserve it.



Nimbus recommends you check in with Rohan and Osiris at the Hall of Heroes before moving on to mission "On The Verge."

title: Legacy: Lightfall
speaker: Nimbus
text:
Nimbus claps you on the back in greeting. After everything that's happened, you are a true ally of Neomuna and welcome in the city anytime.



"We may not be the hottest tourist spot in the system," they quip, looking out at the smoldering skyline, "but we'll take all the help we can get."



There's an ironic twist to the Cloud Strider's mouth, but it can't cover up the worry in their eyes. "Osiris filled me in on everything else that's happened. The Witness created some kind of portal in your Traveler and went through it, right? If it's rejecting all probes… then forget about getting people through it."



"I can't claim we've got the answers, but we're all in this together, right? Humanity's gotta help each other, Neptune or Earth. Neomuna's role in this war isn't over by a long shot. While everyone figures out what's next, could use your help holding the line here. The less gets by us, the less comes at you later.  And when we do know what's next, Neomuna's got your back. It's our galaxy too."

title: Legacy: Lightfall
speaker: Nimbus
text:
Nimbus is bummed about the outcome of the last mission-they were really rooting for you. They sympathize by recounting Rohan's little catchphrase for such an occasion: "Headlong and empty-handed," explaining that it's okay to stop trying to do it all yourself; we're in this together. We'll fix this. 



Whatever the Witness wants from the Veil clearly involves using the Radial Mast to create some sort of… link? So the threat remains high. But right now, the CloudArk-Neomuna's virtual infrastructure built on the Veil's power-needs our help. "I'm sure you've seen the virtual citizens milling about the city. You see… nah, you know what, I'll explain details on the way. Point is, to protect the Veil, we need to protect the CloudArk." Your direct assault on Calus failed. Time to try a different approach.



Nimbus recommends you check in with Rohan and Osiris at the Hall of Heroes before moving on to mission "Breakneck."

title: Legacy: Lightfall
speaker: Nimbus
text:
Nimbus introduces themself as the "Rookie Cloud Strider" in Neomuna. Nimbus, their superior, Rohan, and the long line of Cloud Striders who came before them have been keeping the city and its citizens safe for a long time sans-Guardians. Nimbus isn't sure what Guardians can bring to the table now, but it seems Neomuna and the Vanguard have similar enemies. It can't hurt to work together, right?



Complete the mission "Under Siege" in Neomuna.

title: Lightfall
speaker: Nimbus
text:
Nimbus introduces themself as the "Rookie Cloud Strider" in Neomuna. Nimbus, their superior, Rohan, and the long line of Cloud Striders who came before them have been keeping the city and its citizens safe for a long time sans-Guardians. title: Legacy: Lightfall
speaker: Nimbus
text:
Nimbus congratulates you on the progress you've made with Strand. They council on your next steps, saying that now is probably the best time for you and Osiris to try to master the element. Nimbus also thinks Rohan would agree.



As a sign of the trust you have built together, Nimbus refers to themself with their true name: Cloud Strider Dara Danu. They thought you should know.



Complete the mission "Headlong" in Neomuna.
