title: Reach Level 20
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text: Increase your level to claim these rewards.

title: Lightfall
speaker: Nimbus
text:
Nimbus congratulates you on the progress you've made with Strand. They council on your next steps, saying that now is probably the best time for you and Osiris to try to master the element. Nimbus also thinks Rohan would agree.



As a sign of the trust you have built together, Nimbus refers to themself with their true name: Cloud Strider Dara Danu. They thought you should know.



Complete the mission "Headlong" in Neomuna.

title: Nimbus's Challenge
speaker: Nimbus
text: "You're keeping up great, Guardian! Between us, the Vex and the Shadow Legion don't stand a chance. Neomuna's staying safe as long as we have anything to say about it." -Nimbus

title: The Ascent
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
An Oath Broken




        Shaxx looks at you differently now. He offers you the weapon he used those many years ago at Twilight Gap, and wishes you well when you carry it into battle.

title: Season of Defiance
speaker: Nimbus
text:
"…Oh, wait. This came for you, I think?" Nimbus says, holding up what appears to be a ceremonial scepter of Awoken origin.



"Don't ask me," they shrug. "It showed up alongside that clunky piece of technology over there." 



Nimbus gestures to a nearby Vanguard holoprojector. Its boxy terran design is conspicuously awkward amidst the sleek architecture of Neomuna. 



"Those things just popped out of a swirling purple portal-and that's not even close to the weirdest thing that's happened here recently."



You take the scepter and notice the lights of the holoprojector flashing with an urgent message…



This quest begins the Season of Defiance campaign.

title: The Final Strand
speaker: Nimbus
text:
All Nimbus had to hear was "Strand weapon" for them to hop on board with your project. "What a great idea! Why didn't we think of this sooner?" they practically shout in enthusiasm. 



They switch to brainstorming mode. "Hm. A weapon that harnesses the Veil's energy… can't be made outta your everyday stuff. At the very least, you'll need the same grade materials as the Veil Containment." 



The Cloud Strider perks up. "Actually, you could just retrofit some of the Irkalla Institute's old equipment. I bet their atmospheric spectrometers are chock full of Strand energy!"



Search Veil Containment for an atmospheric Veil spectrometer.

title: Parting the Veil
speaker: Nimbus
text:
"Hey, Guardian! Thanks for coming down."



Nimbus is eager to get to work as they stand up, clapping their hands together.



"We've had some weird Vex activity going on across the city in the last couple weeks. When I sent the data to Osiris, he got all excited about it." Nimbus smirks. "You know how he gets."



Nimbus rolls their shoulders, ready for action. "Osiris thinks whatever the Vex are after has to do with the Veil, and he wants you to look into it; collect some data, see what they've been digging into." Nimbus sighs.



"Problem is, we don't have a lead on the Vex… but the Shadow Legion does. So we're gonna pay 'em a visit, bust a few heads, and figure out which Vex we need to target." Nimbus slaps a fist into their open palm.



"I'll be on overwatch," they eagerly explain, "and the old man will be in your ear the whole way." Then Nimbus raises their brow, motioning to the overlook's edge. 



"So, ready to roll?"

title: …To Hero
speaker: Nimbus
text: "Been seeing a few more hopeful faces around lately. Knowing you're here to help really keeps morale up, you know? The people of Neomuna appreciate it, and so do I." -Nimbus

title: Shellcode Recovery
speaker: Nimbus
text: Dropped your Shellcode?

title: Unfinished Business
speaker: Nimbus
text:
Nimbus takes the Vex compass and Seed of Silver Wings off your hands. They don't mention Osiris insisting they stay behind, though their dampened enthusiasm says it all. 



As they recheck Rohan's notes, they explain the passkey's design. The compass, tuned to the shifting unpredictability of the Nexus, should bring you right to the Black Garden's door. 



There, the Seed of Silver Wings, refractive with the Garden's fluctuating DNA, should allow you to enter as if you belong.



Nimbus presses their Cloud Strider core. A whirl of nanites fly out, welding the components together. 



As they work, Nimbus points out a name in Rohan's notes: the Conceptual Mind.



This is the architect Rohan saw building the Black Heart 10 years ago. It's also your best chance at unlocking the Veil, following the Witness, and bringing a worthy end to Rohan's unfinished business.



They hand over the finished passkey and wish you good luck.



Head to In.Gress to launch the "What Remains" mission.

title: Unfinished Business
speaker: Nimbus
text:
Nimbus admits to leaving the induction ceremony early; it doesn't feel right when Neomuna is still overrun and the Witness is at large. 



If you ask them, a better way to honor Rohan's legacy would be to finish his unfinished business and find the Vex's copycat Veil.



Apparently, early in his training, Rohan stumbled on the Vex building what he believed was a copy of the Veil. Convinced this was a threat, he spent the rest of his career trying to retrace his steps through the Nexus. Nimbus believes Rohan succeeded right before the Shadow Legion's invasion. 



They ask for your help finding Rohan's notes, hidden all around the city in encrypted data packets. To recover the data, you will need cipher qubits, which can be collected from the Vex.



Defeat Vex in Neomuna to collect qubits and recover Rohan's data packets.

title: Unveiled
speaker: Nimbus
text:
Nimbus greets you with their usual enthusiasm. "Guardian! Listen, Osiris just got in touch. He says his data crawler uncovered all kinds of weird stuff."



Their smile becomes a little self-deprecating. "You're better at understanding ancient history and… what did the old bird call it? Paracausal studies? Something like that. The point is, I think you'll get more out of Osiris's data crawler than I will."



"Head back down there and take a look. And let me know if you find anything interesting."

title: Unfinished Business
speaker: Nimbus
text:
Calus is gone.



With an uncharacteristically heavy voice, Nimbus confides they aren't sure what victory looks like going forward, but they're not going to let that undercut the relief that their home and their people are safe.



It feels weird to not be "the rookie" anymore, they tell you; Rohan left big shoes to fill. Nimbus's voice takes a hopeful upturn: they'll get there someday.



They invite you to Rohan's induction ceremony into the Hall of Heroes, telling you Rohan would be honored if you attended.



Attend Rohan's Hall of Heroes induction.

title: Where in Neomuna Is Archie?
speaker: Nimbus
text: "Oh hey, Guardian! I bet you're here looking for Archie, huh? What a fun pup. He asked about using my hoverboard. I, uh, told him it wasn't safe-but that he could check out the rest of my stash."

title: The Crucible
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
Hey there, Guardian.




        Lord Shaxx oversees the Crucible, a tournament that trains Guardians by pitting them against one another in friendly competition. Though the future of the Crucible was in doubt after the fall of the City, Shaxx is convinced that it is needed now more than ever. 



Complete matches in the Crucible to hone your skills against other players and earn rewards.

title: EDZ: Timeline Stabilization
speaker: Obelisk: EDZ
text: "Thank you, Guardian. Because of you, we can now use this obelisk to keep the anomaly on Mercury from spreading to Earth. But your work is not over. Maintain the obelisk by continually strengthening its connection to the Sundial. I am depending on you, Guardian. There are few I would trust with such an important task as this." -Transmission from Osiris

title: Increase Resonance Rank
speaker: Obelisk: EDZ
text: Show the Gunsmith proof of your enthusiasm for destruction.

title: Resonance Rank Reward
speaker: Obelisk: EDZ
text: Upgrade the Resonance Rank of an obelisk to access obelisk enhancements and additional rewards. Completing obelisk bounties and Sundial runs grants Seasonal currency, which you can redeem here to raise the Resonance Rank.

title: Resonance Rank Reward
speaker: Obelisk: EDZ
text: You've strengthened the link between this obelisk and Sundial. Take this reward in recognition of your efforts.

title: Increase Resonance Rank
speaker: Obelisk: Mars
text: Show the Gunsmith proof of your enthusiasm for destruction.

title: Mars: Timeline Stabilization
speaker: Obelisk: Mars
text: "The obelisk is restored. Once you finalize its activation, we can use it to stop the anomalies created on Mercury from spreading to Mars. Thank you, Guardian. But I must ask for your help again in maintaining this structure and strengthening its connection to the Sundial. We must remain vigilant." -Transmission from Osiris

title: Resonance Rank Reward
speaker: Obelisk: Mars
text: Upgrade the Resonance Rank of an obelisk to access obelisk enhancements and additional rewards. Completing obelisk bounties and Sundial runs grants Seasonal currency, which you can redeem here to raise the Resonance Rank.

title: Resonance Rank Reward

title: Resonance Rank Reward
speaker: Obelisk: Nessus
text: Upgrade the Resonance Rank of an obelisk to access obelisk enhancements and additional rewards. Completing obelisk bounties and Sundial runs grants Seasonal currency, which you can redeem here to raise the Resonance Rank.

title: Visit Lord Shaxx
speaker: Lord Shaxx
text:
"You're already making a name for yourself in the Crucible, Guardian. But don't let up. Keep fighting!"



Solo, or with a fireteam, the Crucible helps Guardians master their combat skills against the toughest competition: other Guardians.



Complete Crucible matches and Crucible bounties to gain XP and earn rewards, including weapons, gear, and more!

title: Relics of the Golden Age
speaker: Master Rahool
text: "Fascinating! I haven't seen a design such as this in... hmm. There are Golden Age markers to this weapon that bear further research. If we're going to develop this line of thinking further, I will need fodder for my research. Engrams, to put it succinctly." -Cryptarch Rahool

title: A Missing Link
speaker: Obelisk: Tangled Shore
text:
You approach the obelisk and activate it. It hums to life, radiating luminescence, assuring you of success.



By connecting the obelisks to the Sundial via Sundial Links, you are able to pull specific weapons through time from the Sundial Spire. Each obelisk you link will provide access to weapons tied to that obelisk. Only a limited number of obelisks can be linked at a time, but you can upgrade that limit.

title: Resonance Rank Reward
speaker: Obelisk: Tangled Shore
text: Upgrade the Resonance Rank of an obelisk to access obelisk enhancements and additional rewards. Completing obelisk bounties and Sundial runs grants Seasonal currency, which you can redeem here to raise the Resonance Rank.

title: Increase Resonance Rank
speaker: Obelisk: Tangled Shore
text: Show the Gunsmith proof of your enthusiasm for destruction.

title: Timeline Stabilization
speaker: Obelisk: Tangled Shore
text:
You've restored this obelisk to its full power and stabilized time on the Tangled Shore. But your work isn't over: The obelisk must be fully linked to the Sundial. You can achieve this by completing unique bounties obtained from the obelisk itself.



Complete bounties to raise the Resonance Rank of this obelisk and connect it to the Sundial.

title: A Disturbance on Mercury
speaker: Osiris
text:
You find Osiris in the center of a grand structure. He explains that, after you defeated the Undying Mind, he experienced a dire vision of the future. In this new future, he saw an expanse of nothingness so vast that it terrified him.



When he emerged from the Forest, burdened with this new revelation, he found that the Red Legion had stolen one of his old experiments: the Sundial. Co-opting the Sundial for their own purposes, the Red Legion fractured time on Mercury in hopes of changing the past.



Osiris wants your help repairing Mercury's timeline. He asks that you go to the Tangled Shore to find another of his inventions: an obelisk-one of many across the system-designed to stabilize time while the Sundial is active. Attuning the obelisk and linking it to the Sundial will help you contain the temporal disturbances on Mercury.

title: Lightfall
speaker: Nimbus
text:
Nimbus claps you on the back in greeting. After everything that's happened, you are a true ally of Neomuna and welcome in the city anytime.



"We may not be the hottest tourist spot in the system," they quip, looking out at the smoldering skyline, "but we'll take all the help we can get."



There's an ironic twist to the Cloud Strider's mouth, but it can't cover up the worry in their eyes. "Osiris filled me in on everything else that's happened. The Witness created some kind of portal in your Traveler and went through it, right? If it's rejecting all probes… then forget about getting people through it."



"I can't claim we've got the answers, but we're all in this together, right? Humanity's gotta help each other, Neptune or Earth. Neomuna's role in this war isn't over by a long shot. While everyone figures out what's next, could use your help holding the line here. The less gets by us, the less comes at you later.  And when we do know what's next, Neomuna's got your back. It's our galaxy too."

title: A New Paradox
speaker: Osiris
text:
"This is the Perfect Paradox," Osiris says. There is a note of both reverence and confusion in his voice. He holds the gun in his hands as if it is very delicate, an ancient relic. "Saint-14's gun."



He looks up to meet your eyes. "You created a version of this weapon at the Infinite Forge, didn't you? The one in my hands is a different version entirely, marked with an altered form of your Light that dates back to the Dark Age. Long before you were resurrected."



He shakes his head. "I don't understand it. Why would you find this now? What timeline exists that I have yet to see, that places you in the Dark Age?" His gaze has gone distant, contemplative. "Perhaps…" But he cuts himself off. "No. Saint-14 is lost. This is just another anomaly created by the Cabal's misuse of the Sundial. All the more reason to stay focused on our task." He meets your eyes again, and his expression is steely. "We can't allow ourselves to become distracted chasing the dead."

title: A New Paradox
speaker: Osiris
text:
"This is the Perfect Paradox," Osiris says. There is a note of both reverence and confusion in his voice. He holds the gun in his hands as if it is breakable. "Saint-14's gun."



He looks up to meet your eyes. "The Light signature attached to this gun is yours, but it dates back to the Dark Age, long before you were resurrected. Do you realize what that means?" He looks down at the gun again. "That suggests that you created Saint-14's gun."



He shakes his head. "I don't understand it. Why would you find this now? What timeline exists that I have yet to see, that places you in the Dark Age?" His gaze has gone distant, contemplative. "Perhaps…" But he cuts himself off. "No. Saint-14 is lost. This is just another anomaly created by the Cabal's misuse of the Sundial. All the more reason to stay focused on our task." He meets your eyes again, and his expression is steely. "We can't allow ourselves to become distracted chasing the dead."

title: …To Hero
speaker: Nimbus
text:
With Rohan gone, the weight of protecting Neomuna falls heaviest on Nimbus's shoulders. Their greeting lacks its usual cheer, but they rally enough to attempt a smile.



"Me? Aw, don't worry, I've got it all handled! But between you and me, the citizens could really use some hope right now. People will feel better knowing our allies have our backs."



Complete tasks to bolster the city's defenses and inspire the Neomuni people.

title: Unfinished Business
speaker: Nimbus
text:
Nimbus admits they weren't as settled with Rohan's death as they thought they were. Cloud Striders are trained to accept death as part of the flow. To Nimbus, that meant pushing through the pain, trying to outrun their grief. 



Seeing Rohan's gun in the Black Garden forced them to stop and realize just how much they missed him. 



Nimbus thanks you for seeing the mission through. With the Conceptual Mind's memory core, the odds of unlocking the Veil and following the Witness have shot up. 



Nimbus promises to deliver the memory core so Osiris and Neomuna's researchers can start decrypting it. 



There's just one stop Nimbus has to make first.



Go to the Hall of Heroes to honor those who cut their years short for the sake of humanity.

title: A Timely Discovery
speaker: Osiris
text:
Osiris welcomes you back to the Sundial. The phased object, previously unstable and unrecognizable, has been transformed into the incomplete frame of a weapon.



"Strangely enough," Osiris says, showing you the object. "It appears the object you found is some kind of weapon. A Shotgun, I believe."



He sets the strange frame aside and turns back to face you. "There is a Light signature associated with this weapon, but it's… erratic. I can't identify it, as it's still shifting between timelines. I believe I can anchor it in the present, but I'll need data." He gestures to you. "Perhaps you can help me with that, as well."

title: Crisis Averted
speaker: Osiris
text:
"I have walked through many timelines, in reality and in meditation," Osiris says gravely. "But it is never something I do lightly. One mistake can put everything in jeopardy."



He looks out over the chaos beyond the Sundial. "As you see here." He meets your gaze again. "Thank you for strengthening the Sundial's connection to the obelisks. We will need to continue to guard that connection, if we hope to keep the timeline stable across the system."

title: Containing the Anomaly
speaker: Osiris
text:
"Guardian," Osiris says. "The Red Legion's meddling with the Sundial continues to create timeline instabilities across the system. We need to maintain the link between the Sundial and the obelisks I've created.



"Venture out into the system to strengthen the link between an obelisk and the Sundial. We cannot afford for time to break elsewhere as it has on Mercury."

title: Osiris
speaker: Osiris
text:
Osiris wishes to thank you for all of your great accomplishments on Mercury. Visit him at the Sundial Spire.




        Osiris thanks you, both for helping him thwart the Red Legion's plan to control time on Mercury and for saving Saint-14. He is still unable to believe that, after all his failed attempts, you were able to find his brother and rescue him from his previous fate. Osiris will be forever grateful for your help. Still, he warns you again of the desolate future he saw in the Infinite Forest. It may not yet be averted. He encourages you to prepare for the worst.

title: Journey's End
speaker: Osiris
text: Osiris looks at you with a warmth you've never seen from him. "Thank you," he says. "You saved a legend of the City today. And a friend of mine." His eyes harden. "But I'm afraid I still need your help. Saint will want to speak with you. There's more work to do-in the Sundial and beyond." He nods. "Whenever you're ready."

title: Pharos Link
speaker: Osiris
text:
Osiris meets your approach with warm acknowledgement. "It would seem that our paths are entwined, Guardian. Impeccable work, as always." Osiris offers you a rare smile. "I always wrote off Saint's hopeful speeches as rhetoric or inspiration, but you… you have given credence to his message."



Osiris takes a breath and gives you his full attention. "For the first time I believe we have hope."



He nods and his attention is split again. "Saint-14 will need your assistance maintaining the Tower Obelisk. Trust that it is worth the effort." Osiris looks past you to the horizon. "With cooler tempers, and with the Core secure, perhaps it is time to visit the City again."

title: Return to Osiris
speaker: Osiris
text: Osiris greets you with a curt nod. He looks excited to see you. "I'm still calculating the effects your trip to the distant past had on the timeline. Unlike the changes the Red Legion were attempting to make, which were contained to Mercury by my obelisks, I believe your actions had a lasting impact on the solar system at large." He gestures at Sagira, his Ghost, as she orbits above his head. "I've picked up a distress signal inside the Vex network that was not there until recently-a signal that originated from Saint-14's Ghost. I need you to find it."

title: Phased Through Time
speaker: Osiris
text:
Osiris is holding the phased object you pulled from the Sundial. It continues to flicker in his hands, both material and immaterial at once.



"Guardian," he says, inclining his head. "The most I've been able to determine about this object is that it's been pulled out of a different timeline. Right now, it's existing in two places at once, making it extremely unstable."



He seems intrigued by the object and turns it over in his hands, studying it. "With your help, I think I can stabilize it, at least temporarily. That way, we may be able to determine exactly what it is and why it's here."

title: Increase Resonance Rank
speaker: Obelisk: Nessus
text: Show the Gunsmith proof of your enthusiasm for destruction.

title: Return to Osiris
speaker: Osiris
text: Osiris greets you with a fire in his eyes you've never seen before. "You met Saint-14 on Mercury? That was his first off-world mission for the Speaker. Those Fallen were House of Rain, the lowest of their clans. House Dusk took their colors during the Red War. I-" he speaks quickly. Nervously. He shakes his head. "You mentioned two coordinates broadcast from the Perfect Paradox?" He nods eagerly at you, but his mind is clearly elsewhere. "The Sundial is spent, but it only needs time to recharge. I'll alert you when it's ready for another jump."

title: Return to Osiris
speaker: Osiris
text: "You're attempting an impossible task, Guardian," Osiris tells you. "But if you insist on walking the same excruciating path that I did…" He shakes his head, and chuckles ruefully. "I won't deny you the chance. When the Red Legion hijacked my Sundial, they shattered its components. You must repair them if you're to use it again."

title: Return to Osiris
speaker: Osiris
text: Osiris's eyes narrow as he takes the Ghost shell from you. "The words you heard when you found this were Saint's last," the Warlock says. "I've looked everywhere in the network for this Ghost. There was never a distress signal. There was nothing. Your trip to the past must have changed an element I never took into account." He shakes his head. "The Sundial is nearly ready for another jump, but it's hungry for Light."

title: Return to Osiris
speaker: Osiris
text: Osiris nods with approval. "With the new Empyrean Slate you've constructed, you're now able to access a fully operational Sundial. Activate the terminal and launch the start-up sequence. Perhaps you'll succeed where I failed." He nods again, but his eyes are downcast.

title: Return to the Sundial
speaker: Osiris
text: Osiris welcomes you back with a curt nod. "You have everything you need for another trip through the Sundial. When you're ready, access the terminal." He watches you eagerly. "Take your time."

title: Speak with Osiris
speaker: Osiris
text:
"Guardian, I'm glad that you're here," Osiris says. "The Cabal continue to run rampant through the timelines of Mercury. The temporal instabilities they've caused are in danger of infecting the rest of the system."



He shakes his head. "We can't allow the corruption to spread. We must repair more of the obelisks. You will find them in the EDZ and on Nessus. Reactivating them is the only way to ensure the effects of the Sundial are contained."

title: Visit Osiris
speaker: Osiris
text:
Osiris welcomes you back, standing in front of the Sundial's massive spire. "Well done, Guardian," he says. "The obelisk on the Tangled Shore is one link in the chain that will hold our timelines in place. This will buy us valuable time-time that we must use to push back the Red Legion."



He turns to look out past the translucent barriers that enclose the Sundial's center. Beyond them, battles rage across Mercury's past and future. He turns back to face you.



"Enter the Sundial. We must clear the Cabal from this place if we hope to stabilize Mercury's timeline. Your first run through the Sundial will allow me to calibrate it correctly so you can weave in and out of Mercury's timelines again and again."

title: A Scrap of Paper
speaker: Petra Venj
text:
Petra is glad to see you, as always. She takes the note you found in the Menagerie and puzzles over it.



"It's very odd," she says eventually. "These are instructions to find an Earthmade Rocket Launcher hidden somewhere in the Prison of Elders. The grammar's not very good, though. It almost reminds me of Eliksni…"



She translates the note for you, and then, with a weary apology, she returns to her endless field work.

title: Ascendant Access
speaker: Petra Venj
text:
"My queen has informed me that you require an additional phial of Queensfoil.



"I understand the Ascendant Plane is a challenging place, but try to make this one count, Guardian."

title: Discover the Dreaming City
speaker: Petra Venj
text:
"Another new Guardian dares to explore the Dreaming City. There was a time your presence would've been an affront, but much has changed as our enemies have evolved."



Petra Venj is an emissary of the Reef. She offers bounties, pursuits, and more to challenge and reward Guardians brave enough to explore the Dreaming City.



You will find wonders and horrors here. Unlock the mysteries of the Dreaming City, and your courage will be rewarded!

title: Burn It Out
speaker: Petra Venj
text:
"Do you bring news on our rumor… or have you come to see how deep the cryptoliths have burrowed?" Petra hides the stress of command behind steely eyes.



"I hear you're not the only Guardian running chores for Spider. I'd suggest caution, but you lot know what you're getting yourselves into."



Petra slaps your shoulder. "Spider lackey or not, you're a welcome sight." Her humorous tone quickly fades to seriousness. "Xivu Arath's presence is strong here. I'm not keen on another Hive matron worming their way into Awoken territory."



"Whatever terror she is sowing here," Petra says as if delivering an order, "burn it out." The Queen's Wrath straightens her shoulders. "We will hold back her abominations where we can, but my Corsairs are not impervious to her call. Nor am I."



"I leave that to you."

title: Dawning Delivery
speaker: Petra Venj
text: Petra may not remain in one place long enough to eat the cookies you've made, but she seems quite thankful nonetheless.

title: Forsaken
speaker: Petra Venj
text:
Petra is full of bitter regret: Cayde-6 is dead, and the Awoken are in tatters. But it's not too late for revenge.



Petra gives you a Bow, handpicked from the Vestian armory.

title: Forsaken
speaker: Petra Venj
text:
"I'd like you to have this: my sidearm, the Vestian Dynasty. It's the weapon that... well. You know. Nothing left to say about that.



"But please, take it. May it help you reach the Dreaming City." -Petra Venj

title: Forsaken
speaker: Petra Venj
text:
The Barons got away, but the hunt isn't over. Petra has the Barons' rap sheets from their time in the prison. That information will help you track them down on the Tangled Shore and take them out one by one.



It's time to begin the Baron Hunt.

title: Forsaken
speaker: Petra Venj
text:
Uldren's plan is revealed: He thinks his sister, Queen Mara, is still alive and that she wants him to force open the door to the Dreaming City, a fabled Awoken stronghold. This isn't just about revenge anymore. It's about the survival of the Awoken people.



Stop Uldren from entering the Dreaming City and claim your revenge by completing mission "Nothing Left to Say."

Loyalty to a dead Queen led Petra to the Tangled Shore. Now, that loyalty leads her to a new destination: the doorway at the top of the Watchtower-and beyond it, the Dreaming City. You're not ready to know the secrets that lie within this Awoken bastion… but Petra hopes you soon will be.



She hands you a fractured Awoken talisman and tells you to follow her into the Dreaming City by completing quest "Key of Light and Darkness."

title: Nessus: Timeline Stabilization
speaker: Obelisk: Nessus
text: "Thanks to you, the anomaly on Mercury will not spread to Nessus. But there is more work to be done: You must maintain the obelisk's connection to the Sundial and keep our enemies from destroying what we have built. Our work is never over, my friend, but I know you are up to the task." -Transmission from Osiris

title: Hunters' Remembrance
speaker: Petra Venj
text:
Petra can't seem to tear her eyes from the bow. "The Wish-Ender. I thought it was only a legend. How did you-?"



She shakes her head once, as though snapping herself back to waking reality. "No matter. You did all that I asked and more. With their mementos purified, our honored dead can rest again."



"As for the bow…" Petra gives you a small, almost wistful smile. "I will not ask what passed between Sjur Eido and you. Hunt well, my friend."

title: Hunters' Remembrance
speaker: Petra Venj
text:
Petra holds out a case full of strange mementos. Despite their small size, their antiquity is apparent-as is the Taken corruption clinging to them. Petra starts to speak, and you hear righteous anger behind her clipped words.



"These are mementos of past Awoken Paladins. I don't know how the Fallen learned of them, but a Taken attack targeted the mementos… and desecrated them."



"Our honored dead deserve better. Take their mementos into the Shattered Throne and hunt down the Taken responsible. Their blood will avenge the wrong that's been done and purify the tokens."



Petra's frown deepens. "The Fallen hid themselves well. My scouts revealed some clues, but you will have to search carefully."

title: Hunters' Remembrance
speaker: Petra Venj
text:
A brief message from Petra Venj, the Queen's Wrath, awaits you.



"The past refuses to rest peacefully here. The Taken know this as well as we do, and recent assaults targeted the very history of the Awoken."



"I won't let the Taken go unpunished. Come see me as soon as you can."

title: Restless Slumber
speaker: Petra Venj
text:
"You set foot on hallowed ground, Guardian. Take care to remember that in your efforts here."



Petra Venj watches you with a steely gaze from her uncovered eye. The knife levitating above her hand flips and twirls nonchalantly.



"I swore an oath to aid my Queen, and loathe as I am to see this place tread upon by outsiders, I cannot refuse your help. The Taken and Scorn have run amok, and I don't have enough Corsairs to cover the territory."



"Do what you can against the corruption, but keep your guard up. Dark forces are at play here."



Complete public events, Lost Sectors, and bounties acquired from Petra Venj.

title: Restless Slumber
speaker: Petra Venj
text:
"Your help is appreciated, as much as I wish it wasn't necessary."



Petra turns and gazes at the landscape around her, a wistful look in her eye.



"Corruption tears at the fabric of this sacred place. It pains me to see it so…"



"With your help, I am closer to cleansing this darkness, and for that, I thank you."



Destinations offer a variety of activities and rewards. Keep exploring to discover them!

title: Talk to Petra
speaker: Petra Venj
text:
It's time to strike at the heart of the curse. Talk to Petra in the Chamber of Starlight.




        "The dreams... I understand now. I understand everything." -Petra Venj

        "It doesn't matter where I'm from, what made me. What matters is my choice. And I choose to fight the curse." -Petra Venj

speaker: Petra Venj
text:
"Thank you, my friend," Petra says. "We always appreciate your help, and you are always very welcome here."



She hands you another engram-shaped candy. "The Awoken don't celebrate this Festival of the Lost, but I am always eager to see Guardians from the City this time of year. Your masks, costumes, clever little dances… It brings a little levity to the seriousness of my responsibilities here. Thank you for including us."

title: Talk to Petra
speaker: Petra Venj
text:
The curse is gaining in strength again. Talk to Petra in the Divalian Mists.




        "It's as if the Dreaming City suffers with its prince." -Devi Cassl

title: The Best of My Abilities
speaker: Petra Venj
text:
"Guardian," Petra says. "It's good to see you."



She takes the sour engram from you, examines it quizzically, and then smiles. "Er, thank you. Give my thanks to Devrim." Uncertain what to do with it, she continues to hold it in her hand. "I appreciate you making time for us during one of your holidays. The Dreaming City is a lot of ground to cover, even for my corsairs."

title: Talk to Petra
speaker: Petra Venj
text:
The curse is gaining in strength again. Talk to Petra in the Divalian Mists.




        "I already pledged my Corsairs. Use them well. I know you will lead them to victory, Queen's Wrath." -Kamala Rior

title: Visit Petra Venj
speaker: Petra Venj
text:
"I see your curiosity remains strong. Good. There are mysteries yet to be uncovered by your mind-or your might."



Petra and the Dreaming City are not done with you. Continue to explore the unknown and combat the enemies who threaten this wondrous place. Earn new rewards and XP as you overcome the challenges that await.

title: Where in the Dreaming City Is Archie?
speaker: Petra Venj
text: "I really don't have time for this, Guardian. Yes, Archie was here. I don't know what he was up to, but Archie was yapping on about someone being trapped in a well."

title: Ascendant Lens
speaker: Post Box
text:
Queen Mara's eyebrows lift as you hand her the Ascendant Lens. "This is an exceedingly rare trinket," she says, peering at you through the lens.



"It may not look like much to a common Guardian, but in the hands of our Techeuns, it will be a valuable research tool. You were right to bring it to me."



"Allow me to repay your generosity," she says, handing you a handsome reward.



You start to thank her, but she's already walking away. You've been dismissed.

title: The Prince Lives
speaker: Petra Venj
text:
"My sympathies." Petra turns to you. "I dreamt of their passing. The worlds. Those who remained… and the shadow that hung over them."



"I'm afraid the Dreaming City hasn't fared well since the Darkness swept through our system. You can taste the difference in the air. It is as if there is a war being fought within smoke, bending around us and slipping through our hair, leaving nothing but scorched scent. I do not enjoy being left out of the loop, but we persevere."



As you turn to leave, she stops you.



"There's one more thing. A rumor."



She considers for a moment before speaking.



"The Prince lives." 



Petra's eyes scan your reaction.



"Impossible, I know. But if it's more than a rumor, I don't want to hear it from a report."

title: Increase Umbral Density
speaker: Prismatic Recaster
text: Show the Gunsmith proof of your enthusiasm for destruction.

title: Means to an End
speaker: Prismatic Recaster
text: "Gotta make sure that Seed's charged up for Eris's little phone calls to the Darkness; otherwise, all you're gonna hear is static and interference. No one likes that. Charge up, and keep bringing me that Umbral junk to tune up my tech. We'll be kickin' right along in no time, like a can down the road." -The Drifter

title: Missive
speaker: Prismatic Recaster
text: The irregularity in the Drifter's machine is mirroring a gravitational disturbance being emitted from the Cradle. It has attracted attention from Savathûn's forces. Eris requests you clear a path to the Tree of Silver Wings.

title: Recaster Rank Reward
speaker: Prismatic Recaster
text: Upgrading your rank grants rewards. Complete Prismatic Recaster bounties to receive Twisted Energy, which can be turned in here to advance your rank.

title: Legacy: We Stand Unbroken
speaker: Queen Mara Sov
text:
"I have lived for centuries upon centuries, Guardian," Mara says. "Though death has not lost its sting, it is a ritual whose movements are familiar to me. It has become easier to bear."



"But seeing loss twist the faces of those around me… has not." 



You are unaccustomed to hearing grief in Mara's voice. 



"Amanda's absence will be felt deeply by those of us who knew her. Despair will be at our side where a friend once stood. So while it does not lighten the burden, let us hold this pain together. And when you lift your eyes, may you look only upon kind faces."



"I need to focus on the Queensguard now," she says, resuming her channeling. 



"When the time comes to strike back, we must all be strong… as strong as Amanda Holliday."

title: Umbral Reward
speaker: Prismatic Recaster
text: Your power grows as you increase your understanding of the Darkness.

title: Wavelength
speaker: Prismatic Recaster
text: "That's a healthy heap of honey right there! You keep bringing me what I need, Hero, and I'll keep putting guns in your hand and armor on your back." -The Drifter

title: Bluejay
speaker: Quinn Laghari
text:
"So it turns out-no shocker-Bluejay found the Occlusion from the first Strider's records. I've got a bigger issue for you, though."



"My 'Occlusion' data crawler accidentally expanded to scan Shadow Legion radio chatter. It returned a hit. The Cabal discovered a new Vex operation looking for the Occlusion and ordered their troops to steer clear."



"So the Vex aren't afraid of the Occlusion. They want it, and they're tunneling into the CloudArk to find it."

title: Legacy: We Stand Unbroken
speaker: Queen Mara Sov
text:
Mara seems affected by Zavala's heartfelt words. "That man has borne suffering enough for many lifetimes," she says softly.



There seems to be little she can say to ease his pain, or yours, or even her own. The future is uncertain.



"As the Voice in the Darkness extends its reach, we know only that few will finish this journey with us."



"For the path is long," she says. "As the nebulae whirl and billow above us, we remain. We endure. This is our privilege, our duty, and our curse."



She looks you in the eyes, and you feel the weight of her words. 



"Know that we will endure together."

title: Legacy: We Stand Unbroken
speaker: Queen Mara Sov
text:
Mara Sov stops channeling her power to speak with you. You feel a sudden weight settle on your shoulders again and realize you'd grown used to the strength granted by her favor. 



"We Awoken were first struck when we came between the Traveler and its hunter," she explains, "and I chose my people above either one."



"The choice has come again, and my answer is no different. I do not blindly defend the Light, and I do not listen to the Voice in the Darkness. Instead, I choose that which holds Light and Dark together in hands and heart."



Her hard eyes fix on you, and her expression is deadly serious. 



"I choose you."



Mara's hands glow with power as she traces delicate patterns in the air.



"Detach. Fall forward. Number among the first. Awaken."



With those words, Mara officially knights you into her Queensguard.

title: Bluejay
speaker: Quinn Laghari
text:
Details on the Occlusion trace back to Conrad Jain, the Cloud Strider who went by Bluejay. He was a former hacker and criminal who ultimately turned his skills toward saving the city and transforming the CloudArk into the virtual world it is today. But with so much network security surrounding Bluejay's legacy, you'll need Nimbus's help getting access.



Visit Nimbus to begin bonding with this legacy.

title: Metropolitan Defense
speaker: Quinn Laghari
text: "I know, you've heard it before, but honestly: you're doing great work, Guardian. Thanks. I mean it." -Archivist Quinn Laghari

title: Maelstrom
speaker: Quinn Laghari
text: "My data crawler's running hot! Maelstrom accessed the Occlusion a lot. She called it a 'simulation echo.' But it's not a saved file. It's hidden code in the CloudArk! She found it in Cloud Strider Bluejay's notes, so… you know. Kinda need his archive restored."

title: Stargazer
speaker: Quinn Laghari
text:
"I found Stargazer's algorithm in the data you recovered, except it's not an algorithm. They called it 'The Occlusion.' Love this stuff. My data crawler also pulled some old library records, showing who else accessed Stargazer's archive back in the day. Maelstrom!

She was the greatest military mind in history AND she's one of our smashed servers. It can't be a coincidence."



"If this 'Occlusion' spooked the Vex, maybe Maelstrom kept a backup of it on her server. She was a warrior, so go start some fights!"

title: Maelstrom
speaker: Quinn Laghari
text:
A strange clue connects the Cloud Striders whose memorials were destroyed: Something they refer to as "The Occlusion." What it is or why the Vex want it remains a mystery, though.



Quinn asks you to try restoring the memorial to Sedderik Assur, the Cloud Strider known as Maelstrom. She was a war hero and tactician, so engaging the enemy and stockpiling supplies seem like the next logical steps.



Defend the city by participating in patrols and public events and loot chests to begin bonding with this legacy.

title: Stargazer
speaker: Quinn Laghari
text:
Quinn believes your Strand powers can restore the destroyed memorials of Neomuna's heroes by finding connection with those previous Cloud Striders, perhaps based on their unique places in Neomuni history.



Stargazer-originally a mathematician named Laminak Li-was an explorer. Their legacy revolves around witnessing grand events and recovering lost treasure.



Engage in Terminal Overload activities to begin bonding with this legacy.

title: Strider
speaker: Quinn Laghari
text:
"I guess it isn't too outrageous to think a Strider would protect anyone in need. Even a Vex. If the Occlusion wanted to hurt us, it could have. Instead, it just seems to like its independence and some quiet. And I know I like my naps, so I'm feeling a little connection, you know?"



"It sent a big old compressed data packet in one quick burst, right before it went quiet again. Back to sleep, I guess. This was in the header:



SELF=output.vex :: output.soteria // SUBJECT=paracausal.hero // I ENDURE. GRATITUDE.



"This is going to make for some interesting research papers in the next few years… Anyway. This doc was right at the top of the other files, not encrypted like the rest. Here's the text: 



URGENT: SATURN VI CONTAINS VITAL INFORMATION. ENEMY OF WITNESS ON TITAN. IF STILL LIVING PRESERVATION PARAMOUNT. DO NOT WASTE TIME.



"It must have hauled some information out of the Vex databases. Or… our databases? Both? Ugh. I'm going to be forever figuring out the rest. Still, hope that's helpful to what you've got going on." 



Quinn's gratitude is genuine. "I won't forget everything you've done for me. And for the city. We owe you a lot, friendly space zombie. You're welcome here anytime. Oh, and here! Nimbus said you like weapons, so I dug this out of the archive for you. Don't worry-it's not fragile."

title: Welcome to the Hall of Heroes
speaker: Quinn Laghari
text:
"So I need you to restore Stargazer's records." Quinn's avatar radiates cheer. "All you need to do is sort of 'vibe' with Stargazer… the city's most famous explorer."



"The short version is, you must have tapped into some kind of connection with Siegebreaker. Emotional, experiential… something strong, whatever it was. So my theory is, to do the same thing with Stargazer, the best place to start is emulating them somehow, looking for that same connection. I could expound on the psychological and philosophical theories if you want. There's a lot of interesting research into the nature of consciousness, especially given the CloudArk… Maybe the city's belief in the Cloud Striders helped you anchor the memorial? Or maybe you're just that good at magic archaeology."



Quinn is overjoyed to have one monument back, and that scientific mind is hard at work on the best ways to get you to reconstruct the rest. Between your Strand capabilities and her historical knowledge, she's pretty clearly hoping you'll be able to restore all of the lost records. There's a whole city invested in the history of their heroes, after all. And ideally in the process, you can solve the mystery of the Vex attack.

title: Strider
speaker: Quinn Laghari
text:
It all goes back to the first Cloud Strider, a woman named Mikaela Julaha. "We don't know enough, unfortunately. Record-keeping was spotty back then. We were fighting just to survive, so no one was keeping receipts we could sift through centuries later. What I do know from context clues is that the Strider was the first person to use the Occlusion, and the only person who really knew what it is-except maybe the Vex, apparently. All I know for sure is she never set out to be a hero. She just wanted a safe home, where her kids didn't need to fight every day just to survive."



The Shadow Legion have uncovered a Vex tunneling operation, but the comms chatter Quinn has been able to pick up hasn't been very specific apart from that. The Shadow Legion have been ordered away from the operation, but that still leaves many places in Neomuna where the Vex could be working, and the Shadow Legion might yet be in active retreat.



Sweep through the areas where Vex and Shadow Legion are fighting to rule out those areas, and collect encrypted data from them to analyze and further narrow down where the Vex operation could be. With any luck, the chase will help you bond with the Strider's legacy-but the defense of the city is the most vital goal.  



Unlock a Terminal Overload Key Chest in each occupied area of Neomuna to begin tracking the Vex tunneling operation.

title: Strider
speaker: Quinn Laghari
text:
"This… I must have made a mistake." Quinn's crisis of faith is obvious in her voice. "The Cabal data says the Vex are searching for a Vex Mind inside our network? But that would mean the Strider helped hide it and keep it secret, even from the Council! From me! Not that I was even born yet, but it still feels… personal. We're not supposed to be a city of secrets."



Quinn's holographic form moves back and forth restlessly. "Okay. Okay, let's think this through. The Strider must have had a reason to do this, even if we can't see it yet. Maybe her memorial can tell us more. Think you can fix it?"

title: Welcome to the Hall of Heroes
speaker: Quinn Laghari
text:
"Well, this is a mess," Quinn says, indicating the broken memorials behind her. "But at least you kept the Veil safely in Neomuna! You know, it keeps the CloudArk running; we'd be lost without it. And on top of that, we haven't even scratched the surface on what it has to say about Darkness."



"Most immediately urgent is the broken memorials. The battle with Calus brought CloudArk security briefly offline, and some anomalous signal patterns were broadcast unsecured, coinciding almost perfectly in timing with the activation of the Veil. The Vex broke in immediately afterward, and destroyed five specific Cloud Strider memorials before retreating. Clearly a precision strike, but the question is, why?"



Cloud Strider memorials house all of their personal and professional records for future generations to study. Quinn is sure the answer is somewhere in the destroyed files. With any luck, Ghost's advanced sensors can help her pull data from the destroyed memorial servers and get a clearer picture of why the Vex undertook such a risky attack.



"Go take a look around the Hall first, all right? Get a good picture of how this place is in the parts that aren't on fire, learn a little about Neomuna that doesn't involve sabotage or explosions. Then you can circle back to the memorials, do some scans, and hopefully blow my socks off with what you and Ghost can pick up."



Explore the Hall of Heroes to learn more about Neomuna and about the Cloud Striders represented by the damaged memorials.

title: Earn Reputation
speaker: Reformancer Guzheng
text: Deposit Dark Matter Ingots at the Tharsis Reformation War Chest to earn Reputation with this syndicate. Earn gear, Renegade Abilities, Praxic Blade modifications, and currency.

title: Renegades
speaker: Reformancer Guzheng
text:
The Reformancer greets you with a dramatic flourish of its garments. "This unit, designated Guzheng, currently serves as Reformancer. This title is unique and a pleasing degree of outré, just like Guzheng itself.



"You are extremely puncturable, Guardian unit. Flammable too, in our experience. Might I suggest this defensive tool? Our organization is willing to part with it as a token of equivalent exchange."



Guzheng focuses on your Exotic armor for a moment too long as you take the Deflector unit. Then its gaze snaps back to yours. "May this improve your odds."

title: The Territory War Begins
speaker: Reformancer Guzheng
text:
Reformancer Guzheng unfolds itself from a crouch on your approach. 



"Zephyrus requests your assistance in trouncing our pathetic foes. Rewards are promised, as are access to desirable items and abilities.



"Have you ever thought about what it would be like to be part of the Vex? Your imagination could not simulate reality, but our Deflectors and Stun Fields may give you a taste.



"Gamble on the Reformation. Win big."

title: Weekly Shipments
speaker: Reformancer Guzheng
text:
Reformancer Guzheng synthesizes a droning chord under its voice as it speaks.



"The renegade Guardian has performed to expectations set by Zephyrus, Autonomous Mind," it says. "The Reformancer unit has in turn allocated a portion of our most recent shipment to the Guardian."



"As part of an ongoing social experiment, the Guzheng unit has left your goods with Spider. This unit is measuring how long he can resist the temptation to pocket the funds himself."



Guzheng's eye gleams with a threatening light. "At that point, the experiment will conclude."

title: Ascendant Alloy Requisition
speaker: Relic Conduit
text:
The shadow of power manifests in your thoughts. An intense wave of certitude grips you. To discover the true power of these weapons, their shapes must ascend.



Ascendant Alloys are a rare material used in weapon crafting that can improve a trait into an Enhanced Trait.



Obtain one by completing a weekly campaign mission.

title: Foundry Resonance
speaker: Relic Conduit
text: The vision of a foundry weapon dances across your mind, its shape half-remembered. It will take effort to fully understand it.

title: Foundry Resonance
speaker: Relic Conduit
text:
Deepsight Resonance extraction can award Patterns and Resonant Materials.



Patterns unlock the ability to shape a new weapon using Resonant Materials for customization and fine-tuning.

title: Ascendant Alloy Requisition
speaker: Relic Conduit
text:
Your Ascendant Alloys have unlocked new capabilities for Shaped weapons. Is this a memory of what was, or what could be?



After Shaped weapons are leveled, Ascendant Alloys can be used to upgrade your traits to become Enhanced Traits with improved functionality. 



To obtain more Ascendant Alloys, participate in weekly campaign missions and The Witch Queen offensive activities.

title: Foundry Resonance
speaker: Relic Conduit
text:
Deepsight Resonance extraction can award Patterns.



Patterns unlock the ability to shape a new weapon using various currencies for customization and fine-tuning.

title: Foundry Resonance
speaker: Relic Conduit
text: A clawing at the back of your mind: your Deepsight stirs. The memory of a weapon appears before you. Take it and unlock its full potential.

title: Reshaping the Enigma
speaker: Relic Conduit
text:
Use Shaped weapons in combat and activities in order to level them up and unlock better components.



There is no limit to the number of times a weapon can be reshaped. Experimentation with different components is highly encouraged.



Gather Resonant Materials like Resonant Elements, Ascendant Alloys, and Weapon Patterns to create and customize your favorite weapons.

title: Reshaping the Enigma
speaker: Relic Conduit
text: You have shaped your first weapon: the Enigma. However, further increasing a Shaped weapon's level can unlock additional capabilities.

title: Reshaping the Enigma
speaker: Relic Conduit
text:
A Shaped weapon can be continually enhanced by reshaping it with new components and perks.



The higher the level, the higher the quality of components available.



Take the Enigma to the Relic on Mars and reshape it.

speaker: Relic Conduit
text:
Continue to find weapons and complete their objectives to gather your preferred Resonance and Patterns.



Resonant Materials and Patterns are required to customize your weapons during shaping.



Complete Deepsight Resonance objectives, extract Resonant Elements, and unlock more Patterns.

title: Shaping: Extraction
speaker: Relic Conduit
text:
Activating the Relic has awakened Resonant weapons and activated latent features of others. These weapons can be obtained through world drops and activities and contain Deepsight Resonance. Extraction of the Pattern mod or dismantling of the weapon will make progress toward Weapon Patterns. 



Weapon Patterns are primarily obtained through Deepsight Resonance, and occasionally as a reward from specific quests.

title: Shaping: Extraction
speaker: Relic Conduit
text:
Activating the Relic has awakened Resonant weapons and activated latent features of others. These weapons can be obtained through world drops and activities and contain Deepsight Resonance that must be attuned so the Resonant Materials can be extracted. 



Resonant Materials are used to improve your Shaped weapon or shape new ones.



Weapon Patterns are primarily obtained through Deepsight Resonance, and occasionally as a reward from specific quests.

title: Tethered Consciousness
speaker: Relic Conduit
text:
The Relic hums with peculiar resonance. All at once, it becomes clear to you-it is offering something. The nature of the thing is unclear, but its function is less obscured: a method of quantifying the Resonant Elements obtained from Deepsight Resonant weapons.



The Relic tether is now yours to use.

title: Shaping: Extraction
speaker: Relic Conduit
text:
Continue to find Resonant weapons and extract the Resonant mod or dismantle the weapon to make progress on Weapon Patterns.



Patterns and various materials are required to customize your weapons during shaping.

title: The Relic
speaker: Relic Conduit
text:
You can now shape and reshape weapons using the Relic on Mars.



Activating the Relic has awakened Resonant weapons across the system. Use weapons with Deepsight Resonance in order to gather Resonant Materials from them.



Resonant Materials are used to improve your Shaped weapon or to shape new ones.



With this new information, return to Ikora in the Enclave on Mars.

title: Shaping: Resonant Alloys
speaker: Relic Conduit
text: The core materials for weapon shaping, Resonant Alloys, can be obtained through dismantling Legendary weapons.

title: Shaping: Resonant Alloys
speaker: Relic Conduit
text:
Resonant Alloys are required to make new Shaped weapons or upgrade Shaped weapons. 



Some weapons may require special types of Resonant Alloys that cannot be obtained from normal weapons you find in the world. 



Continue gathering Resonant Alloys to use in shaping and reshaping weapons.

title: The Hidden Shape
speaker: Relic Conduit
text:
Ghost chirps and his eye flickers. A voice chimes in over Ghost's transmitter, that of a Hidden agent.



"Well done. I'm streaming visual of the weapon through your Ghost, and I must say, it's not what I expected. That symbol at the back end isn't one I'm familiar with. I'll need to cross-reference Cryptarchy archives."



"Data from your Ghost indicates that the weapon has some sort of modular firing system, but the alloys it's made out of aren't entirely synthetic either. They resonate with a familiar, unnerving frequency," he says, voice tightening in worry.



"Smells like petrichor and…" The Hidden agent sighs. "Well, I don't want to get ahead of myself. It's definitely BrayTech influenced, but I can't tell the manufacturer."



The Hidden agent is quiet for a moment before adding, "Keep that weapon safe, would you? I'm going to do a little digging and see what else comes up."



"Till then, mate."

title: The Relic
speaker: Relic Conduit
text:
You can now shape and reshape weapons using the Relic on Mars.



Activating the Relic has awakened Resonant weapons across the system. Extract the Pattern mod or dismantle these Deepsight Resonant weapons to acquire progress toward additional weapon Patterns.



With this new information, return to Ikora in the Enclave on Mars.

title: Legacy: The Bladed Path
speaker: Ritual Circle
text:
Eris Morn greets you in her Athenaeum in Savathûn's throne world. She is centering herself before her next shift into her Hive form. 



Despite the physical changes, she does not believe that the ritual alters too much about her. "When I first transformed, I thought I might become something greater," she confides. "Instead, my doubts fell away, and I found myself simplified. Refined. Though I became Hive, I was more… myself."



She explains that your tithes fill her with power, following the Hive philosophy of sword logic. "The Hive believe that only the strongest have earned their existence. If a queen cannot hold her power, she must be betrayed." 



"I will not deny them their dogma," she says with a grin. "I will embody it."

title: Legacy: The Bladed Path
speaker: Ritual Circle
text:
Eris Morn stands before you in her Hive form, brimming with power. 



She dismisses Savathûn's predictions as lies built on lies and tells you that any rule can be unseated by a simple choice.



She raises her voice and challenges the Hive gods themselves.



"Xivu Arath, god of battlefield filth! Savathûn, god of the false and polluted! You have forgotten you were born as prey."



She grins viciously.



"I will remind you."



The air distorts around her form as the power of the tithes of all the Guardians pulse through her. 



"Now is the time, my acolyte, my Guardian," she says. "This will be our final tithe. Let it be glorious."

title: Legacy: The Bladed Path
speaker: Ritual Circle
text:
Eris Morn stands before you once more. She is fully Human, triumphant, and exhausted.



"It is done," she says. "When I killed Savathûn, I claimed her eons of stored power. For a moment, I surpassed even Xivu Arath herself."



"Instead of challenging Xivu Arath, I severed her connection to her throne world. She is mortal now, wherever she may be."



Rejecting the sword logic's power shattered the ritual's hold over her. "Now, here I stand," Eris says. "A woman who was briefly a god."



Immaru has resurrected Savathûn, and the Hive god insisted she had already given us the secrets of the Witness. In exchange for her freedom, she left Immaru with the Vanguard. Eris is free to destroy him if she feels Savathûn is conspiring against humanity.



"But I am weary of destruction," Eris says. "For now, I would like only… tea. Tea, and silence."

title: The Relic
speaker: Relic Conduit
text:
You can now shape and reshape weapons using the Relic on Mars.



Activating the Relic has awakened Resonant weapons across the system. Use weapons with Deepsight Resonance in order to gather Resonant Materials from them.



Resonant Materials are used to improve your Shaped weapon or to shape new ones.



With this new information, return to Ikora in the Enclave on Mars.

title: Legacy: The Bladed Path
speaker: Ritual Circle
text:
"Beloved acolyte," Eris says as she greets you in her Hive form. "Champion of violence, bearing tithes raw and sweet as bitten sores."



She tells you that she hears whispers from the Deep, goading her into pursuing vengeance. She resists them.



Still, she admits, the strength of your tithes thrills her, and there are so many old debts she would like to repay…



But she interrupts herself. "The cards speak of change," she says. "A ripple is cast, a great shadow rises from the sea of blood." 



"Something is coming."

title: Engram Tracker
speaker: Ritual Table
text:
A recorded message from Master Rahool plays when you pick up the engram tracker: 



"Guardian! This is a new device of my own manufacture. It will allow you to monitor the number of engrams available at each of the vendors in the Tower."



"If you ever lose it, you can pick up a new one from any of those vendors. I look forward to seeing you deploy this device."

title: Legacy: The Bladed Path
speaker: Ritual Table
text:
By reading Eris's notes on sword logic and the secrets of the Hive, you see she believes she can claim deeper power over the Throne World by continuing Savathûn's experiments with the Light. 



Attuning to an element will allow you to explore Savathûn's Spire more efficiently and augment your own capabilities.



Choose an element and begin the ritual. 



(Your decision will impact your initial rewards, though you will ultimately be able to attune with all elements.)

title: Legacy: The Bladed Path
speaker: Ritual Table
text:
Eris's notes indicate someone of your magical skill could expand their arcane ability to attune their Light to the final element.



Choose the final element and begin the ritual.

title: Legacy: The Bladed Path
speaker: Ritual Table
text:
A rushed and spidery script marks a dog-eared page:



Guardian,



You have seen the intricacies of the Imbaru Engine firsthand. As I explained, it is a grand mechanism to generate tribute for Savathûn, as the Altars of Summoning are below. Cunning was her nature, as her worm compelled her to confuse. These tests will yield rewards at great risk. Triumph over them, if you are willing.



We have uncovered the Witch Queen's secrets. And we will do so again.



Truth in action,

Eris Morn

title: Legacy: Toil and Trouble
speaker: Ritual Table
text:
The cluttered Ritual Table is covered in various artifacts used in the study of Hive magic. 



Eris Morn's scattered journals lay open across the table, pages weighed down by pieces of rock and bone. You notice sketches of Hive runes, worms, moths, and intricate diagrams of unrecognizable magical objects. 



You recognize buried amongst the esoterica a drawing of the Acolyte's Staff, along with the detailed spell that would bind its maker and wielder in the tithing ritual…

title: Rite of Culling
speaker: Ritual Table
text:
A note from Eris Morn rests on the cluttered table beside your spoils:



"Guardian. Hive magic is soulfire, sharpness, and shadow. It is unceasing. It is hungry. But while we may venture into the dark, there is violence in our curiosity.



"Claim this reward, then reach for the next. Over and over, forever and ever. My appetite for your tithes grows yet more keen."

title: Legacy: Toil and Trouble
speaker: Ritual Circle
text:
"Though my form twists in this rune-bound circle, I remain Eris Morn," says the figure before you, her voice strained by the transformation.



Eris gestures a clawed hand toward the staff you used to begin the Hive ritual. "A splinter of a Hive worm rests in your staff," she says. "It is enough to bind us, and mark you as my acolyte. By the sword logic of the Hive, your conquests strengthen me."



You think of the bargain Immaru offered the Vanguard: Savathûn will reveal how to follow the Witness if you can deal with her sister. You nod in understanding.



"You must tithe mightily if I am to become strong enough to defeat Xivu Arath," Eris says. You hear her smile viciously beneath the mask of chitin.



"Let us show her what it is to be Hive!"

title: Legacy: The Bladed Path
speaker: Ritual Table
text: Tithe your strength to Eris Morn and discover the truth about the Witch Queen's dangerous bargain.

title: Ritual Table Reputation
speaker: Ritual Table
text: Complete Season of the Witch activities to increase your Ritual Table reputation.

title: Seasonal Heirloom
speaker: Ritual Table
text: This item is required to collect Witch's Keys and Witch's Engrams from Season of the Witch.

title: A Sense of Duty
speaker: Saint-14
text:
Saint-14 is impressed by your commitment to the Last City. "Once again, you have inspired me," he says warmly. "As Guardians, we serve the City in ways that are needed-not only in ways that suit us or bring us personal glory. Every small act counts."



He hands you a book. "Now that I have returned, I will provide new ways for you to serve the people. And together, we will keep this city safe."

title: A False Refraction
speaker: Saint-14
text:
Saint-14 reaches out and shakes your hand. "It is good to see you, Guardian. I have a small problem." Saint produces a display, signal-locked to a source of Light in the Tangled Shore. The signal is weak, but aligns perfectly with the frequency of Saint-14's Light from the Sundial and your newfound chronometric core. "It cannot be me. I am here." Saint laughs nervously.



"Zavala tells me you have… friends in the Tangled Shore." Saint crosses his arms. "I do not think the Fallen would react so well to my presence." He chuckles, unfolds an arm to reveal a data pad, and requests you go in his stead.

title: A Rising Chorus: Act II
speaker: Saint-14
text:
Saint-14 stands in the Hangar, tall and proud, his voice strong.



"Maya Sundaresh, risen from the Vex network," he says, shaking his head. Saint recognized Lakshmi-2's face, though Osiris explained to him it is just a mask Maya feels comfortable wearing. Saint shivers at the thought.



He tells you that he thought his personality might be lost completely when he accessed the mind of his other self.



"But as his thoughts merged with mine, it was as though I lived through his centuries of struggle," he says. "And suddenly, all questions the Conductor put in my mind were answered."



"It does not matter if am the 'real' Saint, or the 'true' Saint," he exclaims. "Every me, is me!"



Fully self-realized, when Maya attempted to command Saint again, he was able to resist.



"But still she forced me to my knees," he snarls. "She is growing stronger."



Failsafe is working to reestablish access to Maya's stronghold at the core of Nessus. 



"And when she finds it… I will be ready."

title: A Hero's Welcome
speaker: Saint-14
text: Saint-14 is overwhelmed by how much the City has changed, but he's happy to be home. He has a plan to build a beacon that will help guide Guardians and Lightless alike to the Last City, and he would like your help. While you handle matters in the field, he will build, and together you'll create a monument to the Last Safe City of Earth.

title: A Lost Relic
speaker: Saint-14
text:
Saint-14 takes the weapon frame from you, holding it as if it is something very precious. "This," he says, looking up from the frame, "was used during the Battle of Twilight Gap. That battle was one of the moments that helped define what we, as a City, stand for."



He hands the frame back to you. "The people of the Last City came together as one to fight that battle, Guardians and Lightless alike. If you could repair this, we would recover an important piece of our history. A symbol of what it means to be a Guardian." He considers the frame in your hands, thinking. "Perhaps, in the ruins of Twilight Gap, you could recover the materials to return this weapon to its former glory."

title: As Prophesied
speaker: Saint-14
text:
Saint-14, armor still scorched from the earlier battle, greeted you with pride.



"Eliksni. Mithrax," he said. "They stood with us, brothers and sisters in battle."



"This is a bond that cannot break."



"The House of Light is part of the City now," he said, "under the protection of Saint-14."

title: Change and Choices
speaker: Saint-14
text:
Saint-14 is a pillar of unshakeable Light, beaming warmth down on you. "My friend, sit with me."



You sit with Saint and his pigeons. Time passes as the two of you look over the City and watch indistinct motion flow through its streets.



"Do not forget to take moments like this to clear your mind." Saint-14 rests a hand on your shoulder. "Osiris says the mind is a muscle. It must be worked, but it tires too, if it carries too much weight for too long. That is the lesson I taught him."



"The Traveler has spoken to us. It roared against the Darkness, and the Pyramids halted." He places his hands on his hips. "Ikora does not see it so."



"I mourn as she does, but this is a time of change-and choices. We must take care in the examples we set."



"Be patient." He crosses his arms. "Vengeance is a dark road. Instead, let us pursue justice."

title: Dawning Delivery
speaker: Saint-14
text: Saint-14 opens his arms to you when you arrive with his gift. He accepts the cookies, sets them aside, and then clasps your hand warmly. He wishes you a happy Dawning.

title: Engram Tracker
speaker: Saint-14
text:
A recorded message from Master Rahool plays when you pick up the engram tracker: 



"Guardian! This is a new device of my own manufacture. It will allow you to monitor the number of engrams available at each of the vendors in the Tower."



"If you ever lose it, you can pick up a new one from any of those vendors. I look forward to seeing you deploy this device."

title: From One Brother to Another
speaker: Saint-14
text:
Saint-14 welcomes you wholeheartedly. He gestures to an odd-looking object. "A gift from Osiris; one not unlike the obelisks you've discovered," he chuckles excitedly.



Saint tells you that Osiris has left him instructions on how to synchronize each obelisk to a central hub in the Tower. "This will be a beacon to guide the lost back home."



He looks the obelisk over for a moment before consulting Osiris's notes." But first… it would appear we are missing pieces." Saint tears off a piece of Osiris's note. "Here, this will help you remember what we need."

title: Honoring the Lost
speaker: Saint-14
text:
"Guardian, welcome to my new home," Saint-14 says, spreading his arms wide. "The City feels like a new world to me. Filled with life, with hope." He lowers his arms and inclines his head. "But it is bittersweet. For all we've gained, I cannot help thinking of how much was lost."



He is quiet for a moment, caught between grief and guilt. "Our losses are many. The colonists who perished after the Collapse. The settlements that our enemies destroyed. The civilians who were scattered during the Red War." He lifts his head. "Perhaps… Perhaps you can help me honor those losses, and we can move forward into this hopeful future."

title: Exploring the Corridors of Time
speaker: Saint-14
text: "The Corridors of Time stretch on forever. I glimpsed them within the Infinite Forest." -Saint-14

title: Legacy: As Prophesied
speaker: Saint-14
text:
Saint-14, armor still scorched from the earlier battle, greeted you with pride.



"Eliksni. Mithrax," he said. "They stood with us, brothers and sisters in battle."



"This is a bond that cannot break."



"The House of Light is part of the City now," he said, "under the protection of Saint-14."

title: Legacy: Path of the Splicer V
speaker: Saint-14
text:
Saint-14 tells you that hearing Mithrax's story about how the Eliksni see him affected him deeply.



"To be seen as a terror. A destroyer. To know children tremble in fear at my name, and mourn what I have taken from them," he says. "This is not the Saint-14 I know."



"I can never forgive what the old Houses did to us, but these are not the old Houses," he tells you.



"We must be more than the enemies of our enemies."

title: Guardian of the People
speaker: Saint-14
text:
Saint-14 opens his arms in welcome. "Guardian, it is good to see you," he says. "And it is good to be home. To be back among the people."



He crosses his arms. "But I have been gone a long time. The City was very different when I was here last, as were my duties as a Guardian. Perhaps you can teach me what it means to be a Guardian in this day and age, and I will follow your example."

title: Increase Reputation
speaker: Saint-14
text: Show Saint-14 proof of your deeds in the Trials of Osiris.

title: Parts and Labor
speaker: Saint-14
text:
Saint-14 takes inventory of the materials you've brought him. "Good. Not one of these pieces has a bullet lodged in it. This is very good." Saint commends your marksmanship before turning his attention to Osiris's instructions.



He carefully pores over multi-layered diagrams and compares them to the unfinished obelisk. "Yes… okay…" Saint turns a piece over in his hand and holds it up to Osiris's notes. He nods and looks to you. "Thank you, Guardian. I will… uh… put this together." He gives a shakey thumbs up.



Saint quickly plugs in the components you've brought. He glances at you over his shoulder before punching an unruly piece into place. "No problem! Ready to deploy!"

title: Legacy: A Rising Chorus: Act II
speaker: Saint-14
text:
Saint-14 stands in the Hangar, tall and proud, his voice strong.



"Maya Sundaresh, risen from the Vex network," he says, shaking his head. Saint recognized Lakshmi-2's face, though Osiris explained to him it is just a mask Maya feels comfortable wearing. Saint shivers at the thought.

Failsafe is working to reestablish access to Maya's stronghold at the core of Nessus.
