title: Primer
speaker: Saint-14
text:
"Guardian, hello!" Saint-14 points to a cluttered overlay of schematics on a page of indecipherable nonsense. "As you can see here, we are missing a key component of Orisis's obelisk device."



Saint-14 studies Osiris's notes for a moment. "It would appear the core powering the Sundial is needed, but it is still anchored to one of the timelines within." After a moment of consideration, Saint-14 looks to you. "I will prepare the device while you retrieve the core." He hands you a summation of the task.

title: Moving Forward
speaker: Saint-14
text:
"My friend." Saint-14 beckons you closer. "I think I have learned a lot from this exercise. Your efforts have allowed me to grieve, but they have also inspired me to move forward with hope in my heart."



He hands you a golden statue: a memorial to the lost colonies of humanity. "This tribute will help me always remember both what we've lost and why we continue to fight. I hope it will be a reminder for you as well."

title: Proving Grounds
speaker: Saint-14
text:
You approach Saint-14; the crest of his helm brims with sunlight. "You are ready. I can feel it!" He straightens his stance and looks you over.



"Guardian, the Trials of Osiris are not simply here to train you." His voice grows out of a low rolling timbre of consideration. "I am here to assess your propensity for leadership," Saint mimics a delivery reminiscent of Osiris as he speaks.



Serious now: "The Darkness is coming. The Moon is only the first glimpse. I know it." He looks into your eyes. "When it arrives, we will need heroes, leaders, as we did at the Gap, at Six Fronts." He leans in. "The others… they will look to you." Saint nods. "You will make me proud."

title: Path of the Splicer V
speaker: Saint-14
text:
Saint-14 tells you that hearing Mithrax's story about how the Eliksni see him affected him deeply.



"To be seen as a terror. A destroyer. To know children tremble in fear at my name, and mourn what I have taken from them," he says. "This is not the Saint-14 I know."



"I can never forgive what the old Houses did to us, but these are not the old Houses," he tells you.



"We must be more than the enemies of our enemies."

title: The Mystery of the Missing Bags
speaker: Saint-14
text:
As you approach Saint-14, you notice a suspiciously large number of well-fed pigeons have gathered around him, all cooing at top volume.



"Hello, noble guard! I suppose you're here about the noise complaints?" Saint asks. His voice is proud and booming as ever, but his gauntleted hands twist nervously.



You shake your head. He breaks instantly. "Ah, well, listen… My little friends looked so hungry. A holiday treat couldn't hurt. Do birds not also deserve to celebrate those they have lost? Eva always makes so many spare, I thought she would not notice any missing."



"Perhaps for the best for their digestion and my carpets, Eva's bags had no candy within. But the local ramen shop had a sack of corn to spare! Much better for their little pigeon bellies."



Saint turns to poke through his supplies and digs out the final surviving bag, only lightly pecked. "I have acted shamefully. I will apologize to Ms. Levante! Here, bring this back to her, my good and perceptive guard."



You stay silent, hoping Saint-14 doesn't recognize you under the mask. With an awkward salute, you leave him to clean up after his birds.

title: Talk to Saint-14
speaker: Saint-14
text:
You've returned Saint-14's old Fusion Rifle, Bastion, to him. He fiddles with the rifle briefly and sets the damaged connections straight with the component you had. The rifle hums to life.



He thanks you for finding the source of his Light and laments that his weaponry was used against Guardians. "Never again," he whispers, before handing the gun back.

title: The Passage of Trials
speaker: Saint-14
text:
Saint-14 bows his head to you. "A fellow warrior of the Light. Come close, let me guide your path to the Lighthouse, my friend." Saint explains that to enter the Trials of Osiris, you must posess a Trials Ticket. Your ticket will track your wins and losses. Each ticket has a different powerful effect.



Saint looks over a blank ticket. "You want as many wins as possible, obviously…" he chuckles, "but do not lose three matches, or you are done." He continues that seven wins with no losses grants access to the Lighthouse for Flawless Rewards. "I await your ascension to the Lighthouse. Good luck."



You can reset your Trials Passage on the item in your Pursuits, or on the Trials of Osiris activity node.

title: The Passage of Trials
speaker: Saint-14
text:
Saint-14 bows his head to you. "A fellow warrior of the Light. Come close, let me guide your path to the Lighthouse, my friend." Saint explains that to enter the Trials of Osiris, you must possess a Trials Passage. Your passage will track your round or match wins. Each passage offers a different experience.



Saint looks over a blank passage. "You want as many wins as possible, obviously…" he chuckles. He continues, saying that seven wins on a Lighthouse Passage grants access to the Lighthouse for extra rewards. "I await your ascension to the Lighthouse. Good luck."



You can reset your Trials Passage on the item in your Quests tab, or on the Trials of Osiris activity node.

title: The Pigeon Provides
speaker: Saint-14
text:
Saint listens eagerly to your story of delivering the Etherdips. He is especially pleased to hear that the young Eliksni enjoyed the treats most of all.



"This is good news," he says with a contented sigh. "I know these Eliksni have seen me as a monster in the past. I hope this will show I have moved away from that. It is not too late to show them who we are-Mithrax taught me that. And it was not too late for me to learn."



The big Titan is quiet for a moment as he listens to the pigeons gently cooing at his feet. "This Dawning has helped my heart, Guardian. There is… not peace within me, but there is a small warmth-something I feared I might not feel again."



"For this, I thank you."

title: The Coming Trials
speaker: Saint-14
text:
"Welcome, Guardian! I too look to training when my spirit has sunken."



"The Lighthouse still stands… in a way," he explains. "Osiris's followers made devices: built from scrap delivered to them by the Guardians who patrolled Mercury before it vanished. I found them as I searched for Vance, but it seems he had heeded Osiris's words and abandoned the spire."



"It took much convincing; Osiris showed me how to use these devices to simulate our arenas." Saint stares directly into the distant sun. "The simulated Sun is not as hot as it was on Mercury, but it is just as bright." He turns to you. "I told Shaxx to do the same. We will see if he listens."



He reaches for a fresh Trials Passage. "A fight is coming, Guardian. Do not lose yourself in the chaos."

title: The Trials of Osiris
speaker: Saint-14
text: Saint-14 is overjoyed that you have chosen to take part in the Trials of Osiris. He tries to contain his excitement as he delivers his wonderfully rehearsed speech. Afterward, he nods and says, "I know you will give this everything, Guardian. You've never been one to hold back."

title: Trials Access
speaker: Saint-14
text:
Your zeal is noted, friend, but your Light requires refinement. As the acting Officiator of the Trials of Osiris, Saint-14 has assessed the necessary requirements for entry. His assessment has set the entry bar at a measurable Power of 960. While every Guardian has strength in their own right, some do not yet have the battle experience to operate seemlessly in a Trials fireteam.



Reach Power 960 to participate in the Trials of Osiris.

title: Trials Access
speaker: Saint-14
text:
Saint-14 greets you with an approving nod. "How do you feel? Tired? Triumphant? Both?" 



Before you can answer, his laugh echoes through the Hangar. "I knew you would do well, Guardian. So I saved this for you." He extends a gleaming weapon to you; the Hangar's lights glitter off its surface.



"Remember, the more you win in Trials, the better! Stronger weapons will help. But the rest… that is up to you."

title: The Passage of Trials
speaker: Saint-14
text:
Saint-14 bows his head to you. "A fellow warrior of the Light. Come close, let me guide your path to the Lighthouse, my friend." Saint explains that to enter the Trials of Osiris, you must possess a Trials Ticket. Your ticket will track your wins. Each ticket has a different powerful effect.



Saint looks over a blank ticket. "You want as many wins as possible, obviously…" he chuckles. He continues, saying that seven wins with no losses grants access to the Lighthouse for Flawless Rewards. "I await your ascension to the Lighthouse. Good luck."



You can reset your Trials Passage on the item in your Quests tab, or on the Trials of Osiris activity node.

title: Trials Access
speaker: Saint-14
text:
Your zeal is noted, friend, but your Light requires refinement. As the acting officiator of the Trials of Osiris, Saint-14 has assessed the necessary requirements for entry. His assessment has set the entry bar at a measurable Power of {var:3800354482}. While every Guardian has strength in their own right, some do not yet have the battle experience to operate seamlessly in a Trials fireteam.



Reach Power {var:3800354482}, complete your Competitive Placement Matches, and defeat opponents in Competitive Crucible to participate in the Trials of Osiris.

title: The Pigeon Provides
speaker: Saint-14
text:
"Wonderful!" cries Saint as you place the ingredients before him and set down Eva's Holiday Oven. "Now, we become bakers!"



The process is unexpectedly dangerous. While he measures ingredients carefully, Saint has little regard for cooking time, believing that hotter flames will simply bake more quickly. The Hangar fills with so much smoke that Amanda Holliday rushes over with a fire extinguisher. At one point, Saint is forced to use Ward of Dawn to protect you both from the rapidly rising Kellsdough. His desperate cries of "More sugar!" will echo in your mind for weeks to come.



Finally, it is done, and the delicately spiced, carefully molded nuggets of frosted Ether have been gently wrapped in spirals of flaky dough and baked to golden perfection. A quick dip in an Ether glaze and the Swaddled Etherdips are ready for delivery.



"We are champions of the Dawning this day, my friend," says Saint with deep satisfaction. "Now, quickly, go hand them out while they're still warm."

title: Trials Access
speaker: Saint-14
text:
You approach Saint-14; the crest of his helm brims with sunlight. "You are ready for a mighty tournament!" He straightens his stance and looks you over.



"You will not win the Trials of Osiris with only strength. Here, we test teamwork!" His voice rises, punctuating the final word. "You should fight with those you trust. If you fall, your friends must bring you back in the fight." 



Saint leans in, and he sounds more like his usual self. "Do not worry! Even defeat teaches lessons. If you lose, you can still test yourself against other Guardians on the way to the Lighthouse. Or start over and try again, until you are undefeated." You can almost hear the grin in his voice. "Fight hard, and you will be rewarded. But better rewards if you win, yes?"

title: The Pigeon Provides
speaker: Saint-14
text:
"Guardian! Just who I wanted to see!" Saint-14's voice is bright and he spreads his arms wide when he sees you.



"I have had a wonderous idea for the Dawning," he says proudly. "The Eliksni of the House of Light, they live alongside us now, yes? But still, in many ways, they are outsiders."



He leans close to you. "This Dawning, we change that."



"I remember how I felt welcomed when I first came to the Tower and Guardians brought me lavender cookies. So I think, let us help Eliksni to feel the same way!"



"There is one problem," he says, scratching at the dent in his helmet. "What is lovely cookie to us may be terrible gift for them. They have been polite enough! I want to give them true Eliksni delights for Dawning."



"But worry not," he says with a smile. "For I have heard of a database they left when they fled Europa!"



"And in that data?" He nudges you.



"Recipe!" he shouts before you can answer.



"Now go!" he says, pushing you back with such enthusiasm you nearly stumble. "Find this recipe, and let us spread Dawning cheers all over our Eliksni friends!"

title: Trials Access
speaker: Saint-14
text: The Trials of Osiris are demanding and you are not yet powerful enough to survive in them. Reach Power level 1210, acquire Valor Legend rank, and defeat opponents in Elimination.

title: Trials Access
speaker: Saint-14
text:
You approach Saint-14; the crest of his helm brims with sunlight. "You are ready. I can feel it!" He straightens his stance and looks you over.



"Guardian, the Trials of Osiris are not simply here to train you." His voice grows out of a low rolling timbre of consideration. "I am here to assess your propensity for leadership," Saint mimics a delivery reminiscent of Osiris as he speaks.



Serious now: "The Darkness will not conquer us. I know it." He looks into your eyes. "We will need heroes, leaders, as we did at the Gap, at Six Fronts." He leans in. "The others… they will look to you." Saint nods. "You will make me proud."

title: Trials Access

text:

text:

"Remember this lesson-we will never reach our true potential unless we welcome challengers."

text:

With the superconductor in hand, his mission is complete. Zavala has given him new orders to keep an eye on Hive and Fallen activity in the Cosmodrome, so he entrusts you to deliver the relic to the Last City.



Shaw says farewell with a final gift: Maeve's jumpship, waiting in orbit for a new pilot.



Hover over the ship icon below and select it with , then use the Director to travel to the Last City.

title: And Out Fly the Wolves
speaker: Shaw Han
text:
Shaw Han looks at the Gjallarhorn with unrestrained awe. "The weapon of heroes," he whispers.



He pulls his eyes away from the gleaming barrel for a moment. "Guess that makes you the hero, huh?" he says with a grin. "I knew it the first time I laid eyes on you… of course, I think most of the Guardians I see are heroes. And I'm usually right."



"I have one last thing for you," he says, patting his pockets. "Hold it out, would you?"



You hold the Gjallarhorn steady and Shaw pulls something from a pouch on his belt: a small golden feather.



"I found this in the rubble of the old vaults after Ghaul's attack. I've been holding on to it ever since… for hope, I guess. To remind me of the strength of the Guardians. And now-"



He presses the gold feather into the winged wolf that adorns the Gjallarhorn. It fits into place with a satisfying click.



"-now I don't think I need a reminder," he says, then raises a fist into the sky. "Because the Guardians have the Gjallarhorn again!"



"Now get out there and let the galaxy know the big guns are back!"

title: A Guardian Rises
speaker: Shaw Han
text:
Shaw thanks you for your help, and apologizes for not trusting you to help him.



With the superconductor in hand, his mission is complete. Zavala has given him new orders to keep an eye on Hive and Fallen activity in the Cosmodrome, so he entrusts you to deliver the relic to the Last City.

ACQUIRE SHIP

title: And Out Fly the Wolves
speaker: Shaw Han
text:
Shaw Han lets out a low whistle when you show him the Wolfpack Round.



"You found this under the Loot Cave? I almost can't believe I'm seeing one of these in person," he says as he carefully turns the shell over in his hands.



"I used to hear stories about the Gjallarhorn, you know. What it was capable of, that kind of thing. Never got to see one in action, though."



He pauses as a newly risen Guardian approaches. Shaw shows them how to manifest a grenade by concentrating Light in his palm. The Guardian nods and walks off, flicking their wrist.



He turns back to you. "There was meant to be a tradition where every generation of Guardians would forge their own Gjallarhorn. But then Ghaul destroyed the vaults, and with everything that's happened since then… I mean, Uldren. The Darkness. And now Savathûn…"



Shaw notices he has a white-knuckle grip on the shell. He hands it back to you.



"If you have a shell, then the Gjallarhorn never left us. Maybe it's time to bring it back."



"See what you can shake out of the Fallen scavengers around here. If you can find more traces of the original Gjallarhorn…"



"…you're about to change things for all of us."

title: And Out Fly the Wolves
speaker: Shaw Han
text:
"You found a full set," Shaw Han says, shaking his head in disbelief. "The Gjallarhorn reborn. I can't believe I'm going to be here for its second coming."



"But I'm getting way ahead of myself," he chuckles. "You're going to need a targeting system, armored housing, the whole deal-and I think I can help you out with one of those."



Shaw rummages through a nearby pile of gear and pulls a tarnished housing unit from near the bottom.



"I had the New Lights training with this launcher before it got dry-fired one too many times and fell to pieces. The armor's still good, though. It withstood hundreds of training rounds without so much as a crack."



"This could be the base. Think of it like you're using the strength of the new Guardians-I don't know, I'm not great at that symbolism stuff." He hands the housing to you.



"Now we need to find a gunsmith as good as Feizel Crux to piece this thing together."



He thinks to himself, then shrugs. "Banshee?" he offers. "I know the Vanguard uses him for pretty much everything, but there's a reason for that. I'm sure he'd appreciate the chance to put his mark on the next generation of the Gjallarhorn too."



"Head on up to the Tower. I'll be waiting for you… I want to be there the first time you shoot that thing!"

title: Learning Light
speaker: Shaw Han
text:
As you offer the remains of Maeve's Ghost to Shaw, he pauses, then gestures for you to wait a moment. He pulls the edge of his cloak taut, materializes a knife, and slices a strip of cloth free.



With reverence, Shaw wraps the shards of Ghost shell in the cloth, then holds the bundle gently. 



"It's an old Hunter tradition, a way to honor lost friends. Not practiced much these days."



Looking back at you, he seems to realize something. His eyes brighten and search all around you.



"Have you felt your connection to the Traveler yet?" he asks. "I don't mean throwing purple grenades and shooting golden guns, something deeper."



Shaw tells you to find a quiet place and meditate on the Light. Strange as that sounds, he promises it will make you stronger. "Don't worry, it's not supposed to make sense."

title: And Out Fly the Wolves
speaker: Shaw Han
text:
"Hey, Guardian! Got a minute?" Shaw Han calls as you walk up.



"You've been around the system a bit, yeah?" he asks. "Have you ever seen anything like this?"



Shaw shows you a cracked piece of crystal, faded and gray. It almost looks like-



"It almost looks like a piece of an engram, right?" Shaw says. "But dead, calcified, empty. Engrams don't act like this. Once their data is drained, they decompile. It's weird."



"A New Light brought me this. Said he found it in a little gap in the rocks not far from here… before the Red War, Guardians used to call it the 'Loot Cave.' Rumor was it was overflowing with engrams for some reason."



He shrugs. "Every piece of treasure was pulled out by Guardians long ago, though. The place is picked clean. I poke my head in from time to time on my patrols, but there's nothing left."



He turns the shard over in his hands. "Or so I thought."



"Do you think you could head to the Loot Cave and check it out for me? Any old piece of tech might help the Vanguard, and these days, we need all the help we can get."

title: Beyond Light
speaker: Shaw Han
text:
"These Fallen sure know how to keep us on our toes."



Shaw tells you that Eramis has been trying to recruit her old comrades from the former House of Devils for a while; for her to arrive in person now must mean she's growing desperate. 



Word is, she brought along a trusted sergeant, Bakris, the Adamantine, and empowered her with Stasis as a demonstration of the forces at her disposal. Shaw suspects the sergeant has remained in the Cosmodrome in order to ensure the Devils follow through on their pledge to relocate to Europa. 



Locate Bakris, the Adamantine and scatter the Devils before they leave for Europa. Defeat Fallen in the Cosmodrome, The Divide.

title: Legacy: Beyond Light
speaker: Shaw Han
text:
"These Fallen sure know how to keep us on our toes."

title: Atlas and Almanac
speaker: Simulant Ansible
text:
Maya and Chioma are pleased with the data you've managed to glean from the Vex thus far.



While all they need for their work is information on the Conductor's whereabouts, that's not all they've managed to collect. They offer you their preliminary research on VexNet matter-conversion formulae with gratitude, in the hopes you'll find something valuable within it.



You can now attune to armor from "The Desert Perpetual." Complete additional steps to unlock attunement for more gear.

title: Dawning Delivery
speaker: Shaw Han
text:
Shaw takes the crumbler from you and grins. "If you've got time for baking, things must be going well for you in the Tower," he laughs.



He takes a bite. "How'd you know I love blueberries?"

title: Learning Light
speaker: Shaw Han
text:
Shaw looks you up and down as you stride into the scout post.



"I see you've made progress. I knew it would happen soon, but it's amazing to see how much you've learned." He smiles. "Not long ago, you were fresh out of the ground with only a rusty rifle to your name. Now you're on your way to mastering the powers of the Light. Ikora had better keep an eye on you. Make sure to tell her I said that next time you see her in the Last City."



Shaw looks down at his cloak, freshly mended from where it was cut earlier. 



"Just remember this power has its limits, Guardian. Keep your Ghost close at all times."

title: Atlas and Almanac
speaker: Simulant Ansible
text:
The ansible clicks and crackles before giving way to Maya and Chioma's voices, arriving from the simulation they've dubbed Green Moon Rho.



"The Conductor is out there somewhere. Her Echo is failing, and I am absolutely sure she's looking for some new power to compensate." Maya's voice is grim. She knows her other self better than anyone.



"We think we can find her. Or at least, narrow down the possibility of where in the VexNet she's working," Chioma says, determined. "You helped us find our way to each other-with a small tweak to our methods, I believe we can find her."



She adds with an audible smile for Maya, "I missed my research assistant."



Maya and Chioma sign off, ready for the work ahead. It's time to return to the anchors you've already placed and draw a path on your map.

title: Map and Territory
speaker: Simulant Ansible
text:
The Simulant Ansible presses at the border of Unknown Space and the Vex Network, connecting the threads of simulated worlds beyond number. 227.50 Chioma Esi, herself a simulation of the Vex and a longtime explorer of the Network, speaks to you through its towering figure.



"Maya and I are at different points within the Net. With you, we make three."



"Three points of triangulation: the first step towards a map," Maya adds. "The Vex use their network for simulations, billions of them layered one atop the other. At points of similarity, they converge."



Chioma and Maya can use the nature of the Ansible to call forth a series of anchors with which you may connect the web of Vex simulations.



With the determination of one committed to the impossible, Chioma tells you: "We can begin to chart the VexNet itself."

title: Ascendant Lens
speaker: Sloane
text:
Queen Mara's eyebrows lift as you hand her the Ascendant Lens. "This is an exceedingly rare trinket," she says, peering at you through the lens.



"It may not look like much to a common Guardian, but in the hands of our Techeuns, it will be a valuable research tool. You were right to bring it to me."



"Allow me to repay your generosity," she says, handing you a handsome reward.



You start to thank her, but she's already walking away. You've been dismissed.

title: Clarion Call: Titan
speaker: Sloane
text:
Hey Guardian,




        Now I know why they call it the European Dead Zone. You killed everything!

title: Where in the Cosmodrome Is Archie?
speaker: Shaw Han
text: "Oh yeah, I saw our little friend. He took off in the direction of the Skywatch. Barking about a cave."

title: Map and Territory
speaker: Simulant Ansible
text:
The Simulant Ansible crackles to life once more, projecting voices from the other end of the Vex Network.



"We've charted paths within the Network, learned more about the Vex, and… Maya and I have found our way back to each other," 227.50 Chioma says. She adds, "All thanks to you."



227.87 Maya, now at Chioma's side, says, "Our work continues. We must rally the other exploratory teams, and we must stop the Conductor before she kills again. She may not be me, but I recognize myself in her. I owe it to Chioma to stop her. I owe it to myself."



"So, you're being self-serving," Chioma says, not without a fond twist of humor.



"It's part of my baseline." Maya's voice is wry. "We may as well use it."



Maya and Chioma will continue their work within the VexNet with the help of your map and wish you the best in your battles against the Vex outside it.

title: Enemy of My Enemy
speaker: Sloane
text: You recovered the methane reactor and helped prevent further power shortages.  All systems are fully functional.  Sloane thanks you.

title: Clarion Call: Titan
speaker: Sloane
text: Now I know why they call it the European Dead Zone. You killed everything!

title: Dawning Delivery
speaker: Sloane
text: Sloane, always up for a challenge, looks eager to test the durability of the nigh-unbreakable cookies.

title: Enemy of My Enemy
speaker: Sloane
text:
The data you recovered from the Fallen indicate there is a functional methane reactor somewhere on the abandoned rig. If you can recover it, Sloane will be able to prevent additional power shortages. 



Find the Methane Reactor and bring it back online.

title: Evacuation: Titan
speaker: Sloane
text:
"You're back," Sloane says. "I've been sending supplies to Zavala, but I'm not finished here. Not yet."



"The Hive's preparing a massive ritual beneath the Arcology. Get in there and stop them. They want us to back off, which means we push harder."



"There's also activity on the surface. Some kind of Hive Treasurer has been dredging up Golden Age tech… and I've been letting it." She raises a hand to quiet your protests. "They've been looking for something specific. And they finally found it."



"You just have to go pick it up."

title: Faction Reward
speaker: Sloane
text: Your reputation in the Crucible precedes you. Take this reward in recognition of your deeds.

title: Faction Reward

text: Complete patrols and public events on Titan to get Arcology tokens and earn Level 20 rewards from Sloane.

title: Faction Reward

title: Dawning's Gift: Sloane
speaker: Sloane
text: Sloane's stern demeanor doesn't crack when you hand her the gift, but she's never been one for effusive displays of gratitude.

title: FLASHPOINT: TITAN
speaker: Sloane
text:
Complete various activities around the moon Titan, including public events, Lost Sectors, and Heroic adventures.




        Complete various activities around the moon Titan, including public events, Lost Sectors, and Heroic adventures.

title: Discover Titan
speaker: Sloane
text:
"Welcome to Titan, Guardian. The situation here is stable, but… The Rig. The Sinking Docks. The Solarium. Every inch of this old structure's under constant threat from the Hive and Fallen."



Sloane offers bounties, quests, and more to Guardians who help her defend Titan.



Find patrols, public events, adventures, and Lost Sectors in the world.

title: Forceful Protection
speaker: Sloane
text:
"A welcome face. Thanks for all you've done for us. The fragile existence we're holding onto is maintained only through the efforts of Guardians like yourself."



Explore Titan and complete activities to earn XP and new rewards.

title: Increase Reputation
speaker: Sloane
text: Show Sloane proof of your deeds on Titan.

title: Enemy of My Enemy
speaker: Sloane
text:
With your help, Sloane secured our hold on Titan. Unfortunately, ongoing enemy activity remains a threat. There are reports of Fallen threatening this rig's stability on the ocean surface. 



Clear the Fallen threat.

title: Faction Reward
speaker: Sloane
text: Complete patrols and public events on Titan to get Alkane Dust and earn rewards from Sloane.

title: Not in our House
speaker: Sloane
text:
Sloane digs around for a moment and hands you an odd, purple candy. It cracks and fizzes in your hand. She says, solemnly, "Death has passed us by this night."



After a moment, she breaks into a sheepish grin. "Is that still what the kids say when they give out candy? Anyway. Happy Festival of the Lost, Guardian."

title: FLASHPOINT: TITAN
speaker: Sloane
text:
Sloane thanks you for eliminating the hostiles on Titan.




        Sloane thanks you for eliminating the hostiles on Titan.

title: Reach Level 20
speaker: Sloane
text: Increase your level to claim these rewards.

title: Sloane
speaker: Sloane
text:
Sloane is impressed with your many successful adventures on Titan. Speak with her in the Command Center.




        Sloane thanks you for the work you've done in securing Titan.



New challenges appear on the horizon, however.

title: Fortifying Titan
speaker: Sloane
text:
"Good work out there," Sloane tells you.



"I'll put together a plan. In the meantime, you just keep sending those Hive back through their portals in little pieces."



She falls silent, lost for a moment in the shadow of the Pyramid. She looks out over Titan's tumultuous seas, her jaw set, her mouth a hard line.



You nod. Sloane nods back. It's enough.

title: Not in our House
speaker: Sloane
text:
Sloane takes the sugary engram from you, smiling. "I've got a bit of a sweet tooth," she says. "And we don't get much occasion for sweets out here, so. Thanks."



She sets the candy aside. "Guardians stationed out here get tired of it fast. The Hive never stop, never slow down. That and the endless rain make it kind of grueling. I'm hoping that some candy and masks might brighten things up."

title: Preparation: Titan
speaker: Sloane
text:
"I was wondering who Zavala would send," Sloane says as you arrive. She seems pleased to see you. "He's watching the skies, but I'm more concerned about what's happening on the ground."



"I'm seeing increased hostile activity across the board. The Hive's digging deep for Golden Age tech. They know the Pyramids have us distracted, and they're taking everything they can reach."



In the distance, you hear the unearthly cackling of Hive. "They think they can pick our bones before we're dead?"



She squares her shoulders. The medals on her spaulders clink softly. "Not a chance."

title: The Red War
speaker: Sloane
text:
Hi




        The control center is secure and operational. Now it's time to focus on those intercepted Red Legion transmissions, which could provide a significant advantage in the war. Amanda Holliday needs the power of the central processing units in the bowels of the Arcology to crack the encryption. 



Choose your exotic gear and retrieve a Golden Age CPU by completing mission "Utopia."

title: Sloane
speaker: Sloane
text:
After your decisive victory over Ghaul, Sloane wishes to congratulate a fellow warrior. Speak with her in the Command Center.




        Sloane congratulates you on your victory over Ghaul.



While the head of the Red Legion has been slain, the Red War continues across the solar system.

title: Sloane
speaker: Sloane
text:
When a Guardian dies, the entire community mourns them. Go check in on Sloane to see how she's doing.




        Even if the Vanguard doesn't support you, Sloane does. She understands what it's like to lose a comrade. Sometimes, a Guardian has to follow their heart. No matter where it leads you.

title: Sloane
speaker: Sloane
text:
The control center is secure and operational. Now it's time to focus on those intercepted Red Legion transmissions, which could provide a significant advantage in the war. Amanda Holliday needs the power of the central processing units in the bowels of the Arcology to crack the encryption. 



Retrieve a Golden Age CPU by completing mission "Utopia."

title: Unnamed Interaction
speaker: Sloane
text:
Hey Guardian,




        Now I know why they call it the European Dead Zone. You killed everything!

title: Aquatic Operations
speaker: Sonar Station
text: "Arcology's seen better days. Let's salvage what we can from them and fight for a new tomorrow." -Deputy Commander Sloane

title: The Red War
speaker: Sloane
text:
The control center is secure and operational. Now it's time to focus on those intercepted Red Legion transmissions, which could provide a significant advantage in the war. Amanda Holliday needs the power of the central processing units in the bowels of the Arcology to crack the encryption. 



Choose your exotic gear and retrieve a Golden Age CPU by completing mission "Utopia."

title: Titan Challenges
speaker: Sloane
text: Lost wonders await beneath the waves, and thanks to your efforts we're one step closer to rediscovering them.

title: Engram Tracker
speaker: Sonar Station
text:
A recorded message from Master Rahool plays when you pick up the engram tracker: 



"Guardian! This is a new device of my own manufacture. It will allow you to monitor the number of engrams available at each of the vendors in the Tower."



"If you ever lose it, you can pick up a new one from any of those vendors. I look forward to seeing you deploy this device."

title: Legacy: Into the Depths
speaker: Sonar Station
text:
Saladin commends you on your progress thus far and instructs you to conduct another dive for more coral.



He also comments on your continued teamwork with Sloane, drawing a parallel to his own experiences leading the Iron War Beasts.



"I had forgotten what such camaraderie could be like," he admits, "and I suspect the same holds true for Sloane."



Saladin urges you to keep working together as you carry out the mission.

title: Legacy: Beneath the Waves
speaker: Sonar Station
text:
Despite the ordeal she's been through, Sloane appears to maintain her composure as deputy commander.



"Good to be back in contact with the Vanguard," she says.



While Titan was gone, Sloane took on the Taken corruption in order to better track the enemy's movements as she rotated between extraction points. She also formed a psychic bond with Ahsa, a massive paracausal sea creature that dwells within Kraken Mare.



Ahsa has critically important information regarding the Witness, but her bond with Sloane must be amplified before it can be divulged.



"Drifter claims he knows a way," Sloane tells you, before supplying you with gear that will allow you to explore the depths of Titan's methane sea.

title: Gone Fishin'
speaker: Sonar Station
text:
The holoprojector's speaker crackles back on after Sloane signs off. Drifter's voice comes in loud and clear.



"Hey, hero! Heard you brought back a little something extra from your dip in the drink. Now obviously it ain't gonna add anything to my machine… but I got a feeling it could be useful in other ways."



"Why don't you swing by the Tower and pay Hawthorne a visit? Something tells me she'll be pleased to see it."

title: Legacy: Into the Depths
speaker: Sonar Station
text:
The screen illuminates, revealing an encoded message that unscrambles itself as the projector recognizes your credentials. It reads:



This on? Uhh… start recording. Oh, it is… okay.



Hey, hero-[clears throat]



Hey, hero.



You dredged up some mighty fine scrap for me. Pyramid tech that all those rot-bags could get their hands on, and I hammered that black gold into shape. Now my rig's running smoother than liquid methane.



Sloane and the long girl, their special link is pretty strong, thanks to you and me, but it's missing something to bridge the gap between the big ol' worm and our little ol' lady, Thunderguns… respectfully.



Seeing as how you're always in the mood to do favors, how 'bout one more? I need something… under the table.



We need a little something out of both worlds, you dig? One of those traitor Ghosts. The bad ones… the Hive ones. Scrap 'em, and bring me the fragments.



Savvy's throne world is chock full of 'em, but I've got one in mind. Details'll hit ya soon.

title: Legacy: Into the Depths
speaker: Sonar Station
text:
Saint is pleased with the mission's progress, but remains concerned over Sloane's well-being. 



He recounts how Xivu Arath goaded Osiris into a battle he couldn't win, and how Sagira was slain as a result. Even Saint himself is not immune to the war god's barbs.



"I have felt how the right word, the right face, can incite one to violence," he says with a heavy heart.



He urges you to stay beside Sloane and offer her the support she needs.

title: Legacy: Into the Depths
speaker: Sonar Station
text:
Drifter informs you that a strange coral with psychic properties similar to the egregore fungus you've encountered in the past is growing deep beneath the waves of Kraken Mare. He posits that it can be used to strengthen Sloane's bond with Ahsa.



"I can modify my Gambit equipment to bank that stuff and harness its power," he explains, "but I'll need some Golden Age parts to do it."



He tasks you with salvaging the necessary equipment so that he can prep you for a dive.



"So, what do you say? Ready for another swim?"

title: Legacy: Into the Depths
speaker: Sonar Station
text:
Saladin informs you of a Hive ritual that targeted Ahsa and seemed to injure her. Ahsa has descended into the ocean depths to put a stop to it, with Sloane and Zavala in pursuit. Saladin sends you in after them while he mobilizes the Iron War Beasts.



"We need you in the fight, Guardian."



He transfers the coordinates to your Ghost and orders you to prep for an emergency dive. The hunt is on.

title: Legacy: Into the Depths
speaker: Sonar Station
text: Salvage Golden Age tech and dive into the depths of Kraken Mare.

title: Legacy: Into the Depths
speaker: Sonar Station
text:
Sloane opens up to you about all she's been struggling with since Titan's return. Much has happened while she's been gone, leaving her feeling like it's impossible to catch up to it all.



"If I returned to the Tower," she asks, "would it even be my home anymore?"



She relates how Xivu Arath's voice has been echoing in her head, telling her that the only place she belongs is on the battlefield. Sloane has to wonder if she might be right.



Either way, the deputy commander is fully committed to seeing the mission through, regardless of where she ends up when it's done.

title: Legacy: Into the Depths
speaker: Sonar Station
text:
Drifter says he's put the salvage you've brought him to good use, but that he needs parts from a different type of machinery to further improve his device.



"I need Savathûn's swamp to wash up a few finishing touches for my rig," he elaborates.



He instructs you to travel to Savathûn's throne world and secure pieces of Pyramid technology from the Scorn. With it, he can modify his extraction equipment to work in the deepest trenches of Kraken Mare.

title: Legacy: Into the Depths
speaker: Sonar Station
text:
Sloane confirms that the coral was successful in allowing her to boost her connection with Ahsa. However, doing so also amplifies the Taken interference that plagues them both.



"I started hearing it when my arm got this new paint job," she confides in you. "But it hasn't sounded that real since…"



She shakes it off and reiterates that Drifter's plan seems like it will work. Though she needs some time to recover, she'll be ready to connect with Ahsa again soon.



"That's the mission," she declares. "And I always complete the mission."

title: Legacy: Into the Depths
speaker: Sonar Station
text:
Zavala informs you that Drifter can improve the device he's been building if you are able to provide him with more Golden Age salvage. The mission is progressing according to plan, but placing it on Sloane's shoulders doesn't sit well with Zavala.



"Sloane's been through enough as it is," he tells you.



Zavala recounts how he debriefed Sloane on the events that transpired while she was gone, and how she buried her reaction to it-particularly the news of Amanda's death.



He asks you to stand by Sloane in his stead, to be the confidant he feels he can't be as her commander.



"Show her that she doesn't have to fight this battle alone."

title: Legacy: Into the Depths
speaker: Sonar Station
text:
Sloane seems to carry the full weight of Ahsa's revelations on her shoulders, likening the Witness's obsession with finding purpose to her own internal struggles.



She reflects on her own search for purpose, and how it's led her to cling to the mission at hand.



"Without it," she painfully admits to you, "I'm lost."



Sloane questions why she has endured all that she has, and the only answer she can come up with is to see her current mission through.



"If I can do that, it will all have been worth it."



Her connection with Ahsa ended before she could tell us how to get through the portal. Once they have both recovered, it will be time for one last dive.

title: Legacy: Into the Depths
speaker: Sonar Station
text:
Sloane confides in you that it hasn't been easy for her to see Saladin in command of the Iron War Beasts.



"We lost a lot of people in the Red War," she explains, "and now Saladin commands an Imperial Legion?"



She recounts how many Guardians under her own command lost their lives to establish a foothold on Titan, and how she refused to give up that ground without a fight.



Despite her initial reservations, she recognizes that Saladin wouldn't have joined Caiatl's War Council unless he felt it was noble and right.



Choosing to trust his judgment, she tells you she'll soon be ready for another dive.

title: Legacy: Into the Depths
speaker: Sonar Station
text:
Sloane reports that Ahsa's thoughts are becoming clearer to her, despite the Taken interference.



"Hearing those sounds puts me right back in the thick of it," she tells you as the memories of that time claw at her.



She reflects on how her bond with Ahsa bolstered her resolve throughout the harrowing ordeal, and how they're both giving it their all to see this mission completed.



Unfortunately, it seems that Drifter needs some additional time to improve his machine. Sloane is loathe to sit and wait, but she doesn't have a choice in the matter.

title: Seasonal Heirloom
speaker: Sonar Station
text: This item is required to collect Salvage Keys, Deep Dive Keys, and Deep Engrams from Season of the Deep.

title: Sonar Station Reputation
speaker: Sonar Station
text: Complete Salvage and Deep Dive activities to increase your Sonar Station Reputation.

title: A Cry from Beyond
speaker: Spider
text: As Spider summons you back in his sanctum, you can hear the greed in his voice. It seems he has important information for you… and information is always valuable.

title: Legacy: Into the Depths
speaker: Sonar Station
text:
Sloane breathes a long-awaited sigh of relief.



"The mission is complete," she declares. "I've waited a long time to say those words."



She reflects on how she used to dread what would come after, and how she now realizes that constantly pushing forward doesn't help her move past what she's been through.



Sloane informs you that Ahsa has entered hibernation, and that she will remain on Titan to watch over Ahsa for now. 



She promises to one day return to the Tower, and warns you to watch your back when it comes time to revive Savathûn.



"If you ever need to punch her lights out," she says with a grin, "you know where to find me."

title: A Smiling Mask
speaker: Spider
text:
"Ah, my dear associate," Spider says with a laugh. "You must be here about that favor I asked. I'll cut to the chase: some years ago, the House of Kings had a rather auspicious salvaging operation out in the rings of Saturn. The crew ran afoul of the Vex on their way back and they disappeared-along with their cargo.



"Rumor has it that the Vex hauled it to one of their simulations-the Haunted Forest. My proposition is simple: I give you the coordinates, you hunt down the caches, and we split the difference.



"Just one catch. The caches were all locked with adaptive ciphers from the House of Kings, so you'll need to scrounge up some decoders around the system to unlock the caches.



"I'm sure someone will be willing to part with them… one way or another. Maybe, if you find everything, I'll have a little something extra in it for you. To sweeten the pot."

title: Ascendant Hunter
speaker: Spider
text:
Spider is pleased-your pursuit of Xivu Arath's most trusted devotee has paid off, as the High Celebrant has been tracked to the Dreaming City, and you now have what you need to end their reign of terror.



Travel to the Dreaming City and eliminate the High Celebrant.

title: Ascendant Hunter
speaker: Spider
text: "A deal's a deal," Spider says. "Take what you came for and get out."

title: Beyond the Watchtower
speaker: Spider
text:
Speak with the Spider on the Tangled Shore.




        "Ah, the talisman… it's beautiful. I envy you, friend. With that lovely little bauble, you may now enter the Dreaming City. Give Petra Venj my… regards… won't you?



"I've taken the liberty of preparing you an escort. They are ready to march when you are." -The Spider

title: Apocryphal Accomplice
speaker: Spider
text:
"I had complete faith in you," Spider says with greedy anticipation. "It looks like you've recovered everything the House of Kings salvaged before they, ah, met with an untimely fate."



Spider leans back, satisfied with your efforts. "In exchange for your discretion on matters of my salvage, I wanted to offer you this. Something I picked up in the Dreaming City a while back. Think of it as a… trophy for a job well done."



"Now run along; I have business to tend to."

title: Beyond the Watchtower
speaker: Spider
text:
Complete the Awoken Artifact




        "This bauble Petra gave you... it's missing pieces. I know because I've seen 'em before around the Shore. Seen folk kill for 'em, too. If I had one, I'd stash it in a Lost Sector to keep it safe. You understand me?" -The Spider

title: Beyond the Watchtower
speaker: Spider
text:
Petra gave you a talisman that will allow you to enter the Dreaming City. Inspect it in your inventory to begin a quest to mend and charge it.




        "This bauble Petra gave you… it's missing pieces. I know because I've seen 'em before around the Shore. Seen folk kill for 'em, too. If I had one, I'd stash it in a Lost Sector to keep it safe. You understand me?" -The Spider

title: Dawning Delivery
speaker: Spider
text: You can sense the Spider's hunger. It's unsettling. Best to move on before he consumes what you've made him.

title: Even Handed
speaker: Spider
text:
"Here you are, friend. A trade." The Spider holds up a sparkling blue candy between his clawed fingers. 



"This is a strange way to remember your dead, but I wish you luck in it," he says. "When your little holiday is over, though, don't forget to visit again soon."

title: Discover The Tangled Shore
speaker: Spider
text:
"Not much scares you, does it, Guardian? I like that. Why be intimidated when you can intimidate? I could use a… friend like you for some mutually beneficial knuckle-cracking."



Spider offers Tangled Shore bounties, pursuits, and rewards for Guardians who aid him in his shady business.



Complete Tangled Shore bounties and public events as well as Wanted bounties to gain favor with Spider and earn rewards!

Complete Tangled Shore bounties and public events as well as Wanted bounties to gain favor with Spider and earn rewards!

title: FLASHPOINT: TANGLED SHORE
speaker: Spider
text:
The Spider thanks you for cleaning up the Tangled Shore.




        The Spider thanks you for cleaning up the Tangled Shore.

title: FLASHPOINT: TANGLED SHORE
speaker: Spider
text:
Complete various activities around the Tangled Shore, including public events, Lost Sectors, and Heroic adventures.




        Complete various activities around the Tangled Shore, including public events, Lost Sectors, and Heroic adventures.

title: Forsaken
speaker: Spider
text:
You couldn't strike all the Barons' names from your list at once, but the Fanatic and his gang's time will come soon enough.



Stalk the Tangled Shore for the killers of the legendary Vanguard Hunter by completing the Baron Hunt adventures: "The Hangman," "The Trickster," "The Rider," "The Mindbender," "The Mad Bomber," and "The Rifleman."

title: Forsaken
speaker: Spider
text: The Spider is willing to help you track down the Scorned Barons… but before he scratches your back, you'll have to scratch his. Take down a few escapees from the Prison of Elders. Then he'll give you the info on Uldren and his Barons that you need.

title: Even Handed
speaker: Spider
text:
The Spider takes the box of raisins and lifts it into the light to examine it. He chuckles affectionately.



"Trading favors in exchange for tiny dehydrated fruits," he says. "Earth traditions are so very clever. Yes, I do have something for you. But first, a favor."

title: Forsaken
speaker: Spider
text: Now that you and Spider are friends, he gives you the location of the Scorned Barons' hideout. It's time to have your revenge and rob Uldren of his Barons by completing story strike "The Scorned."

title: Forsaken
speaker: Spider
text:
The Spider congratulates you on your victory-and himself on becoming the de facto power on the Tangled Shore.



He's feeling quite magnanimous at the moment, and would be happy to indulge in a bit of artifact repair by helping you fix Petra's Awoken talisman in quest "Key of Light and Darkness."

title: Forsaken
speaker: Spider
text: Now that you and Spider are 'friends,' he gives you the location of the Scorned Barons' hideout. It's time to seek revenge and rob Uldren of his Barons by completing mission "Scorned."

title: Forsaken
speaker: Spider
text:
You've killed six of the eight Barons. Their deaths have forced the Machinist, the Fanatic's right hand, out of hiding.



Cross another name off your list in mission "The Machinist."

title: Forsaken
speaker: Spider
text:
Spider always wondered what secrets lie within the Watchtower. That Uldren so clearly wants the treasures locked behind its doors only heightens his curiosity. Spider will even send a few of his associates to help you challenge the Scorn.



Seek your closure by completing mission "Nothing Left to Say."

title: Forsaken
speaker: Spider
text:
You couldn't strike all the Barons' names from your list at once, but the Fanatic and his gang's time will come soon enough.



Stalk the Tangled Shore for those who defeated the legendary Vanguard Hunter by completing the Baron Hunt adventures: "The Hangman," "The Trickster," "The Rider," "The Mindbender," "The Mad Bomber," and "The Rifleman."

title: Honor Among Thieves
speaker: Spider
text:
"The storied hero of the Red War, the rumored princekiller-working as a mule for the likes of the Drifter," Spider says. "My, my, how the mighty fall. I hope you know everything about your new friend's enemies." There is a pregnant pause. "You… did ask him about all that, didn't you?"



You say nothing as you reach casually to check the position of the heavy weapon slung across your back.



Recognizing the subtle threat, Spider sobers. "Well. Have a look at my wares, then."

title: Inert Awoken Talisman
speaker: Spider
text: "Ah, the talisman is repaired. You must now attune it to that troublesome half of the Awoken's nature: the power you call Darkness." -The Spider

title: Forsaken
speaker: Spider
text:
The Spider is willing to help you track down the Scorned Barons… but before he scratches your back, you'll have to scratch his. Take down a few escapees from the Prison of Elders. Then he'll give you the info on Uldren and his Barons that you need.



Complete five bounties for the Spider.

title: Hunter and the Hunted
speaker: Spider
text:
Uldren Sov has been reborn as a Guardian and now goes by the name Crow. After gloating over having this former prince in his employ, Spider proposes a mutual collaboration to deal with Xivu Arath's infestation and offers Crow's services as aid.



Speak with Crow to learn more about how to hunt down Xivu Arath's forces.

title: Key of Light and Darkness
speaker: Spider
text:
Awoken Talisman (Broken)




        "Don't ask me to name my source, but a Guardian friend of mine is quite convinced the Scorn's Ether was corrupted by Darkness itself. Just what your little bauble needs if it's to get you to the Dreaming City, isn't it?" -The Spider

title: Legacy: Ahoy and Aweigh
speaker: Spider
text:
In the safety of The Ether Tank, the notorious Spider greets you as an old friend. 



"Seems like only yesterday I was in the Tangled Shore," he says. "Now I'm nestled in the bosom of the Traveler."



His voice drops. "Let's keep the details of my ignominious rescue between us," he requests.



Out of gratitude (or perhaps something less altruistic), he agrees to let you keep his Skeleton Key and continue using his ship to fight against Eramis and the old crews that serve her. He even offers to prepare some accessories no captain should be without.



"Go show those pirates what happens when they cross the Spider," he snarls.
