text:
You've killed six of the eight Barons. Their deaths have forced the Machinist, the Fanatic's right hand, out of hiding.



Cross another name off your list in mission "The Machinist."

title: Legacy: Sails of the Shipstealer
speaker: Spider
text:
Spider gestures to the now-familiar set of engrams.



"Back for more, I see? Excellent," he says. "You can't quit on a loss-that's bad luck." 



"Now pick an engram and reveal your prize!"

title: Legacy: Sails of the Shipstealer
speaker: Spider
text:
Spider looks at the weapon you won, then to you, then back to the weapon. 



"This… isn't right," he whispers to himself. He fixes you with an icy stare.



"I'll let you know when I get more engrams to distribute, Guardian," he growls.



"…and no more funny business." 





"I just jammed another signal," Eido reports through your radio. "Any change?"  



You tell her that you just had another lucky round of Spider's game.  



"Hmm," Eido thinks. "You won the initial round, then lost the second two-it is possible that Spider has some sort of cheating device and intended that you win once to build your confidence, then lose every time after that."



"I will continue to disrupt signals as I come across them," Eido says, "in the name of fairness."

title: Legacy: Sails of the Shipstealer
speaker: Spider
text:
Spider chuckles as you look at the meager pair of leggings before you.



"Oh, my dear Guardian," he says sadly. "I'm afraid they can't all be winners."



"I'll contact you when I have more engrams for our game. Until then…"



Spider leans forward, stifling his laughter.



"Enjoy your little pants."





Your radio chirps with a curious voice.



"Guardian," Eido says, "I just detected another brief interference spike from your coordinates in The Ether Tank. Is everything all right?"  



You assure her that it is.  



"How interesting," she says, apologizes for the interruption, and terminates the call.

title: Legacy: Sails of the Shipstealer
speaker: Spider
text:
You look up from your pitiful winnings and notice Spider is barely paying attention to the engrams. 



"Bad luck again?" he mumbles. "That's a real shame, Guardian. But I suppose we all have cold streaks from time to time."



He straightens up in his chair. "Give me a while to restock," he says. "I'll let you know when I have new engrams to distribute."



He fixes you with a condescending smile.



"I'm sure you'll win next time."





Eido's voice comes in over your radio.



"More energy interference!" she cries. "That was the last piece of triangulation data I required. I believe I have figured out a way to block these energy spikes, should another one occur."  



"You seem to be the catalyst," she tells you. "Thus, I will trigger my suppression field the next time Spider asks you to pay him a social call."



"Perhaps we will be able to figure out this puzzle together."

title: Legacy: Sails of the Shipstealer
speaker: Spider
text:
Spider reveals your winnings and snarls. 



"So this is how it's going to be, eh Guardian?" he growls. "You want to go head-to-head with me?"



You say nothing as you admire your new weapon. Spider takes a raspy breath.



"Fine. Just know… I know what you're up to."



"Come back next time, Guardian," he says, his eyes cold. "I'll have a fresh batch of engrams for you." 





"I've set up a relay to automatically block all surges on that suspicious frequency," Eido tells you over the radio. 



"Each surge is logged. It appears that interference was attempted… 38 times in the last minute, as though someone was repeatedly triggering a jamming mechanism."



Eido chuckles. "I hope my assistance here will help you even the odds."

title: Legacy: Sails of the Shipstealer
speaker: Spider
text:
"Good of you to visit, Captain," Spider says. "Seems like only yesterday I loaned you my ship, and now you're known across the system."



His eyes narrow-it's clear he disapproves. "It's safer in the shadows," he says. 



"I learned that long ago from a handsome young fellow named Rakis."



Spider tells you this Rakis served on the old crews until he was betrayed, and then spent the rest of his life on the run. Eventually, Rakis was killed, and his bounty was claimed.



…by someone who called himself Spider.



"Savvy?" Spider snarls as he lets you in on his secret. "Cashed in a past, bought a future. Walked away reborn and never looked back… just like Misraaks, pretending his old life never happened."



Spider's voice drips with envy. "The old fury is still inside him somewhere," he hisses.



"It's best he not forget that."

title: Legacy: Sails of the Shipstealer
speaker: Spider
text:
Spider barely reacts as you pull a powerful reward from the engrams.



"Lucky draw, Guardian," he shrugs. "Go introduce it to some pirates. I'll send up a flare when I get new engrams in."



He turns away and busies himself with his supplies.





"It's strange, Guardian," says Eido's voice over the radio. "I have no energy surges to report. My instruments are working perfectly, but there was no recent interference attempted from The Ether Tank."



"I am unwilling to speculate as to why, but I am pleased things appear to have resolved."

title: Legacy: Sails of the Shipstealer
speaker: Spider
text:
Spider stares at the weapon you won with confusion. 



"How in all the-"



As if noticing you for the first time, he looks up and smiles broadly.



"How could anyone be so lucky?" he says in a syrupy voice. "What a… surprise."



"Now take your winnings and go," he says bluntly. "I'll contact you later for more games."



He mumbles softly to himself as you back away. 





Eido's excited voice comes through your radio.



"I employed my signal suppressor when you entered The Ether Tank," she says. "Did anything happen? Or… not happen?"



You mention that you just won a powerful weapon from Spider in a game of chance.



"I'm sure that's just a coincidence," she says, but her voice belies her uncertainty…

title: Legacy: Sails of the Shipstealer
speaker: Spider
text:
As Spider watches you draw yet another powerful weapon from the offered engrams, he chuckles.  



"Hard to argue with luck like that," he says.



"One thing I've learned through all this: the Guardians are a safe bet."



"And with that," he says gruffly, readjusting in his chair, "I believe I've dutifully distributed all the gear entrusted to me by the Vanguard. So now I must ask you, with all possible kindness and expediency-"



"-to get out of my bar."





You can tell Eido is smiling when she contacts you over the radio.



"No attempts at energy jamming today, Guardian," she says. "Either Spider finally found his faith in the Guardians, or he realized opposing you is more trouble than it's worth."



"Either outcome is quite positive, wouldn't you agree?"

title: Legacy: Sails of the Shipstealer
speaker: Spider
text:
Spider awaits behind an array of engrams.



"This is the end of my stash, Guardian," he says. "Nothing left to give after this batch."  



"Choose carefully."

title: Legacy: Sails of the Shipstealer
speaker: Spider
text:
As you enter, Spider gestures grandly to a set of engrams he has laid out before him.



"Just the Guardian I wanted to see," he says with a grin.



"I told the Vanguard I had a plan to help arm the Guardians against Eramis's forces. They funded me with some Glimmer, and I traded it in for some incredible gear."



"But just handing out weapons…" he trails off, shaking his head. "Where's the fun in that?"  



"I thought I'd make it a little more interesting," he purrs, rubbing his hands together excitedly.



"So pick an engram, any engram, and reveal your prize!"

title: Legacy: Sails of the Shipstealer
speaker: Spider
text:
Spider catches your eye.



"You and I, we've been through it, Guardian," he sniffs, "so enough with the formalities."



He motions at the engrams before him.



"Take your pick."

title: Legacy: Sails of the Shipstealer
speaker: Spider
text:
"Didn't I just tell you we're closed?" Spider snarls, but quickly composes himself. 



"…I did ask you to return, didn't I?" he says, and then gestures to a set of engrams he has laid out before him.



"You walked away a big winner last time, Guardian," he says. "Give it another shot. I'm sure your luck will hold."



"Pick an engram and reveal your prize!"

title: Legacy: Sails of the Shipstealer
speaker: Spider
text:
A stone-faced Spider gestures to the engrams before him.



"Let's cut the small talk, Guardian," he says. "Step up and choose your reward." 



"And… good luck."

title: Legacy: Sails of the Shipstealer
speaker: Spider
text:
Spider gestures to the familiar set of engrams.



"Back again? That's the spirit, Guardian!" he says. "Let's see what fate has in store for you today." 



"Now pick an engram and reveal your prize!"

title: Legacy: Sails of the Shipstealer
speaker: Spider
text:
Spider gestures to the engrams before him.



"Another round, Guardian?" he says eagerly. "Let's test your luck again." 



"Now pick an engram and reveal your prize!"

title: Legacy: Sails of the Shipstealer
speaker: Spider
text:
Spider looks at your reward, clearly impressed.  



"Jackpot! You're one savvy customer, Guardian!"  



He shakes his head and chuckles. "Take it easy on me, please!" he laughs. 



"I'll let you know when I have more engrams for you-but if you're that lucky every time, I'll lose money on this little act of benevolence!"



**



Eido's voice crackles over your radio.  



"I noticed you were taking in the sights in the Eliksni Quarter," she says brightly. "That might explain the strange energy readings I just picked up from The Ether Tank."



"Please, carry on," Eido says. "Don't let me interrupt your recreation!"

title: Lost Connection
speaker: Spider
text:
"Greetings my… you get the idea." Spider's breath shudders in anticipation. "I trust you have business? Dealings?" He pauses, waiting for you to produce something worthwhile.



Realization sweeps across Spider's several eyes. "Oh… no. You need a favor." You can almost smell his twisted grin as he chides your imposition between deep rebreather hits. "Well… what is it then?"



You nod, and Ghost replays segments of Fallen chatter, isolating a repeated name. "Bahaha. Old 'Lightkiller'? He has a big, arrogant, mouth." Spider sneers before beckoning you closer. "Hit the club." He pats your shoulder. "I expect… reciprocation. When it's needed." Spider draws deeply on his rebreather, nods, and slumps back. "You always bring me the best stories."

title: On the Trail
speaker: Spider
text:
The Spider is willing to help you track down the Scorned Barons… but before he scratches your back, you'll have to scratch his. Take down a few escapees from the Prison of Elders. Then he'll give you the info on Uldren and his Barons that you need.



Complete five bounties for the Spider.

title: Renegades
speaker: Spider
text: Spider leans back and guffaws into the air. "You enraged all three major syndicates in a single infiltration of the Lawless Frontier," he spits gleefully. "Well done, renegade. Your reward: a few ontological materials Drifter's Ghost will need. Kitbash her with these, and she'll be good as new." He reaches out, four paws full of glittering, paracausal metals.

title: Renegades
speaker: Spider
text:
Spider hunches towards you eagerly. "You're in luck. The Pikers have agreed to a deal for a Splicer Shank under the condition that you go and help them with a little side project first."



"Go make your introduction with Riliks and see how you might be of service. They don't give their trust away lightly, but when Riliks respects you and your code? Perhaps we can manipulate them." Spider snickers lightly to himself.

title: Renegades
speaker: Spider
text: Spider chortles low and gleefully as you approach. "I've always liked Drifter's Ghost," he says. "She's the best thing about him! If she's finally looking to get her voice back, I'd be glad to help. For a small favor." He gestures towards the dark corners of the den. "My transport crews have failed me. I sent them into the Lawless Frontier to bring back hard-won contraband. If you'll venture out there, find my crew, and more importantly, my contraband-I'll make sure you obtain the Ghost parts you still need."

title: Renegades
speaker: Spider
text: Spider leans forward eagerly as you approach. "Tharsis has been overrun by delinquency," he roars, huffing the air. "Feels more like home than Variisis Core ever did. Hold on to your Glimmer; it's not the anchor coinage of Mars. You'll need Credits to entice the Tharsis Syndicates and craft specialists. And I'd be happy to part you from your Credits in exchange for frontier tech, purchased directly from yours truly. Go on. You deserve a shopping spree now that you're free of your Vanguard bonds. When you're done, your old pal Drifter has news from the Pikers."

title: Rogue Network
speaker: Spider
text:
"Guardian! My friend, my partner in perfectly legal enterprise! Enriched with the fruits of your labor!" 



Spider roars cheerfully at you from his throne. His agents scurry past on errands of their own.



"A job well done as usual. That's what I like to see in a partner. Steadiness. Trustworthiness, even. And a willingness to share the profits."



"That little AI up there… She's lonely, don't you think? Best keep an eye on her. We haven't turned up that key yet, but it's got to exist. One access code implies another, doesn't it?"



Spider puffs out depleted Ether, satisfied with himself. He adds, "All perfectly aboveboard, of course. It would be a kindness, even-I'm sure she could use the distraction."



Despite his generous words, there's a look in his eyes that speaks loudly of greed.



Mysteries linger within Vesper Station, and in Spider's intentions.

title: Rogue Network
speaker: Spider
text:
"Ah, my little scallywag. Welcome to my newest home. Ever closer to the center of power!"



Spider throws four arms out wide, showing off his new quarters.



"Vanguard wants to keep an eye on me, I'm sure. That's fine. I've got more eyes than they do." Spider laughs in a wheeze that shakes his suspended throne before leaning in to make direct eye contact.



"I had an agent investigating one orbital station for salvage-then she lost contact. It'd have to be something worse than Salvation vagrants knocking around up there to take her down."



Spider is unwilling to send more of his people into a dangerous situation but suggests that there are plenty of riches waiting for the Guardian ready to take on the task of digging into a derelict station in Europa's orbit.



He leans back again, folding his arms over his belly and adds, "Just try not to crash this station, too, would you?"

title: Rogue Network
speaker: Spider
text:
"We've learned so much together, haven't we?" Spider says. "Believe me, I treat my Guardian partners well. Look at how high my last partner has risen in City authority. Always remember what Spider can do for you."



"Now, for Vesper Station…." Spider leans in conspiratorially, lowering his voice to a crackling whisper. "There's an ultimate control mechanism. Bray's personal key. And if you control the AI, you control the station. Vesper Central seems lonely up there. A bit out of control. She could use a guiding hand, don't you think?"



One hand flexes on the armrest of his throne.



"Now, my agents have turned up one little key on their search for the big one. You take it and you grab what you want-and you remember it was your old chum Spider who had you in his thoughts this whole time, all right?"



Spider waves to an agent of his in the back of the room. They tap at a console to transfer a fragment of data:



PERMISSIONS GRANTED:

TechAccess|Storage|Restricted|42

title: Rogue Network
speaker: Spider
text:
"Curiouser and curiouser," Spider rumbles. "A whole Salvation gang absconding with a Ketch, and a Golden Age AI locked up on a station alone… Well, Guardian, you did better than my own agents-and cheap at the price!" He barks a long, loud laugh.



After clearing his throat noisily, Spider continues: "A BrayTech AI is a valuable thing, no matter how poor her personal attitude. We'd better make sure she doesn't fall into the wrong hands."



"While you were busy clearing the nest, I had my people doing some digging on the side. Their key discovery was… that many discoveries are waiting for us in Europa's orbit. More investigation means more profit for us all, and an answer to some lingering mysteries, eh?"



Spider looks you over in satisfaction. Before dismissing you from his presence, he adds, "My last contract with a Lightbearer ended… unhappily, let's say. But I believe ours will be a fruitful partnership. Don't you?"



Return to the "Vesper's Host" dungeon and uncover its secrets.

title: Talk to Spider
speaker: Spider
text:
You couldn't strike all the Barons' names from your list at once, but the Fanatic and his gang's time will come soon enough.



Stalk the Tangled Shore for those who defeated the legendary Vanguard Hunter by completing the Baron Hunt adventures: "The Hangman," "The Trickster," "The Rider," "The Mindbender," "The Mad Bomber," and "The Rifleman."

title: Talk to Spider
speaker: Spider
text:
You've killed six of the eight Barons. Their deaths have forced the Machinist, the Fanatic's right hand, out of hiding.



Cross another name off your list in mission "The Machinist."

title: Talk to Spider
speaker: Spider
text:
Spider always wondered what secrets lie within the Watchtower. That Uldren so clearly wants the treasures locked behind its doors only heightens his curiosity. Spider will even send a few of his associates to help you challenge the Scorn.



Seek your closure by completing mission "Nothing Left to Say."

title: Territorial Profit
speaker: Spider
text:
Spider tosses you a bag jingling with currency and illicit goods-now yours.



"Where one Kell sees detritus, another finds opportunity. And there is so much detritus borne from the territory war you've started." His shoulders shake as he chuckles. "Let's see what my scavengers have found you. As long as this conflict goes on, there's profit to be made." 



He taps his fingers eagerly as you open his gift.

title: The Black Armory
speaker: Spider
text: The Spider, kingpin of the Tangled Shore, has a favor to ask of you.

title: The Investigation
speaker: Spider
text:
"Don't see what you're looking for, my friend?" Spider asks, growing impatient. "Did your friend not tell you? When you pick up for the Drifter, you use the code words. You do not-"



You hold up your hand. Ghost transmats a Vanguard token into your waiting fingers. The message is clear: you stand with the Vanguard, not the Drifter.



Spider backpedals. "Now, now, my friend, I'm sure you can understand my position. Times are lean here on the Shore. And I'm but a simple businessman. I'll deal with anyone who comes through my door. If my business with the Drifter offends you so much, I would be pleased to cut off all relations with him… for the right price."

title: The Spider's Competition
speaker: Spider
text:
It looks like the tainted gear is coming from a new Fallen syndicate that, coincidentally, is making a push on the Spider's turf right now.



Find clues about them, and the Spider will help you find the origin of the tainted gear.

title: The Spider
speaker: Spider
text: Now that you and Spider are 'friends,' he gives you the location of the Scorned Barons' hideout. It's time to seek revenge and rob Uldren of his Barons by completing mission "Scorned."

title: Talk to Spider
speaker: Spider
text:
The Spider bristles at your approach. "Ah… my Guardian." Spider's eyes linger on your mud-covered boots trailed by soil-caked tracks. An uneven hiss spews from his rebreather as he gestures for a guard to bring the stained note in your outstretched hand. "I trust your meeting went well?" 



Spider flaps the ragged note flat against the thick Shore air. He mumbles Eliksni between chittering clicks and hisses. "Buyer's remorse," he chortles. "Sounds like some trigger-happy Lights snuffed him out." Spider relaxes, satisfied with his answer. Silent seconds pass.



"Oh… it wants the gun." Spider produces a tittering giggle. "Of course you do." He agrees to find the burial site for you, but needs your persuasive flair. "Do what you do best. Crack a few skulls. Sow fear. Whenever a Guardian starts wreaking havoc, they always come to me."

title: The Spider's Competition
speaker: Spider
text:
The Spider and Siviks have history, but it seems that the Spider is ready to let go. He tells you where to look next: the EDZ.



Travel to the EDZ where the tainted Black Armory gear is sold and track it down to its source.

title: The Spider's Competition
speaker: Spider
text:
It would appear the tainted gear is coming from a new Fallen syndicate that is also making a push on the Spider's turf.



Scavange the Shore for information about the syndicate, and the Spider will help you find the origin of the tainted gear.

title: The Spider's Competition
speaker: Spider
text:
The Spider and Siviks have history, but it seems that the Spider is ready to let go. He tells you where to look next: the EDZ.



Travel to the EDZ where the tainted Black Armory gear is sold and track down its source.

title: The Territory War Begins
speaker: Spider
text:
"War beckons, my renegade!" Spider booms. "War among the Syndicates for power, prestige, territory! And above all, profit!"



He leans forward, looming over you from his raised seat. "You did this, you know. With the Imperium neutralized, a power vacuum has opened on the Lawless Frontier. Everything is up for grabs, and that includes your allyship.



"The Syndicates and their quartermasters have all come to me-on bended knee, mind you-to ask for your assistance."



Spider winks his glowing eyes. "Give them a moment of your time, will you? And remember that out here, today's ally can always be tomorrow's rival. Follow the Glimmer, Guardian. Follow the Glimmer."

title: Untangling the Shore
speaker: Spider
text:
Untangling the Shore




        The Spider is very interested in maintaining a strong friendship with you. You do him favors, he does you favors.

title: Untangling the Shore
speaker: Spider
text:
Untangling the Shore




        The Spider is determined to strengthen his hold on the Tangled Shore. If you found it in your heart to share his interest, he would make it worth your while.



Clear out enemies holed up in Lost Sectors on the Tangled Shore.

title: Visit the Spider
speaker: Spider
text:
"Ah, the talisman… it's beautiful. I envy you, friend. With that lovely little bauble, you may now enter the Dreaming City. Give Petra Venj my… regards… won't you?



"I've taken the liberty of preparing you an escort. They are ready to march when you are." -The Spider

title: As Prophesied
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text: The Servitor flashes urgently. Words scroll across its viewscreen: EMERGENCY RADIO BROADCAST IN PROGRESS.

title: Beneath the Great Machine
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
An alert sounds from the Servitor as you approach. On a small viewscreen, a wireframe image of a cube appears. An access port slides open and the cube changes to a single word:



ANALYZE



You take the cube of living code you claimed from the Vex on Europa and hold it in your palm. Its corners and edges move, reforming endlessly in your hand. You place it into the Servitor.



The Servitor scans the cube with a field of soft light for several moments, then emits a chime and the text changes:



STABLE



A pictogram suggests that the cube is somehow still connected to the Vex Nexus. Mithrax will be able to study its secrets, and just by holding it, you are able to access certain permissions from the deep Vex networks.



The readout changes once more:



UTILIZE



You nod as you claim the Paradrome Cube.

title: Visit Spider
speaker: Spider
text:
"The way you bust heads has made you almost as notorious as me, Guardian. That kind of reputation comes with perks… like fear.



"But watch yourself. I'd hate to think you're after my job. HehhehHAHA!"



Continue exploring the Tangled Shore to earn XP and new rewards from Spider.

title: Faction Reward
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text: Decrypted Data increases your rank with the Splicer Servitor. Earn it by completing seasonal activities and challenges in the Season of the Splicer.

title: Heroes' Memorial
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
Mithrax's tone is somber, even filtered through the Servitor. "Many victories are made sacred with loss. Our victory over Quria and the Vex is just so."



After a meditative pause, he continues, "It is right to celebrate, but celebration must also remember our lost heroes… Humans and Eliksni. Visit the memorial in the Tower to pay respects."



"In gratitude," he continues proudly, "the Vanguard and the House of Light combine to gift you this ship. May it always remind you of our friendship, and those we lost."

title: Heroes' Memorial
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
Mithrax's tone is somber, even filtered through the Servitor. "Many victories are made sacred with loss. Our victory over Quria and the Vex is just so."



After a meditative pause, he continues, "It is right to celebrate, but celebration must also remember our lost heroes… Humans and Eliksni. Visit the memorial in the Tower to pay respects."

title: Legacy: As Prophesied
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text: The Servitor flashes urgently. Words scroll across its viewscreen: EMERGENCY RADIO BROADCAST IN PROGRESS.

title: Increase Rank
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text: Decrypted Data increases your rank with the Splicer Servitor. Earn it by completing seasonal activities and challenges in the Season of the Splicer.

title: Legacy: Beneath the Great Machine
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
An alert sounds from the Servitor as you approach. On a small viewscreen, a wireframe image of a cube appears. An access port slides open and the cube changes to a single word:



ANALYZE



You take the cube of living code you claimed from the Vex on Europa and hold it in your palm. Its corners and edges move, reforming endlessly in your hand. You place it into the Servitor.



The Servitor scans the cube with a field of soft light for several moments, then emits a chime and the text changes:



STABLE



A pictogram suggests that the cube is somehow still connected to the Vex Nexus. Mithrax will be able to study its secrets, and just by holding it, you are able to access certain permissions from the deep Vex networks.



The readout changes once more:



UTILIZE



You nod as you claim the Paradrome Cube.

title: Legacy: Path of the Splicer I
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
Mithrax shares what he learned by studying the Vex data you brought him: the City is a conflux, a paradromic knot of threads from the Vex network. The Vex are draining the energy from the City, but beyond that, their motives are unclear.



There is no way to easily separate the City from the Vex domain-for one to survive, the other must be destroyed.



But he sees hope in the future, as your victories against the Vex are visible in the simulated sky. He will continue his studies, upgrade your Splicer Gauntlet, and learn how to break the City free once again.

title: Legacy: Path of the Splicer I
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
Mithrax speaks to you through the Splicer Servitor that his House of Light liberated from Eramis's House of Salvation.



He explains that he is a Sacred Splicer, one specially trained to interface with the Light threaded through the Vex network. He is so impressed with your mastery of the Light that he gives you a custom-made Splicer Gauntlet to help you focus your own abilities. He is willing to guide you in your journey to become a Sacred Splicer, while Ikora, Osiris, Lakshmi-2, and Saint-14 assist when they are able.



He asks that you bring him Vex data so he can begin to decode the mysterious Paradrome Cube you claimed from the Vex on Europa. He believes it will reveal how to lift the oppressive simulation that hangs over the City.



"Fight bravely," he says. "Free your people from this Endless Night."

title: Legacy: Path of the Splicer II
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
Mithrax confides in you that his earlier disagreement with Saint-14 and Osiris weighs on him heavily. He tells you he is afraid; after fleeing with his people for so long, the thought of losing the safety of the City wounds him.



He feels as though the strange pressures of the Endless Night are bearing down on the City. He speculates this may be a weapon meant to turn a city against itself-or turn the City against those in his House.



He asks you to bring him Vex data once again. He believes a breakthrough is within reach.

title: Legacy: Path of the Splicer II
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
Mithrax is pleased to see you return to continue the fight. He hopes his people will learn from your resilience, as adjusting to life in the City has been difficult for them.



He has never seen anything like this Endless Night. It is as though the air leeches life from everything in the City. The people of the City are under immense stress, and he says he suspects the simulation is somehow draining them, as well.



"The Vex guard powerful secrets," he says. "Tighten your Gauntlet and let us take them."

title: Legacy: Path of the Splicer III
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
Mithrax tells you that he has studied the Vex and come to understand the drives that govern their behavior-which is why he finds their recent actions so confusing.



The Vex seem to be growing alongside your powers, acting to counter your growth as a Splicer. He feels as though there is something in their network no Splicer has encountered before. It is vital you continue to enter the Vex domain and collapse their networks.



He warns you powerful foes will emerge from the Vex domain and that, as a Splicer, you must be ready for them.



"Keep to the path," he tells you.

title: Legacy: Path of the Splicer III
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
Mithrax greets you with news of his official alliance with Lakshmi-2. Osiris ordered Mithrax to share his Vex data with Lakshmi-2, and he accepted-though he tells you the Exo makes him uneasy.



He has heard her transmissions and knows she is skeptical of the Eliksni, but he is confident that working together will cause her to realize they are fighting for the same future.



"If it will show her we will walk together in peace," he explains, "I will give her all she asks."



Mithrax has compiled the data you brought him and discovered a new path into the Vex domain. He asks you to enter it and consecrate the network inside-purify it with your Light and collapse it around the Vex within.

title: Legacy: Path of the Splicer III
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
The Servitor hums softly as you approach, and your Splicer Gauntlet echoes the tone. 



An access port slides opens on the Servitor and a single word appears above on a small screen:



UPGRADE



You align your Gauntlet with the port and feel it charge with strange energy. After a moment, you hear a tone and the word on the screen changes:



WITHDRAW



You withdraw your Gauntlet and feel it pulse with new power. The word changes again:



EXPUNGE



Use your Splicer Gauntlet to enter an Expunge mission, secure the network, and collapse it behind you.

title: Legacy: Path of the Splicer IV
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
The Endless Night is getting worse, Mithrax says. He can hear the City groaning under the strain.



The Eliksni in the House of Light are suffering alongside the City's citizens, but still they are regarded with suspicion.



He has faith that your progress as a Splicer will collapse the Vex simulation, but says the night muffles even the impact of your victories.



"The people hear of your triumphs against the Vex, but they see only dark skies above," he says. "They are being bent… and some may break."

title: Legacy: Path of the Splicer V
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
Mithrax seems eager to get back to work dispelling the Endless Night and put the recent attack on his people behind him.



"Cruel words and thoughtless deeds will not break us," he says. "We will not be led to violence, no matter how wide the path."



He tells you not to worry about him and his people, but to focus your attentions on continuing your Splicer training, improving your Gauntlet, and collapsing the Vex networks.

title: Legacy: Path of the Splicer IV
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
The attack on his people left Mithrax shaken and despondent. You can hear the frustration in his voice even through the Servitor.



Although he feels betrayed, he refuses to retaliate. He tells you he won't stop fighting to protect the very people who took up arms against his Eliksni. "The Light passes through us all," he says. "We focus it through the prism of our will. Those who attacked us were blinded by fear, poisoned by venomous words… but they are not truly our enemies."



He says it is not easy to walk the path of the Light, of forgiveness, but he and his people will walk it nevertheless.

title: Legacy: Path of the Splicer V
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
Mithrax tells you a story about seeing Saint-14 interact with a young Eliksni: The big Titan raised a hand in greeting and seemed upset when the Eliksni recoiled and fled. He feels that telling Saint-14 about how the Eliksni see him has affected the Titan, and he hopes that his words truly reached him.



"If we are to survive this long night, we must be able to see one another as we truly are," he says.

title: Legacy: Path of the Splicer VI
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
The force at the center of the Vex network has a name: Quria.



Mithrax pledges to use his abilities as a Sacred Splicer to search through the Vex domain until he finds its lair. He tells you he imagines his Light as a beacon, something to use to guide others through the darkness of the world.



He believes you were given your Light to use as a weapon… and Quria is the target.

title: Legacy: Path of the Splicer VI
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
Mithrax and Osiris tell you that Quria, the Dreaming Mind, is the dark force at the center of the Vex network.



Osiris plans to confer with Ikora on the best course of action while Mithrax refines his strategy.



They will both depend on you and the power of your newly enhanced Splicer abilities.



You should report these findings to Ikora.

title: Legacy: Path of the Splicer VI
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
When Mithrax speaks to you this time, his tone is different. His usual spiritual optimism is tempered by foreboding.



He feels a malevolent force pulling from the center of the Vex network-the same force he noticed when you first stepped into the network on Europa. He fears the Vex are being manipulated somehow, and that the Endless Night has a greater purpose than he initially thought.



"Darkness is coming for you," he warns. The Vex must be disrupted before it is too late.

title: Legacy: Path of the Splicer VII
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
Mithrax has determined that the energy of the City is being siphoned by Quria for an unknown reason . He says he has been pursuing Quria's signal through the domain, but its exact location keeps slipping through his fingers. When he gets close, the Vex rise to break his focus.



"It may seek the destruction of your City, or of your Vanguard," he says, "or something even greater may be at stake."



He asks you to strike at the Vex and disrupt their network so he can find Quria through the chaos.

title: Legacy: Path of the Splicer VIII
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
Mithrax celebrates your victory over Quria.



He looks into the dark of the Endless Night and imagines it slowly lifting, and his spirits lift along with it.



He tells you he is honored to have watched you grow into a Sacred Splicer and hopes that your journey together is not over.



Even through the Servitor, you can hear the joy in his voice when he pictures the future.



"We will have a beautiful sunrise," he promises.

title: Legacy: Path of the Splicer VII
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
You hear fear in Mithrax's voice when he tells you he senses Quria's true strength pulsing through the network.



Although he has nearly pinpointed Quria's location buried in the Vex domain, his words to you are ominous.



"Death surrounds this place-the true death, which always starts from within," he says. "I fear this Endless Night will grow even more terrible before we see the sun again."

title: Legacy: Path of the Splicer VIII
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
Mithrax greets you with dark news: the Light is fading.



As the Endless Night peaks in intensity, Quria's powers reach from within the Vex network to drain the last of the City's energies, intent on forcing its terrors upon this reality.



He tells you he has finally found Quria's seat of power in the Vex domain, and only a Splicer of your ability can stop it.



"Charge your Gauntlet," he says, "and walk further into the Light than ever before."



"Please."

title: Path of the Splicer I
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
Mithrax speaks to you through the Splicer Servitor that his House of Light liberated from Eramis's House of Salvation.



He explains that he is a Sacred Splicer, one specially trained to interface with the Light threaded through the Vex network. He is so impressed with your mastery of the Light that he gives you a custom-made Splicer Gauntlet to help you focus your own abilities. He is willing to guide you in your journey to become a Sacred Splicer, while Ikora, Osiris, Lakshmi-2, and Saint-14 assist when they are able.



He asks that you bring him Vex data so he can begin to decode the mysterious Paradrome Cube you claimed from the Vex on Europa. He believes it will reveal how to lift the oppressive simulation that hangs over the City.



"Fight bravely," he says. "Free your people from this Endless Night."

title: Path of the Splicer I
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
Mithrax shares what he learned by studying the Vex data you brought him: the City is a conflux, a paradromic knot of threads from the Vex network. The Vex are draining the energy from the City, but beyond that, their motives are unclear.



There is no way to easily separate the City from the Vex domain-for one to survive, the other must be destroyed.



But he sees hope in the future, as your victories against the Vex are visible in the simulated sky. He will continue his studies, upgrade your Splicer Gauntlet, and learn how to break the City free once again.

title: Path of the Splicer II
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
Mithrax is pleased to see you return to continue the fight. He hopes his people will learn from your resilience, as adjusting to life in the City has been difficult for them.



He has never seen anything like this Endless Night. It is as though the air leeches life from everything in the City. The people of the City are under immense stress, and he says he suspects the simulation is somehow draining them, as well.



"The Vex guard powerful secrets," he says. "Tighten your Gauntlet and let us take them."

title: Path of the Splicer II
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
Mithrax confides in you that his earlier disagreement with Saint-14 and Osiris weighs on him heavily. He tells you he is afraid; after fleeing with his people for so long, the thought of losing the safety of the City wounds him.



He feels as though the strange pressures of the Endless Night are bearing down on the City. He speculates this may be a weapon meant to turn a city against itself-or turn the City against those in his House.



He asks you to bring him Vex data once again. He believes a breakthrough is within reach.

title: Path of the Splicer III
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
Mithrax tells you that he has studied the Vex and come to understand the drives that govern their behavior-which is why he finds their recent actions so confusing.



The Vex seem to be growing alongside your powers, acting to counter your growth as a Splicer. He feels as though there is something in their network no Splicer has encountered before. It is vital you continue to enter the Vex domain and collapse their networks.



He warns you powerful foes will emerge from the Vex domain and that, as a Splicer, you must be ready for them.



"Keep to the path," he tells you.

title: Path of the Splicer III
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
The Servitor hums softly as you approach, and your Splicer Gauntlet echoes the tone. 



An access port slides opens on the Servitor and a single word appears above on a small screen:



UPGRADE



You align your Gauntlet with the port and feel it charge with strange energy. After a moment, you hear a tone and the word on the screen changes:



WITHDRAW



You withdraw your Gauntlet and feel it pulse with new power. The word changes again:



EXPUNGE



Use your Splicer Gauntlet to enter an Expunge mission, secure the network, and collapse it behind you.

title: Path of the Splicer IV
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
The attack on his people left Mithrax shaken and despondent. You can hear the frustration in his voice even through the Servitor.



Although he feels betrayed, he refuses to retaliate. He tells you he won't stop fighting to protect the very people who took up arms against his Eliksni. "The Light passes through us all," he says. "We focus it through the prism of our will. Those who attacked us were blinded by fear, poisoned by venomous words… but they are not truly our enemies."



He says it is not easy to walk the path of the Light, of forgiveness, but he and his people will walk it nevertheless.

title: Path of the Splicer III
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
Mithrax greets you with news of his official alliance with Lakshmi-2. Osiris ordered Mithrax to share his Vex data with Lakshmi-2, and he accepted-though he tells you the Exo makes him uneasy.



He has heard her transmissions and knows she is skeptical of the Eliksni, but he is confident that working together will cause her to realize they are fighting for the same future.



"If it will show her we will walk together in peace," he explains, "I will give her all she asks."



Mithrax has compiled the data you brought him and discovered a new path into the Vex domain. He asks you to enter it and consecrate the network inside-purify it with your Light and collapse it around the Vex within.

title: Path of the Splicer V
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
Mithrax seems eager to get back to work dispelling the Endless Night and put the recent attack on his people behind him.



"Cruel words and thoughtless deeds will not break us," he says. "We will not be led to violence, no matter how wide the path."



He tells you not to worry about him and his people, but to focus your attentions on continuing your Splicer training, improving your Gauntlet, and collapsing the Vex networks.

title: Talk to Petra
speaker: Petra Venj
text:
The curse has returned. Confer with Petra in the Strand.




        "Paladins, disregard my previous message. The Dreaming City is not safe. Not yet." -Petra Venj

title: Path of the Splicer V
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
Mithrax tells you a story about seeing Saint-14 interact with a young Eliksni: The big Titan raised a hand in greeting and seemed upset when the Eliksni recoiled and fled. He feels that telling Saint-14 about how the Eliksni see him has affected the Titan, and he hopes that his words truly reached him.



"If we are to survive this long night, we must be able to see one another as we truly are," he says.

title: Path of the Splicer VI
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
When Mithrax speaks to you this time, his tone is different. His usual spiritual optimism is tempered by foreboding.



He feels a malevolent force pulling from the center of the Vex network-the same force he noticed when you first stepped into the network on Europa. He fears the Vex are being manipulated somehow, and that the Endless Night has a greater purpose than he initially thought.



"Darkness is coming for you," he warns. The Vex must be disrupted before it is too late.

title: Path of the Splicer VI
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
The force at the center of the Vex network has a name: Quria.



Mithrax pledges to use his abilities as a Sacred Splicer to search through the Vex domain until he finds its lair. He tells you he imagines his Light as a beacon, something to use to guide others through the darkness of the world.



He believes you were given your Light to use as a weapon… and Quria is the target.

title: Path of the Splicer VI
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
Mithrax and Osiris tell you that Quria, the Dreaming Mind, is the dark force at the center of the Vex network.



Osiris plans to confer with Ikora on the best course of action while Mithrax refines his strategy.



They will both depend on you and the power of your newly enhanced Splicer abilities.



You should report these findings to Ikora.

title: Path of the Splicer VII
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
Mithrax has determined that the energy of the City is being siphoned by Quria for an unknown reason . He says he has been pursuing Quria's signal through the domain, but its exact location keeps slipping through his fingers. When he gets close, the Vex rise to break his focus.



"It may seek the destruction of your City, or of your Vanguard," he says, "or something even greater may be at stake."



He asks you to strike at the Vex and disrupt their network so he can find Quria through the chaos.

title: Path of the Splicer VIII
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
Mithrax greets you with dark news: the Light is fading.



As the Endless Night peaks in intensity, Quria's powers reach from within the Vex network to drain the last of the City's energies, intent on forcing its terrors upon this reality.



He tells you he has finally found Quria's seat of power in the Vex domain, and only a Splicer of your ability can stop it.



"Charge your Gauntlet," he says, "and walk further into the Light than ever before."



"Please."

title: Path of the Splicer VII
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
You hear fear in Mithrax's voice when he tells you he senses Quria's true strength pulsing through the network.



Although he has nearly pinpointed Quria's location buried in the Vex domain, his words to you are ominous.



"Death surrounds this place-the true death, which always starts from within," he says. "I fear this Endless Night will grow even more terrible before we see the sun again."

title: Path of the Splicer VIII
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
Mithrax celebrates your victory over Quria.



He looks into the dark of the Endless Night and imagines it slowly lifting, and his spirits lift along with it.



He tells you he is honored to have watched you grow into a Sacred Splicer and hopes that your journey together is not over.



Even through the Servitor, you can hear the joy in his voice when he pictures the future.



"We will have a beautiful sunrise," he promises.

title: Rewiring the Light
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text: "Your Light flows through the Splicer Gauntlet more freely every day. Armed with Guardian weapons and Splicer skills, no Vex can stand against you." -Mithrax

title: Legacy: Ahoy and Aweigh
speaker: Star Chart
text:
A reward awaits you beside the Star Chart. It rests on a scrap of paper covered in surprisingly delicate handwriting.



"I knew you had the steel for it," the note reads. "Now gather your crew and begin your journey. I've met a few pirate captains in my time, and you can't be any worse than them. Good luck."



The note bears Spider's insignia.

title: Legacy: Cryptic Quatrains I
speaker: Star Chart
text: You find a hidden switch on the side of the Treasure Beacon. You press it, and from a hidden compartment slides a piece of parchment covered in messy handwriting.

title: Legacy: Cryptic Quatrains II
speaker: Star Chart
text: You press the switch on the side of the Treasure Beacon. From a hidden compartment drops a piece of parchment, densely covered in the scribblings of a renegade pirate.

title: Legacy: Cryptic Quatrains III
speaker: Star Chart
text: You eagerly press the switch on the Treasure Beacon and a hidden compartment pops open. You pull out a folded piece of parchment used by a desperate pirate during a daring escape.

title: Legacy: Sails of the Shipstealer
speaker: Star Chart
text:
Mithrax, Kell of House Light, seems shaken by the violence employed by Eramis and the pirate crews at her command. "I thought the Eliksni had moved on from such senseless brutality," he says.



"It seems I was mistaken."



He explains the heavy book that awaits near the Star Chart: a Captain's Atlas, which will enable you to better command your ship and crew.



He asks that you discover why Eramis is using these old crews. "They know the stars in a way even House Salvation does not," he says, but does not know what they are searching for.



Finding the answer to that question falls to you.

title: Legacy: Sails of the Shipstealer
speaker: Star Chart
text:
Eido briefs you on the current situation with Eramis-her loyal crews chase another powerful relic.



Eido tells you that she spoke with her father and explained why she disagreed with his attempt to shelter her from the violence of Eramis's crews.



"One does not protect by forbidding exposure," she told him. "Ignorance is not safety."



Though Mithrax did not completely agree, he and Eido appear to have reached an understanding. Eido will continue to provide mission support over your comms.



"Now," Eido says, "we must continue to pursue the relics Eramis seeks. Board your ship and let us begin."

title: Legacy: Sails of the Shipstealer
speaker: Star Chart
text:
Mithrax hails you on the H.E.L.M. holoprojector. There is fear in his voice as he tells you what he has learned about the relic.



"It is an object pulled from Eliksni legend," he says, "and I fear it is not the only one of its kind."



The relic, previously believed to be an old pirate rumor, emanates pure Darkness. Mithrax is afraid this is why the Witness awoke Eramis: to unite the old crews, as they are the only ones who know where the other relics are hidden. 



"Eramis cannot be allowed to claim the powers within," Mithrax warns. "If she does… all will fall to corruption."



"You must find them," he insists. "You must."

title: Legacy: Sails of the Shipstealer
speaker: Star Chart
text:
Drifter wastes little time with pleasantries before he gives you a warning:



"You don't survive as long as me without being able to smell trouble, and honestly, kid? You stink of it."



"You're going after chunks of a dead Disciple of the Witness," he says. "That's some serious juju."



He tells you to watch your back and be careful who you trust.



"The stakes are high," he says. "That's when folks tend to get… unpredictable."

title: Legacy: Sails of the Shipstealer
speaker: Star Chart
text:
Mithrax is beside himself with urgency. He tells you that Eido has reached out to Eramis.



Eido invoked an old ritual followed by the pirate crews: "words with empty hands," a type of parley. 



If Eramis accepts, there will be a brief ceasefire, as no violence is permitted at a parley. Still, Mithrax asks that you attend.



"This may be a ploy, and we must not be fooled," he says.



Mithrax hopes that Eramis will ignore the request. He knows she will do nothing that is not to her benefit. Still…



"A word can do more damage than a blade," Mithrax cautions, "and Eramis is skilled at wielding both."

title: Legacy: Sails of the Shipstealer
speaker: Star Chart
text:
"Hey there, hero," Drifter says. "I heard you parleyed with Eramis, and she hit you with some heavy truths."



He tells you it doesn't bother him that Mithrax used to be a pirate. "He's just a fella who done somethin' he ain't proud of," he says. "And that I understand." 



He says what a person does now is more important than who they used to be.



He sympathizes with Eido-he knows how the hurt of having someone hide the truth from you can be worse than the truth they were hiding. 



And speaking of hiding, Drifter comes clean with you: He knew what the relics were the first time you brought one back, as he recognized their energy from a distant visit to the Fourth Tomb of Nezarec. The dangerous power they contain is why he insisted on your involvement from the beginning.



He says Eris gave him some ideas about how to harness that power-"If we can stop Eramis from findin' the last few relics and killin' us all," he adds.



"So get on that."

title: Legacy: Sails of the Shipstealer
speaker: Star Chart
text:
"You are close to securing the last relic of Nezarec," Mithrax tells you through the hologram, "and we near the end of our mission."



Mithrax has noticed no communications between Eramis and her loyal crews… but he did find record of a message she sent to Eido, buried in the end of a Scribe log.



Although Eramis's words were benign, he does not trust her - "We know the Shipstealer only acts to her own benefit," he says.



Mithrax reveals that Eido is barely speaking to him. She only sits and studies the coordinate patterns of the pirate lairs. He has never seen her so immersed in study.



"I meant only to protect her," he says softly. "She will see that, in time-she must… unless she has already made her choice."



"Claim the final reliquary and finish this conflict," he urges. "May the Light provide."

title: Savvy
speaker: Star Chart
text: Complete Ketchcrash and Expedition missions to increase your Savvy.

title: Legacy: Sails of the Shipstealer
speaker: Star Chart
text:
With alarming bolts of Arc energy, the Star Chart crackles to life as you approach. 



The interface, clearly adapted from a Fallen Walker, shows possible pirate routes across the galaxy. The screen is a confusing mess of Eliksni symbols and coordinate shorthand.



The screen flickers impatiently, anticipating calibration with someone bearing a Captain's Atlas…

title: Seasonal Heirloom: Captain's Atlas
speaker: Star Chart
text: This item is required to collect Map Fragments and Treasure Coordinates from Season of Plunder.

title: Solstice of Heroes
speaker: Statue of Heroes
text: The statue remains silent.

title: The Astral Seas
speaker: Star Chart
text:
Complete Bounties




        In honor of your continued victories over Eramis's pirate crews, Mithrax left a shining engram near the Star Chart for you.

title: A Single Thread
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
Hawthorne turns to you with a serious look in her eyes. She passes a datapad to you containing schematics of the Leviathan and transmat beacon details for the Leviathan's Tribute Hall.



"Eris is up to something," Hawthorne says with a tightness in her voice. "She won't say what, and she asked me to relay this to you, personally, ignoring Vanguard protocol."



She continues with a sigh. "I don't like going around Ikora, but whatever this is… it sounds urgent. I don't know Eris well, but I trust her judgment. If we have to break protocol to get something done, so be it. You should go see what this is all about."



Launch the "Duality" dungeon from the Moon in the Director.

title: A Single Thread
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
"A mind heist?" Hawthorne says with a laugh, shaking her head. "Only you, Guardian. Only you."



She turns to look out over the City for a moment, then up to the sky. "I'm glad you helped Eris out, but Ikora found out about everything. You can't keep much from her Hidden. I hear she's authorizing future dives into the Mindscape…"



Hawthorne turns back to you. "Hopefully, Eris got what she was looking for. Because it sounds like you two opened a door that should have stayed closed."

title: Alloy Completionist
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text: "Feeling ambitious this week, weren't you? Well done, Guardian." -Hawthorne

title: Clan Engram: Crucible
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text: "Looks like your clan's been impressing Shaxx and company. I bet I could hold my own in the Crucible. Whaddaya think?" -Hawthorne

title: Clan Banner
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
Represent your clan well, Guardian.



This banner will grow in strength as your clan demonstrates its power.

title: Clan Engram: Crucible
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text: Your clan's reputation grows, and with it your rewards.

title: Clan Engram: Crucible Ops
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text: Your clan's reputation grows, and with it your rewards.

title: The Will of a Titan
speaker: Sloane
text:
Sloane takes the recovered tech and listens to your report. "Savathûn," she repeats. "So it's worse than I thought."



"I was able to do a little research on this tech. Pieces of survival gear from the Golden Age-and they're just my size. When that ship decides to land, I'll be here to deal with whatever walks out of it."



The resolute look in Sloane's eyes stops you from speaking.



"When it all started, me, Zavala, Shaxx… we didn't build the wall; we were the wall." The unbreakable woman's voice is unexpectedly soft. "I told Zavala once: I was there for the beginning, and I'll be there for the end."



She smiles. Her crow's feet crinkle.



"It's not the end yet."

title: Clan Engram: Fireteam Ops
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text: Your clan's reputation grows, and with it your rewards.

title: Clan Engram: Gambit
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text: Hawthorne has worked with plenty of shady characters in the past, so she's more understanding of your collaboration with the Drifter than most. She offers you a reward for your clan's Gambit performance.

title: Clan Engram: Gambit
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text: Your clan's reputation grows, and with it your rewards.

title: Clan Engram: Nightfall
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text: "Whatever your clan's been doing out there, Zavala's pretty impressed." -Hawthorne

title: Clan Engram: Nightfall
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text: Your clan's reputation grows, and with it your rewards.

title: Clan Engram: Raid
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text: "Well, whatever your clan's been up to, they've got the attention of whoever's been talking to that weird sweeping frame. Is that Cabal symbology?" -Hawthorne

title: Clan Engram: Raid
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text: "Your clan's been busy, taking care of threats to the system that would have sent other clans running. The City's noticed, and… well, we'd like you to have this." -Hawthorne

title: Clan Engram: Pinnacle Ops
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text: Your clan's reputation grows, and with it your rewards.

title: Clan Engram: Raid
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text: Your clan's reputation grows, and with it your rewards.

title: Clan Engram: Trials of the Nine
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text: "Not sure what this 'Nine' nonsense is all about, but apparently your clan did some good stuff in their Trials. These 'spoils' were left for you." -Hawthorne

title: Clan Engram: Trials of the Nine
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text: Your clan's reputation grows, and with it your rewards.

title: Imbalanced Awoken Talisman
speaker: Spider
text: "Don't ask me to name my source, but a Guardian friend of mine is quite convinced the Scorn's Ether was corrupted by Darkness itself. Just what your little bauble needs if it's to get you to the Dreaming City, isn't it?" -The Spider

title: Clan Engrams
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
The strongest clan is one that works together. 



When you prove your strength, come back, and we'll have a little something for you.

title: Clan Reputation
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text: Complete activities while in a clan to earn clan reputation. More difficult activities grant more progress. Playing with clanmates grants a large bonus to progression.

title: Clan Rewards
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
Speak to Hawthorne to collect your reward.




        "It's a lonely system, Guardian. Being in a clan makes it a little bit easier." -Hawthorne

title: Clan Rewards
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
Speak to Hawthorne to collect your reward.




        Hawthorne and Louis both light up as you approach.



"It's easy to feel adrift in all this, Guardian. Don't forget it's our ties to each other that keep us grounded."



"It may not always seem like much, but the work you do with your clan, and the example you set-it matters. To me, and to a whole lot of other folks. Thank you."

title: Clan XP
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
Speak to Hawthorne to collect your reward.




        Thanks to your efforts, the renown of your clan continues to grow.

title: Clarion Call: Clans
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
Clarion Call Complete




        Look who's back. Showed them all, didn't we? Clans are the way to go.

title: Clarion Call: Clans
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
Go to Hawthorne for more information.




        Never thought I'd be rah-rah about anything, but Clans give us strength and wisdom. Time to put those to good use.

title: Clarion Call: Clans
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
Clarion Call completed.




        Look who's back. Showed them all, didn't we? Clans are the way to go.

title: Clarion Call: Clans
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
Go to Hawthorne for more information.




        Never thought I'd be rah-rah about anything, but clans give us strength and wisdom. Time to put those to good use.

title: Dawning Delivery
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text: For a split second, it seemed like Louis was staring at you. Hawthorne didn't seem to notice. She accepts the gift on his behalf.

title: Conquering Heroes
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
"Hey… You put together a fireteam, stepped into the belly of the beast, and lived to tell the tale. Few can say the same. I'm impressed, Guardian."



Continue to rally your fireteam and challenge yourselves to complete raid activities to earn even more XP and more powerful rewards!

title: Faction Reward
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text: Your reputation with Hawthorne precedes you. Take this reward in recognition of your deeds.

title: Legacy: Hunter and the Hunted
speaker: Spider
text:
Uldren Sov has been reborn as a Guardian and now goes by the name Crow. After gloating over having this former prince in his employ, Spider proposes a mutual collaboration to deal with Xivu Arath's infestation and offers Crow's services as aid.



Speak with Crow to learn more about how to hunt down Xivu Arath's forces.

title: Fishing Rally: EDZ
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
Hawthorne claps her hands for you with a smile.



"Not a bad day's catch, Guardian. Can't say I've ever had that kind of luck on my own fishing trips."



"Seems like a good time to get out there and cast your line. Never know what's gonna bite."

title: Fishing Rally: EDZ
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
Hawthorne crosses her arms in front of her.



"Something's got the fish around the EDZ all riled up. I've done my fair share of fishing out there, and I've never seen them act like this before."



"Might be worth checking out. Ready for some angling?"

title: Fishing Rally: Nessus
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
Hawthorne furrows her brow.



"Guardian, how's the fishing on Nessus? I've been hearing that something's stirring up the critters in the ponds out there.



"I don't know much about the Vex or radiolarian fluid, but it might be worth some, er, data collection.



"And by that, I mean fishing."

title: Fishing Rally: Nessus
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
Hawthorne greets you with a pensive look.



"Well, you certainly caught a bunch of fish. I'm not sure how much we can learn from them, but they'll at least make nice additions to your aquarium."



"I used to always share a portion of my catch with Louis, but considering what those fish were swimming around in, that probably wouldn't be a good idea."



Hawthorne looks to Louis, who almost seems to nod in agreement.



"Anyway, good angling out there. Seems like the fish are eager to bite, so you might want to take advantage of the opportunity."

title: Fishing Rally: Throne World
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
Hawthorne mutters something to herself and shakes her head.



"Look, I'm not going to pretend I understand why Savathûn has fish on her throne world, or what could cause them to swarm. What I do know, is that any unusual activity in that place is worth investigating."



"Take your bait and rod, see what you can fish up. Just be careful you don't get pulled under yourself."

title: For the People
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
"Don't tell me Shaxx roped you into this too?"



Hawthorne eyes you with feigned suspicion, then shrugs. 



"Me and Louis are both doing just fine. Just like I've told each and every raid fireteam that's come up to dutifully ask after my health: I'll probably outlive all of you."



She flashes you a wry smile.



"You should get back to helping Shaxx keep the City's borders clear. I'll be here, keeping an eye on the little people."



Hawthorne pauses, giving you a serious look. "We fought hard to get the City back during the Red War. You know I won't let anything happen to this place."



"And hey, if we make it through this-maybe I'll see you at Marc's sometime for family dinner?"

title: Fishing Rally: Throne World
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
Hawthorne waves as you approach.



"Glad to see you back in one piece. I was worried YOU might end up as the bait for once."



"I don't think we'll ever truly understand Savathûn or that swamp of hers. Maybe studying the fish you caught can yield some answers. Rahool's already creating a taxonomy for them."



She looks to Louis and rolls her eyes with a grin.



"Good fishing out there, Guardian."

title: Guardians United
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text: Hawthorne may not say it out loud, but she's proud of how you and your friend never quit. She gives you a reward for your persistence.

title: Gone Fishin'
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
Hawthorne greets you with a raised eyebrow.



"A fishing tackle? Must be flotsam from the Arcology, a way for some nostalgic scientists to pass the time. I know I've got fond memories of casting my line alongside friends and family out in the EDZ."



She gives you a thoughtful look.



"I heard you Guardians are building an aquarium up on the H.E.L.M. A few fish would go a long way to livening it up. Maybe you could use this to catch them yourself."



A grin spreads across Hawthorne's face, as if her fond memories were rising to the surface.



"After you scrounge up some bait, of course."

title: Guardians United
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text: Hawthorne congratulates you and your friend on reaching a significant milestone, and she offers a reward to help celebrate.

title: Guardians United
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text: Hawthorne doesn't trust the Drifter, but she supports you and your friend working together to push back the enemies of humanity.

title: Guardians United
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
Complete a story mission with a linked friend.




        Hawthorne recognizes your shared commitment with another Guardian and is eager to challenge the two of you to prove that connection.

title: Introduction: Raids
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
"Feeling confident, Guardian? You'll learn fast that survival isn't just about skill. Having friends who'll cover your blind spots in pinch is crucial if you're gonna hunt big game."



Hawthorne offers challenges, consumables, XP, and rewards for completing raid activities.



Gather your fireteam and take on the "Leviathan" raid to prove you can work as a team, and earn powerful rewards!

title: It's in the Cards
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
Speak to Hawthorne to collect your reward.




        Hawthorne and Louis both light up as you approach.



"It's easy to feel adrift in all this, Guardian. Don't forget it's our ties to each other that keep us grounded."



"It may not always seem like much, but the work you do with your clan, and the example you set-it matters. To me, and to a whole lot of other folks. Thank you."

title: Never Quit
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
Suraya Hawthorne cocks her head toward you. "You've been busy. Pretty impressive for a half-dead Guardian I dragged out of the mountains." She smirks.



"Been talking to Zavala. He needed to be reminded of everything the City's achieved. Everything we've fought for… everything you've all let me be a part of. He needs those memories to lean on." Hawthorne's head droops, and Louis nuzzles her temple.



"I'll admit, I thought it was over when live casts of those horrible ships hit the Tower. It's all I could look at for days." She absent-mindedly feeds Louis a bit of meat scrap. "I've thought that way before. But we survived. Then and now."



"I'm sorry to hear about Sloane, and Asher." Hawthorne turns away to look over the City before craning her head back towards you. "Sometimes we lose. Just don't ever quit on us… and we won't quit on you."

title: Refer-a-Friend Reward
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text: Hawthorne is impressed by your dedication to bringing more Guardians into the fold, and she offers a reward in return.

title: Reputation Max Rank
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text: Complete activities while in a clan to earn clan reputation. More difficult activities grant more progress. Playing with clanmates grants a large bonus to progression.

title: Rise
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
Hawthorne hurries to hand you a datapad. "This just came in from a communications relay on Titan. The commander asked me to deliver it to you immediately."



The datapad contains coordinates on Titan for the New Pacific Arcology. "The Hive have a foothold there, but the deputy commander says the situation has changed," Hawthorne says with concern.



"Something about a Lucent Hive ship entering Titan's atmosphere and diving into the ocean," Hawthorne says and motions to the datapad. "Details look scarce. But whatever's going on can't be good."



Launch the "Ghosts of the Deep" dungeon from the H.E.L.M. in the Director.

title: Rise
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
"No one will tell me what happened down there," Hawthorne says with a nervous look back at Ikora. "Whenever I ask, she says it's 'privileged information' and shuts me down."



Anxiously looking around, Hawthorne shakes her head. "I won't ask you to go against Ikora's wishes. She's gotta be keeping secrets for a good reason. But I haven't seen her that shaken since she learned about Savathûn having the Light…"



Hawthorne furrows her brow and stares into the distance for a moment. "Actually… maybe it's better if I don't know, " she murmurs, shifting her attention back to you. "Sometimes the truth is more terrifying than your own imagination."

title: Rogue Network
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
Hawthorne raises her eyebrows at you. "Your correspondent has graduated from letters to packages. I'm telling you, Guardian, you're putting Kadi out of business like this."



You tear open the latest envelope from Spider and a data chip falls out. The attached message reads,



"Dear Guardian,



"We've learned so much together, haven't we? I treat my partners well. Look at how high my last partner has risen in City authority. Always remember what Spider can do for you.



"Now, for Vesper Station… There's an ultimate control mechanism. Bray's personal key. And if you control the AI, you control the station. Vesper Central seems lonely up there. A bit out of control. I think you'll agree she could use a guiding hand.



"My agents have turned up one little key on their search for the big one. You take it and you grab what you want, and you remember it was your old chum who had you in his thoughts this whole time.



"XOXO, etc, the Spider."



PERMISSIONS GRANTED:

TechAccess|Storage|Restricted|42

title: Rogue Network
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
"Love letters? The latest Omolon catalogue? Criminal activity? Whatever it is, you're real popular these days, Guardian."



Hawthorne flips a hawk-nibbled envelope over to you. The letter inside reads,



"To the Hero of the City,



"Curiouser and curiouser! A whole Salvation gang absconding with a Ketch, and a Golden Age AI locked up on a station alone… well, that's news plenty would pay for. A BrayTech AI is a valuable thing, no matter how poor her personal attitude. We'd better make sure she doesn't fall into the wrong hands.



"While you were clearing the nest, I had my people doing some digging on the side. Their key discovery was that many mysteries still wait in Europa's orbit. More investigation means more profit, and an answer to some lingering questions, eh?



"My last contract with a Lightbearer ended… unhappily, let's say. But I believe ours will be a fruitful partnership.



"As ever, your friend, the Spider."



Return to the "Vesper's Host" dungeon and uncover its secrets.

title: Rogue Network
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
Hawthorne holds the latest envelope back for a moment.



"Either give your mystery admirer your comm frequency or a restraining order, but stop using my place as a dead drop, yeah?"



You nod, contrite. Hawthorne passes you the letter, watched by a fierce Louis. It reads,



"To the Guardian, my friend and partner in perfectly legal enterprise,



"A job well done as usual! That's what I like to see in a partner. Steadiness. Trustworthiness, even. And a willingness to share the profits. That little AI up there is lonely, don't you think? Best keep an eye on her. We haven't turned up that key yet, but it's got to exist. One access code implies another. That's what I think. And I'm not often wrong!



"All perfectly aboveboard, of course. It would be a kindness, even-I'm sure she could use the distraction.



"With all the usual sickening sentiments, the Spider."



Mysteries linger within Vesper Station, and in Spider's intentions for Vesper Central.

title: Rogue Network
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
Hawthorne nods at your approach. "Guardian. Ever thought about getting an apartment down in the City? Something with a balcony, maybe a mailbox? I found this under my door this morning. Nearly slipped on your mail-and Louis nearly did worse to it."



With an apologetic grimace, you open the letter. It reads:



"To my dearest scallywag,



"I've got a job for you, and it comes with a sob story. I had an agent investigating an orbital station above Europa for salvage. She lost contact. It'd have to be something worse than Salvation vagrants knocking around up there to take her down. All we're getting on the Europa channels now are automated warnings. Old Human ones. I'm not sending anyone else on my payroll after a corpse. It's time for drastic measures-and you, Guardian, are the most drastic measure I can think of.



"The pay's good: whatever you can salvage. A Golden Age station is a treasure hoard for a canny explorer. I'll content myself with your leftovers.



"Give it a look. Just try not to crash this station, too, would you?



"With anticipation, your friend, the Spider."

title: Specimen ID: NES009
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
Hawthorne passes you a spare bird perch.



"Louis doesn't like this one. I don't know why, it's exactly like all his other ones. Uh, I did clean it, don't worry about that."



Louis screeches. Hawthorne shakes a finger at him sternly.



"Don't give me guff, you flying rat. I'm not making the Guardian carry anything you touched without disinfecting it first." 



She turns her attention back to you.



"He's getting a little temperamental as he ages. Hey, tell Failsafe good luck, all right? Can't wait till I can see those batadactyls for myself. Next time the H.E.L.M. comes home, all right?"



She dismisses you with a firm nod.

title: Suraya Clawthorne
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
"The people of the City use this holiday to bring a little levity to our grim reality," Hawthorne says. "We're scared, but we're laughing."



She pauses and gives you a meaningful look. "I think Guardians can probably relate."

title: Suraya Hawthorne
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
Hawthorne prefers the solitary life, choosing to live beyond the Wall. Despite this, she took charge of this camp to help the refugees of the City survive in unfamiliar and dangerous lands. She wants to help you out and offers you a ship for your journey. 



Follow your vision to the Shard of the Traveler by completing mission SPARK in the EDZ.

title: Suraya Hawthorne
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
We have a new plan. The Vanguard will lead a host of Lightless Guardians on a counteroffensive against the occupied City, hoping to free the Traveler. Meanwhile, you must disable the Almighty's sun-killing superweapon before it can destroy the entire solar system. To approach the Almighty undetected, steal the personal ship of Thumos the Unbroken, one of Ghaul's chosen Blood Guard. 



Bring the fight back to the Red Legion by completing mission "Payback" in the EDZ.

title: Suraya Hawthorne
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
Your vision from the Traveler was true and it led you back to the Light. The camp is even safer now that you have reconnected to your power. But there are still a lot of people out there in the wild who need refuge. Help get them to the Farm. 



Go meet Hawthorne's friend Devrim by selecting the landing zone TROSTLAND in the EDZ.

title: Suraya Hawthorne
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
We have witnessed the miraculous: the Traveler has reawakened… and Hawthorne has returned to the City. Zavala convinced her to continue her role as guide for both new and old Guardians. She found her place in this new community, bridging the gap between humanity and the Guardians who protect them. 



Visit Hawthorne for all of your clan-related activities.

title: The Guardian Games
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
"The people of the City are excited about the Guardian Games," Hawthorne says as you walk up. "We don't usually get to see you Guardians in action.



"The way you all came together during the Red War… the way you risked your lives even when you couldn't be sure you'd come back." She nods. "It meant a lot. And I know you're still protecting the City every day. So…" She smiles at you. "Let's celebrate."

title: Path of the Splicer IV
speaker: Splicer Servitor
text:
The Endless Night is getting worse, Mithrax says. He can hear the City groaning under the strain.



The Eliksni in the House of Light are suffering alongside the City's citizens, but still they are regarded with suspicion.



He has faith that your progress as a Splicer will collapse the Vex simulation, but says the night muffles even the impact of your victories.



"The people hear of your triumphs against the Vex, but they see only dark skies above," he says. "They are being bent… and some may break."

title: Detached from Time
speaker: Osiris
text:
Osiris accepts the strange object and examines it. In his hands, it flickers in and out of existence, an ever-fluctuating presence.



"Strange," he says, looking up to meet your eyes. "An object like this has never emerged from the Sundial before." His brow crinkles with concern. "I fear this is evidence of how drastically the Red Legion has corrupted time on Mercury."



He sets the object aside. "Give me some time to study this. I may be able to determine what it is or where it came from. Meanwhile, the obelisk network could still use your help." He reaches for something and then presents it to you: a strange lantern. It glows faintly. "This will help you in the battles to come."

title: Unnamed Interaction
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
Hey Guardian,




        Now I know why they call it the European Dead Zone. You killed everything!
