title: A Gift from Eververse: Warmind
speaker: Tess Everis
text: Tess expresses her gratitude to you for helping her friend Ana Bray, with a gift from her store's inventory.

title: A Gift from Eververse: Curse of Osiris
speaker: Tess Everis
text: Tess expresses her gratitude to you for helping Osiris with a gift from her store's inventory.

title: A Gift from Tess
speaker: Tess Everis
text: After tales of your courage, Tess grants you another gift to help you continue as inspiration to the survivors of the City.

title: A Gift from Tess
speaker: Tess Everis

title: A Gift from Eververse: The Red War
speaker: Tess Everis

title: A Gift from Tess
speaker: Tess Everis
text: ...and wants to make sure you look good while you do it.

title: A Gift from Tess
speaker: Tess Everis
text: Tess encourages you to keep inspiring survivors of the City...

title: A Gift from Tess
speaker: Tess Everis
text: Tess, moved by your courage, was struck by a flash of inspiration-and rewards you with the result.

title: A New Season Arrives at Eververse
speaker: Tess Everis
text: You receive a package with a note from Tess that reads, "I have something for you, Guardian. No need for repayment. Here-I hope it spurs the imagination."

title: A Gift from Tess
speaker: Tess Everis

title: A New Season Begins
speaker: Tess Everis
text: Tess is grateful you've completed the Eververse bounty, and she rewards you with a gift to celebrate.

title: A New Season Begins
speaker: Tess Everis
text: Though the mood in the Tower is dark, Tess welcomes you to Eververse and encourages you to celebrate the beginning of a new season. She has a request in the form of a bounty.

title: A New Season Begins
speaker: Tess Everis
text: Tess once again appreciates your completion of an Eververse bounty. She rewards you with a gift to celebrate the new season.

title: A New Season Begins
speaker: Tess Everis
text: Tess welcomes the dawn of a new season with a gift from Eververse in the form of a bounty.

title: Changing Seasons
speaker: Tess Everis
text: Tess welcomes you back to the Tower, and offers a gift to celebrate the spirit of change in the air.

title: Legacy: Sails of the Shipstealer
speaker: Star Chart
text:
Mithrax greets you with grave news-Eramis's fleet is converging on another relic. 



He also has a request: "Do not involve Eido in your violence against the old crews," he asks.



"She is brave and curious, but does not yet understand the brutality of the world," he says, with some difficulty. "There are pain-truths in our history."



Mithrax admits Eido should know about the past of her people, but he wants to be the one to teach her. He asks that you give him time to prepare to do so responsibly.



For now, Eramis's crews must be disrupted, and another relic snatched from her grasp.

title: Decrypt Engrams
speaker: Tess Everis
text: A Cryptarch can decrypt complex engrams into powerful gear and other items.

title: Dawning Delivery
speaker: Tess Everis
text:
"Oh, how utterly delightful!" Tess says as she takes the treats from you. She admires them for a moment and then places them below the counter, out of sight.



"I'll enjoy these later, when we're not quite so busy," she says. "Happy Dawning!"

title: Eververse Promotions
speaker: Tess Everis
text: Greetings, Guardian! Have you heard about our latest promotion?

title: Eververse Promotions
speaker: Tess Everis
text: Welcome to Eververse, Guardian! With your first Bright Engram purchase we'll throw in an additional Bright Engram for free.

title: Eververse Promotions
speaker: Tess Everis
text: Congratulations, Guardian! Another year has passed since your Ghost first resurrected you with the Traveler's Light. Please accept this gift from Eververse, along with our thanks for your tireless defense of our City.

title: Eververse Promotions
speaker: Tess Everis
text: Please, take this. A thank-you for your continued support.

title: Eververse Remembers
speaker: Tess Everis
text: Tess expresses her gratitude for your festive good work and presents you with a reward from her special stock.

title: Eververse Remembers
speaker: Tess Everis
text: To celebrate the Festival of the Lost, Tess requests that you complete a challenge in remembrance of times past.

title: Lavish Fashions
speaker: Tess Everis
text: Tess smiles. "Ah, perfect. Thank you so much. Here, take this." She offers you a Bright Engram. "It's the least I can do."

title: Lavish Fashions

speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text: Both Louis and his lifelong friend appreciate the thoughtful gift you've brought them. Louis seems calmer already.

title: Spring Comes to Eververse
speaker: Tess Everis
text:
You're no closer to knowing whether the rumor Tess heard was real or not.



Undaunted, she presents you with a Jubilant Engram. "Make the most of the Revelry, Guardian."

title: Spring Comes to Eververse
speaker: Tess Everis
text:
"Ah, the Revelry!" Tess says. "What a good tradition for us to embrace."



She pauses, then asks, "Is it true that someone hacked the Infinite Forest to simulate something a bit more… cheerful? I heard maybe Sagira complained to Osiris. Ha! Wouldn't that be rich. But maybe you could follow up on those rumors for me. Do you mind?"

title: Faction Reward
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text: Your reputation in the Crucible precedes you. Take this reward in recognition of your deeds.

title: Spring Comes to Eververse
speaker: Tess Everis
text:
You're no closer to knowing whether the rumor Tess heard was real or not.



Undaunted, she presents you with a Jubilant Gift. "Make the most of the Revelry, Guardian."

title: Summer Style
speaker: Tess Everis
text: "I hope the Solstice is everything you want it to be," Tess says. She hands you a Bright Engram with a smile, then turns toward her next customer.

title: Tess Everis
speaker: Tess Everis
text:
We may have lost the battle, but Tess refuses to give up the war.



Visit Tess to browse and purchase cosmetic items and rare goods.

title: Summer Arrives at Eververse
speaker: Tess Everis
text: Tess greets you with a warm smile. "I hope you're enjoying the nice weather, Guardian."

title: The Dawn Comes to Eververse
speaker: Tess Everis
text: Tess welcomes you to her stall, handing you a gift that will help you usher in the new season in style.

title: The Undying Comes to Eververse
speaker: Tess Everis
text: Tess smiles. "I have something for you, Guardian. No need for repayment. Here-I hope it spurs the imagination."

title: The More, the Merrier
speaker: Tess Everis
text: Tess seems a bit glum to not receive any treats herself, but she still rewards you with a gift from Eververse's Dawning collection.

title: Welcome to Crimson Days
speaker: Tess Everis
text: I've always had my eye on you, Guardian. Take this, but don't tell anyone I gave it to you for free!

title: The Worthy Come to Eververse

title: Welcome to Crimson Days
speaker: Tess Everis
text: Tess greets you warmly as you approach-and gives you a gift to celebrate Crimson Days.

title: Welcome to Eververse
speaker: Tess Everis
text: Tess Everis, proprietor of Eververse, has a welcome gift for you.

title: Welcome to the Dawning
speaker: Tess Everis
text: Happy Dawning, my dear. I have a little something set aside for you.

title: Welcome to the Solstice of Heroes
speaker: Tess Everis
text: Tess greets you warmly as you approach-and gives you a gift to celebrate the Solstice of Heroes.

title: Legendary Exotic
speaker: Tharsis Cantina
text: Collect your Exotic armor reward for completing all missions on Legendary difficulty.

title: Legendary Power
speaker: Tharsis Cantina
text: Collect your Powerful Gear reward for completing all missions on Legendary difficulty.

title: Renegades
speaker: Tharsis Cantina
text:
You open a letter written formally and stamped with the Cormorant Seal:



Rookie,



A Praxic Guardian's education never stops. You've got more to learn about yourself and your Blade, and so do I. 



If we're going to change the Order, we need to work at it. Come see me upstairs when you've got a moment.



Ever forward,

Aunor



P.S. Try the Ether Fizz House of Kings style sometime. Don't let the price on the receipt scare you off: it's worth every credit.

title: Renegades
speaker: Tharsis Cantina
text: "Years ago, my Ghost lost her voice when I got us into an ice-cold situation on one of the Cabal Emperor's Athenaeum worlds. A couple other Lights didn't make it out, but thanks to her, I did. Hand to my heart, I regret it-and I thought she and I were making progress, especially after Kepler. She's clearly holding some grudges, but-thanks for helping her just the same. Now let's see what we can do to take this fight to the Imperium." -The Drifter

title: Renegades
speaker: Tharsis Cantina
text: Aunor speaks quietly into her earpiece, then closes the call and waves you over. "We're all set for the job on Venus, Guardian. Drifter's sent word: reality and his visions are converging. It's time."

title: Gone Fishin'
speaker: Suraya Hawthorne
text:
Hawthorne gives you a knowing look as you approach.



"So, are you… hooked?"



She laughs at her own joke until she catches sight of Louis staring her down.



"Anyway," she continues, "There's something nice about sitting still and waiting for a catch to come to you. It's like a metaphor for life."



"At least, that's what Devrim keeps telling me."



She smiles as she sends you on your way.



"Go fish, Guardian."

title: Renegades
speaker: Tharsis Cantina
text: We've established a tenuous business relationship with the Pikers, and Drifter has helped us set up an exchange with them: They'll bring a Splicer Shank to help us extract further data from Imperium installations on the whereabouts, defenses, and operational status of Nightfall.

title: Renegades
speaker: Tharsis Cantina
text:
Aunor sets down her datapad. "We need to be ready for the upcoming battles. And if that means breaking with a fundamental tradition of the Praxic Order… then that's just what I'll do." 



She beckons you forward.

title: Renegades
speaker: Tharsis Cantina
text: The Drifter is certain that the Nine are involved with the Barant Imperium, controlling them through Bael. They've shown him a new vision, which he's about to share with you…

title: Renegades
speaker: Tharsis Cantina
text:
Aunor would like our help discovering what the newly emerged Dredgen Bael is up to, alongside the crime syndicates of Mars. 



Start by assisting her in targeting syndicate operatives across the system to help discover their long-term plans.

title: Renegades
speaker: Tharsis Cantina
text:
There's an empty glass on the bar behind Aunor. She pushes it away as you approach, but her hands are steady.



"Guardian. As much as I'd love to find that bastard and wring his neck… we can't." She spits the words like a curse. "Not while Nightfall's still in the sky. Taking that weapon down has to be our top priority. So, let's get started."

title: Renegades
speaker: Tharsis Cantina
text: Defy Vanguard orders and delve into the criminal underworld of Tharsis to confront the rising Barant Imperium… Drifter is certain the Imperium and the Nine are connected.

title: The Territory War Begins
speaker: Tharsis Cantina
text:
The barkeep flags you down before you can leave the Cantina and draws your attention to a crumpled receipt tucked under Aunor's envelope. On its back side is a second note from her, this one written in far more haste:



Guardian, 



You showed me I was wrong about the Darkness. Eido showed me I was wrong about the Prophecy. The people of the City deserve to know what we're all up against-so we can face it together.



The Syndicates are scrambling for resources and territory. All eyes are on them, and that means plenty of cover for this unauthorized action.



Eido has a line on a busted broadcaster. Parts for repair have to be available somewhere, but we're coming up empty. Help us fix it. Let's blow this thing wide open. 



Ever forward,

Aunor

title: A Difficult Teacher
speaker: The Crow
text:
"You just missed Osiris," Crow notes with a look over his shoulder. "He's been teaching me a Hive dowsing ritual so we can map out the interdimensional pathways through the Ascendant Plane. Use what we're learning about the cryptoliths to track down the High Celebrant."



Crow puffs out his chest, just so. "He says I'm a fast study, and maybe the Spider might allow him to continue tutoring me when this is over. There's a lot I could learn from him."



The corner of his mouth crooks up. "When I asked him where he learned so much about the Hive, he told me not to ask questions I wasn't ready to have the answers to."



Crow laughs. "I can see why people think he's kind of an ass."



Continue completing Wrathborn hunts to weaken Xivu Arath's forces.

title: As the Crow Flies
speaker: The Crow
text: Crow looks distracted when you approach; his eyes hold a distant and far-away quality. But when he sees you, there is a dawning look of recognition, and for a moment it's as if he sees you with new eyes. But it isn't the look of an enemy. It's the look of a friend. A look of trust…

title: Ascendant Hunter
speaker: The Crow
text:
Crow shuffles esoteric gadgets around his workbench.



"We're on the verge of the coup de grâce. I've tracked the High Celebrant to the Dreaming City, but the Lure will need to be upgraded one last time before we can make our move."



The Lightbearer holds up one of the strange baubles and examines it closely. "Here it is: the final piece."



Crow smirks. "Well then, like Spider always says, we're in business."



Upgrade the Lure one last time.

title: Building Pressure
speaker: The Crow
text:
"Spider's getting impatient," is the first thing Crow says.



He's a ball of frenetic energy, struggling not to pace. "A horde of Wrathborn descended on a docked Ketch and slaughtered the crew."



Crow's mouth flattens. "Not that our Baron is concerned about the loss of life beyond the work stoppage it causes." He sounds bitter.



"He ever-so-politely reminded me about the explosives he planted in Glint." Crow takes a breath and gives you a sharp look. "If we don't find the High Celebrant soon…"



He knows he doesn't have to finish the end of that sentence. Instead, with quiet desperation, he says, "We have to work harder."



Continue completing Wrathborn Hunts to weaken Xivu Arath's forces.

title: Challenger's Proving IV
speaker: The Crow
text:
Crow offers a restrained fist pump. He mutters affirmation under his breath. He seems impressed by the Light-disruptor, and thankful for your help, but behind his eyes, you can tell his mind is racing over what this could mean. He's glad he spoke up. He thinks something like this could have easily gotten away from us.



You see Crow flinch as if a literal lightbulb flicked on inside his head. He mentions a report he'd seen: Psions hit the City and stole some tech. Then he'd heard a few Guardians hadn't checked in from field ops, and yesterday, one of their bodies was found. No Ghost. No Light. Dead by what looks like City weapons. He thinks whoever these Psions are, they've been at this for a while.

title: Challenger's Proving V
speaker: The Crow
text: Crow offers his apologies, but still believes he did the right thing. He's glad to have your support, and says he will be watching Commander Zavala's back more closely from here on out.

title: Challenger's Proving IV
speaker: The Crow
text: Crow's eyes are stern. His voice is strained with worry. He tells you he swung by Nessus; stopped by a Vex conflux near where you hit those Psions. He was worried and had to ease his mind. Glint tapped into them and managed to dig out a corrupted Cabal transmission from that site. It could be nothing, but they traced it back to Europa. Crow would feel better if a friend were to check it out.

title: Challenger's Proving VII
speaker: The Crow
text:
Despite an initial unease, Crow seems pleased with Zavala's acceptance of him and his redeployment. He expresses that he feels a personal responsibility to track down any of the Psion actors that remain at large. He chuckles, looking at his broken mask. He mumbles something about a vendetta, wry smile on his face.



Crow wishes you the best, thanks you for all you've done for him… for the many doors you've opened and the life you, Osiris, and Glint showed him he could have. He's confident you'll see each other soon.

title: Cleaning Up the Shore
speaker: The Crow
text:
Crow seems different today, as though a weight has lifted off of him.



"Still can't believe it," he says with cautious amazement, "but Spider was quick to agree to your terms. He never gives up that easy, which means he thinks there's something to gain."



"He sent an engineer to remove the explosives from Glint, so he's held up his end of the bargain… for now." Crow's wariness for the future is tempered by a growing sense of optimism for the present.



"As for me, I plan on sticking around." He cracks a rare smile. "Just a little longer. The High Celebrant may be gone, but we need to clear out the remaining Wrathborn before the cryptoliths will decay. That could take weeks… possibly months."



Crow squares his shoulders to the task ahead. "I'll get things started, then you Tower Guardians can handle the rest. I've earned my freedom, and I intend to enjoy it."



Continue completing Wrathborn hunts to weaken Xivu Arath's forces.

title: Dawning Delivery
speaker: The Crow
text:
Crow glances around the area furtively before accepting your offered gift, then stuffs it under his cloak without checking what it is. He soon notices the scent of almond and chocolate and looks at you with gratitude.



"Thank you," he says softly. "Truly."

title: Dawning Delivery
speaker: The Crow
text:
Crow accepts your gift with a grin, but he looks thoughtful a moment later. 



"A lot's happened since the last Dawning. Eva's right-this is a good time to say thanks. From me, from Glint. For everything."

title: A Gift from Tess
speaker: Tess Everis
text: Inspired by your efforts, Tess grants you a reward.

title: Deadly Venatics
speaker: The Crow
text:
Crow assesses your blood-splattered armor with grim admiration.



"Good work, Guardian. Looks like the Hive god of war has competition for her title."



He half-jokes, "I wouldn't want to be on your bad side…"

title: Hunt for the Wrathborn
speaker: The Crow
text:
Crow gives a wry smile. "Nice work. You picked that up quickly."



"But that's only the beginning." His smile fades. "There are much more dangerous Wrathborn than that one."



He checks the sights on his weapon. "So let's get to work."



Continue charging the Lure and equipping it with mods to unlock Wrathborn hunts. Complete hunts to progress Crow's weekly challenge.

title: A Gift from Tess
speaker: Tess Everis
text: Tess is overjoyed at all you've accomplished, and offers quite a reward.

title: Fate Worse than Death
speaker: The Crow
text:
You come around the corner and hear a loud metallic clang as Crow hurls a wrench at his workbench in anger. He looks sheepish when he sees you and begins to tidy up.



"Spider's attitude toward these hunts is getting to me," he confesses. "I've tried to reason with him that there might be a way to save the corrupted Eliksni. He won't hear it."



"I know the Wrathborn are a threat, but I refuse to abandon these people to death, or a fate worse than that. They took me in, and they deserve… better."



Continue completing Wrathborn hunts to weaken Xivu Arath's forces.

title: Increase Reputation
speaker: The Crow
text: Burnish your reputation with Crow.

title: Hunt for the Wrathborn
speaker: The Crow
text:
Xivu Arath's minions are a threat to business on the Shore, and Spider wants them dealt with.



Crow has cobbled together a Lure from an old Hive artifact; it seems to be effective at baiting out the Wrathborn, Xivu Arath's corrupted army.



Acquire the Lure from Crow's workshop.

title: Lavish Fashions
speaker: Tess Everis
text: Tess smiles. "I have something for you, Guardian. No need for repayment. Here-I hope it spurs the imagination."

title: Legacy: Ascendant Hunter
speaker: The Crow
text:
Crow shuffles esoteric gadgets around his workbench.



"We're on the verge of the coup de grâce. I've tracked the High Celebrant to the Dreaming City, but the Lure will need to be upgraded one last time before we can make our move."



The Lightbearer holds up one of the strange baubles and examines it closely. "Here it is: the final piece."



Crow smirks. "Well then, like Spider always says, we're in business."



Upgrade the Lure one last time.

title: Legacy: Bound in Sorrow
speaker: The Crow
text:
It's over.



Crow has finally confronted and defeated the Nightmare of Uldren Sov, and in doing so, believes he understands his purpose as a Guardian.



"I thought being a Guardian was my destiny," Crow said. "That wielding the Light for good was the most I had to offer. But it's clear now… this is what the Traveler chose me for. I was reforged in the Light, for a purpose."



Crow's renewed faith and strength has given him a new lease on life, and you're to thank for that. Return to Eris at the Crown of Sorrow to further discuss this victory.

title: Legacy: Bound in Sorrow
speaker: The Crow
text:
Crow is distraught after his confrontation with the Nightmare of Uldren Sov. Being confronted by a manifestation of his darkest fears and greatest failures has crushed his spirits.



"We're exactly the same, down to the instincts. It's in my blood," Crow says, unable to reconcile the pain of his past.



He won't be able to perform the ritual of severance in this state. You should seek Eris's guidance at the Crown of Sorrow.

title: Legacy: Challenger's Proving IV
speaker: The Crow
text:
Crow offers a restrained fist pump. He mutters affirmation under his breath. He seems impressed by the Light-disruptor, and thankful for your help, but behind his eyes, you can tell his mind is racing over what this could mean. He's glad he spoke up. He thinks something like this could have easily gotten away from us.



You see Crow flinch as if a literal lightbulb flicked on inside his head. He mentions a report he'd seen: Psions hit the City and stole some tech. Then he'd heard a few Guardians hadn't checked in from field ops, and yesterday, one of their bodies was found. No Ghost. No Light. Dead by what looks like City weapons. He thinks whoever these Psions are, they've been at this for a while.

Acquire the Lure from Crow's workshop.

text:

He checks the sights on his weapon. "So let's get to work."



Continue charging the Lure and equipping it with mods to unlock Wrathborn hunts. Complete hunts to progress Crow's weekly challenge.

title: Let Loose Thy Talons
speaker: The Crow
text:
"On our way back, I… felt something. It's a yearning. For change, for… adventure." Crow smiles awkwardly. "It feels childish, but it's like the gun⁠-or maybe the Traveler⁠-wants us to experience triumph."



"Glint thinks this may have to do with elevated states of emotion. Like we need to attune our minds to a specific… wavelength." Crow doesn't seem completely convinced, but there's a part of him deep down that believes it's true.



"I think we should try," Crow asserts. "Together."



Defeat Champions or Guardians in Gambit and Crucible matches.

title: Legacy: Challenger's Proving IV
speaker: The Crow
text: Crow's eyes are stern. His voice is strained with worry. He tells you he swung by Nessus; stopped by a Vex conflux near where you hit those Psions. He was worried and had to ease his mind. Glint tapped into them and managed to dig out a corrupted Cabal transmission from that site. It could be nothing, but they traced it back to Europa. Crow would feel better if a friend were to check it out.

title: Let Loose Thy Talons
speaker: The Crow
text:
Hawkmoon is beginning to transform through your actions.



Crow is reminded of another dream he had; you were holding the effigy, but it was dazzlingly bright. In the dream, you took it to the Shard of the Traveler in the EDZ… but that's all he can remember. He suggests you head there to investigate.



Return to the EDZ and investigate the supplied coordinates.

title: Legacy: Challenger's Proving VII
speaker: The Crow
text:
Despite an initial unease, Crow seems pleased with Zavala's acceptance of him and his redeployment. He expresses that he feels a personal responsibility to track down any of the Psion actors that remain at large. He chuckles, looking at his broken mask. He mumbles something about a vendetta, wry smile on his face.



Crow wishes you the best, thanks you for all you've done for him… for the many doors you've opened and the life you, Osiris, and Glint showed him he could have. He's confident you'll see each other soon.

title: Legacy: Retribution
speaker: The Crow
text:
"It's time to act," Crow says.



You're struck by Crow's confidence as he explains his and Mara's plan. 



"The Witness sees our connection to each other as a weakness to exploit. It's counting on us not risking more lives in another attack," he points out. 



"But if Amanda were here, I think she'd tell us it's time to play some offense."



"Mara's focusing all her energy directly through you, Guardian. We need you to blaze through the Ascendant Plane one last time…"



"But it won't be without backup," he grins. "We're ALL going."



"Lead the charge, Guardian."

title: Let Loose Thy Talons
speaker: The Crow
text:
Crow is experiencing troubling dreams that he believes involve a peril in the EDZ. He has trusted you to help him discover if they are more than just dreams.



Travel to the EDZ and complete mission "Cry from Beyond."

title: Let Loose Thy Talons
speaker: The Crow
text:
"It's a cycle," Crow says confidently.



"Life, death, rebirth… The Traveler is trying to tell us something in metaphor because it-or we-lack the words to have a true conversation."



"This gun… an effigy of a firearm spun from the same material as the Traveler. These crystals inside the frame, they're dark but-part of me is certain they should be glowing."



"Glint thinks we need to charge the crystals with Light… as if we're trying to bring the gun back to life." He hesitates. "The way you do with a dead Guardian. I'm ready to test that theory whenever you are."



Collect and generate Orbs of Power to strengthen Hawkmoon.

title: Peace for Savek
speaker: The Crow
text:
Crow leans against the table, his head bowed. "There was an Eliksni," he says, "a salvager Dreg named Savek. We'd worked together a few times out on the Shore."



"A few days ago, I saw her in a horde of Wrathborn. Managed to isolate her. Drag her away. Restrain her."



He refuses to meet your eyes. "I tried to get through to her, to reach the Savek I knew, but she fought so hard to free herself that she nearly tore one of her arms off."



Crow swallows and you see his throat jump.



Silence, then, "I didn't know what else to do, so I gave her what peace I could."

title: Peace for Savek
speaker: The Crow
text:
Crow leans against the table, his head bowed. "There was an Eliksni," he says, "a salvager Dreg named Savek. We'd worked together a few times out on the Shore."



"A few days ago, I saw her in a horde of Wrathborn. Managed to isolate her. Drag her away. Restrain her."



He refuses to meet your eyes. "I tried to get through to her, to reach the Savek I knew, but she fought so hard to free herself that she nearly tore one of her arms off."



Crow swallows and you see his throat jump.



Silence, then, "I didn't know what else to do, so I gave her what peace I could."



Continue completing Wrathborn hunts to weaken Xivu Arath's forces.

title: Redouble Your Efforts
speaker: The Crow
text:
"It feels like it'll never end," Crow says.



"No matter how many of the Wrathborn we kill, it feels like Xivu Arath has six times as many waiting to take their place. What worries me is that we're only seeing the Eliksni among the converted… but I know remnants of the Red Legion were corrupted as well."



"We need to redouble our efforts, focus on hunting down the most powerful of Xivu Arath's servants, and find a way to shut the cryptoliths down forever. Or, I suppose, die trying."



"Repeatedly," he adds with a smirk.



Continue completing Wrathborn hunts to weaken Xivu Arath's forces.

title: The Man I Am
speaker: The Crow
text:
"I suppose this is it," Crow says with a sense of finality. "Time to say goodbye to the Reef. To the only home I've ever known."



He looks thoughtful, if a little distant. "Osiris came by earlier. We talked for a while about my plans for the future. I told him I'd considered exploring somewhere remote, like Venus, but he suggested a different course."



"I'm coming to the Tower." Crow holds his head up high. "People may judge the man I was, but I refuse to cower in the shadow of his legacy. I'm a Guardian. I need to act like one."



Continue completing Wrathborn hunts to weaken Xivu Arath's forces.

title: Preview Reward Engram
speaker: The Crow
text: Complete Wrathborn hunts to earn a reward engram.

title: Reward Engram
speaker: The Crow
text: The targets you've defeated have yielded a useful reward.

title: A Dubious Bento
speaker: The Drifter
text:
Drifter does a poor job of hiding his relief at the sight of you.



"You'd think the Sol system was getting sliced up all over again, the way people are hollering for help. Been hard to keep up." 



He sighs. "Nobody counted on me for this kind of thing before. My mistake was turning reliable. You don't see anybody running to Spider for a helping hand. Or four. No, with him, they pay up front." 



"I'm practically doing the Vanguard's job for them! You'd think I like this place or something." 



Drifter groans. "Hell. I might like this place." 



"Don't you look at me. Just go take care of business. And here: I made this dish special. Had to call in a favor to get the right ingredients. Don't spill it."

title: Wayfinder's Voyage
speaker: The Crow
text:
Crow is fuming after being barred from speaking with Savathûn by Petra Venj. "Venj thinks I'm vulnerable, and I'm just supposed to take a seat?" he asks.



He looks to you, pointing out that other people knew Osiris longer than he had, including yourself.



He tells you he is tired of being held accountable for the actions of the person he used to be. "Our past lives aren't supposed to matter," he says. Crow takes a moment, then nods to himself. He tells you he deserves answers, and he isn't going to wait around for someone else to give him permission.

title: Wayfinder's Voyage
speaker: The Crow
text:
"Now I know the man I was," Crow says, anger rising in his voice. You can tell he wants to yell, to scream, to ask why you didn't tell him the truth. Ultimately, he decides he understands why you and the Vanguard handled his past life the way you did. "I don't think I would have told me either," he admits.



He says he saw everything he did as Uldren, as if he were reliving it. He looks shaken, but steadies himself and explains that he too is afraid of the man he used to be.



"I've asked Ikora to put me on another assignment," he states. Crow looks to you and assures you that he just needs some time to think things through. He tells you to offer whatever explanation you like to the Awoken queen; but for now, he just needs to be alone and asks you to respect his privacy.

title: A Weapon of Sorrow
speaker: The Drifter
text: Although Drifter is in the business of manufacturing new age Dredgens, he still can't help but be shocked when you show up to his shop carrying a replica Thorn. He wants nothing to do with it. If you're smart, neither should you.

title: A Friendly Temptation
speaker: The Drifter
text:
"That look in yer eye says you're ready for some Gambit Prime, my friend.



"Fair warning… Prime ain't for the faint of heart. But that's what makes it so gosh-darn fun."



Head into Gambit Prime from the Gambit tab of the Director.

title: Acting Bad, Looking Good
speaker: The Drifter
text:
Acting Bad, Looking Good




        Sometimes it's not what you win-it's how you win. The Drifter wants you to dress your best and cause a scene.



Win a Gambit match wearing a full set of Season 4 Gambit armor.

title: A Guardian Rises
speaker: The Drifter
text:
"You look like you could use a friend," Drifter says with a smirk.



"Back from the grave with almighty powers, just to wind up in this stuffy place, salutin' Commander Stick-Up-His-Butt. Sounds like a bad beat."



A coin appears in Drifter's hand; he casually rolls it across his knuckles.



"I could use a friend, too, you know, and what you need to understand is old Drifter always takes care of his friends." His smile stretches ear to ear.



"Heard you tore the Hive up good back in Old Russia. Tell you what, since you like tusslin' with Knights, you can have this Sword. No charge, of course, for a friend."



"Just swing back when you're tired of being Zavala's errand runner, and we'll talk business."

title: Darkness in the Light
speaker: The Drifter
text: You've defeated a particularly powerful Primeval in Gambit and taken its heart. Drifter might find it valuable. Take it to him.

title: Darkness in the Light
speaker: The Drifter
text: You've been at Gambit for a while now. You've met the enemies of Humanity head-on and made them pay. The Drifter has rewarded you handsomely for the Motes of Dark you've collected. Now it's time to see the culmination of your partnership with the Drifter.

title: Acting Bad, Looking Good
speaker: The Drifter
text:
Acting Bad, Looking Good




        You've got moves, and you've got swagger. The Drifter knew he could count on you.

title: Darkness in the Light
speaker: The Drifter
text: You found a component part of some kind of weapon at Callum's grave. It must be what he stole from the Drifter. He'd probably like it back.

title: Breakneck
speaker: The Drifter
text: You haven't told the Drifter of your success, but he seems to already know. He tosses a reward your way.

title: Decision Point
speaker: The Drifter
text:
The Drifter knows someone has been snooping into his affairs. He likes you, but he needs to trust you… and so he has a simple question for you. Are you with him? Or are you against him?



Choose where your loyalties lie.

title: By Your Bootstraps
speaker: The Drifter
text:
By Your Bootstraps




        The Drifter rummages through a battered supply crate. He extracts a Machine Gun and tosses it toward you with a flourish.



"Don't say I never gave you nothin'," he winks.

title: Don't You Cry
speaker: The Drifter
text:
Drifter holds out a quiver and a Compound Bow with both of his greasy hands.



"Use this," he indicates the Bow, "To stick 'em with these." He juts his chin at the arrows. "Go to town."

title: Dredgens of Yore
speaker: The Drifter
text:
"I take it all back-I'm going to Neomuna. Gonna upload myself into that CloudArk of theirs, maybe become some kind of computer virus." 



Drifter rubs his temples. "Everything was simpler when I had a different crew every week, and we were all trying to kill each other." 



His expression of grim severity doesn't survive under observation. "Hey. Let a man live." 



Yet another container of food is pushed into your hands. "You take care of that, and I'll think about sticking around."

title: Engram Tracker
speaker: The Drifter
text:
A recorded message from Master Rahool plays when you pick up the engram tracker: 



"Guardian! This is a new device of my own manufacture. It will allow you to monitor the number of engrams available at each of the vendors in the Tower."



"If you ever lose it, you can pick up a new one from any of those vendors. I look forward to seeing you deploy this device."

title: Gambit, in Its Prime
speaker: The Drifter
text:
A Token of Gratitude




        As you approach, the Drifter fixes you with an appraising stare. Is he… sizing you up?



In the next instant, he breaks into a disarming smile and you forget your doubt.



Drifter thanks you for your interest in his new "operations," saying that he hopes to see you out on the field very soon.

title: Dawning Delivery
speaker: The Drifter
text: Drifter's smile never falters as he accepts the delicious chocolate treats.

title: Gambit, in Its Prime
speaker: The Drifter
text:
No Strings Attached




        The Drifter is pleased with your performance in Gambit Prime, but that's not the only con he's cooked up.



With some sleight of hand and an unnecessary flourish, he presents you with a curious device that he calls a Synthesizer.



Your new Synthesizer can be used to combine Synths found in Gambit Prime into Motes which can be used in another one of Drifter's schemes: a mysterious trial he mentions briefly as the Reckoning.

title: Gambit Rank
speaker: The Drifter
text: Compete in Gambit. Earn armor and weapons at each rank, and powerful upgrades at major ranks.

title: Gambit Salvager
speaker: The Drifter
text:
"Between you 'n me, I'm surprised they let me back in here after that whole runabout on Europa."



Drifter looks around as if someone could secretly eavesdrop on him in this open room. "You know what they say about where you keep your friends and enemies? The real trick is to be neither, then no one knows what to do with you. Ya dig?"

title: Gambit
speaker: The Drifter
text:
Talk to the Drifter




        "Hey, I see you. I know what you're about. Come to the Tower. A Guardian like you should get to know a fella like me. The benefits would be… mutual." -The Drifter

title: Gambit, in Its Prime
speaker: The Drifter
text:
A New Scam




        The Drifter has unveiled a new training exercise for the Guardians of the Tower: a role-based, single-round evolution of Gambit that he calls "Gambit Prime."



He's eager for you to give it a try.

title: Guardian Games Registration
speaker: The Drifter
text:
"Guardian Games, huh?"  The Drifter sizes you up as you hand him your class gear. He passes a small device over it and lets out a satisfied grunt when a light on the back of the device turns green.



"You're all set," he says. "I usually go in for competitions with higher stakes, but there's something about that Eva lady. I just can't say no to her."



He winks at you. "Of course, this is good advertising. Sometimes I think you forget about me down here." He gestures to you. "Now go bank that medal at the podium. Good practice for Gambit."

title: Honor Among Thieves
speaker: The Drifter
text:
The Drifter seems relieved that you're still willing to talk to him after you heard everything he had to say.



As far as Drifter is concerned, the two of you are part of a crew now. If anyone crosses either one of you (and they likely will, given Drifter's extensive list of enemies)… well, he's got your back, and you've got his.

title: Gambit, in Its Prime
speaker: The Drifter
text:
Acquire a Gambit Prime bounty from the Drifter.




        The Drifter has unveiled a new training exercise for the Guardians of the Tower: a role-based, single-round evolution of Gambit that he calls "Gambit Prime."



He's eager for you to give it a try.

title: Honor Among Thieves
speaker: The Drifter
text:
The Drifter is jittery but earnest as he tells you that he's come to think of you as a friend. One of his only friends, at that.



To that end, the awkward tape he left you in the Derelict is the first in a series of tapes that are supposed to impart words of wisdom from "the ultimate prepper himself."



Begin your search in the European Dead Zone.

title: In the Face of Darkness
speaker: The Drifter
text: Drifter grins. "Guardian! You've come to the right place for answers to the questions I'm sure you're about to ask!"

title: Infamy
speaker: The Drifter
text: Compete in Gambit. Earn armor and weapons at each rank, and powerful upgrades at major ranks.

title: It Wasn't Me
speaker: The Drifter
text:
"Well, well, well…" Drifter says with a smirk. "I've known lots of folk who made the mistake of outstaying their welcome. Not many of 'em left today. But that's not your style, is it?"



"In and out in a flash-clinical! You're a joy to watch, kid. Just do me a favor, all right? I'll admit I like havin' you around, so if you're plannin' to give me the slip someday, make sure to leave poor old Drifter a nice note." He gives a sly smile.



"Consider it repayment for this beauty. Happy trails, friend."

title: Jack the Drifter
speaker: The Drifter
text:
"Give a man a mask, and you're givin' him permission to be a bad guy," Drifter says. "That's what you and your friends are all waiting for, right?"



He winks. "Have fun out there, huh? Tear it up."

title: Jack the Drifter
speaker: The Drifter
text:
"Give a man a mask, and you're givin' him permission to be a bad guy," Drifter says. "That's what you and your friends are all waiting for, right?"



He winks. "Have fun out there, huh? Tear it up. And, uh, have a little extra candy. Just a little 'thanks for not being a lousy snitch,' from me to you."

title: Martial Mementos
speaker: The Drifter
text:
"Get your favorite Cannon ready-I have more work for you. Figure if they're going to put me in charge of this kind of thing, I might as well lean into it. Run you ragged. Really make you regret being so helpful."



Drifter winks at you. "But I still know how to motivate Guardians, don't you worry. Mind, I'll tell the Vanguard you were an altruist through and through." 



"Got another delivery for Eris, while you're here. Tell her I said… well, never mind. Just let me know what she thinks about it, yeah?"

title: He Doth Protest Too Much
speaker: The Drifter
text:
The Drifter tells you that he used to know the Emissary. She used to be a Guardian named Orin, with ties to the Awoken Queen. Then… she left. She was changed.



Bristling, he demands that you back off. He believes there's nothing for you to learn from her.

title: Honor Among Thieves
speaker: The Drifter
text:
"Really pisses me off when people break their word," Drifter says. "The Man with the Golden Gun was set to leave this system to me-resume his hunt for the Shadows of Yor beyond the borders of Vanguard authority. But he's back, without prompting. And he's killed associates of mine-associates like you. Lightbearers.



"Might be the Vanguard's decided I've outlived my welcome-brought the Man back in to cut ties, and they're startin' with my rank and file. Might be he's waitin' to burn us down last. Or could be he's workin' with that Praxic rat Aunor. Everywhere she goes, something dies in a fire." A pause. "You know what? I don't care what's going on down there. I need you to make a statement. Get into the Crucible and sow some discord. I'll pay you for every Guardian you drop. No, really. Let me hear 'em scream."

title: Misplaced Trinkets
speaker: The Drifter
text: "No, I'm not gonna pay you to take it." Drifter flashes a quick grin at you. "Won't say no if you want to play a round of Gambit, though. Here you go." He doesn't even stop to ask if you want the piece, just hands it over.

title: Meet the Drifter
speaker: The Drifter
text:
"Well, well, well… Another champion of the Light's come to play in the shadows."



The Drifter offers Gambit bounties, pursuits, shaders, and other rewards for challenges in the Gambit playlists.



Gambit combines cooperative and competitive gameplay. Teams of 4 compete to clear the battlefield of enemies. Hinder your opponents with enemy Blockers or Guardian Invaders. Summon and defeat a Primeval to win!

title: Meet the Drifter
speaker: The Drifter
text:
"Well, well, well… Another champion of the Light's come to play in the shadows."



The Drifter offers Gambit bounties, quests, shaders, and other rewards for challenges in the Gambit playlists.



Gambit combines cooperative and competitive gameplay. Teams of 4 compete to clear the battlefield of enemies. Hinder your opponents with enemy Blockers or Guardian Invaders. Summon and defeat a Primeval to win!

title: Misplaced Trinkets
speaker: The Drifter
text: "Makes no sense," Drifter grumbles, handing over another piece. "Waste of space is what this is. Turned around a few minutes ago and tripped over this one. Wherever these are coming from, I hope they find better things to do. If I trip over one more piece I'm kicking it into low orbit."

title: Misplaced Trinkets
speaker: The Drifter
text: "Yeah, another one of 'em. You can have this one too for all I care-don't mean a thing to me." Drifter tosses it to you without even waiting to hear an answer.

title: Misplaced Trinkets
speaker: The Drifter
text: "Whatever this is-bounced off my shoulder the other day. You want it? Go ahead and take it off my hands. No, really, I mean it. Just taking up space here." Drifter hands the piece over with a little shrug.

title: Mysterious Disturbance
speaker: The Drifter
text: "All hell's breakin' loose out there, Hero. You gonna do something about it?" -The Drifter

title: New Digs
speaker: The Drifter
text:
Drifter has moved shop to the Annex. Drop by the Tower and pay him a visit.




        Drifter has moved shop to the Annex. What's more, he's about to unveil a new evolution of the game he calls Gambit Prime.



Note: Gambit Prime is available only to Annual Pass holders.

title: Misplaced Trinkets
speaker: The Drifter
text: Before any words can be exchanged, Drifter tosses the piece to you. "Have fun, hero," he says, and moves on.

title: Packed Lunch
speaker: The Drifter
text:
"Hey, partner. Hold up a minute."



"So I gutted that vending machine out front a while back… used it to stash some goodies I picked up after the Red War." 



Drifter grimaces. "Thing is, I didn't expect those Eliksni to keep feeding that machine their Glimmer. Maybe you can give them a little consolation prize to send them on their way-my treat-and get yourself some privacy so you can dig around." 



"Besides, there's something in there I think you'll like."

title: Nightmare Kills
speaker: The Drifter
text:
"Hey, hero. You regret saving the world yet? They're gonna keep you busy till the end of time!" 



Drifter offers you a rueful grin. "'Course, I'm the one wound up with all the paperwork, this round. Goes to show: Never do anything for anyone." 



"You ruminate on that little pearl of wisdom while you run around saving lives and all. Me, I've got contacts shouting down the comms-figure I can point you where you'll make a real difference to people that need it." 



"And… I've got a favor to ask you. You know Moondust-Eris, I mean-has a habit of letting the hours fly by. You and I both know you can't accomplish much on an empty stomach." 



"Besides, she's always on me about my ingredients. Just 'cause I can make do with alternatives in a pinch doesn't mean I don't know my spices!" 



"Anyway, seeing as you're headed out there, will you drop off this meal I packed for her? It'll be worth your time. Trust."

title: Nightmare Lunch

text:
"Hey, hero. You regret saving the world yet? They're gonna keep you busy till the end of time!" 



Drifter offers you a rueful grin. "'Course, I'm the one wound up with all the paperwork, this round. Goes to show: Never do anything for anyone."

"Anyway, seeing as you're headed out there, will you drop off this meal I packed for her? It'll be worth your time. Trust."

title: One of the Crew
speaker: The Drifter
text: You choose to stand with the Drifter. Pleased by your decision, he rewards your loyalty with a request for assistance…

title: Planned Obsolescence
speaker: The Drifter
text:
Drifter takes a look at your trusty Synthesizer, scratches his jaw, gives you a long look of consideration… then smiles. "Figure that thing's due for an upgrade, don't you think? You scratch my back, I'll scratch yours. And then some. Ha!"



The Drifter is offering a bounty that you can use to upgrade your Synthesizer to the next level. Take a look at the Drifter's bounties to get started.

title: Packed Lunch
speaker: The Drifter
text:
Drifter has a faraway look in his eyes as you approach.



"Sometimes I think of the old Tower. I never saw it, but…"



"Eris talks about it sometimes. She's got lots of memories of that place. So much of it went up in smoke during the Red War. We might've won, but… couldn't save everyone. Or everything." He cracks his armored knuckles.



"Anyway! City needs your help. I'm here to entice you with the goods. But only when you're done."

title: Primeval Patina
speaker: The Drifter
text:
"I was hopin' you'd stop by." Drifter, energetic as ever, greets you with a grin. "Banshee mentioned you might be lookin' for me. Couldn't remember why, but I pieced it together."



"New gun, right? Lookin' to deck it out, Drifter-style?" He narrows his eyes. "Well, this time, the Dredgen gets to wet his beak."



He leans in close. "I'm gonna wager some hefty Glimmer on you, and you're gonna win some Gambit for me, dig?"



Drifter leans back proudly. "C'mon, it'll be fun. Whaddya say, hero?"

title: Planned Obsolescence
speaker: The Drifter
text:
Drifter takes a look at your trusty Synthesizer, scratches his jaw, gives you a long look of consideration... then smiles. "Figure that thing's due for an upgrade, don't you think? You scratch my back, I'll scratch yours. And then some. Ha!"



The Drifter is offering a bounty that you can use to upgrade your Synthesizer to the next level. Take a look at the Drifter's bounties to get started.

title: Quid Pro Quo
speaker: The Drifter
text:
"Like I said, kid; when Drifter wins, you win. Don't ever say I didn't do anything for you.



"Whenever you feel like making some more cheddar, you come on back. Don't be shy about it; Gambit's always here, and Drifter never forgets his friends."

title: Return to the Drifter
speaker: The Drifter
text:
The burnt ozone smell of the Umbral Decoder still hangs in the air. Drifter nods approvingly.



"Got something nice, huh? You're a natural."



"You've seen the containment unit in the corner? I call it the Prismatic Recaster. Pieced it together from junk I had lying around."



He shrugs innocently. "What can I say? A thirsty fella should always be ready to make lemonade."



"That Recaster can focus the Darkness from your Seed. Help me skim some of that sweet Darkness, upgrade it a few times, and you'll come out of this with full pockets and a smile on your face."

title: Primeval Patina
speaker: The Drifter
text:
"Great work out there, Guardian!" the Drifter says. "I had the Glimmer in my hands! But, well…"



He shrugs his shoulders, palms up in helpless confusion. "Something weird happened when I was cashing in my contraband. I ordered a whole mess of exotic gun parts, but a big shipment of supplies got delivered to the Eliksni Quarter instead! I guess these clumsy fingers of mine hit an elaborate series of wrong keys."



"And-get this-instead of putting 'FOR DRIFTER, HANDS OFF,' I somehow accidentally wrote 'FROM LAKSHMI-2' on all the crates. Can you believe it?"



He shakes his head and grins. "I'll still pretty up your piece for you. Least I can do for you, keeping my embarrassing mix-up to yourself, you get me?"

title: Quid Pro Quo
speaker: The Drifter
text:
"I knew you'd be back before too long. Old Drifter presents opportunities that are too good to pass up…



"Here's the game, kid; it's called Gambit, a friendly competition between Guardians with the Darkness sandwiched in the middle. Every time you play, I get some cheese, and I kick some of that back to my friend, you dig?



"And when I say friend, I mean you. We're in this together, you see? When you win, Drifter wins, and when Drifter wins, you win. Heck of a scheme if I say so myself.



"So get out there and give it a spin, yeah?"

title: Season 6: One of the Crew
speaker: The Drifter
text: The Drifter slips you a package on the sly, giving you a nod of acknowledgment. He's grateful that you have his back.

title: Rite of Dawning
speaker: The Drifter
text:
The Drifter squints at you suspiciously. "Ceremonial wine?" he asks through a mouthful of chocolate. "The only thing I got like that around here is this old bottle of engine cleaner."



He rummages on a nearby shelf for a cloudy bottle of thick liquid. He examines it more closely, rubbing dust off the side with his thumb, revealing Cabal language hidden under the grime.



"Well, I'll be damned." He holds the bottle up to the light. "Is it supposed to be all chunky like this?"



Drifter shrugs and hands you the bottle. "All yours, kid," Drifter grins. "Just make sure to mention to Zavala how gracious I was." He winks, then laughs to himself.



"Y'know, I was just tellin' Tess and Eva at mahjong last week, 'This Dawning, I want Zavala to owe me a favor.' And would you look at this!"



He breaks into a wide, reptilian smile.



"It's a Dawning miracle."

title: Rendezvous with Drifter
speaker: The Drifter
text: Visit the Drifter in the Annex.

title: Return to the Drifter
speaker: The Drifter
text:
"Ha! I couldn't have done it better myself; you're a natural," Drifter says and rubs his hands together. "It's time to put that Seed to work."



"If you plan on helpin' Eris commune with the shadows or whatever, you'll need to recharge that Seed with Darkness each week."



"The Recaster can do a lot, but its primary function is keepin' that Seed charged. Speaking of which, it's lookin' mighty… empty."



Drifter's usual grin creeps back across his face. "I kinda like this. I'm the general, you're the enforcer, right? Check the Recaster and head back out there, Hero!"

title: Shady Schemes
speaker: The Drifter
text:
"You may be wondering what this was all for," the Drifter says.



"Sometimes, my friend, ignorance is bliss. Here's something for your trouble, but let's not ask too many questions, you dig?"

title: Return to the Drifter
speaker: The Drifter
text:
"We make a mighty fine team. Guardian and the Drifter!"



Drifter looks you in the eyes and puts his hand up. He holds it awkwardly. With his other hand, he slowly reaches over and grabs your wrist, firmly pulling your hand upward to complete the high five.



"Now, I'm not going to get all technical here, but we'll need Twisted Energy to keep the Recaster purring."



"I'll give you what's left of my supply to get you started. Slap this into the Recaster-and don't hold back when you find more. We're going to need all you can get if we're gonna strike it big!" Drifter says and chuckles quietly.



"Take that Altered Element and see how Umbral Engrams react to it."



He grins. "You're gonna love this next part."

title: Sign Me Up
speaker: The Drifter
text:
"Guardian Games, huh?" The Drifter sizes you up and accepts your class gear from you. He passes a small device over it and lets out a satisfied grunt when a light on the back of the device turns green.



"You're all set," he says. "I usually go in for competitions with higher stakes, but there's something about that Eva lady. I just can't say no to her."



He winks at you. "Of course, this is good advertising. Sometimes I think you forget about me down here." He gestures to you. "Now go bank that medal at the podium. Good practice for Gambit."

title: Sign Me Up
speaker: The Drifter
text:
"Guardian Games, huh?"  The Drifter sizes you up as you hand him your class gear. He passes a small device over it and lets out a satisfied grunt when a light on the back of the device turns green.



"You're all set," he says. "I usually go in for competitions with higher stakes, but there's something about that Eva lady. I just can't say no to her."



He winks at you. "Of course, this is good advertising. Sometimes I think you forget about me down here." He gestures to you. "Now go bank that medal at the podium. Good practice for Gambit."

title: Snakeskin Wrap
speaker: The Drifter
text:
Drifter shakes his head. "I hate to see a beautiful gun covered in Taken goo."



He wraps a Gambit banner around the gun and hands it back to you with a wink.

title: Taken Anomaly
speaker: The Drifter
text:
Investigate the Taken anomaly on Io




        The Drifter nods and leans to one side as he sees you. "I've been hearing my Gambit regulars talkin' about some wild energy spikes over on Io. The Taken are real aggressive in that region. Seems to me like there's something out there they're tryin'a protect." He shakes his head and smiles at you with lightless eyes. "I'm sure you'll get answers once you go out there and mow some of'em down." He catches a coin you didn't see him flip. "Get out there and see what you can find. I'll make it worth your while."

title: Shattered Shards: Lost in Prophecy
speaker: The Drifter
text:
Drifter regards you with a wry smile as you approach. 



"Hey Hero, or is it Killer? Hard to tell these days." His smile widens. "You notice the Taken in there ain't singing the same song as the ones the Echo has all riled up? Yeah, me too. Wonder what that's about."



Drifter flips a jade coin between his fingers. You see a Taken symbol on one side, and a Hive symbol on the other. "Anyway, I've pulled out that little shard of Dark you freed up. Wicked piece of work there: still sharp and cold as ice. Wouldn't want to be on the wrong end of it, so that's why I'm giving it to you. Put it to the throat of every monster you meet on Oryx's ship, would ya?"

title: That's Close Enough
speaker: The Drifter
text: Drifter's eyes squint as he peers at you. He doesn't want you to be too comfortable.

title: Snakebite
speaker: The Drifter
text:
"Been thinking… Yeah, yeah, no jokes."   



"Thinking about old times. New times. Fact is, if we really aren't going to high-tail it out of here-and it does seem a bit late for that-I guess we might as well start to think of this place like home." 



He shakes his head. "Never been a smart move. But it just so happens that nearly everyone I can stand to be around is here in one place." 



"…Bunch of other idiots here, too, of course. Anyways, look here: I made a dessert this time. Don't sneak a bite-I'll cook up something for you when you're not on the clock."

title: The Bigger Game
speaker: The Drifter
text: The Drifter does not like that you continued your visits to the Emissary, but there's nothing he can do about it now… and anyway, the two of you have bigger fish to fry. He's seen omens of the future, and he believes the only path to survival is the ethos bound up in Gambit and Gambit Prime.

title: Speak with the Drifter
speaker: The Drifter
text:
Drifter smiles when he sees you come into the room-then again, it seems like he was smiling already.



"When things get dark, everybody comes runnin' to ol' Drifter," he cackles. "Eris mentioned your situation, said you could use a little guidance. A steady hand."



He shrugs. "Guess I'll have to do, huh?"



"I don't have to tell you that Seed you've got is all kinds of special. Take it down to where those Pyramids are busy changin' the honest dirt into something they like more."



"I threw together a souped-up bank to help," he winks. "Easy money says you'll do great things together."

title: Taken Anomaly
speaker: The Drifter
text:
Investigate the Taken anomaly on Io




        The Drifter nods and leans to one side as he sees you. "I've been hearing my Gambit regulars talkin' about some wild energy spikes over on Io. The Taken are real aggressive in that region. Seems to me like there's something out there they're tryin'a protect." He shakes his head and smiles at you with lightless eyes. "I'm sure you'll get answers once you go out there and mow some of 'em down." He catches a coin you didn't see him flip. "Get out there and see what you can find. I'll make it worth your while."

title: The Draw
speaker: The Drifter
text:
You gathered all you needed for a ritual of your own.




        The Drifter has helped you track a dangerous Hive warrior tied to the infamous Weapons of Sorrow. The fight won't be easy. You will be outgunned and alone, but you've come this far and there's no turning back.



It's high noon, Guardian. Gun down the Hive weapons expert before his diseased arsenal can spread.

title: The Draw
speaker: The Drifter
text:
The Drifter has set you on a dark path, but insists you are doing the right thing, regardless of the danger. After all, what better way to stand against Darkness than to embrace it?



The cleansed artifact hungers for Light. Defeat your fellow Guardians to feed it.

title: The Draw
speaker: The Drifter
text:
The Drifter has acquired an ancient Hive artifact that he thinks you should take a look at. He believes that it might be tied to one of the Hive's fabled Weapons of Sorrow. He is eager to help you unlock its secrets… and its power. He is offering you stolen pages from a dark Book to help further your understanding.



Restore the tainted artifact to its original state by defeating Hive and gathering items the Drifter needs.

title: The Draw
speaker: The Drifter
text:

He is eager to help you unlock its secrets… and its power. He is offering you stolen pages from a dark Book to help further your understanding.



Restore the tainted artifact to its original state by defeating Hive and gathering items the Drifter needs.

title: The Draw
speaker: The Drifter
text:
The Drifter thinks the tainted artifact you've uncovered may be tied to the Hive's fabled Weapons of Sorrow. He is eager to help you unlock its secrets… and its power. He is offering you stolen pages from a dark Book to help further your understanding.



Restore the tainted artifact to its original state by defeating Hive and gathering items the Drifter needs.

title: The Drifter
speaker: The Drifter
text:
The Drifter has a unique perspective on death and Hunters. Touch base with him.




        The Drifter encourages you to shake off your grief about Cayde. Somewhere, someone out there has a bullet with your name on it. So did Cayde. So does he. Nothing you can do but go out on your terms.

title: The Draw
speaker: The Drifter
text:
The ritual you disrupted on Titan intrigues the Drifter. He believes that a certain Hive Wizard was behind the twisted ceremony. She was betrothed to a Hive weapon master, and the two were responsible for the creation of new Weapons of Sorrow.



It's time for a ritual of your own.

title: The Draw
speaker: The Drifter
text:
The Drifter is disturbed seeing the Last Word in your hand, but he is endlessly intrigued by the Hive weapon you uncovered. He offers a quick warning about trust, then brushes it all off with a laugh.



There is still much to learn about the Weapons of Sorrow. Hopefully, the trust you've placed in the Drifter will lead to new understandings.

title: The Drifter
speaker: The Drifter
text:
The Drifter wants to give you a little something in commemoration of your hard-fought victories.




        The Drifter commends you for all your hard work. He warns that his old enemy, the Man with the Golden Gun, may come looking for you. You're not just guilty by association. You're guilty by action... a new Dredgen.

title: The Drifter
speaker: The Drifter
text:
There are a lot of rumors circulating about your part in Uldren's demise. The Drifter wants to talk to you about them.




        The Tower is buzzing with gossip about what actually went down at the top of the Watchtower. If you really did pull the trigger... then you're the apple of the Drifter's eye and a perfect fit for his Gambit.

title: The Drifter
speaker: The Drifter
text:
There's a new Guardian in town. Says he's looking for open-minded Guardians. You should talk to him.




        The Drifter has rolled into town with his Gambit: a high-stakes competition between fireteams and the enemies of Humanity. But something about his cavalier attitude is a little unsavory...

title: The Drifter
speaker: The Drifter
text:
You've been working hard. Why not check in with the man behind all that hard work?




        The Drifter sees something special in you. You're not like the other Guardians. You're fiercer, stronger, maybe even a little meaner... and the Drifter's got his eye on you.

title: The Drifter
speaker: The Drifter
text:
There are a lot of rumors circulating about your part in Uldren's demise. The Drifter wants to talk to you about them.




        The Tower is buzzing with gossip about what actually went down at the top of the Watchtower. If you really did pull the trigger… then you're the apple of the Drifter's eye and a perfect fit for his Gambit.

text:
