        The Drifter commends you for all your hard work. He warns that his old enemy, the Man with the Golden Gun, may come looking for you. You're not just guilty by association. You're guilty by action… a new Dredgen.

title: The Guardian Games
speaker: The Drifter
text:
"Looks like you're ready for the Games," Drifter says, flipping a coin that disappears into his palm. "My money's on the Warlocks. I've seen you in action. The way you hold Light in your hands…" He shakes his head. "Freaky."



He smiles again, and the coin reappears in his hand. "Do me proud out there, huh?"

title: The Drifter
speaker: The Drifter
text:
There's a new Guardian in town. Says he's looking for open-minded Guardians. You should talk to him.




        The Drifter has rolled into town with his Gambit: a high-stakes competition between fireteams and the enemies of Humanity. But something about his cavalier attitude is a little unsavory…

title: The Guardian Games
speaker: The Drifter
text:
"Looks like you're ready for the Games," Drifter says, flipping a coin that disappears into his palm. "Titans are gonna take the whole damn thing. I'd bet money on it. Big money."



The coin reappears between his thumb and forefinger. "Line 'em up, and a Titan will knock 'em down. I've been around long enough to know that."

title: The Drifter
speaker: The Drifter
text:
You've been working hard. Why not check in with the man behind all that hard work?




        The Drifter sees something special in you. You're not like the other Guardians. You're fiercer, stronger, maybe even a little meaner… and the Drifter's got his eye on you.

title: The Mystery of the Missing Bags
speaker: The Drifter
text:
Drifter stands up straight and slides something quickly out of view behind his back.



"Well, well, what can I do for-oh, it's you, hero. That's a mighty fine mask you got on there. Almost fooled 'ol Drifter. 'Cept for the, uh, tape you got hanging there."



You inquire about the missing grab bags, but he shakes his head.



"That's the kind of trouble you'll never find me lookin' for. Last thing I want is to end up as Eva's next Dawning cookie!"



He mentions hearing rumors about Exo boot prints leading out of the storage room where Eva keeps her extra grab bags.



He shudders. "But if Eva asks, you didn't hear that from me."

title: The Rumor Mill
speaker: The Drifter
text:
There's gossip floating around the Tower that you might have snuck into a quarantined Cryptarch vault in the ruins of the old Tower.



Drifter is impressed. He asks you to keep him in mind if you ever go back.

title: The Guardian Games
speaker: The Drifter
text:
"Looks like you're ready for the Games," Drifter says, flipping a coin that disappears into his palm. "Well, you know my bet's on you Hunters. Quick. Sly. Real nasty with a knife." He grins. "My kinda people, yeah?"



The coin reappears in his hand, and he dances it over his knuckles. "I know you won't let old Drifter down. I've got big money riding on it."

title: The Snitch
speaker: The Drifter
text: You choose to stand with the Vanguard. The Drifter grudgingly respects your integrity, but this will change how he views you…

title: The Stasis Prototype
speaker: The Drifter
text: Drifter is impressed. He admires the gun and asks you to bring it through Gambit sometime. This weapon could really shake things up.

title: The Reckoner
speaker: The Drifter
text:
Drifter respects the way you've continued to make yourself notorious. You have no fear of declaring who and what you are. You've reckoned with yourself.



That kind of confidence can get you killed.

title: The Stasis Prototype
speaker: The Drifter
text:
The Drifter examines the blueprints you found. Turns out that the Fallen are using Praksis's armor tech to create a weapon capable of channeling Stasis energy. Eramis had plans to distribute this weaponry to Fallen all across the system, expanding the capabilities of her army.



Drifter likes the idea so much that he immediately cooks up a plan to steal the prototype from the Fallen. He thinks Spider's associates might be able to offer some insider information too. While he looks over the blueprints and calls in a favor, he asks you to go to Europa and gather more intel on the prototype.

title: The Stuff of Legends
speaker: The Drifter
text:
"Hey, kid. Decent work out there so far. I've been kicking some ideas around. Got a new assignment for you, if you're up for it." 



He chuckles. "You know, we make a decent little fireteam: you, me, Moondust. Well, if you set aside that you're the only one going into the field this time. But hey-you get to reap the benefits of our experience." 



"Oh, and here: run this down to Eris for me?" 



Drifter grins as he hands you another container of food. "Just in case you don't hear it often enough: you're the best Guardian in town."

title: The Stasis Prototype
speaker: The Drifter
text:
Drifter flashes a crooked smile as you walk up. "Nice work, hotshot," he says. "You're almost ready to go grab that gun."



"According to those blueprints, the one thing the Fallen haven't worked out yet is how to stabilize the Stasis energy. So I whipped up a prototype of my own." He winks. "This should help you get the gun firing."



Return to Europa and complete the "Stealing Stasis" mission.

title: Visit the Drifter
speaker: The Drifter
text:
"Now that you got a little taste of the action, how about we up the ante? I've got bounties worth yer time, kid."



Gambit bounties offer focused objectives for Guardians to complete while playing Gambit activities.



Select Gambit bounties from the Drifter. Complete their objectives. Then, claim the completed bounties to gain XP and rewards.

title: The Wheel-Horse
speaker: The Drifter
text:
"Hey there, hero. Shaxx still foisting his little check-ins on you?" Drifter winks. "Hey, no worries. I don't mind a visit."



Drifter takes up an insouciant lean against the nearby railing.



"Me, I'm keeping busy. Making a little Glimmer on the side too. Turns out Shaxx's Redjacks could use some new iron." He aims a finger at you, and mimes shooting.



"Hard for me to get too worked up about the end of the world-but this is your first time, huh?" 



"I've gone by a few names in my time… apocalypse will do that to you. Personally, I can't wait to meet whatever version of you comes out the other side." 



He ventures a sly grin.



"Think we'll still be pals? I did help work up these shiny new BRAVE weapons for you, after all. Heh."

title: Watch Your Back, Big Shot
speaker: The Drifter
text: You own both the Last Word and Thorn: two guns with larger-than-life reputations, two guns loaded with symbolism that Drifter fears you don't understand… or worse, are deliberately ignoring. He warns you to be more cautious.

title: Weapons of the Pantheon
speaker: The Drifter
text:
"Hey, hero." Drifter has a familiar insouciance as he greets you.



"Got something here for you. Some kind of challenge. Yeah, I know you're up for anything. Whaddaya think: your greatest foes, given renewed strength? Sound good?"



The bravado falls away a little. Drifter's look is briefly sympathetic.



"It's only gonna get worse," he reminds you. "Whatever the Nine put in front of their Weapon. You can kill anything, Guardian. Time to prove it."



He's back to a grin inside of a moment.



"And hey, you'll get a good prize out of it! That's what I'm talking about."

title: Umbral Engram
speaker: The Drifter
text:
As you enter the Annex, Drifter's nostrils flare and his dark eyes snap up to meet yours. The effect is slightly unsettling.



"What's that sizzling in your pocket? You brought back a puzzle, huh?"



You pull out the Umbral Engram. Drifter grins and thumbs toward a machine humming nearby.



"Just so happens I've got a puzzle-solver here. Whaddya say we crack that little thing open and taste the yolk?"

title: Visit the Drifter
speaker: The Drifter
text:
"Welcome back, killer. Havin' fun? That's rhetorical. I know you are."



Return to the Drifter to acquire bounties, gear, and other rewards related to Gambit activities.

title: Faction Reward
speaker: The Emissary
text: Your reputation with the Nine precedes you. Take this reward in recognition of your deeds.

title: Increase Reputation
speaker: The Emissary
text: Show the Emissary proof of your deeds in the Trials of the Nine.

title: Word of Warning
speaker: The Drifter
text:
Drifter bristles defensively when your Ghost mentions that you experienced a vision from the Emissary of the Nine. He, too, is experiencing visions, and he wants you to keep your distance.



Whether you respect his wishes is, of course, entirely up to you.

title: Faction Reward
speaker: The Emissary
text: Complete Trials of the Nine matches to obtain Trials of the Nine tokens and earn powerful rewards from the Emissary of the Nine.

title: Trials of the Nine
speaker: The Emissary
text: Those who earn favor in the Trials are gifted mementos from the vast collections of the Nine.

title: Welcome to the Trials
speaker: The Emissary
text: The Emissary welcomes you to this odd place.

title: Power in Connection
speaker: The Pouka Pond
text:
The pond shimmers as pouka weave in and out of it, navigating water and air easily as though there were no difference between the two. Sparkling droplets scatter from their fins. In the moment, it is easy to see again how all things are connected, how one strand plucked here resonates at a great distance with all of the others.



There is a new power here, between the stillness and the motion. Reach for it, and it is yours.



A new grenade is available for purchase from the Pouka Pond.

title: Trials of the Nine
speaker: The Emissary
text:
Hi Guardian




        Those who earn favor in the Trials are gifted mementos from the vast collections of the Nine.

title: The Final Strand
speaker: The Pouka Pond
text:
The air around the Pouka Pond thrums with extra energy upon your return. Even the poukas are trilling with excitement, as they flit across the surface of the water like skipping stones.



In the midst of this inspired atmosphere, it takes almost no time for you to combine the retuned spectrometer with the found Neomuni nanites. 



Metallic bits and green threads whirl as they knit together a mighty fine Strand weapon.



You pick up the gun-it feels just right-then stow it along with the rest of your arms.



You can now wield Strand in all respects.

title: The Final Strand
speaker: The Pouka Pond
text:
Now that you've mastered the power of Strand, the time has come to get creative with it. Meditating at the Pouka Pond sparks an exciting notion. How might you incorporate Strand energy into your weapons? 



The Cloud Striders have developed some interesting weapons systems over the years. Perhaps Nimbus could help you out with their nanites. At the very least, they'll be eager to brainstorm on a cool new gun.



Visit Nimbus in Striders' Gate to discuss incorporating Strand into a weapon.

title: The Final Strand
speaker: The Pouka Pond
text:
At the Pouka Pond, you hold the Veil spectrometer. It pulses with Strand energy, but something about it feels off. The vibrations are uneven, out of sync with what's around you.  



Perhaps the Shadow Legion tampered with it. Or perhaps you simply need to reset its energetic signature. 



Osiris's training program helped you get into the rhythm of using Strand before. A speedy run-through should be enough to align the spectrometer's energy with your unique combat tempo. 



Complete Osiris's training program in Radiosonde to retune the spectrometer's Strand vibrations.

title: Generated Polarized Fractaline
speaker: The Tower Obelisk
text: The resonate power collected from other obelisks, combined with the core components of this one, manifests itself as a lump sum of Polarized Fractaline ready for the taking.

title: Parting the Veil
speaker: The Pouka Pond
text:
Osiris has left a note behind for you. It reads:



Guardian, 



I do not know where our research into the Veil will bring us. The work done by Chioma Esi and Maya Sundaresh is undoubtedly critical to our understanding of not only the Veil but also its greater purpose in the Witness's agenda. We have only begun to scratch the surface. I wish there were more time.



Regardless, even the beginning of our work has borne fruit in further understanding Strand through its source of origin within the Veil. The more we understand of one, the more we understand of the other. In that, I believe, there is hope.



In the meantime, I believe there are other obligations that demand your attention. I will let you know of any future developments.



Warmest Regards,

Osiris

title: Purchasing Strand Upgrades
speaker: The Pouka Pond
text:
You harnessed the power of Strand and defeated Calus. But the journey is far from over…



Strand Meditations allow you to unlock the full potential of Strand and become a true master. Use them to purchase new Strand Aspects, Fragments, and grenades.

title: Act I
speaker: Tonic Table
text:
A note has been left here in impeccable neatness on the Tonic Table:



"I'm glad the City allowed us to build Variisis Core near the Market District. With this new lab and workshop, I was able to make you all kinds of equipment."



"I wish I could focus on curing my father, but Fikrul won't stop until all Eliksni are turned. We need to support your battle against the Revenants."



"Along with your title comes a gift: your Slayer Baron Apothecary Satchel. It may be small, but it's reinforced and filled with ingredients. May it protect you as you protect us."

title: Act II
speaker: Tonic Table
text:
"Hmph. So Scribe Eido wants to organize a prison break. I never thought she'd have the claws to defy the Vanguard. Maybe my mentorship is finally sinking in."



"Still damn foolish if you ask me. Eramis was never an earner. Did nothing but spend for all those years: Ether, lives, weapons. All wasted. In time, she'll spend Eido's good will too. Mark my words."



"But… business is business. I see you have my payment. Check your console. I left what you'll need to open the cell. Just don't let the Praxics catch you with it. They might confuse it for the one that went missing from their vault."



"Now go. Let Eramis and Fikrul tear each other apart."



"Just don't let anything happen to our little Eido, eh?"

title: Lantern in the Dark
speaker: The Tower Obelisk
text:
The obelisk hums louder. It reverberates through your body as all indicators display strong connections. According to your Ghost, this obelisk is giving off a much more stable energy signature than any of the others you've encountered. 



Ghost mentions picking up an additional link outside the normal obelisk network, but cannot determine its origin.

title: Synchronized Resonance
speaker: The Tower Obelisk
text: The obelisk hums as energy passes through it. Individual sections whir to life. It is functioning smoothly, but multiple indicators appear, showing weak signals coming in from all across the system. The other obelisks must not be putting out a strong enough signal. There is more to do before this beacon can shine.

title: Act II
speaker: Tonic Table
text:
Eido is visibly distressed. "My father's condition is deteriorating. He's not himself. His mind veers constantly toward vengeance, he questions those most loyal to him, and-"



"And I have nothing! No answers. No cure. Only jars full of powders and a few hundred ancient texts I can make no sense of! I'm sorry. I should… You have enough to worry about."



"Variks has some troubling reports from the old prison. Apparently ther have been intruders-someone else with an interest in Fikrul's new abilities."



"He needs you over there right away."



"I don't know how much longer my father has. And if a Kells of Kells isn't there to challenge Fikrul…"



"We have to end this soon."

title: Act I
speaker: Tonic Table
text:
"I visited Eramis in her cell. We've been talking a little. I think we're making progress!" Eido tells you excitedly.



"She's been more responsive lately. You've been out there, protecting our people-even she has to admit that much."



"I mentioned that I've been working with Variks to track down more information about tonics. Eramis said she knew a couple of older Eliksni with knowledge of such things. If we could track down an apothecarist, it would speed up my research considerably!"



"In the meantime, Eramis also spoke of a Salvation enclave that might need our help. I sent Crow the coordinates. I… might have left out the part where Eramis gave them to us… I think we can trust Eramis to look after the interests of her own people. I'm sure Crow will see that soon enough."



She stares expectantly at you. "Trust me on this?"

title: Act II
speaker: Tonic Table
text:
"Incredible. The Echo is alive? And so is Skolas. My father told me many stories about him. Few good."



"If the Echo reached out to you, actually communicated, using that song from old Riis…"



"Variks recognized it. Eramis might too. She's nearly as old as he is. She remembers old Riis. If there's anyone who can reach out to the Echo, help us call it away from Fikrul… Guardian, we have to free Eramis!"



"I know it's a lot to ask, but… Look, it'll be easy."



"I have a Golden Age relic that I think Spider will like. A kind of scroll, with many vibrant illustrations."



"Spider has all kinds of useful devices. I bet people ask him for help breaking out of jail all the time!"



"We can't wait any longer. And I know this is the right call. But if it isn't… tell Crow I'm really sorry?"

title: Act II
speaker: Tonic Table
text:
"It pleases me to see you embrace the title of Slayer Baron. The Dark Ether of many Scorn stain your armor."



"But against the dead, killing is not enough. It is clear that Fikrul seeks something within the Prison of Elders. What it is, we do not know. But I have a song in my blood-an intuition-which gives me fear…"



"That it is a dangerous weapon from our past. A memory from a long-dead House, revived in Darkness."



"Return to the Prison and stop the Scorn from reviving that which should remain buried."

title: Act III: Kell of Kells
speaker: Tonic Table
text:
"Machine-spawn. This is Eramis, of no House, Echo-Bearer and Voice of Riis."



"I reach you from the outer edges of Sol, where I am departing this war-torn slum forever. That I leave my people under your blithe tyranny shall be another of my unavoidable regrets."



"The Echo believes I am still worthy. I've made so many compromises…. Can I truly say I am of old Riis?"



"Eido would have me stay, of course, using my new power to reclaim Scorn from the Darkness. But the Echo calls me home. Its song resonates through every drop of my being. It sounds like… gusts of Ether flowing through canyons. Roiling as clouds and condensing as dew."



"I shall build a new life with my family… and think of you no more."

title: Act III: Kell of Kells
speaker: Tonic Table
text:
"I really can't thank you enough for your help with Eramis. We're on the same side of this fight. So long as her people are safe, it's in her best interest to help us."



"Just in time too. Scouts from the House of Light found something out in the Reef-a formation of asteroids, lashed together. Between the reckless approach to construction and their taste in architecture, it's safe to say the Scorn are involved. We're closing in on Fikrul's base of operations, and everyone's pitching in on a plan."



"But before you go-I have something for you."



"I've spent countless hours studying Nezarec's curse. I've come to believe it shares a few elements with Dark Ether. I haven't yet found a safe treatment, but I did think of a way to weaponize my experiments against the Scorn."



"I hope it can be of use to you in the field."

title: Act III: Kell of Kells
speaker: Tonic Table
text:
You see that Eido has left you a paracausal injector at the holo console.



"Guardian. This will be the best and final test of all that we have learned together."



"This tonic will alter the Ether that flows through Fikrul's body, filling him with Light. While the potion runs its course, he will be Eliksni, not Scorn."



"My hope is that Fikrul will be cut off from his Dark Ether just long enough for you to put an end to him. To bring him a final death, as the Ghosts say."



"I've had an injector prepared and delivered to you. I wish we could test it first-but we have to take advantage of Fikrul's arrogance while we can."



"I know you can do this, Slayer Baron. Our House trusts in you."

title: Act III: Kell of Kells
speaker: Tonic Table
text:
"I greet you in the Light once again, Guardian. You have prevented another Whirlwind, and brought honor to the title of Slayer Baron."



"I am now Kell of Kells, but I do not embrace it with four arms. Though I feel the Light flow through me once more, I fear the God of Pain will always be with me. A lingering note of discord in my blood."



"I thought to make Eramis or Variks Kell of Kells, but they refused. Eramis offered me the Echo, but I could not accept. It has chosen her."



"Eido would keep the Echo in Sol, to clarify the Ether of the Scorn… but it is too great a threat. We cannot risk another mass corruption."



"Instead, Eramis will take the Echo far from this system. Perhaps she can finally create a new Eliksni homeworld, as she always dreamed."



"Besides, House Light has all it needs here: kin, allies, and the Great Machine above."

title: Episode: Revenant Act I: Eliksni Rescue
speaker: Tonic Table
text:
Eramis wonders if it's gratifying for you to see her imprisoned. 



She's glad she hasn't been imprisoned with Salvation captains, so her humiliation can remain private.



Eido has convinced her you're willing to defend Eramis's people against Fikrul, so she has the location of a hidden enclave for you to visit-and possibly protect.

title: Episode: Revenant Act I: Eliksni Rescue
speaker: Tonic Table
text: Eido has left you a neatly written note: "Your Tonic Capsule stores all your tonic reagents in the field. And speaking of reagents, I've stocked the Capsule with a few reagents to help get you started. When you're ready, head on over to the testing machine and give it a try. Now you're ready to forge a whole new Slayer Baron legend!"

title: Episode: Revenant Act I: Eliksni Rescue
speaker: Tonic Table
text:
"Variks sees suspicion in the Slayer Baron."



"Can they trust Variks? Perhaps he still desires to be Kell of Kells, yes?"



"After all, many died to make it so."



"It is true that Variks wanted power. Not for himself, but for all Eliksni. To build a new home, filled with peace."



"But Variks lied. To himself and his people. He was misled by Darkness. And he lost the way of his House."



"And many terrors were born of his failure."



"Now Variks is humbled. He remembers he is not a Kell. He is a Scribe!"



"House Judgment is not the way of fighting or ruling. It is the way of keeping history. Promoting justice. Teaching hatchlings."

title: Kell's Fall
speaker: Tonic Table
text:
"Ah, the Vanguard's handler. I won't embarrass us with empty declarations of gratitude."



"Eido briefed me on Maya Sundaresh's Echo, and its ability to manipulate radiolaria. I believe Fikrul's Echo does something similar to Ether. Eliksni fables tell of alchemy that changed the polarity of Ether between Light and Dark. When the Ether inside of living Eliksni is affected, it turns them into Scorn."



"The reverse may be possible, but we won't know for certain until we claim the Echo for ourselves. I have looked into my people's eyes as their Ether was defiled. Watched their minds unravel as they rotted from within."



"This has never been about politics or power for Fikrul. He must be stopped."

title: Decrypt Engrams
speaker: Tyra Karn
text: A Cryptarch can decrypt complex engrams into powerful gear and other items.

title: Independent Study
speaker: Tyra Karn
text:
Tyra is pleased to have a visitor. She is not pleased that you're here to talk about a DIY "build-your-own-Thorn" project. "I won't lecture you," she says, "but I do hope that you know exactly what sort of misdirected selfishness and reprehensible cruelty this gun symbolizes. A Young Wolf of the Iron Lords would not carry this gun.



"That said. The provenance of the original Thorn has been vigorously debated. We have incomplete texts which speak of a so-called 'hated path.' One must 'bathe their Light in horrors,' one must 'feed the weapon with death,' one must maintain their Light while 'binding a sickness' to the weapon itself… Hive heresy, all of it. I advise you speak to Ikora about this if you have further questions."

title: Grave Robber
speaker: Tonic Table
text:
"I… obviously my father misspoke, Guardian," Eido shakes her head in apology.



"It frustrates him he cannot follow you into the field."



"Queen Mara would prefer that we keep any Awoken structures intact, and my father respects that. He's dealing with a lot right now, and I know he relies on your better judgment. I'm sure the queen will understand if we pick up a few items while we're inside, though. There must be all kinds of useful material in the Prison of Elders. Awoken tech too."



"Bring me whatever you can find, and maybe I can develop some new tonics."



"I know it's been picked over a few times, but it's a big prison… maybe too big."



"A lot of prisoners lived out their final days in that place. So much misery and bloodshed… I guess we shouldn't be surprised that Fikrul made his way back there."

title: Relics of the Golden Age
speaker: Tyra Karn
text: "It is not surprising that Rahool would find this data challenging. This weapon has a mate, Guardian. One that we may yet be able to find. Take your weapon. Make use of it, and return it to me with your data. It will be a place to start." -Tyra Karn

title: Relics of the Golden Age
speaker: Tyra Karn
text: "Just as I suspected. The crash of the Exodus Black carries this weapon's mate. Return to Nessus once more and seek it out in the wreckage of that massive vessel." -Tyra Karn

title: Relics of the Golden Age
speaker: Tyra Karn
text: "And so the pair are reunited. Sturm and Drang. For the first time in centuries. Thank you, Guardian, for allowing me to see history firsthand. Go with these relics of war. And may your place in their story be a worthy one." -Tyra Karn

title: Strike Up Peace
speaker: Tyra Karn
text: The storykeeper of the Iron Lords, Tyra Karn, has lived through more bad years than good ones. She knows the true value of peace and friendship.

title: The Red War
speaker: Tyra Karn
text:
Tyra escaped the City and found refuge in this camp as well. She, too, lost her connection to the Light and learned you had a vision of the Shard. Tyra cautions you against the danger of the surrounding Dark Forest and your newfound mortality. 



Take this gift from Tyra and go talk to the reluctant leader of this camp, Suraya Hawthorne.

title: Tyra Karn
speaker: Tyra Karn
text:
With her Light restored, Tyra has chosen to remain at the Farm-and wishes to congratulate you on your defeat of Ghaul.




        Tyra Karn chose to remain at the Farm to study the Traveler's Shard. With the Traveler reborn and humanity united in celebration, Tyra's curiosity lingers. Why did the Traveler choose to wake up now and not when the Red Legion first attacked the City? Is the Traveler's Light a beacon of hope… or a beacon for something else? 



Visit Tyra at the Farm to decrypt engrams or just say hello.

title: Tyra Karn
speaker: Tyra Karn
text:
Tyra has heard that you've recovered your connection to the Light, and wishes to speak with you at the Farm.




        Tyra is overjoyed by the return of your Light. She wishes you good luck in the battles to come.

title: Tyra Karn
speaker: Tyra Karn
text:
Tyra escaped the City and found refuge in this camp as well. She, too, lost her connection to the Light and learned you had a vision of the Shard. Tyra cautions you against the danger of the surrounding Dark Forest and your newfound mortality. 



Take this gift from Tyra and go talk to the reluctant leader of this camp, Suraya Hawthorne.

title: Decrypt Umbral Engrams
speaker: Umbral Decoder
text: Decode Umbral Engrams into weapons and armor. Drifter swears this device is perfectly safe to use.

title: Cryptarchy Rank-Up Reward
speaker: Umbral Decoder
text: Our knowledge grows from your continued support of our research. Take this as a thank you from the Cryptarchy.

title: The Red War
speaker: Tyra Karn
text:
Hi




        Tyra escaped the City and found refuge in this camp as well. She, too, lost her connection to the Light and learned you had a vision of the Shard. Tyra cautions you against the danger of the surrounding Dark Forest and your newfound mortality. 



Take this gift from Tyra and go talk to the reluctant leader of this camp, Suraya Hawthorne.

title: Decrypting the Darkness
speaker: Umbral Decoder
text:
The focus of these Umbral Engrams remains a source of fascination. The potential applications are endless.



I am still wary of interacting so closely with the Darkness, but we can no longer avoid it. Do you think the Dark Fleet is attempting to communicate through these lenses and engrams? There's still much to learn.



Return to the H.E.L.M. with any Prismatic Lenses or Umbral Engrams, and let's continue our research together!



-Tyra Karn

title: Decrypting the Darkness
speaker: Umbral Decoder
text:
Guardian, when the Dark Fleet arrived, it changed many things, including engrams. Some of them now behave much differently than before. The Cryptarchy needs your help in studying these changes.



Of all the unlikely sources, it was the Drifter who first created a device for altering Umbral Engrams. Now, the Cryptarchy is using his design as the basis for further research.



We will provide you with the equipment for further research on these Umbral Engrams. In return, please help us by recording the results of your experiments!



-Tyra Karn

title: Faction Reward
speaker: Umbral Decoder
text: Decrypt Umbral Engrams to gain reputation with the Cryptarchy and earn an engram reward.

title: Shape
speaker: Umbral Decoder
text: The branch gifted to you by the Pyramid has gorged on paracausal power and been bound to you through Eris's repurposing of Savathûn's twisted rituals. Contained within an engram structure, the branch is ready to be forged within the Umbral Decoder. As you grip it, a cold emptiness stings your fingers briefly before subsiding, barely noticed. It is time for this gift to find its final shape.

title: Decrypt Umbral Engrams
speaker: Umbral Decoder
text: Decode Umbral Engrams into weapons and armor.

title: Decrypting the Darkness
speaker: Umbral Decoder
text:
When the Black Fleet arrived, the Cryptarchy discovered that Umbral Engrams and Legendary Engrams are generated through similar processes. How or why the engrams change is still a mystery.



However, we now have a tool for controlling the contents of these Umbral Engrams! We call them Prismatic Lenses. The Drifter has yet to divulge how they're constructed, and truth told, it's possible he doesn't know either.



Here's the final Prismatic Lens remaining from our previous studies. It's quite fragile, and we estimate it has a single charge left before it breaks. Take it, along with this Umbral Engram, and try the focusing process for yourself!



-Tyra Karn

title: Forging Iron
speaker: Valus Saladin
text: "Watching young cubs become wolves… there are few responsibilities more thrilling." -Lord Saladin

title: Hold Up, Guardian!
speaker: Umbral Decoder
text:
As you approach the Umbral Decoder, Drifter's pre-recorded voice plays from its tinny speakers.



"Whoa, there! If you're hearin' this, you're touchin' my machines in the wrong order! There'll be plenty of time for decoding later, but now you gotta check out the Recaster!"



You look over at the Drifter, who can barely contain his joy. "Gotcha, Hero!" he manages to say before dissolving into peals of laughter.

title: Iron Banner
speaker: Valus Saladin
text: Compete in the Iron Banner. Earn armor and weapons at each rank and powerful upgrades at major ranks.

title: Testament of Strength
speaker: Valus Saladin
text:
Lord Saladin urges you to keep proving yourself to the Iron Banner. Not everyone can, but he recognizes your strength and ability. 



"Simply finishing isn't enough if you want to reap the best rewards, Guardian. Prove yourself."

title: Testament of Strength
speaker: Valus Saladin
text: Lord Saladin stands nobly with a piercing gaze. "The strongest Guardians will rise above the weak-willed to the Iron Banner. Are you up to the challenge?"

title: Wolf's Clothing
speaker: Valus Saladin
text:
Lord Saladin is pleased: You've demonstrated the spirit of the Iron Banner and taught your opponents the humility of defeat.



"New Guardians can learn something from watching you," he says. "Now I want you to show them what it means to dominate the arena."

title: Wolf's Clothing
speaker: Valus Saladin
text:
"You've shown your opponents what it means to truly wield the Light," Lord Saladin says when you return. "Now make them work harder."



Some new recruits seem too reliant on their favorite weapons. He wants you to show your fellow Guardians that it pays to be well-rounded.

title: Forging Iron
speaker: Valus Saladin
text:
Saladin's gaze could fell trees. The Iron Lord does not lift his eyes from you as you approach.



"Well met, Guardian. Every time I return to the City, I'm reminded of how far we've come. Nevertheless, we must stay vigilant. Our enemies grow stronger; so should we.



"My duty to the Cabal does not prevent me from carrying the Iron Banner forward. This test of skill is one that hones Guardians in ways that the conventional Crucible can't.



"More than that, the proceedings honor the Iron Lords who have come and gone before you. Will you make them proud?"

title: Wolf's Clothing
speaker: Valus Saladin
text:
Lord Saladin congratulates you on a job well done. You've shown your opponents the importance of being prepared for anything.



"They've seen what it takes to win," he says. "Now show them how to keep winning."

title: Wolf's Clothing
speaker: Valus Saladin
text:
Lord Saladin is impressed with your ability to take control of a fight. He hopes his new recruits are paying close attention, and he has another lesson for you to teach.



"Some new Guardians are shy about using their Light," he says. "Show them a better way."

title: Beyond Light
speaker: Variks the Loyal
text:
Variks tells you about Eramis, a new Kell of the Fallen, or the Eliksni, as they call themselves. Through communing with Pyramids, she has managed to harness the power of Darkness and use it as a weapon.



Variks escaped with proof of that Dark power, asking for help. If Eramis succeeds in giving this power to all of her Eliksni followers, nothing, not even the Guardians, will be able to defeat her.



Variks asks you to find Eramis immediately. Perhaps she can still be stopped.



Pursue Eramis, Kell of Darkness. Complete "The New Kell" mission.

title: Beyond Light
speaker: Variks the Loyal
text:
Variks is alarmed to hear about Eramis's lieutenants using Stasis. The situation is more dire than he realized.



He wants to remain on Europa in order to help other Eliksni who wish to flee Eramis, and asks you to help set up a comms network using a nearby array. That way, he can communicate with his allies and prepare for evacuation.



Help Variks set up the patrols network in Charon's Crossing.

title: Wolf's Clothing
speaker: Valus Saladin
text:
Lord Saladin thanks you for your hard work. You've set a strong example for Guardians who wish to follow in the footsteps of the Iron Lords.



He asks that you carry these lessons forward, even after the Iron Banner has ended.

title: Beyond Light
speaker: Variks the Loyal
text:
Variks is surprised and impressed that you managed to defeat Phylaks. He now believes you may be capable of wielding Stasis without being corrupted.



He tells you that your next target is Praksis, the Eliksni who created the technology that allows House Salvation to wield Darkness. Defeat him and Eramis's plans will come to a halt. Variks believes he's been experimenting on the Vex, and if you disrupt his experiments, you might get his attention.



Investigate Praksis, the Technocrat's plans in Asterion Abyss.

title: Collectible Detector I
speaker: Variks the Loyal
text:
Variks accepts the requisitioned Vex technology you've collected. He uses it to make you a special device for locating valuable items on Europa.



You now have access to a short-range Europa Collectible Detector.

title: Beyond Light
speaker: Variks the Loyal
text:
Variks disapproves of your new Stasis abilities. He thinks you're being reckless. He warns you to remember what the Darkness has done and what it is doing to Eramis. He refuses to believe that this is the only way to stop her.



But he acknowledges that you are free to walk your own path, even if it's a dangerous one. He urges you not to lose sight of your goal. To get to Eramis, you must begin by defeating the leader of her army: Phylaks. Thanks to his secret communication network, Variks learned that Phylaks was ordered to take control of an area currently occupied by the Vex.



Gather information about the whereabouts of Phylaks, the Warrior by challenging her soldiers in Eventide Ruins.

title: Beyond Light
speaker: Variks the Loyal
text:
Variks looks somber. When he witnessed Eramis releasing the Vex, he realized that she has truly lost sight of what she was fighting for. Now she has endangered everything the Eliksni have built on Europa.



As the Vex make their way across Europa and towards Riis-Reborn, Variks is planning to help some of his allies evacuate the city. They are carrying an important asset that he claims will be invaluable to House Light on Earth. He asks for your help defending them, and then the way will be clear for you to confront Eramis.



Help Variks evacuate the allied Fallen in Eventide Ruins.

title: Dawning Delivery
speaker: Variks the Loyal
text: Variks takes the offered gift carefully in one of his lower hands. "It is good to be your friend," he says gratefully.

title: Collectible Detector II
speaker: Variks the Loyal
text:
Variks uses the data collected to make some adjustments to your detector and wishes you luck in your explorations of Europa.



Your Europa Collectible Detector now has an increased range.

title: Collectible Detector III
speaker: Variks the Loyal
text:
To thank you for your help, Variks adjusts your detector for a final time and wishes you luck on your Europan travels.



Your Europa Collectible Detector now has maximum range capabilities.

title: Empire Hunt I
speaker: Variks the Loyal
text:
Variks is grateful for your work on Europa. He hopes you will continue to help him, as new threats arise every day.



Empire Hunt quests now cost fewer Herealways Pieces.

title: Empire Hunt II
speaker: Variks the Loyal
text:
Variks is grateful for your work on Europa. He hopes you will continue to help him, as new threats arise every day.



Your first Empire Hunt quest of each week now costs no Herealways Pieces to acquire.

title: Empire's Fall
speaker: Variks the Loyal
text:
"Kridis seeks to claim power," Variks says. "She has always had ambition to prove herself Kell-worthy."



He leans closer to you. "Variks hears whispers that her followers are collecting remnants of the Dark. To stop her, we must understand why."

title: Droning On and On
speaker: Variks the Loyal
text: "You found and dealt with all of House Salvation's intrusive drones, yes? Another strike to what remains of Eramis's empire. Variks is most pleased. And now, I extend that pleasure to you, in the form of this token of power. May it serve you well, savior."

title: Empire's Fall
speaker: Variks the Loyal
text:
"Your commander has asked me to lead you once more through Riis-Reborn," Variks says. "Another attack on the city, to see how the Vex have fared. Eliksni of House Salvation will not expect us. They are distracted by their fight."



He shakes his head. "Their loss, your gain."



Help the Vanguard investigate the Vex presence in the Fallen city by completing the mission "The Aftermath."

title: Empire Hunt III
speaker: Variks the Loyal
text:
Variks is grateful for your work on Europa. He hopes you will continue to help him, as new threats arise every day.



Your first two Empire Hunt quests of each week now cost no Herealways Pieces to acquire.

title: Empire's Fall
speaker: Variks the Loyal
text:
"As you saw when you attacked the factory, Vex swarm Riis-Reborn," Variks says bitterly. "They are pests. But your commander is right. Such pests will make House Salvation weak."



"Variks will help you and your Vanguard once more. House Salvation must be destroyed, yes?"



Variks offers to guide you through several low-level sabotage operations, so that you might take advantage of House Salvation's disorganized state.



Complete two Sabotage quests acquired from Variks.

title: Europa Arms
speaker: Variks the Loyal
text: "This armor was built long ago for the harsh conditions of Europa. Take it. Use it wisely."

title: Europa Challenge
speaker: Variks the Loyal
text:
Variks is grateful for your help. Thanks to you, House Salvation's presence on Europa grows weaker every day, and the Eliksni move one step closer to peace. With the Guardians defending Europa, Variks believes more and more Eliksni will be swayed to join House Light on Earth.



"Perhaps the new life we were promised can still be built," he says. "Thank you, friend."

You now have access to a weekly challenge from Variks.

title: Europa Rewards I
speaker: Variks the Loyal
text:
Variks examines the materials you've brought him. "Remnants of your Golden Age," he muses. "Samples found and preserved. Or, perhaps, Clovis Bray wished to bring more Earth-life to Europa. I cannot say for certain." 



Either way, he believes this may be a valuable resource and would like to help you find more.



You can now find more planetary materials in the Europa Eclipsed Zone.
