text:
Variks disapproves of your new Stasis abilities. He thinks you're being reckless. He warns you to remember what the Darkness has done and what it is doing to Eramis. He refuses to believe that this is the only way to stop her.



But he acknowledges that you are free to walk your own path, even if it's a dangerous one. He urges you not to lose sight of your goal. To get to Eramis, you must begin by defeating the leader of her army: Phylaks. Thanks to his secret communication network, Variks learned that Phylaks was ordered to take control of an area currently occupied by the Vex.



Gather information about the whereabouts of Phylaks, the Warrior by challenging her soldiers in Eventide Ruins.

title: Legacy: Beyond Light
speaker: Variks the Loyal
text:
Variks looks somber. When he witnessed Eramis releasing the Vex, he realized that she has truly lost sight of what she was fighting for. Now she has endangered everything the Eliksni have built on Europa.



As the Vex make their way across Europa and towards Riis-Reborn, Variks is planning to help some of his allies evacuate the city. They are carrying an important asset that he claims will be invaluable to House Light on Earth. He asks for your help defending them, and then the way will be clear for you to confront Eramis.



Help Variks evacuate the allied Fallen in Eventide Ruins.

title: Legacy: Beyond Light
speaker: Variks the Loyal
text:
Variks tells you about Eramis, a new Kell of the Fallen, or the Eliksni, as they call themselves. Through communing with Pyramids, she has managed to harness the power of Darkness and use it as a weapon.



Variks escaped with proof of that Dark power, asking for help. If Eramis succeeds in giving this power to all of her Eliksni followers, nothing, not even the Guardians, will be able to defeat her.



Variks asks you to find Eramis immediately. Perhaps she can still be stopped.



Pursue Eramis, Kell of Darkness. Complete "The New Kell" mission.

title: Old Secrets, New Challenges
speaker: Variks the Loyal
text:
"Exo training protocols, huh?



"It seems we were right to investigate. Engage with them whenever you'd like, but keep their existence safe from House Salvation.



"We must not give them even a single ledge from which to pull themselves up."

title: Legacy: Beyond Light
speaker: Variks the Loyal
text:
Variks is surprised and impressed that you managed to defeat Phylaks. He now believes you may be capable of wielding Stasis without being corrupted.



He tells you that your next target is Praksis, the Eliksni who created the technology that allows House Salvation to wield Darkness. Defeat him and Eramis's plans will come to a halt. Variks believes he's been experimenting on the Vex, and if you disrupt his experiments, you might get his attention.



Investigate Praksis, the Technocrat's plans in Asterion Abyss.

title: Reclaiming Europa
speaker: Variks the Loyal
text: You can now obtain Herealways Pieces by completing patrols, Lost Sectors, and public events on Europa. Herealways Pieces can be used to purchase various quests from Variks.

title: Reclaiming Europa
speaker: Variks the Loyal
text:
Variks is somber when you approach. Eramis's single-minded quest for revenge made her unfit to lead the Eliksni, but Variks mourns her all the same.



But there is little time to mourn. Variks knows new Eliksni challengers will rise on Europa. He agrees to help you and the Vanguard take down what remains of House Salvation.



Complete the "Sabotaging Salvation" mission.

title: Old Secrets, New Challenges
speaker: Variks the Loyal
text:
"Old secrets emerge in the wake of your kind invading the Deep Stone Crypt. Something siphons power where it didn't before, in Bray Exoscience."



"Investigate, yes?"

title: The Dark Priestess
speaker: Variks the Loyal
text:
"Kridis wishes to triumph where Eramis failed," Variks says gravely. "She has plans within Riis-Reborn. To revive House Salvation."



He watches you steadily. "My spies say she gathers Darkness around her. Hoards it. Planning something." He shakes his head. "Variks knows not. You must uncover her plans. We cannot fail now. Too much has been lost."



Learn more about the plans of Kridis, the Dark Priestess by seeking out her followers in Cadmus Ridge.

title: The Technocrat
speaker: Variks the Loyal
text:
Variks thanks you for defeating Praksis. With her military commander and chief science officer eliminated, Eramis's empire is wounded. But it is not yet dead.



He warns you that the fight ahead will not be easy. Before you defeat Eramis, he asks for your help smuggling more allied Eliksni from the city.

title: The Warrior
speaker: Variks the Loyal
text:
Variks is impressed that you managed to defeat Phylaks. He had his doubts about you using Stasis, but he admits that it may be a necessity in these dire times.



He warns you that Praksis will have an even greater command of Stasis than Phylaks did. You will need to prepare for the next fight.

title: The Dark Priestess
speaker: Variks the Loyal
text: Variks is relieved that you were able to disrupt Kridis's efforts, but he warns you that new leaders will rise in her place. From now on, he can offer you guidance on how to continue defending Europa from ambitious enemy Eliksni.

title: The Warrior
speaker: Variks the Loyal
text: Variks is impressed that you managed to defeat Phylaks. He has high hopes for your continued dismantling of House Salvation.

title: Ascendant Lens
speaker: Vault
text:
Queen Mara's eyebrows lift as you hand her the Ascendant Lens. "This is an exceedingly rare trinket," she says, peering at you through the lens.



"It may not look like much to a common Guardian, but in the hands of our Techeuns, it will be a valuable research tool. You were right to bring it to me."



"Allow me to repay your generosity," she says, handing you a handsome reward.



You start to thank her, but she's already walking away. You've been dismissed.

title: Dawning Delivery
speaker: Visage of Calus
text: As you place your gift at the golden statue's feet, it swivels its head to look at you and opens its mouth. The Emperor laughs, deep and delighted.

title: The Technocrat
speaker: Variks the Loyal
text: Variks is thrilled you defeated Praksis. House Salvation continues to topple thanks to you.

title: Invitation from the Emperor
speaker: Visage of Calus
text:
Calus has a deep and abiding admiration for your tenacity and endurance. As a small token of his affection, he has built this Tribute Hall for you to fill with trophies.



Of course, you'll have to earn those trophies…

title: Opulence
speaker: Visage of Calus
text:
Exchange a Boon for an increased discount on all tributes.




        The Visage of Calus

title: Invitation from the Emperor
speaker: Visage of Calus
text:
Via remote mechanism, Calus presents you with your first tribute.



"Take this," he says. "Find a suitable place of honor for it, little Guardian. And then let me see you fill this whole hall until it overflows with the evidence of your golden strength."

title: Shadow of Earth
speaker: Visage of Calus
text:
Your many successes in Calus's Menagerie have more than demonstrated that you are worthy of a new title: Shadow of Earth.



Tread carefully. All of Calus's other Shadows succumbed to inglorious ends.

title: Pest Control
speaker: Visage of Calus
text:
Speaking through his robotic double, Calus tells you that Gahlran's so-called Crown of Sorrow had a very peculiar effect on the Leviathan-it briefly split the seams of reality, allowing access to an altered plane of reality that Calus believes you're quite familiar with.



Calus's men ventured in and found the frame of a cursed gun. Since then, the gun's incorporeal essence has tormented the Leviathan's upper decks and eluded Calus's grasp.



Perhaps you'll have better luck than the Cabal.

title: Bring the Lake Down
speaker: War Table
text:
A message flashes on the War Table screen as though it was anticipating your arrival…



INCOMING TRANSMISSION





B.R.A.K.I.O.N.

<\message>

<\transmission>



The message disappears, but one word remains burned into the viewscreen, as though etched with digital fury: BRAKION.



It is time to deliver the final blow to Brakion and remove its influence over the AVALON node.

title: Bring the Lake Down
speaker: War Table
text:
The War Table behaves completely normally as you approach.



No message awaits you, and you hear only the steady hum of the H.E.L.M. systems. The signal is truly gone.



Though the silence is total, you feel as though you were finally able to give the signal what it wanted.

title: Challenger's Proving
speaker: War Table
text:
The War Table holds a message from Lord Saladin.



"Your efforts on Europa and Nessus were commendable, but there are dozens more opportunistic Cabal looking for a promotion. Sharpen your teeth on her commanders, Guardian. If Zavala won't press Caiatl's fleet directly, we'll have to settle for a death by a thousand cuts."

title: Challenger's Proving
speaker: War Table
text:
Defeating Commander Dracus has halted the Cabal push on Nessus, but Nessus is not the Vanguard's only concern. Cabal all over the Sol system have started vying for Caiatl's attention, hoping to earn a seat on her War Council. This cannot be allowed.



Osiris has devised a strategy for rebuffing the Imperial Cabal incursion without total open war. Caiatl is using an ancient Cabal tradition known as the Rite of Proving to select her War Council from Red Legion commanders to bring them back into the fold. Any challenger may approach these rites. Vanguard High Command directs Guardians to engage any and all prospective War Council appointees. With each disrupted rite, we send fractures through their empire's authority.

title: Challenger's Proving
speaker: War Table
text:
Another notification from Osiris is present on the War Table:



It's working, Guardian. Each challenge you issue sends another fracture through the Cabal's confidence in Caiatl's leadership. Unruly systems have broken Cabal leaders before. Keep pushing, and do remember to take the spoils of your triumphs. By Cabal law, those offerings belong to you now… maybe we can make something from them with that hammer you're wielding.

-Osiris

title: Challenger's Proving
speaker: War Table
text: Europa holds a treasure trove of technological and paracausal assets. Right now, a Cabal Commander named Basilius is skulking through the ice looking for anything he can find to present to the empress. Saladin wants you find him and disrupt his search by challenging him to combat. Either he fights you and dies, or he runs and dishonor does the rest.

title: Challenger's Proving
speaker: War Table
text:
As you approach the table, you notice the ceremonial hammer retrieved from your last mission. A warm, golden light radiates out from the mouth and eyes of the Cabal face sculpted into one head of the hammer, as though a fire burns inside.



"It was an offering," Osiris says from behind you. "From the Red Legion to Caiatl. The Cryptarchs can provide more nuance about its history, but what matters is its purpose: a symbol of Cabal culture, power, entitlement. One you now wield."



Osiris spreads his hands and says, "Master the hammer, and forge yourself a path to victory."

title: Challenger's Proving II
speaker: War Table
text:
The War Table holds a message from Lord Saladin.



The Iron Lord notes that Caiatl's initial push into the system has been halted by Vanguard counter-maneuvers and imbedded intel operatives. He is quick to point out that this hasn't stopped the line of Red Legion commanders flying Caiatl's banners and making offerings to secure seats on her War Council.



He reminds you that Zavala has chosen a battle of perseverance over one of might to avoid total war. Saladin offers some advice, "Keep hitting them, over and over again, until they stop standing back up."

title: Challenger's Proving II
speaker: War Table
text: A hopeful Cabal commander named Val Ma'rag has begun an offensive push against Hive forces in the Cosmodrome as a symbolic offering to Caiatl. A symbolic victory can embolden her authority, and conquered Hive territory can provide ground for a new Firebase in Old Russia. They cannot be allowed to succeed. You are to challenge Val Ma'rag, and break his assault.

title: Challenger's Proving III
speaker: War Table
text: Vanguard scouts report a detachment of Psions led by one: Ixel, the Far-Reaching has moved deep into Vex territory on Nessus. Lord Saladin explains that Osiris is the expert here, but he has spoken enough about Vex temporal capabilities for Saladin to know that this cannot end well. The Iron Lord wants you to find out what the enemy is up to.

title: Challenger's Proving III
speaker: War Table
text:
The War Table holds a message from Lord Saladin.



"Vex prediction engines? And right under my nose. Osiris is playing with fire now. If those Psions were able to extract anything of use, they won't wait long to hit us with it. Eyes up, Young Wolf… for whatever they're planning."

title: Challenger's Proving IV
speaker: War Table
text: Lord Saladin is outraged that the Cabal would sink so low, but he is not surprised. He commends your fieldwork, and says you should keep pressure on the Cabal. They cannot be allowed such a brazen act without consequences.

title: Challenger's Proving IV
speaker: War Table
text: Lord Saladin urges you to keep pressuring the Cabal. With each defeat, Caiatl loses the respect of her soldiers and control over her subjects. While you're deployed to the Battlegrounds, Saladin has directed Crow to continue looking into the futures Ixel, the Far-Reaching, saw on Nessus.

title: Challenger's Proving V
speaker: War Table
text:
You can almost feel the heat of Lord Saladin's rage in his written word. He states Caiatl and her Cabal have shown their true colors, that of cowards and cutthroats. He wants retribution for their attack and demands all active Guardians redouble their patrols through Cabal territories.



His message urges Guardians to not hold back, to not show mercy, that the Cabal invited death on themselves.



He reminds you that they speak of honor and show none. Break them.

title: Challenger's Proving VI
speaker: War Table
text:
The War Table holds a message from Lord Saladin.



"I don't trust these half measures, but regardless of my own opinion I have a duty to see it through. As do you. If Caiatl accepts our terms, we will crush her champion, whoever it may be. Now we wait and see how this new empress acts in the face of imminent defeat."

title: Lavish Fashions
speaker: Tess Everis
text: Tess welcomes you to her stall, handing you a gift that will help you usher in the new season in style.

title: Challenger's Proving VI
speaker: War Table
text: Saladin warns of escalating Cabal brutality across the system. As Caiatl's council chambers remain empty, prospective commanders lash out in desperation. Their supply lines are straining, and confidence in the empire is waning. Saladin has seen what desperation can drive a foe to do and believes now is the opportune time to deliver a finishing blow.

title: Opulence Comes to Eververse
speaker: Tess Everis
text:
Tess welcomes you warmly, as always, then leans a little closer to you. "If you wouldn't mind me asking a favor…"



She presents you with a bounty note. "Hard to get away from the shop, I'm afraid. If it's too much trouble, don't worry about it."

title: Engram Tracker
speaker: War Table
text:
A recorded message from Master Rahool plays when you pick up the engram tracker: 



"Guardian! This is a new device of my own manufacture. It will allow you to monitor the number of engrams available at each of the vendors in the Tower."



"If you ever lose it, you can pick up a new one from any of those vendors. I look forward to seeing you deploy this device."

title: Faction Reward
speaker: War Table
text: You've gone head-to-head with Caiatl's Commanders, but the strongest are still to come. May this aid you in the coming challenges.

title: Challenger's Proving VII
speaker: War Table
text: Saladin bristles at the thought of gambling on some ceremonial bout instead of taking the fight to Caiatl's doorstep in one final assault. While he will defer to Commander Zavala and Osiris's plan, he has made it clear where he stands on the issue. Lord Saladin wants you to make it impossible for Caiatl to turn down Osiris's offer by pressuring her forces into submission across all of Sol's battlegrounds.

title: Evicting the Cabal
speaker: War Table
text: "We would rather lose with honor than win dishonestly." -Empress Caiatl

title: For the Light… Against the Light
speaker: War Table
text: The War Table dispenses a reward as recognition for the Champions you've defeated.

title: Kill the Messenger
speaker: War Table
text:
A Psionic propaganda message is emanating from a decommissioned Cabal installation on Mars. It exhorts Empress Caiatl's legions to mutiny.



Shut down the Psionic signal, and find out who's attempting to destabilize the Cabal/Vanguard coalition.

title: Increase Rank
speaker: War Table
text: Increase your rank with the War Table by completing certain Seasonal Challenges in Season of the Chosen.

title: Legacy: A Challenger Rises
speaker: War Table
text:
The War Table has a notification from Osiris:



Impressive work, Guardian. You'll get a full briefing soon, but in the meantime, let me fill you in on that Cabal artifact you picked up on Nessus. It's known as the Bell of Conquests.  



I've attached a reading with more details, but in short: by claiming that bell, you've officially declared yourself challenger to the Cabal Empire. Caiatl's commanders won't stop coming for you until they see you buried and the bell retrieved. 



You made a bold move, but I believe we can use it to our advantage. We'll talk more soon.

-Osiris

title: Legacy: Awaken, Queensguard
speaker: War Table
text:
The Vanguard War Table displays holographic images of the Shadow Legion Pyramid outposts.  



You notice evidence of extensive upgrades, as though the H.E.L.M. internals now house various high-tech systems-due in part, you surmise, to the Awoken Corsairs and House Light Eliksni who are working nearby. 



A weapon awaits you, and as you move to take it, you notice the War Table seems to await pairing with an Ascendant Scepter…

title: Legacy: Awaken, Queensguard
speaker: War Table
text: Work with Mara Sov and the forces of the Last City to rescue prisoners and push back against the Shadow Legion's invasion of Earth.

title: Kill the Messenger
speaker: War Table
text:
A Psionic propaganda message is emanating from a decommissioned Cabal installation on Mars. It exhorts Empress Caiatl's legions to mutiny.



Shut down the Psionic signal, and find out who's attempting to destabilize the Cabal/Vanguard coalition.

title: Legacy: Challenger's Proving
speaker: War Table
text:
Defeating Commander Dracus has halted the Cabal push on Nessus, but Nessus is not the Vanguard's only concern. Cabal all over the Sol system have started vying for Caiatl's attention, hoping to earn a seat on her War Council. This cannot be allowed.



Osiris has devised a strategy for rebuffing the Imperial Cabal incursion without total open war. Caiatl is using an ancient Cabal tradition known as the Rite of Proving to select her War Council from Red Legion commanders to bring them back into the fold. Any challenger may approach these rites. Vanguard High Command directs Guardians to engage any and all prospective War Council appointees. With each disrupted rite, we send fractures through their empire's authority.

title: Legacy: Challenger's Proving
speaker: War Table
text:
As you approach the table, you notice the ceremonial hammer retrieved from your last mission. A warm, golden light radiates out from the mouth and eyes of the Cabal face sculpted into one head of the hammer, as though a fire burns inside.



"It was an offering," Osiris says from behind you. "From the Red Legion to Caiatl. The Cryptarchs can provide more nuance about its history, but what matters is its purpose: a symbol of Cabal culture, power, entitlement. One you now wield."



Osiris spreads his hands and says, "Master the hammer, and forge yourself a path to victory."

title: Legacy: Challenger's Proving II
speaker: War Table
text: A hopeful Cabal commander named Val Ma'rag has begun an offensive push against Hive forces in the Cosmodrome as a symbolic offering to Caiatl. A symbolic victory can embolden her authority, and conquered Hive territory can provide ground for a new Firebase in Old Russia. They cannot be allowed to succeed. You are to challenge Val Ma'rag, and break his assault.

title: Legacy: Challenger's Proving
speaker: War Table
text: Europa holds a treasure trove of technological and paracausal assets. Right now, a Cabal Commander named Basilius is skulking through the ice looking for anything he can find to present to the empress. Saladin wants you find him and disrupt his search by challenging him to combat. Either he fights you and dies, or he runs and dishonor does the rest.

title: Legacy: Challenger's Proving
speaker: War Table
text:
The War Table holds a message from Lord Saladin.



"Your efforts on Europa and Nessus were commendable, but there are dozens more opportunistic Cabal looking for a promotion. Sharpen your teeth on her commanders, Guardian. If Zavala won't press Caiatl's fleet directly, we'll have to settle for a death by a thousand cuts."

title: Legacy: Challenger's Proving
speaker: War Table
text:
Another notification from Osiris is present on the War Table:



It's working, Guardian. Each challenge you issue sends another fracture through the Cabal's confidence in Caiatl's leadership. Unruly systems have broken Cabal leaders before. Keep pushing, and do remember to take the spoils of your triumphs. By Cabal law, those offerings belong to you now… maybe we can make something from them with that hammer you're wielding.

-Osiris

title: Legacy: Challenger's Proving III
speaker: War Table
text: Vanguard scouts report a detachment of Psions led by one: Ixel, the Far-Reaching has moved deep into Vex territory on Nessus. Lord Saladin explains that Osiris is the expert here, but he has spoken enough about Vex temporal capabilities for Saladin to know that this cannot end well. The Iron Lord wants you to find out what the enemy is up to.

title: Legacy: Challenger's Proving III
speaker: War Table
text:
The War Table holds a message from Lord Saladin.



"Vex prediction engines? And right under my nose. Osiris is playing with fire now. If those Psions were able to extract anything of use, they won't wait long to hit us with it. Eyes up, Young Wolf… for whatever they're planning."

title: Legacy: Challenger's Proving II
speaker: War Table
text:
The War Table holds a message from Lord Saladin.



The Iron Lord notes that Caiatl's initial push into the system has been halted by Vanguard counter-maneuvers and imbedded intel operatives. He is quick to point out that this hasn't stopped the line of Red Legion commanders flying Caiatl's banners and making offerings to secure seats on her War Council.



He reminds you that Zavala has chosen a battle of perseverance over one of might to avoid total war. Saladin offers some advice, "Keep hitting them, over and over again, until they stop standing back up."

title: Legacy: Challenger's Proving V
speaker: War Table
text:
You can almost feel the heat of Lord Saladin's rage in his written word. He states Caiatl and her Cabal have shown their true colors, that of cowards and cutthroats. He wants retribution for their attack and demands all active Guardians redouble their patrols through Cabal territories.



His message urges Guardians to not hold back, to not show mercy, that the Cabal invited death on themselves.



He reminds you that they speak of honor and show none. Break them.

title: Legacy: Challenger's Proving VI
speaker: War Table
text:
The War Table holds a message from Lord Saladin.



"I don't trust these half measures, but regardless of my own opinion I have a duty to see it through. As do you. If Caiatl accepts our terms, we will crush her champion, whoever it may be. Now we wait and see how this new empress acts in the face of imminent defeat."

title: Legacy: Challenger's Proving IV
speaker: War Table
text: Lord Saladin urges you to keep pressuring the Cabal. With each defeat, Caiatl loses the respect of her soldiers and control over her subjects. While you're deployed to the Battlegrounds, Saladin has directed Crow to continue looking into the futures Ixel, the Far-Reaching, saw on Nessus.

title: Legacy: Challenger's Proving VII
speaker: War Table
text: Saladin bristles at the thought of gambling on some ceremonial bout instead of taking the fight to Caiatl's doorstep in one final assault. While he will defer to Commander Zavala and Osiris's plan, he has made it clear where he stands on the issue. Lord Saladin wants you to make it impossible for Caiatl to turn down Osiris's offer by pressuring her forces into submission across all of Sol's battlegrounds.

title: Legacy: Echoes Act I: A Familiar Voice
speaker: War Table
text:
A handwritten note from Zavala lies on the War Table, addressed to you:



Guardian, there are no greater words to call one to action than a threat. There is a blade at our throats, and the thing that holds it believes we are already beaten.



We've been underestimated before. We will be underestimated again.



Their desperation will never outshine our hope. Our resolve.



Stand with me-all Guardians-and together let us show one more god the error of their ways.



I'll look for you on the other side.



The Vanguard is with you. Eyes up, Guardian.



-Vanguard Commander, Zavala



Episode: Echoes will begin the week after the conclusion of The Final Shape. During this time you can process your Echo Engrams at the War Table.

title: Legacy: Challenger's Proving IV
speaker: War Table
text: Lord Saladin is outraged that the Cabal would sink so low, but he is not surprised. He commends your fieldwork, and says you should keep pressure on the Cabal. They cannot be allowed such a brazen act without consequences.

title: Legacy: We Stand Unbroken
speaker: War Table
text:
Amanda hails you brightly from the holoprojector. "Been meaning to thank you for busting us all out of prison earlier. I heard you came back from Neptune just to help us out."



"Near enough to make a girl tear up!" she jokes.



She mentions that some of the rescued civilians have already been asking when they can get back out there and look for other survivors. Seeing their determination filled her with equal parts concern and hope. 



"I asked Mithrax to talk some sense into 'em, but he shrugged, like, three of his arms and said, 'The Witness created heroes instead of victims.'"



"I couldn't have said it better myself," she smiles.



The Shadow Legion has been sighted in the Cosmodrome, apparently gathering more prisoners. Amanda will meet you there.

title: Legacy: Challenger's Proving VI
speaker: War Table
text: Saladin warns of escalating Cabal brutality across the system. As Caiatl's council chambers remain empty, prospective commanders lash out in desperation. Their supply lines are straining, and confidence in the empire is waning. Saladin has seen what desperation can drive a foe to do and believes now is the opportune time to deliver a finishing blow.

title: Legacy: We Stand Unbroken
speaker: War Table
text:
Mara greets you via the holoprojector. 



"I sensed your triumph through the choke of the Pyramid's suppression," she says. "With the Scepter in hand, you were able to move through the depths of the Ascendant Plane. It is as I hoped. Your Light sings with the incantations I send forth, strengthening you in ways not seen since the seven Paladins…"



She hesitates. "…Since the Queensguard."



Mara explains why she is sending her power to the Guardians. "Powerful as I am, I cannot be everywhere at once. But the Guardians can. So, I entrust you with my favor."



"Claim this power freely, as your strength serves my kingdom and your own. Let it flow through you, Queensguard, and I shall knight you myself."

title: Legacy: We Stand Unbroken
speaker: War Table
text:
"Rally up, Guardian," Amanda says. "I won't say we've got the Shadow Legion on the ropes just yet, but we're making progress."



She asks how you like being a Queensguard. "Only thing that's changed for me is that Crow bowed and asked if he should call me 'Lady Amanda of Holliday,'" she says.



The holoprojector feed is blurry, but you believe you see her roll her eyes.



"Anyway, I like how things have been shaking out lately," she continues. "Tearing through magic planes to bust into a Shadow Legion ship uninvited? That's the kind of entrance Cayde would've liked."



"Let's get back out there."

title: Legacy: We Stand Unbroken
speaker: War Table
text: Work with Mara Sov and the forces of the Last City to rescue prisoners and push back against the Shadow Legion's invasion of Earth.

title: Operation Elbrus
speaker: War Table
text:
The Psion has given Lord Saladin the knowledge claimed from the mind of the Hive that you brought to the Psisorium.



The Lucent Hive appear to be hunting Guardians, draining them of their Light, and collecting it-storing it for later use. The Psion doesn't know why.



"Savathûn knows how to keep a secret," Saladin says, "and so do her Hive."



Saladin asks you to find another Hive Lieutenant and defeat it in the Mindscape. He hopes it will have the knowledge locked away in its mind that the Vanguard seeks.



"I need you to hunt more of them," he says. "Cut them off from their Light and make them wither in the face of ours."



"They hate us… they want to usurp us. Become us. I will never let that happen."

title: Legacy: We Stand Unbroken
speaker: War Table
text:
Though it could just be the holoprojector, Devrim's voice seems tired and heavy.



"I woke up this morning and looked out across the gray mists of Trostland, and I've got to tell you, my heart just wasn't in it," he confesses. Amanda's death had sapped his vigor.



"But then, out in the distance, I spotted a deployment of Shadow Legion moving through the fog, pushing a group of prisoners before them." The sight was enough to stir him into action.



"We've got to fight on," he explains. "Not just because we're in the Vanguard, or Queensguard, or because we're heroes, or all that rot."



"Because it's what Amanda would have done," he says. "That's good enough for me."

title: Operation Elbrus
speaker: War Table
text:
Commander Zavala speaks of Lord Saladin with great respect.



"I'm grateful Saladin stepped in when he did," he says. "He preserved the Cabal alliance without bloodshed."



"All these centuries later and Saladin is still saving me from myself."



Empress Caiatl is true to her word: Crow's life debt is paid. "Our coalition is back on solid ground," Zavala says. Caiatl will continue to secure the defeated Lucent Hive commanders for solar incineration-her Cabal have seen Lightbearers revive too many times to take chances-but the Psisorium will not be repaired.



"Humanity finally has a voice on Caiatl's War Council," Zavala says. "We must respect Saladin's choice."

title: Operation Elbrus
speaker: War Table
text:
Lord Saladin congratulates you for another battle won.



While you were fighting against the Hive, Saladin spoke with the Psion running the Psisorium.



He tells you he allowed the Psion to host him in its Mindscape, where they communicated telepathically. He was surprised to learn the Psion shares the same distaste for searching the minds of the Hive that he does, and also that it has an old friendship with Empress Caiatl.



Saladin seems a bit surprised by how relatable he found the Psion to be. He suggests that Crow might benefit from such a communion-perhaps it would help him work through some of his inner demons.



Saladin will contact you when the Psion has gleaned fresh intel from the Hive.

title: Operation Elbrus
speaker: War Table
text:
Lord Saladin greets you with grim news: the Lucent Hive are mobilizing.



Intel pulled from the mind of the Hive has revealed a hazy vision of a stockpile of Light in the Cosmodrome, stolen from dead Guardians. Saladin will not allow such blasphemy to go unpunished.



"I need you down there," he says. "Find the Hive responsible, crush its spirit, tear it from the Light, and drag it back here."



"Then we will lay its evil secrets bare."

title: Operation Elbrus
speaker: War Table
text:
As he discusses Crow, Lord Saladin's frustration is evident even through the hologram.



He explains he shared the story of the thief with Crow to give him perspective, to show how well-intentioned mercy can ultimately lead to terrible loss. 



With a sigh, he confides that Commander Zavala expressed similar concerns about the morality of psychically analyzing the Hive, even though the process is painless. And he admits he would rather defeat the Hive on the battlefield than in a lab.



Still, he says, Crow must not lose sight of the fact that the Lucent Hive are murdering Guardians.



"These demons have taken the Light," he says. "Nothing is more important than stopping them."



"I know it, you know it, and Crow… let's hope he's a fast learner."

title: Operation Elbrus
speaker: War Table
text: The War Table chimes with an incoming transmission...

title: Operation Elbrus
speaker: War Table
text:
Lord Saladin is impressed with your performance in the Mindscape.



The Psion in the H.E.L.M. is now combing through the minds of the defeated Hive, searching for clues that could reveal their next attack.



"Each Hive holds a piece of the puzzle," Saladin explains. "If we discover their plans, we can bring their entire operation down upon them."



"We'll find what secrets they're hiding. And when they gather for their next ritual, you'll be there… with the full strength of the Light behind you."

title: Operation Elbrus
speaker: War Table
text:
Lord Saladin urgently relays the intel taken from the minds of the Hive: the Lucent Hive are going to use the Light stolen from the dead Guardians to manifest Savathûn's throne world on the Moon.



If they succeed, they will launch a full-scale invasion of Earth.



"This was their plan from the beginning," Saladin snarls. "Take our home. Corrupt our planet, overrun us, remove us from the universe."



"And when we are gone, forgotten… they will become the Guardians."



You must go to the Scarlet Keep and disrupt the summoning ritual. Caiatl is already en route with her forces-her chosen warriors will fight alongside you to defeat the Lucent Hive.



"Let that be the last thing these Hive see: unity in the face of oblivion," Saladin says.



"Show them that even if they destroy us, they will never destroy who we are."

title: Rising Tensions
speaker: War Table
text:
Empress Caiatl greets you through the hologram. Though the alliance between her Cabal and the Vanguard is tenuous, she forgives you for exchanging fire with her forces-better to focus on the battles ahead.



She asks you to locate and engage high-ranking Lucent Hive Lieutenants. Once you weaken one, her Psions will pull it into their Mindscape-a psychic plane where thoughts manifest into physical reality.



The Psions will connect your Light with the Light of the Hive and enable you to enter the Mindscape as well, where you will battle against manifestations of the Hive's faith in Savathûn.



The Synaptic Spear will enable you to destroy any traces of Savathûn's influence and sever the Hive's connection to the Light.



"Without the Light or a worm, the Hive will die," Caiatl growls, "unless my Psions keep it alive."



The Lightless Hive will be transported to the research station on the H.E.L.M., where Caiatl will turn the operation over to Lord Saladin.



"Fight well, Guardian," Caiatl says, and the hologram flickers with another incoming transmission…

title: Operation Elbrus
speaker: War Table
text:
There is calm, almost proud resolve in Lord Saladin's voice as he tells you why he demanded Caiatl take justice out on him instead of Crow:



"Because I chose to," he says.



He knew the value of the alliance with the Cabal when he saw you fighting alongside Caiatl's warriors, and he believes that, in a moment of misplaced compassion, Zavala would have thrown that alliance away to save Crow.



"And for a time, he would have believed that was mercy," Saladin says with an uncharacteristic smirk.



He will go willingly to join Caiatl's Cabal-a life for a life, to pay for the Psion that Crow killed. "If this is the cost of tomorrow for the Vanguard, I will gladly pay it," Saladin says.



He will accept the rank of Bracus and serve aboard Caiatl's ship, though he will return to the Tower to hold the Iron Banner-Caiatl seems interested in that Guardian tradition. 



"Until our paths cross again, Young Wolf," he says.

title: Operation Elbrus
speaker: War Table
text:
Lord Saladin warns that the Lucent Hive have redoubled their hostilities in the field. You should prepare for heightened resistance.



Saladin reflects on the brutal necessity of having to destroy Ghosts-even the twisted beings that accompany the Hive. He once thought those horrors were left in the distant past, buried with the Warlords of the Dark Ages.



He regrets that today's Guardians have to go through the same experience-and he holds the Hive responsible.



"If the Hive have taken our Light, let us take their ferocity," he says. "Show them they've done nothing but teach us how to destroy them."

title: Rising Tensions
speaker: War Table
text:
Lord Saladin's visage appears on the hologram before you.



There has been no word from the Guardian teams sent to fight the Lucent Hive in the EDZ. Saladin fears the worst.



He needs answers, and Caiatl's Psions are the only way to get them. Once you have severed a Hive's connection to the Light with the Synaptic Spear, Caiatl's forces will transmat it to the H.E.L.M., where a Psion will search its decaying mind for information about their plans.



There is fury in Saladin's voice as he speaks of the Lucent Hive. It is clear he believes Hive wielding the Light is sacrilege of the highest order.



"The Hive are at our doorstep," he says. "They think their corrupted Light gives them the strength to stand against us."



"Show them how wrong they are."

title: Season of the Lost
speaker: War Table
text: Queen Mara succeeded in exorcising Savathûn's worm, but failed to destroy the Hive god for good. In the wake of the exorcism, Osiris has returned.

title: Rising Tensions
speaker: War Table
text:
After you destroyed the aspect of Savathûn in the Mindscape, the newly Lightless Hive was successfully transported to the Psisorium.



Now you can feel a low-frequency thrum pulsing through the air as the Psion analyzes the Hive-a psychic vibration that sets your teeth on edge. It is unsettling… but then again, so were the Light-drained Guardians that you saw in the EDZ.



The Psion will search through the mind of the Hive for any intel about the Lucent Hive's strategy. It's unorthodox, but the Vanguard is willing to take any steps to stop the spread of this new threat.



Lord Saladin will contact you once progress has been made. Be ready.

title: Seasonal Focusing
speaker: War Table
text:
A new Umbral Engram awaits you on the War Table. It is weighing down a note written in Master Rahool's flowing script:



"As I mentioned, Umbral Engrams can be focused into greater rewards than I can provide myself. Decrypt this one using the resources of the War Table and claim the secrets that await within."

title: Seasonal Heirloom
speaker: War Table
text: This item is required to collect Defiant Keys and Defiant Engrams from Season of Defiance.

title: Seasonal Heirloom
speaker: War Table
text: This item is required to collect Psychogenic Intel from Season of the Risen.

title: The Liberator's Path
speaker: War Table
text: In honor of your commitment to the liberation of all civilian captives, the Vanguard grants you a reward.

title: The Variable
speaker: War Table
text:
As you approach the War Table, the lights in the H.E.L.M. flicker ominously. 



You place the object claimed from the AVALON network node on the table.



Suddenly, a cyclone of digitized information swirls from the War Table dataports. "TRANSFER DETECTED" flashes on the viewscreen as a surge of data flows over the object, imbuing it with strange power.  



In a moment, it is over, and a gleaming Glaive awaits you on the table. It seems as though Vanguard and Vex technology combined to create… something altogether new. 



The lights in the H.E.L.M. flicker once more… perhaps in smug satisfaction.

title: The Variable
speaker: War Table
text:
The War Table loads a Vanguard scout report, seemingly of its own volition…



It seems Guardians in the EDZ have encountered strange signals and flickering digital traces that vanish upon approach.



There are also details of erratic Vex activity-highly unusual for that sector. 



Just as you finish reading, the report vanishes as mysteriously as it appeared.

title: Vexcalibur: Authorization Override
speaker: War Table
text:
The War Table chimes with an incoming message, but the screen is scrambled and corrupted…



IN//COM.ING TR/ /ANSMIS..SIONISSI.~.//ON.~ISSION





ovrd.ovrd.OVRD.OVRD.

<\message>

<\transmission>



The message blinks off the viewscreen, but as it does, you notice your Vexcalibur humming with a strange resonance. 



It whirs softly, as though priming itself for battle…

title: Vexcalibur: Authorization Override
speaker: War Table
text:
As before, the viewscreen on the War Table flickers as it displays a corrupted message…



INCOMING TRRRRRRRR//





^grd.ovrd.xsg8.AVALON

<\message>

<\transmission>



The message vanishes, but you get the distinct impression the Vexcalibur can now interface with the restrictive access gates you encountered in the AVALON node…

title: Vexcalibur: Expert Authorization Override
speaker: War Table
text:
A corrupted message awaits you on the War Table viewscreen…



INCOMING TRANSMISSION





admin.access = true

<\message>

<\transmission>



The transmission clears itself from the screen, but the message is clear: as the wielder of Vexcalibur, you can now access the true depths of the Vex network.

title: War Table Rank
speaker: War Table
text: Complete missions in the PsiOps Battlegrounds playlist and decode Runic Chests to increase your rank.

title: Vox Revelata
speaker: War Table
text:
You receive a missive emblazoned with Empress Caiatl's insignia.



"Guardian-I regret to inform you that the Psionic propaganda messages have resumed."



"It's concerning to think that the rebels have already rebuilt their base. But there's clearly more to their enterprise than we suspected." 



"I've already spoken with Commander Zavala, and we agree: uncovering the extent of this operation is of the utmost importance. The danger Calus poses to your system cannot be understated." 



"Return to Mars, discover the origins of this rot, and burn it away. But be forewarned: they will be expecting you this time. Prepare for the worst."

title: Vexcalibur: Expert Authorization Override
speaker: War Table
text:
The War Table viewscreen flashes as you approach and displays a corrupted message…



INNNCOCOCOming//





remote connection // IN PROGRESS // ovrd.x2 init 

<\message>

<\transmission>



The screen cuts abruptly to black before fading in to the reassuring Vanguard logo.  



You sense that something dormant in the Vexcalibur has been activated, and the weapon is ready for another upgrade…

title: Vox Revelata
speaker: War Table
text:
You receive a missive emblazoned with Empress Caiatl's insignia.



"Guardian-I regret to inform you that the Psionic propaganda messages have resumed."



"It's concerning to think that the rebels have already rebuilt their base. But there's clearly more to their enterprise than we suspected." 



"I've already spoken with Commander Zavala, and we agree: uncovering the extent of this operation is of the utmost importance. The danger Calus poses to your system cannot be understated." 



"Return to Mars, discover the origins of this rot, and burn it away. But be forewarned: they will be expecting you this time. Prepare for the worst."

title: War Table Reputation
speaker: War Table
text: Complete Defiant Battleground activities to increase your War Table reputation.

title: A Difficult Teacher
speaker: The Crow
text:
"You just missed Osiris," Crow notes with a look over his shoulder. "He's been teaching me a Hive dowsing ritual so we can map out the interdimensional pathways through the Ascendant Plane. Use what we're learning about the cryptoliths to track down the High Celebrant."



Crow puffs out his chest, just so. "He says I'm a fast study, and maybe the Spider might allow him to continue tutoring me when this is over. There's a lot I could learn from him."



The corner of his mouth crooks up. "When I asked him where he learned so much about the Hive, he told me not to ask questions I wasn't ready to have the answers to."



Crow laughs. "I can see why people think he's kind of an asshole."



Continue completing Wrathborn hunts to weaken Xivu Arath's forces.

title: The Investigation
speaker: The Drifter
text:
The Drifter remains as distant and standoffish as ever: He will not forget that you chose not to trust him.



You regret nothing.



Despite everything, though, you realize that he was right: He wasn't what you thought. He's something else: a fearful, scrabbling scavenger running from spectres of death. He's below your concern, but he may not yet be below your sense of duty.

title: A Challenger Rises
speaker: War Table
text:
The War Table has a notification from Osiris:



Impressive work, Guardian. You'll get a full briefing soon, but in the meantime, let me fill you in on that Cabal artifact you picked up on Nessus. It's known as the Bell of Conquests.  



I've attached a reading with more details, but in short: by claiming that bell, you've officially declared yourself challenger to the Cabal Empire. Caiatl's commanders won't stop coming for you until they see you buried and the bell retrieved. 



You made a bold move, but I believe we can use it to our advantage. We'll talk more soon.

-Osiris

title: Legacy: We Stand Unbroken
speaker: War Table
text:
Mara welcomes you with an unexpected suggestion: using the Ascendant Plane to pursue the Shadow Legion into space.



"By observing your astral wake, I am discovering ways through the Ley Lines that have never been charted before," she says. "As you move through the Ascendant Plane, you consecrate it on a paracausal level. Its borders fray and yield to your touch. The corruption within withers as you approach."



"For someone of your ability, one step through that darkness can equal a thousand on this plane-ten thousand. Ten million."



She asks that you report to her when you are ready. "Show them nothing is outside your reach."
